news_mentions.headline: NFL Week 8 Sunday aftermath: Ravens' season on the brink; can Vikings trust Kyler Murray?
news_mentions.description: Kevin Patra breaks down Sunday's Week 8 action in the latest edition of The Aftermath. Is the Ravens' season on the brink of collapse? Can the Vikings trust Kyler Murray?
news_mentions.body_text: now that it s november the playoff picture is starting to emerge and week 8 featured a number of key divisional matchups that could have lasting effects on the rest of the season the broncos and steelers notched revenge wins over the chiefs and browns respectively the lions asserted themselves in the uber tough nfc north while the jaguars handed the colts a potentially fatal blow in a season cratering toward disaster let s examine some key storylines in sunday s aftermath including another concerning loss for schottenheimer s boys minnesota s qb issues rear their ugly head in detroit buccaneers lean on run game in historic win broncos take over driver s seat in afc west race burrow channels norm van brocklin against tennessee but first we start with lamar jackson suffering a potential season ending injury and where the ravens go from here ravens season on the brink after jackson injury the baltimore ravens find themselves in quite the quandary lamar jackson s return was supposed to buoy a club coming off back to back divisional defeats it lasted one play on sunday in buffalo jackson s right thumb injury which will require surgery leaves the 4 4 ravens floundering in the afc north cellar before we hit thanksgiving jesse minter told reporters after the 36 10 loss to buffalo that jackson will be placed on injured reserve knocking him out for at least four games asked if the setback ultimately could end jackson s season the ravens first year head coach admitted that it s possible potentially but we ll see where it s at minter said without the two time mvp qb the ravens offense is clipped baltimore is 7 14 in games in which jackson has not started since 2019 averaging just 17 6 points in 2026 the team has scored six touchdowns in the 18 quarters jackson has missed jackson s latest injury shrouds his future in baltimore we ll have plenty of time to delve into the contract situation later right now the focus is on how the ravens survive it would be bad enough if jackson s thumb issue were baltimore s only qb injury but backup tyler huntley also exited sunday s game and didn t return espn reported that huntley suffered a possible turf toe injury and will undergo an mri on monday to determine how much time if any he could miss undrafted rookie third stringer joe fagnano battled against the bills but given the situation trying to keep up with josh allen on the road with no prep time he performed as expected completing 10 of his 21 pass attempts for 91 yards with a pick and three sacks taken the ravens are in a rough spot with a short week before thursday night s game against the rolling jaguars even if huntley doesn t miss much time is it worth baltimore trading for a qb ahead of the nov 10 deadline would shelling out more assets in a potentially lost season be wise let s rip through some of the potential qb options for the ravens if they decide to go the trade route tyson bagent the bears qb2 struggled in his last outing against green bay in week 5 and was eventually benched for case keenum but his familiarity with declan doyle would benefit baltimore considered one of the league s better backups by many bagent could be a long term play for the ravens i have my doubts about if the bears would be willing to part with their no 2 but such a move could help recoup some of the trade capital sent away in last week s jeffery simmons deal the cost to pry bagent away from chicago could prove prohibitive for a ravens team on the brink jacoby brissett benched in favor of gardner minshew during the cardinals stirring comeback win over dallas on sunday brissett has experience while inconsistencies have plagued him this season in arizona he is a professional qb who could pick up the offense quickly editor s update on monday mike lafleur named minshew as the cardinals starter moving forward shedeur sanders cleveland has insisted that it has no intention of trading sanders but coach todd monken hasn t seemed to be in the former colorado quarterback s corner at any point in the process sanders has his warts but he could bring more pop to the ravens offense than huntley or fagnano the browns shipped joe flacco to cincinnati last year so intra division trades can t be ruled out we know the browns brass will take a pick if it makes sense kirk cousins i don t think the raiders would trade him while they re still in contention at 4 4 if they were willing to the cost would probably be prohibitive however for the next week any qb trade list should at least mention the veteran playing at a high level in front of no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza two non trade options easton stick currently on the tampa bay buccaneers practice squad stick was in l a in 2024 with minter so at least there would be some familiarity jimmy garoppolo the veteran hasn t officially retired if he wants a shot to play again baltimore could be his last best chance cowboys collapse in stunning loss credit gardner minshew for bringing the mania once again credit tyler allgeier for gashing the cowboys defense and powering the cards back into the game credit michael wilson for continuing to do his best puka nacua impression credit the cardinals defense for forcing field goals late and getting a three and out in overtime credit mike lafleur s club for not quitting when quitting could have been easy and credit the first year coach for being willing to make a second half qb change in the heat of the moment credit the cards but let s be real this was an epic collapse for which dallas should be crushed brian schottenheimer s club held a 24 10 fourth quarter lead before disintegrating like walter donovan drinking from the wrong chalice he chose poorly could be the title of every cowboys move on sunday a confluence of ineptitude caused dallas to collapse at home to drop to 3 5 on the season the defense became a sieve in the fourth quarter and couldn t tackle i understand that the cowboys had some injuries but letting allgeier look like jim brown is not a product of a few missing players the secondary inexplicably got burned late when all the cowboys needed to do was keep everything in front of them frankly arizona could have scored quicker in the fourth quarter if not for a few misses the defensive breakdowns continue to perplex dallas this season the offense also did its part in the collapse stalling out inside the red zone early then failing to get a first down after the cardinals failed on the onside kick an explosive offense should be able to move the chains to secure a victory then there was the depressing three and out to begin overtime dallas got outgained in yardage 467 261 on sunday that should not happen despite the latest example of schottenheimer s teams playing below their talent jerry jones stuck by his coach after the game that s not in my mind at this time jones said when asked about a potential coaching change per espn com a lot of people let brian down today and so for whatever criticism we want to have of brian we can all get in line the line for blame in dallas is long it starts at the top vikings qb problems can t be brushed aside brian flores defense had done the heavy lifting to build minnesota s 6 0 start but sunday s divisional loss to the lions showed that the ferocious unit can t do it alone detroit went big and ran over the vikings in the second half wearing down the stout defense to the tune of 164 rushing yards after halftime by the end flores group was gassed and couldn t stop jahmyr gibbs and the lions from grinding out the w if the vikings offense had any semblance of consistency the end game scenario would have played out much differently kyler murray continues to struggle with his consistency despite facing the worst passing defense in the nfl on sunday he couldn t keep the vikings on the field he sailed more than a few balls way too high never seemed comfortable and rarely moved the chains on nine third down throws he completed four three went for first downs murray connected on some deep balls and averaged 11 2 air yards per attempt the second highest mark of his career but he also missed a host of shots per next gen stats on downfield attempts 10 plus air yards murray threw for a season high 115 yards despite only completing four of his 13 attempts 30 8 his lowest downfield completion rate in a game since 2023 min 10 downfield attempts the inability to keep the chains moving sits in stark contrast to the best offenses under kevin o connell we ll see if koc pulls the plug and gives carson wentz a shot at least we know he ll force feed justin jefferson if the struggles persist the j j mccarthy trade probably needed to happen but seeing the 2024 first rounder look like a different qb in new york while murray struggles has to sting minnesota with a tough trio of games on tap vs buffalo 6 1 at green bay 5 3 and against san francisco 6 1 in mexico city the vikings must get more production from the qb position or they ll see their once strong nfc north lead evaporate editor s update on monday after publishing kevin o connell said kyler murray is dealing with hamstring tightness is the bucs offense sustainable the monsoon in tampa fla dictated the run heavy approach from zac robinson s offense but even in pristine weather the buccaneers would have leaned on the ground game the slop tipped the scales even harder with baker mayfield attempting just three passes all falling incomplete in the 16 0 win we knew it was going to be a nasty day and what kind of conditions it was going to be bucs coach todd bowles said we were worried about ball security and we took care of it other than the fumble in the end zone bowles added i didn t say we were not going to throw the ball the conditions told robinson that you could see it it s a downpour and the wind was blowing you can kind of see the ball wasn t going anywhere tampa became just the second team in the super bowl era to have zero completed passes in a single game joining the 1974 bills who did so in a win over the jets per nfl research three of the four teams to not have a completion in a game since 1950 have gone on to win including the buccaneers on sunday they are the first team to win by 10 points without completing a pass since the 1945 pittsburgh steelers beat the chicago cardinals the ground game has gotten the bucs back in the nfc south race in week 7 against carolina tampa bay rushed for 258 yards while mayfield attempted just 11 passes completing seven for 64 yards and a td bucky irving has been sensational making defenders miss and has the pop to turn those broken tackles into big runs all 170 of irving s rushing yards came after contact on sunday per next gen stats one of the more inexplicable issues with the bucs early struggles when they started 1 5 was the offensive line s play the veteran crew missed far too many blocks and committed too many penalties over the last couple weeks the group has gotten back on track by smashing defenses in the face tampa s rushing attack is absolutely replicable i expect irving to keep motoring through defenses slithering through holes and ripping chunk gains that said it s 2026 at some point mayfield will be asked to win a game through the air with the bears and lions on tap in weeks 9 and 11 the bucs will have to keep pace with higher powered offenses after thumping two division rivals though tampa is back on track in a moribund division and the bucs feel like the most stable nfc south club as we head into the second half of the season broncos take command in afc west race it s not pretty but who cares when you stack a w bo nix earned his 15th career game winning drive in denver s 28 24 win over kansas city on sunday breaking a tie with dak prescott for the most such drives in a player s first three seasons since at least 1950 according to nfl research the broncos came back to win after trailing the rival chiefs by 11 points in the fourth quarter it marked the third victory in nix s career in which denver erased a fourth quarter deficit of 10 points the most such wins in the nfl since 2024 conversely sunday marked the third game in patrick mahomes career in which the chiefs blew a fourth quarter lead of 10 points and the first since over five years ago in week 2 of 2021 at the ravens harrison butker s missed fourth quarter field goal opened the door for denver and nix immediately cashed in hitting running back jonah coleman for a 51 yard catch and run to set up the go ahead 5 yard td the 15 point fourth quarter explosion came after nix and the offense once again struggled to stay on the field denver went three and out on three third quarter drives entering the final frame the home fans were frustrated then boom big plays galore and the broncos not only escaped with a win but took control of the afc west race the big plays included a massive goal line stand by the denver defense which held the chiefs out of the end zone in the game s final seconds after they got a first and goal at the 4 the sequence was aided by a k c false start but a denver d that once again missed too many tackles ultimately stood tall when needed with malcolm roach taking down mahomes for the game ending sack it was ball out or go home edge rusher que robinson said of the dramatic finish via the denver post and we weren t going home without that dub the loss stings k c which could have taken complete control of the division race with a sweep over the broncos denver 6 2 has now won four straight while the chiefs 5 2 have lost back to back games after taking advantage of a soft early slate andy reid s trust in butker came back to bite him according to the next gen stats fourth down decision guide with kansas city leading 24 21 and facing fourth and 8 from the broncos 36 yard line with 2 36 remaining a punt would have given the chiefs the highest win probability 74 3 1 8 percentage points ahead of going for it 72 5 while a field goal attempt ranked last 71 5 reid elected for the fg butker missed the 54 yard attempt giving the ball back to the broncos who scored two plays later sometimes analytics does suggest punting week 8 sunday spotlight

news_mentions.headline: NFL experts' Week 8 takeaways: Do Ravens need drastic QB measures? Plus, Cowboys collapse
news_mentions.body_text: each sunday three of the athletic 39 s nfl writers react to the biggest news plays and performances from the day 39 s games every sunday matters in the nfl that 39 s what makes the league so popular but this sunday seemed especially consequential with a significant quarterback injury a stunning comeback and several key division matchups the biggest news of the day came early as the return of baltimore ravens quarterback lamar jackson lasted one play before he left with a thumb injury it got worse when backup tyler huntley also left with an injury in the end emergency quarterback joe fagnano gave a game performance but it wasn 39 t nearly enough in a 36 10 loss to the buffalo bills now the ravens will have to hold their breath and see if their franchise quarterback is going to miss the rest of the season the most important game of the day was in detroit as the lions handed the minnesota vikings their first loss of the season detroit 39 s offense did just enough against the dominant minnesota defense in a 19 15 win the wildest game of the day was in dallas as the arizona cardinals scored two touchdowns in the final three minutes of regulation and won 33 30 in overtime it was another stunning collapse by the cowboys in a season that is getting away from them the season has already gotten away from the indianapolis colts who suffered a humiliating 42 7 loss to the jacksonville jaguars the fire sale that started earlier this week could accelerate with the trade deadline looming nfl writers mike jones austin mock and ted nguyen share their thoughts on the ravens 39 quarterback mess the stumbling cowboys the surging lions and the hapless indianapolis colts should the ravens trade serious draft capital for a quarterback in an attempt to save their season if lamar jackson misses a significant amount of time jones if tyler huntley will not miss time then the ravens don 39 t even need to consider this if both jackson and huntley will miss time baltimore needs to do something but there 39 s not really a quarterback worthy of serious draft capital on the trading block when it comes to veterans capable of stepping in and leading a team effectively the pickings are rather slim the cincinnati bengals aren 39 t going to trade joe flacco to a divisional rival the san francisco 49ers aren 39 t going to part with mac jones andy dalton would seem to have a little left in the tank and is a member of the atlanta falcons 39 crowded quarterback room but he wouldn 39 t seemingly command 34 serious draft capital 34 another option josh johnson who is in his 19th professional season and is a member of the bengals 39 practice squad baltimore wouldn 39 t have to trade for him to add him to their roster mock i don 39 t think so and am pretty sure that would be a poor decision in the long run first being desperate and turning to the trade market is a dangerous combination second i 39 m not even sure who you 39 d trade for at this point kirk cousins is probably the only starter that makes sense but i 39 m not sure if the las vegas raiders would be willing to do that mac jones will certainly be buzzy but i 39 m skeptical what we saw in half a season under kyle shanahan in the 49ers 39 system is the type of production you 39 ll get in baltimore at the end of the day you have to be content with understanding that the future is more important than the now and that 39 s where i 39 m at with the ravens maybe you can win some games down the stretch with poor quarterback play but if not you get a better draft pick to supplement lamar jackson for 2027 and beyond nguyen i 39 m not sure who would be available that could help them at this point cousins is leading the league in touchdown passes but i think the raiders are intent on keeping him as fernando mendoza 39 s mentor maybe the bears would be willing to trade tyson bagent and go with case keenum as their backup bagent knows offensive coordinator declan doyle 39 s system and the transition should be relatively simple it would take maybe a second round pick for the 49ers to trade mac jones there just aren 39 t a lot of options i 39 m not sure if the ravens defense is good enough to hold things together during a qb transition period sometimes you just have to accept your fate at the very least they may get to keep doyle longer who 39 s most to blame for the cowboys 39 stunning collapse against the cardinals jones there 39 s plenty of blame to go around a defense that let gardner minshew come off the bench to carve them up for three touchdown passes while completing 17 of 23 passes for 188 yards in less than 17 minutes of play a defense that let tyler allgeier gash them for 147 rushing yards and a touchdown on just 11 touches a defense that let michael wilson rack up 111 receiving yards and a touchdown on eight catches a defense that surrendered 30 points after halftime or do we want to go with a cowboys offense that got out gained 467 261 while averaging just 3 6 yards per play this was a bad day all around for coach brian schottenheimer and his team mock can i say everyone because it 39 s not that simple the easy answer is the defense because they 39 ve been horrendous for two seasons now and the offseason moves to address that side of the ball haven 39 t come to fruition the defense isn 39 t even close to being a respectable unit right now and you can 39 t consistently win games in the nfl with a unit that bad but the offense deserves some blame too with their inability to run the ball 34 percent success rate against the cardinals which resulted in them being unable to put away the cardinals with a lead so that comes back to the blame on everyone the coaching staff on both sides of the ball the front office it 39 s all bad right now the coaching staff isn 39 t elevating the talent they have and the front office hasn 39 t given them the talent to be a winning football team so while it 39 s easy to point fingers at one person or one unit the blame is shared and goes the whole way to the top of the organization nguyen the offense certainly deserves blame for not putting away the game against a cardinals defense that had been struggling however the defense gave up 20 points in the fourth quarter to a minshew led offense without any timeouts the cardinals drove 80 yards in just over a minute and should have won the game in regulation but missed an extra point and there were wide open receivers the cardinals weren 39 t making a bunch of amazing catches in overtime the offense went three and out and the cardinals drove right down the field the detroit lions didn 39 t light up the scoreboard against the minnesota vikings 39 fearsome defense but jared goff led the game winning drive in the fourth quarter goff has 15 touchdown passes and one interception is he the mvp so far this season jones if you ask vegas goff doesn 39 t even crack the top five in the mvp race the popular picks josh allen brock purdy joe burrow patrick mahomes and trevor lawrence lead the way according to most books however goff certainly deserves consideration sunday was a big statement game for the lions and the 11th year veteran goff has been masterful this season especially against the blitz where entering sunday 39 s game he had completed roughly 77 percent of his passes the vikings definitely got to him on sunday but when it mattered most goff came through goff has provided stability and effectiveness despite a change at offensive coordinator and injuries on that side of the ball and despite all the change detroit boasts one of the most prolific offenses in the league thanks largely to goff mock goff came into this week sixth in quarterback index qbi heading into the week and i 39 m not sure his stat line against the vikings will improve that number but it 39 s the vikings so we are happy to give him a pass but with the weapons that they have on offense it 39 s hard for me to see goff getting enough credit to win the award the lions have a ton of talent going around with jahmyr gibbs amon ra st brown and even on the offensive line with penei sewell and then you factor in that allen is still doing otherworldly things in buffalo i don 39 t know if he can be the favorite with goff being non existent in the run game his passing numbers would need to be above and beyond allen and others and with gibbs in the backfield i 39 m not sure we will see that in the conversation sure but he 39 s in that second tier right now and likely behind allen purdy and mahomes if i was in charge nguyen he should definitely be in the conversation the hiring of offensive coordinator drew petzing and passing game coordinator mike kafka has gotten this offense back on track the lions still are a run first team and gibbs might win offensive player of the year goff has been extremely productive but it 39 s hard to overlook the super human play of allen this season goff 39 s final numbers would have to be substantially better than allen 39 s for him to win in my opinion after trading two of their best players the colts were crushed by the jaguars they don 39 t own their first round pick and daniel jones looks lost after getting a huge contract extension is this the most bleak situation in the nfl right now jones the colts have two more wins than the winless chargers but it 39 s clear indianapolis is headed toward a franchise reset this offseason they 39 ve already fired their general manager and unloaded two key players in quenton nelson and deforest buckner they really should go ahead and move jonathan taylor and josh downs and anyone else they can to stockpile picks for their next gm to work with in the spring mock i think so yes and if i were in charge i 39 d be selling off just about every player i could to try and maximize my draft capital in the coming years considering the colts don 39 t have their first rounder and with new ownership will a promising general manager and or coaching staff be willing to come in for a rebuild if head coach shane steichen isn 39 t around next season you 39 d have to really sell the new front office and staff on this being a long rebuild and preach patience because the roster is void of talent on both sides of the ball and there is no future quarterback at the moment and even then if you hit on a quarterback how long does it take to surround your rookie with enough talent to compete for titles before you have to pay him a gaudy amount with the lack of draft capital this is certainly the franchise furthest from winning and will need a full rebuild and most importantly time to get this thing turned around nguyen can 39 t think of many worse than the colts right now who don 39 t have a first round pick the sauce gardner trade for two first round picks could be the worst trade since the browns 39 for deshaun watson maybe the colts could recoup a first for taylor extending jones from a small sample of successful play after a career 39 s worth of underwhelming play was a bad mistake chris ballard put this team in dire straits before his firing which is one of the dangers of having a gm on the hot seat they start to make desperate moves to save their job this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: 2026 NFL season, Week 8: What We Learned from Sunday's games
news_mentions.description: Around The NFL breaks down what you need to know from Sunday's action in Week 8 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 8 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below early window buffalo bills 36 baltimore ravens 10 cincinnati bengals 43 tennessee titans 36 ot arizona cardinals 33 dallas cowboys 30 ot detroit lions 19 minnesota vikings 15 jacksonville jaguars 42 indianapolis colts 7 las vegas raiders 38 new york jets 33 pittsburgh steelers 27 cleveland browns 6 tampa bay buccaneers 16 atlanta falcons 0 late window los angeles rams 24 los angeles chargers 9 denver broncos 28 kansas city chiefs 24 new england patriots 24 miami dolphins 19 sunday night washington commanders 27 philadelphia eagles 10 nick shook s takeaways bills let hunters loose buffalo s biggest underlying question mark was its defense a leaky unit that struggled to get stops and limit opposing offenses in what became weekly shootouts for the bills that finally changed for the better on sunday with lamar jackson exiting quickly and tyler huntley back in the lineup buffalo decided it was time to hunt the quarterback dialing up blitzes and registering pressures on half of huntley s four passes which also incidentally forced huntley out of the game due to injury once undrafted rookie joe fagnano took over the carnivorous bills saw nothing but red meat blitzing on 64 5 of their total defensive snaps logging qb pressures at a rate of 61 3 and short circuiting baltimore s offense all afternoon the ravens finished with just 144 net yards of offense scored their only touchdown via a short field earned by a broderick washington interception and couldn t piece together more than one drive of significance which ended in a 26 yard tyler loop field goal buffalo s defense made sure it wouldn t allow derrick henry to carry the ravens and denied fagnano the space to breathe overwhelming the inexperienced signal caller in a runaway win quarterback injuries decimate ravens lamar jackson s anticipated return lasted just one snap his first pass attempt fell incomplete and on the follow through to his throw jackson s thumb collided with a defender s hand resulting in an injury that will land jackson on injured reserve for the foreseeable future after a few weeks of backup turned starter duty tyler huntley found himself on the field sunday appearing skittish and struggling to gain a single yard through the air before an injury knocked him out of action as well leaving the ravens with their emergency third qb joe fagnano as their only remaining option the uconn product gave his best effort but was constantly under duress leaving the ravens with little room to move the ball all afternoon zay flowers went without a catch on five targets rashod bateman s one catch for 22 yards accounted for the most receiving production for any raven and running back justice hill led baltimore in receptions with four it was a lifeless offense that left the ravens defense on the field for far too long buffalo won the time of possession battle 37 36 to 22 24 and sunday s display should rightfully worry ravens fans about their team s outlook for the remainder of 2026 it sounds as if jackson s season could be finished and recent results without him including sunday are discouraging at best moore delivers in return after missing a handful of weeks buffalo welcomed back its prized offseason acquisition d j moore who showed no signs of hesitancy and delivered a strong outing four catches 82 yards including a spectacular grab for 49 yards to set up a james cook touchdown and a touchdown catch moore s return helped draw some attention away from buffalo s tight ends dalton kincaid finished with a team best 86 yards and a touchdown on four catches took a bit of pressure off cook and unlocked enough of the unit s attack to help the bills climb out of a grind it out start to pour it on in the second half moore s rapport with josh allen remains strong even after the time off and helped allen pass jim kelly for the franchise s all time lead in touchdowns 260 now moore will need to prove he can be this reliable on a weekly basis next gen stats insight for ravens bills via nfl pro the bills blitzed on 64 5 of opposing dropbacks against the ravens in week 8 their highest blitz rate since 2021 and the highest blitz rate ravens quarterbacks have faced this season the bills blitz rate had not exceeded 39 in any of their prior six games this season when blitzing the bills generated 11 pressures including a season high seven quick pressures under 2 5 seconds and three sacks including a strip sack fumble recovery in the second quarter nfl research josh allen and james cook each had a rushing touchdown in week 8 marking the 16th time that allen and cook have scored a rushing touchdown in the same game sixteen games breaks a tie with dak prescott and ezekiel elliott for the most games by any teammate duo in nfl history in which both players had a rushing touchdown back to top bobby kownack s takeaways burrow was everything good bad about bengals offense what a roller coaster performance by joe burrow the cincy quarterback unquestionably served as the team s hero accounting for six touchdowns in an unexpected shootout with the titans but his three interceptions contributed initially to a slow start and later allowed tennessee to stay in it two of those picks were deep heaves to ja 39 marr chase with one way overthrown and another that came up far too short if you re going to make mistakes though make sure you make up for them burrow did that and more piling on the points and feeding his top two receivers to great success tee higgins had 10 catches for 155 yards and two tds on 11 targets while chase tallied 11 receptions for 141 yards and a score on 16 looks burrow also importantly cleaned it up in crunch time of his five drives that took place in the fourth quarter or overtime one ended in a chase brown fumble and the other ticked down the final 17 seconds to the extra frame on the other three burrow marched his bengals 73 81 and 70 yards throwing two touchdowns and scoring the game winner on a 9 yard scramble he finished with 426 yards five tds and three ints on 38 of 48 passing marking his third consecutive game with at least four passing touchdowns it s a bit scary how many points the bengals put up despite four giveaways and that s all credit to burrow standout performances not enough for tennessee there was not an ounce of quit in the titans after trading away their best player defensive tackle jeffery simmons on thursday the defense still generated four takeaways the most it has had in a game this season safety amani hooker had joe burrow s number intercepting him a whopping three times while defensive end jacob martin tallied three sacks and linebacker anthony hill was relentless with 14 tackles on offense cam ward enjoyed by far his best game of the season despite being without carnell tate ward dissected cincinnati s defense with regularity going 26 of 40 for 304 yards and two touchdowns snapping a five game interception streak and nearly doubling his average of 168 4 passing yards per game he led two separate go ahead td drives in the fourth quarter plus tony pollard continued his recent resurgence rushing for 117 yards and two scores after going for 129 and three tds in week 7 his 40 yard touchdown to open the scoring will be one of the highlights of the day in his or any game with pollard breaking multiple tackles before stiff arming one bengals defender into another s path in a keystone cops sequence on the way to pay dirt of course it was still not enough for the 1 7 titans but the fight they showed was admirable regardless of the nfl s aversion to moral victories concerning trends taking shape for bengals the most important result from sunday is the bengals moving to 5 2 in a highly competitive afc north however there are some underlying issues still plaguing cincinnati the bengals found themselves trailing 13 0 for the second straight week this deficit came at the end of the first quarter unlike last week s halftime hole against the ravens and the bengals started picking it up much earlier to go into intermission with a lead but they couldn t pull away like they did in baltimore instead the titans pushed them to overtime taking advantage of a defense that forced a pair of turnovers but couldn t get enough stops to make things easy in the past three games the bengals have needed to outlast a one win titans team in overtime looked asleep for far too long facing backup quarterback tyler huntley and let a then winless dolphins squad make things uncomfortable late before that it was two straight losses those who choose optimism will point to the bengals record and their three game winning streak but venturing through a season as escape artists typically catches up down the line next gen stats insight for titans bengals via nfl pro amani hooker picked off joe burrow three times which included 15 3 expected points added across five targets in coverage the second most coverage epa by a player in a game this season hooker allowed only 12 yards in coverage on the day nfl research joe burrow became just the second quarterback in league history to have 450 plus passing yards five plus passing tds and a rushing td in a game joining norm van brocklin week 1 1951 back to top nick shook s takeaways qb change sparks comeback through nearly three quarters the cardinals were repeating the same frustrating offensive performance that had become all too familiar in recent weeks jacoby brissett was under constant pressure and resorting to throws that amounted to little more than prayers and after watching brissett take two consecutive sacks for double digit negative yardage in the third quarter coach mike lafleur had enough calling for gardner minshew to replace the battered brissett oddly enough the quarterback change coincided with a revival of the running game that depended solely on tyler allgeier after jeremiyah love left with another ankle injury and bam knight was knocked out of action due to a concussion allgeier put the team on his back rushing 11 times for 147 yards and a touchdown and repeatedly turning to the sideline oxygen tank as a means of survival minshew meanwhile created a rhythm in the passing game that the cardinals haven t enjoyed in over a month completing 17 of 23 passes for 188 yards and three touchdowns including a magnificent final touchdown drive that covered 80 yards in eight plays and 1 03 to tie the game and balancing the offense by turning to michael wilson plenty eight catches 111 yards one touchdown arizona pulled off this 23 point outburst and improbable comeback after losing love knight and receiver kendrick bourne maximizing its returns with its remaining contributors with just enough time to escape defeat it will likely prompt a quarterback change and could be a minor springboard forward for a team that was desperate for a morale boosting win like this cowboys collapse could have devastating effect dallas will look back at this game and have no choice but to admit this was its worst loss of 2026 entering the final minute of the third quarter the cowboys were in control holding a 17 3 lead that was all but guaranteed to eventually become 20 3 or larger in that moment though their defense broke down surrendering a rumbling 63 yard touchdown run to tyler allgeier the first of a few massive chunks gained by allgeier in the final 16 minutes of regulation on a 52 yard allgeier run in the fourth quarter safety caleb downs got pancaked by hjalte froholdt twice in the same play typifying arizona s sudden takeover with the image of downs tumbling across the turf like a runaway cheese wheel speeding down a hill this all happened after dallas had suffocated arizona s offense for the first 44 minutes of the game and the cardinals awakening delivered repeated violent blows to the ribcage of the cowboys defense landing a liver punch in the form of a michael wilson dependent touchdown drive to tie the game in the final six seconds of regulation a quick defensive stop and a 44 yard scoring drive in overtime sent the cowboys to the mat for good resulting in one of the most stunning outcomes of the entire nfl season this type of loss can send a team into a spiral could cost defensive coordinator christian parker his job and will undoubtedly cause cowboys fans to angrily punch the air the same problems persist they still can t beat the lowly cardinals in texas and the solutions continue to prove fleeting arizona s rebuilt backfield disintegrates but one pillar remains standing tyler allgeier s second half outburst produced a victory for the cardinals but it was even more triumphant for a workhorse who has often been left to the shadows of more recognizable running mates in atlanta and arizona the talk at the start of the season revolved around first round pick jeremiyah love and when the cardinals couldn t generate consistently on the ground love s absence was quickly blamed allgeier never quite saw the chances he needed to blossom but found himself in an unexpected moment of opportunity sunday when love and bam knight exited due to injury he could have played an average brand of football as the lone remaining runner available but that s not allgeier those who were unfamiliar with his style were reminded rudely on his 63 yard touchdown run in which he broke three tackles and followed a trio of teammates who escorted him to the goal line where he fell across it for a score while finally being brought down that touchdown made it a 17 10 game but more importantly it gave the cardinals reason to believe his ensuing 52 yarder saw hjalte froholdt get out in front and wreck caleb downs in open space setting an aggressive tone embodied by the runner benefitting from the blocking in those two plays and gardner minshew s stint as a mid game replacement the cardinals brought the fight to the cowboys refusing to lay down despite a double digit deficit and little reason to believe they d turn things around because of allgeier s toughness determination and relentless desire to produce when called upon he also caught five passes for 44 yards and an incredibly gritty touchdown reception the cardinals pulled off the stunning win and might have found a new identity in the process next gen stats insight for cardinals cowboys via nfl pro tyler allgeier carried the ball 11 times for 147 yards and a touchdown in week 8 against the cowboys including three explosive gains of 10 or more yards after totaling just two explosive gains across 61 carries over the first seven weeks of the season allgeier recorded a 63 yard touchdown run on arizona s final play from scrimmage in the third quarter before opening the cardinals next drive with a 52 yard scamper he gained 96 rushing yards over expected the most by a cardinals rusher in a game since at least 2018 additionally allgeier finished as the cardinals third leading receiver catching all five targets for 44 yards and a touchdown nfl research the cardinals last second touchdown positioned them to kick a go ahead extra point with 0 06 remaining sunday but chad ryland pushed his attempt wide left entering the cardinals into some exclusive and undesirable company they became the third team to miss a go ahead pat in the final 10 seconds of regulation joining the bengals week 1 2022 and buccaneers week 2 2003 back to top kevin patra s takeaways lions run over undefeated vikings to close gap in nfc north detroit figured out the best way to combat brian flores relentless pressure packages go to the ground after falling behind 15 12 midway through the fourth quarter detroit ran the ball on 11 of its final 13 non kneel plays one of those two jared goff throws was the go ahead touchdown toss to jameson williams detroit leaned on jahmyr gibbs and bruising backup sione vaki gibbs blasted his way to 153 rushing yards and a td on 23 carries while vaki chipped in 11 totes for 65 yards detroit getting production from vaki is a positive sign for the lions down the stretch the lions couldn t get out of their way early with miscues hampering dan campbell s club including some bad penalties goff missed passes early and threw his first interception of the season when williams slipped on a route detroit put up just six points and goff was sacked four times through two quarters then the run game took over allowing the qb to utilize play action and wear down the vikings d it wasn t a perfect game for the home squad but the offense perked up late when needed to close out a big win that bunches the division even closer it was a need to have home game for detroit dan campbell s crew came up clutch in the end vikings offensive struggles continued it was only a matter of time before brian flores defense couldn t carry the day minnesota has been playing on the razor s edge through its first six wins with the defense spearheading wins while the offense was along for the ride against a high powered lions offense flores defense did enough forcing a turnover early field goals and a pivotal late three and out yes the defense ran out of gas against jahmyr gibbs late but kevin o connell s offense needed to do more kyler murray managed the game early but missed too many throws particularly high which led to stalled drives nearly a quarter of murray s 210 yards 24 3 came on a 51 yard bomb to jordan addison the qb missed several other shots right now murray isn t a station to station passer when the big plays don t connect the vikings offense struggles against a lions defense that entered with the worst pass d in the nfl and allowing the most yards murray came up small the vikings generated just 266 yards and 15 first downs going 3 for 10 on third down and 0 for 1 on fourth down isn t winning offense koc needs his offense to find itself at the start of a tough stretch of games right now it s not close detroit s defense stepped up for the second straight week kelvin sheppard s defense has played up a level the defensive line particularly the interior pestered kyler murray alim mcneill led the way with four qb pressures and one sack the secondary did a better job sticking with vikings receivers where we d seen wrs scamper wide open early in the season detroit s secondary at least challenged most plays cornerback d j reed was having his best game including a diving int and a big late pass breakup before leaving with an injury when the defensive line is getting pressure and the secondary plays on a string it s a workable defense the issue sheppard faces now is that he lost a trove of players on sunday star linebacker jack campbell was taken to a local hospital after suffering a neck injury d j wonnum and brian branch each exited with concussions after a collision rookie linebacker jimmy rolder suffered a hamstring injury reed s was a hip can an already shaky unit overcome injuries moving forward next gen stats insight for lions vikings via nfl pro the vikings blitzed on 26 of 29 dropbacks 89 7 in their week 8 loss against the lions the highest blitz rate by a team since at least 2018 breaking the previous record held by the vikings set last week against the colts 85 2 when blitzed jared goff completed 17 passes tied for the most against the blitz in a game this season for 130 yards a touchdown and an interception goff was sacked a season high three times on six pressures when blitzed nfl research jahmyr gibbs became the fifth player in nfl history prior to age 25 to have at least 1 000 scrimmage yards and 10 plus touchdowns in their team s first seven games of a season joining christian mccaffrey 2019 edgerrin james 2000 eric dickerson 1983 and jim brown 1958 back to top kevin patra s takeaways jags stampede floundering colts good teams don t just beat bad ones they take their soul jacksonville is a good team liam coen s squad walloped its division rival in every facet from the start the jaguars blasted indianapolis with an offensive barrage and smothering defense for a team that s struggled at times in the red zone coen s club simply avoided that area splashing scores from distance of the jags five offensive touchdowns only one came inside the red zone jacksonville ripped through a limp colts defense for scores of 31 yards 39 28 and 25 yards pass protection had some concerns but trevor lawrence overcame them side stepping pressure and ripping passes to wide open targets the mvp candidate generated 210 yards and three touchdowns on 10 of 14 attempts before taking a seat for the bulk of the fourth quarter jacksonville ran over the colts earning 183 rushing yards and two tds with bhayshul tuten leading the way 16 104 1 tuten was a tackle breaking maven earning 159 scrimmage yards and two scores have a day rayuan lane jaguars safety rayuan lane snagged a flubbed catch by colts tight end tyler warren and scampered the other way for a 92 yard pick six late in the second quarter the play was the cherry on top of a big day for the navy product who made his second career start and netted three tackles a qb hit and three passes defensed lane making plays after being thrust into significant action highlights a defense that came in waves sunday anthony campanile s defense forced three turnovers held the colts to 243 total yards and 4 1 yards per play jacksonville stymied jonathan taylor holding the veteran back to 2 9 yards per carry and discombobulated daniel jones a stingy run defense combined with sticky coverage on the back end is a recipe for a smothering unit a defense that forces turnovers and an offense that can generate explosives is a formula for blowout wins colts crumbling amid a fire sale shane steichen s squad played like a crew that knows the season is all but over awful tackling missed reps terrible penalties flubbed catches head scratching passes bad blocking porous coverage you name it the colts messed it up daniel jones continued to struggle missing passes and looking flustered in the pocket the first int wasn t his fault the second certainly was jones has been unable to overcome bad surroundings looking like the quarterback who wore out his welcome in new york jones finished 19 of 28 passing for 144 yards one td and two ints before being replaced by anthony richardson jonathan taylor scampered for 19 yards on his first touch he did little else the rest of the contest earning eight rushes for 23 yards and catching four passes for 24 yards he also fumbled on a trick play it might have been taylor s last game in indy most colts players seemed to play like their time in town could be coming to an end if steichen keeps his job beyond monday morning he ll have to do a much better job preparing and motivating his players next gen stats insight for jaguars colts via nfl pro trevor lawrence generated 15 0 yards per attempt the most in a game in his career much of that production came against zone coverage where he completed seven of nine passes for 167 yards and all three of his touchdowns lawrence was also efficient on play action connecting on four of five attempts for 124 yards and a touchdown nfl research bhayshul tuten is the first jaguars player to rush for 100 plus yards score a rushing touchdown record 50 plus receiving yards and a receiving td in the same game back to top jeremy bergman s takeaways raiders snap losing streak as cousins staves off mendoza klint kubiak gave kirk cousins a vote of confidence early in the week definitively declaring him the starting qb as calls for no 1 pick fernando mendoza increased amid las vegas four game skid consider kubiak and cousins vindicated the only thing that had been working for the raiders worked again on sunday afternoon picking up a leaky sometimes absent defense cousins was efficient and error free completing 19 of 26 passes for 247 yards to just four pass catchers two tight ends one running back one wide receiver after leading just one scoring drive in the first half the raiders offense under cousins was nearly flawless in the final two frames scoring three straight touchdowns out of the half and finding a game sealing field goal at the end of a clock killing drive at the end of the fourth quarter as much as we would all like to see mendoza get some reps just for curiosity s sake it s not prudent for the raiders to move away from kirko chainz as long as he s still moving the chains he s a steadying presence and a rising tide and las vegas gauntlet only gets tougher from here games against san francisco seattle denver and cleveland await before its december bye it s kirk s offense until the wheels call off jets run out of fuel again a running theme of the aaron glenn jets has been their inability to finish plays possessions games awareness of the problem has yet to lead to a remedy sunday s loss to las vegas was the latest example geno smith and the jets came out of the gates on fire reaching at least the raiders 21 yard line on each of their first six drives a run that extended into the third quarter in place of breece hall braelon allen was a force again running for 121 yards in the first half alone finished with 147 yards on 21 totes adonai mitchell career high 142 yards and garrett wilson 83 yards were big time chain movers all day but of those six opening scoring drives new york found the end zone just thrice keeping the game within reach for the raiders into the second half by the time las vegas forced its first punt with 1 33 to go in the third it was in striking distance to take the lead which it did because of course the jets found themselves back in the raiders red zone down four points with 5 24 to go in position to take a lead deep in the fourth but after three plays with no gain new york kicked its fourth field goal of the day of under 40 yards the jets had little time to launch a game winning drive after the raiders pushed their lead to five but reached las vegas 35 before smith launched an ill advised interception with seven seconds remaining new york s second half collapse would be more frustrating if it was more out of character but blowing opportunities in the red zone and in the win column is gang green s calling card at this point it doesn t get any easier for the 2 6 jets with the chiefs and bills up next an 11th straight losing season is in sight jeanty takes back seat to rookie ashton jeanty spent the week calling out the jets defense as a get right unit for the raiders run game he was right just not for him jeanty was relegated to a third down role against new york ceding starting reps to mike washington the fourth round rookie logged a career high 83 yards on 25 carries the most by any raiders rb this season it wasn t the most efficient outing but washington was a much more solid contributor in the lead role than jeanty had been in his previous three games 64 yards on 28 carries jeanty wasn t completely absent from the game however and played a crucial role on las vegas fourth quarter drive to take the lead breaking free for a 45 yard catch and run to flip the field he finished with just 9 rushing yards on two carries season low 22 snaps but jeanty proved once again that he is more useful to this offense in a pass catching role will las vegas solidify these roles in the weeks to come and if so how will the former top 10 pick handle the apparent demotion next gen stats insight for raiders jets via nfl pro brock bowers caught seven of 10 targets for 92 yards and two touchdowns in the raiders win recording six of his receptions aligned as an outside receiver bowers six receptions lined up outside tied his career high from week 3 this season and tied for the most by any tight end since at least 2016 no raiders wide receiver has caught six passes lined up outside in a game this season nfl research the raiders and jets each had season highs in points scored while combining for 71 points the third highest scoring game between the teams and just the second time they both scored at least 30 points joining week 11 1968 when the raiders won 43 32 in the infamous heidi game the raiders have scored 221 points this season their most through eight games since 2002 226 points when they went to the super bowl back to top dan parr s takeaways steelers cruise thanks to dominant ground game stifling defense pittsburgh s most lopsided victory of the season was fueled by a season high 200 rushing yards running backs jaylen warren and rico dowdle each chipped in a rushing touchdown with warren running for 143 yards tying his career high on his 28th birthday aaron rodgers was held to 13 of 25 passing for 172 yards no touchdowns and one interception on a pass that was dropped by dk metcalf but struggles through the air didn t end up costing the steelers with a big lead for most of the game and no significant threat from the browns rushing game the steelers pass rushers were able to pin their ears back and make deshaun watson s life miserable for most of the afternoon pittsburgh recorded a season high eight sacks on 21 qb pressures watson has now been sacked a whopping 22 times in the last four games poor starts come back to bite browns cleveland was abysmal on offense especially early on against the steelers a team the browns defeated back in week 4 the browns finished the first quarter with negative 1 yard on 10 plays and two lost fumbles it s part of a troubling trend for todd monken whose team has been outscored 65 13 in the first quarter of games this season the key to the browns surprising 5 2 start to the season was their ability to bounce back from those rough starts but sunday offered cleveland a stark reminder of what it s like to fall behind and stay behind it was the first time the browns have never held a lead since the jaguars blew them out in week 1 and the first time they were held to zero touchdowns in a game since week 15 of last season second year tight end harold fannin was one of the few bright spots making a career high 10 catches for 154 yards of course the combination of not being able to run the ball protect the passer or stop the run on defense is a recipe for disaster the browns had allowed one rushing touchdown in their first six games they have now allowed six such scores in their last two games including three on sunday they ll play their third straight road game next week against a desperate saints team that will be coming off a bye steelers hit bye week in driver s seat of afc north pittsburgh will be alone at the top of the division entering week 9 the browns are the only team with a winning record the steelers have faced during their four game winning streak but the goal is to stack wins and that s what pittsburgh is doing under head coach mike mccarthy the steelers will want to find a way to get aaron rodgers going again though after the 42 year old was held to a season low 172 yards passing on sunday he s now thrown only one touchdown over the last two games the going could get tougher coming out of the bye with a trip to visit the bengals awaiting the steelers in week 10 then again cincinnati needed overtime at home on sunday to beat the lowly titans in a 43 36 shootout next gen stats insight for browns steelers via nfl pro steelers linebacker alex highsmith generated six qb pressures across 21 matchups 20 1 on 1 with browns offensive tackle spencer fano in week 8 including two quick pressures under 2 5 seconds and 0 5 sacks highsmith also drew three holding calls two of which were declined fano also allowed four pressures in 13 matchups with steelers linebacker nick herbig including one quick pressure and one sack nfl research the browns have lost 23 straight regular season road games against the steelers tied for the longest road losing streak against a single opponent in nfl history with the lions at the packers from 1992 to 2014 the browns loss also means they have failed to sweep the steelers in the season series for the 35th straight season last accomplishing the feat in 1988 back to top bobby kownack s takeaways bucky puts bucs on his back handed a box score with the player names and teams redacted one would be forgiven for guessing sunday s nfc south showdown took place in 1926 rather than a century later the buccaneers ran the ball 55 times excluding kneeldowns part of a combined 83 carries by the two clubs in a bad weather game baker mayfield recorded just three pass attempts and completed none of them as tampa bay joined the 1974 bills as only the second team in the super bowl era to complete zero passes in a game and emerge victorious not only that but the bucs became the first team to win a game by 10 plus points without completing a pass since the 1945 pittsburgh steelers over the chicago cardinals so how did they pull out such an unlikely victory bucky irving his cuts were vicious and precise allowing him to weave through an atlanta defense that appeared to be on skates at times on a field flooded by rainwater he rushed for 170 yards and a touchdown on 27 carries eclipsing 100 yards in a first half for his first time as a pro and eventually setting a career high the operation also didn t slow down at all with kenneth gainwell occasionally mixing in and later on taking over to milk clock the backup back logged 25 carries for 140 yards it was a similar smashmouth formula that tampa bay used in last week s 43 13 pummeling of the panthers when mayfield only threw for 64 yards and the buccaneers have now produced three of the franchise s top 10 single game rushing outputs over the last four weeks at some point mayfield will need to air it out but it s been a remarkable run and remarkable running by tampa bay of late to reenter the nfc south race penix implodes atlanta ultimately lost for two reasons it couldn t stop bucky irving and michael penix couldn t stop giving the ball away while the bucs basically gave up trying to throw under a heavy rain that persisted for most of the contest penix accepted the challenge and promptly failed he couldn t find his targets especially during the first half spraying the ball around but not to his targets far too often he sailed one over drake london s head during atlanta s first drive into jacob parrish s hands but the corner couldn t handle it even provided that little bit of luck though he still threw three picks over the subsequent four possessions becoming the first quarterback to toss three interceptions in the first 18 minutes of a game since bailey zappe in 2023 and the first falcons qb to do it since matt ryan in 2012 penix threw his fourth int of the game after atlanta had finally found some momentum in better conditions ruining a 43 yard drive down to tampa bay s 24 yard line by leaving one behind tight end charlie woerner for zyon mccollum to collect the falcons had been averaging 31 0 points per game with penix starting which ranked behind only the bills 32 8 entering week 8 but he was a difference maker in the negative sense against tampa bay he finished 8 of 24 for 125 yards and an ugly 12 0 passer rating in a messy game like sunday s was the best thing quarterbacks can do is protect the ball he didn t and he lost miserable conditions lead to slopfest the true victor of sunday s game might have been the elements atlanta and tampa bay spent most of the day just trying to get through a torrential downpour the rain caused errors in every conceivable way there were overthrows botched snaps missed kicks fumbles and all varieties of dropped passes would be touchdowns easy pickups and interceptions there are too many examples to point to but perhaps the most emblematic football folly took place on the bucs second drive after the center quarterback exchange went wrong baker mayfield recovered the ball and improvised magnificently darting into traffic before throwing it backward to bucky irving who streaked toward the end zone and nearly made it there before jessie bates punched the ball out right at the goal line for a touchback by halftime the game had seen more fumbles five and interceptions three than completions two both teams tightened up on ball security out of half and the rain let up some toward the fourth quarter but tampa bay was able to outlast by stacking some successes despite the elements throughout the contest chase mclaughlin was money helping build a lead in the first half by going 3 of 3 on field goals of 46 34 and 42 yards alex anzalone picked off penix twice six plays apart jacob parrish made up for an earlier drop with a second quarter interception and the bucs shut out the falcons offense on third down 0 for 12 for such an ugly ugly day there will actually be a fair amount of pretty plays for todd bowles and co to rewatch next gen stats insight for falcons buccaneers via nfl pro bucky irving generated all 170 of his rushing yards against atlanta after contact the third most in a single game this season nfl research the buccaneers had a franchise record 322 rushing yards in week 8 against the falcons those 322 rushing yards are the second most by any team in a game where they had zero completions over the last 90 years behind only the 1933 boston redskins who had 420 against the giants in a 21 20 win back to top kevin patra s takeaways rams rumble over chargers in battle of l a sean mcvay s offense got off to an ugly start failing to record a first down in its first five drives the rams finally broke through with less than 90 seconds remaining in the first half on a matthew stafford 40 yard bomb to tutu atwell the home squad skated from there scoring 21 straight to blow out their sofi stadium mates the rams came out at halftime and saddled up the rushing attack after just 10 yards on the ground through two quarters blake corum and kyren williams blasted their way for 129 rushing yards and two touchdowns on 27 carries for the game corum started the second half generating chunk gains juking defenders out of their shoes he capped the drive with a 23 yard scamper to give l a a lead it wouldn t relent finding pay dirt on both sides of halftime seemed to break the chargers the successful rushing attack stabilized an offense that was stubbing its toe early after a wobbly start mcvay s squad has battled back to 500 with games against washington and arizona on tap chargers disaster season continues the chargers play poorly they also played scared jim harbaugh s winless club had multiple chances to strike an early big punch but repeatedly whiffed the chargers settled for three field goals on fourth and short situations deep in rams territory the final decision proved to be the worst facing a fourth and 2 at the rams 23 yard line with under 2 minutes left in the first half harbaugh elected to kick a field goal to go up 9 3 if the chargers went for and converted it they could have gone up double digits and perhaps burned the clock so the rams couldn t have scored late to jumpstart their offense winning teams make winning plays on winning decisions losing teams stay losing with a losing mentality speaking of mentality justin herbert s is lost in a blind wilderness the chargers qb threw a pair of ugly interceptions the type you can t believe that a 50 million player would make right to defenders herbert isn t trusting what he s seeing and isn t seeing what defenses are putting in front of him he s a mess mentally right now with little hope of digging out of the hole when the highest paid player on the team is making rookie level mistakes what can you expect from the rest of the club rams d takes advantage of herbert mistakes quentin lake jumped a first quarter justin herbert pass to the outside and scampered into chargers territory even after the offense generated just 8 yards the return was enough to give the rams an early three point lead after halftime trent mcduffie saw a pass tossed right to him in zone coverage which he returned 26 yards to set up a td that would put the game out of reach the rams stuffed the chargers run game 2 6 yards per carry and pestered herbert into mistakes in addition to two sacks and two picks the rams generated 20 qb pressures including three from defensive tackle aaron donald the rams early play keeping the chargers out of the end zone proved huge giving the offense time to figure things out without falling too far behind next gen stats insight for rams chargers via nfl pro matthew stafford averaged a time to throw of 2 38 seconds in the rams week 8 victory over the chargers his third quickest in a game since joining the rams in 2021 stafford was efficient on quick passes completing 13 of 14 passes for 94 yards and a touchdown 57 1 success rate when he held on to the ball for over 2 5 seconds he completed just four of 11 passes for 63 yards with an interception 33 3 success rate nfl research the chargers are the first team in nfl history to lose each of their first seven games of a season after winning at least 11 games in the previous season back to top nick shook s takeaways fourth quarter broncos are back denver s offensive output is slowly starting to improve bo nix completed 20 of 32 passes for 222 yards and two touchdowns took a few shots downfield and connected once with jaylen waddle for a big gain and most importantly delivered in a frantic fourth quarter comeback effort facing a goal to go situation nix ran himself into pressure when inexplicably trying to break a clean pocket but didn t let that mistake sink him he calmly executed a play action rollout later in the sequence and found fullback nate adkins for a touchdown then coolly converted the two point try by firing a bullet to waddle to make it a three point game jonah coleman later handled the rest ripping off a 51 yard gain after catching a short pass from nix to set up denver s go ahead touchdown a score that was ultimately the deciding trip to the end zone denver still finished 2 for 11 on third down and under 300 total yards of offense but when it needed to score late it found a way to get the job done in a high pressure situation the broncos will need to build off that going forward chiefs rediscover offensive mojo still fall short after being completely shut down by seattle last week kansas city was able to get back on track and produce in denver on sunday thanks to some early big plays headlined by running back emmett johnson s 73 yard touchdown reception explosive plays propelled the chiefs to a 17 13 lead before patrick mahomes pieced together a methodical 11 play 63 yard touchdown drive to take an 11 point lead late in the third quarter that score came at the end of what was the chiefs most impressive drive of the season and appeared to be enough to keep the broncos at bay until denver s fourth quarter scoring outburst moved the broncos within three points of tying the chiefs and then ahead of kansas city in the game s final two minutes in years past that would have been too much time to give mahomes and co and it nearly was again sunday but kansas city s inability to finish off its frantic two minute drill reminded us of this offense s limitations mahomes wasn t able to scramble for a touchdown instead throwing away a pass a few yards shy of the goal line and kenneth walker s hesitant third down run preceded a sequence that will live in chiefs fans memories for a while facing fourth and goal from the 1 kansas city stacked three receivers in a tight bunch set on the left sent the shotgun snap to mahomes and let the route combination work freeing rashee rice for what should have been the game winning touchdown jaylon moore s slight movement before the snap drew a false start penalty though and mahomes crumbled beneath the denver pass rush on the game s final play there were things to like from this game including kansas city s ability to compete on the road without receiving stellar production from walker 25 touches 84 scrimmage yards but the frustrating result erased the chiefs grip on first place in the afc west race instead they ll have to try to keep pace with denver the rest of the way oh and we already knew this but it was reaffirmed sunday harrison butker is marching toward unemployment his wide right miss from 54 yards loomed large in this contest and is just the latest of a growing string of misses from deep denver s defense shows cracks but holds up in biggest moment the broncos have built their 6 2 mark on the backs of their defenders who have collectively stifled opposing offenses by harassing quarterbacks relentlessly over the last month on sunday they weren t quite as effective for most of the afternoon patrick mahomes managed to lead one drive in which he repeatedly converted third downs by barely moving the ball beyond the line to gain showing flashes of what has made him a special quarterback in the post tyreek hill era in kansas city and dealing a few deflating blows to the denver defense in the process that wasn t enough to tear them down though in need of a stop denver managed to force a chiefs drive to stall in the fourth quarter leading to butker s 54 yard miss and granting the broncos a fresh opportunity to complete their comeback effort and even after letting mahomes drive the chiefs down the field rapidly in the final two minutes denver bowed up and denied the chiefs from entering the end zone in the game s final seconds as nix noted afterward the broncos have been leaning on their defense all season and they managed to prevent the opposition from gaining the one yard they needed most the fact they ended the game with a sack credited to malcolm roach but truly the product of a collective unified pass rush was fitting next gen stats insight for chiefs broncos via nfl pro on first and goal from the denver 4 yard line in the game s final minute the chiefs owned a 76 chance of winning per next gen stats win probability they did not score losing 28 24 nfl research the broncos came back to win in week 8 after trailing by 11 points in the fourth quarter against the chiefs the win was the broncos third in bo nix s career in which they came back from a double digit fourth quarter deficit to win which is the most such wins in the nfl since 2024 this was just the third game in patrick mahomes career in which the chiefs blew a double digit fourth quarter lead and the first since week 2 2021 in baltimore back to top brooke cersosimo s takeaways maye pats offense has big second half the patriots looked as if they were still feeling last week s loss to chicago in the first half of sunday s contest new england s receiving yards leader hunter henry remained drake maye s preferred option early against the dolphins catching all three of his targets for 30 yards but the veteran tight end left the game with a foot injury midway through the second quarter and never returned maye looked stumped without henry and his top three receivers a j brown ankle knee who s missing his fifth game this season romeo doubs and mack hollins both on injured reserve for the rest of the half the offense compiled less than 100 total yards and had a 13 3 deficit going into the locker room prompting too many mike vrabel eye rolls to count then came some much needed adjustments from offensive coordinator josh mcdaniels and maye after a three and out maye began stretching the field and finding the few pats receivers at his disposal to string together three straight touchdown drives that scoring avalanche opened with maye finding kyle williams on a 43 yard touchdown before maye stunned a defender when taking it in himself on an option from 2 yards out maye s third td saw him connect with demario douglas deep downfield for a 48 yard touchdown maye finished the day 16 of 20 passing for 199 yards with the three total tds it marked maye s fifth straight game with three or more total touchdowns the first time a patriots qb has done so since tom brady accomplished the feat in 10 consecutive games in 2007 despite some dicey moments early the pats appear to be back on track dormant third quarter sinks fins miami built some momentum offensively before halftime with 11 and 12 play scoring drives that gave it a 10 point lead heading into the locker room the latter was undoubtedly miami s most impressive march of the day as malik willis connected with greg dulcich caleb douglas jalen tolbert kevin coleman and finally malik washington in the end zone for a 1 yard score that s about when the fun stopped for miami as the third quarter saw it gain a piddly 13 net yards zero pass yards on eight plays credit the dolphins for trying to get out of the 11 point hole late with a nice 35 yard touchdown from willis to coleman late in the fourth quarter though a missed field goal failed two point try and an unsuccessful onside kick attempt all but sealed their fate willis finished the loss 21 of 32 passing for 211 yards two tds and an int which crazily launched off a defender s helmet at the line of scrimmage into kevin byard s hands downfield for the first time in several weeks the run game went away with ollie gordon racking up 69 yards on 19 carries 3 6 yards per attempt the game was ultimately decided by five points but it didn t feel all that close for much of the rainy second half some love for the defenses there were a handful of players on both teams that made notable plays the dolphins entered the contest with only six sacks dead last in the nfl but logged three sunday 2024 first round pick chop robinson led all players with two takedowns of drake maye while josh uche a former patriot had one miami also received solid contributions from jordyn brooks 11 total tackles jacob rodriguez eight tackles forced fumble and julius brents fumble recovery new england sacked malik willis five times in the win with gabe jacas and cory durden leading the way with 1 5 sacks apiece carlton davis nine tackles kaden elliss nine tackles 5 sacks two tfls and kevin byard int also deserve flowers for their performances next gen stats insight for patriots dolphins via nfl pro drake maye completed 16 of 20 passes for 199 yards and two tds against the dolphins in week 8 maye was perfect on throws of more than 10 air yards completing all five attempts for 149 yards and both of his touchdowns since week 4 maye has thrown six deep 20 air yards touchdown passes without an interception the most deep touchdowns in the nfl over that span nfl research with sunday s win over the miami dolphins patriots head coach mike vrabel is 13 4 in his career in games with eight or more days of rest back to top grant gordon s takeaways daniels gets long awaited win in a battle of attrition for the commanders eagles and those tuned in washington and jayden daniels emerged as survivors and victors there were zero style points but daniels and co rallied from a 10 point deficit in the first quarter as the quarterback stunningly earned his first win since oct 5 2025 battling through injuries in this season and the last daniels had gone 0 7 1 over his last eight starts with washington this one is unlikely to be a triumph he ll put on a highlight reel as the commanders and eagles entered sunday night on a combined eight game winless streak the product was emblematic of the teams travails for the most part daniels however largely avoided big mistakes throwing for 217 yards and an 8 yard touchdown pass to stefon diggs that led to a 10 all score in the second quarter and was part of a 27 0 run for washington daniels and washington have been desperate for a win at 2 4 1 the commanders are still within flailing distance of the nfc east s top spot though that s hard to fathom with the showing regardless dan quinn daniels and the commanders have something to celebrate at the expense of a division rival that is dealing with harder times eagles endure another ugly loss after 10 points and nearly 15 minutes of game time things looked sunny for philadelphia for the first time in a long time the eagles hadn t laid claim to a double digit lead since week 4 unfortunately during a trying season for the eagles in which injuries have taken hold they lost their sixth in a row for the first time in nick sirianni s tenure as a banged up saquon barkley was limited and fill in starter tanner mckee was bamboozled by washington pressure held scoreless following a 3 yard touchdown run by barkley with 4 27 to go in the first quarter the eagles mustered just 268 yards of offense the running game was held to 91 yards and mckee couldn t hold up against the commanders pressure washington racked up a season best five sacks as mckee was pressured 20 times 46 5 pressure rate and it seemed as though he was under duress far more than that despite a roster completely hobbled by injuries this was a winnable game for the eagles but mckee and the offense simply had no answers emblematic of the struggles was philadelphia s best drive of the second half a 15 play odyssey that took up 7 35 it ended with a jake elliott 41 yard field goal attempt clanging off the upright following back to back 5 yard penalties eight games into the season and residing in an nfc east that s hardly a heavyweight division it s still arduous to believe the eagles season isn t done washington wins in trenches in week 7 the eagles defense was shockingly held to six qb pressures no sacks and no tackles for loss in a setback against the cowboys the stats weren t so damning in this one but it still wasn t where it should be credit to the commanders offensive line for that guard samuel cosmi more than held his own against jalen carter carter had one of the eagles two sacks and it came versus cosmi but overall cosmi won this battle allowing the sack and one pressure in 19 matchups including 12 one on ones the pressure and the sack allowed to carter were cosmi s only blemishes in 33 pass block snaps former first round pick josh conerly and center lucas patrick also had commendable showings next gen stats insight for eagles commanders via nfl pro
