news_mentions.headline: NFL Week 8 Sunday aftermath: Ravens' season on the brink; can Vikings trust Kyler Murray?
news_mentions.description: Kevin Patra breaks down Sunday's Week 8 action in the latest edition of The Aftermath. Is the Ravens' season on the brink of collapse? Can the Vikings trust Kyler Murray?
news_mentions.body_text: now that it s november the playoff picture is starting to emerge and week 8 featured a number of key divisional matchups that could have lasting effects on the rest of the season the broncos and steelers notched revenge wins over the chiefs and browns respectively the lions asserted themselves in the uber tough nfc north while the jaguars handed the colts a potentially fatal blow in a season cratering toward disaster let s examine some key storylines in sunday s aftermath including another concerning loss for schottenheimer s boys minnesota s qb issues rear their ugly head in detroit buccaneers lean on run game in historic win broncos take over driver s seat in afc west race burrow channels norm van brocklin against tennessee but first we start with lamar jackson suffering a potential season ending injury and where the ravens go from here ravens season on the brink after jackson injury the baltimore ravens find themselves in quite the quandary lamar jackson s return was supposed to buoy a club coming off back to back divisional defeats it lasted one play on sunday in buffalo jackson s right thumb injury which will require surgery leaves the 4 4 ravens floundering in the afc north cellar before we hit thanksgiving jesse minter told reporters after the 36 10 loss to buffalo that jackson will be placed on injured reserve knocking him out for at least four games asked if the setback ultimately could end jackson s season the ravens first year head coach admitted that it s possible potentially but we ll see where it s at minter said without the two time mvp qb the ravens offense is clipped baltimore is 7 14 in games in which jackson has not started since 2019 averaging just 17 6 points in 2026 the team has scored six touchdowns in the 18 quarters jackson has missed jackson s latest injury shrouds his future in baltimore we ll have plenty of time to delve into the contract situation later right now the focus is on how the ravens survive it would be bad enough if jackson s thumb issue were baltimore s only qb injury but backup tyler huntley also exited sunday s game and didn t return espn reported that huntley suffered a possible turf toe injury and will undergo an mri on monday to determine how much time if any he could miss undrafted rookie third stringer joe fagnano battled against the bills but given the situation trying to keep up with josh allen on the road with no prep time he performed as expected completing 10 of his 21 pass attempts for 91 yards with a pick and three sacks taken the ravens are in a rough spot with a short week before thursday night s game against the rolling jaguars even if huntley doesn t miss much time is it worth baltimore trading for a qb ahead of the nov 10 deadline would shelling out more assets in a potentially lost season be wise let s rip through some of the potential qb options for the ravens if they decide to go the trade route tyson bagent the bears qb2 struggled in his last outing against green bay in week 5 and was eventually benched for case keenum but his familiarity with declan doyle would benefit baltimore considered one of the league s better backups by many bagent could be a long term play for the ravens i have my doubts about if the bears would be willing to part with their no 2 but such a move could help recoup some of the trade capital sent away in last week s jeffery simmons deal the cost to pry bagent away from chicago could prove prohibitive for a ravens team on the brink jacoby brissett benched in favor of gardner minshew during the cardinals stirring comeback win over dallas on sunday brissett has experience while inconsistencies have plagued him this season in arizona he is a professional qb who could pick up the offense quickly editor s update on monday mike lafleur named minshew as the cardinals starter moving forward shedeur sanders cleveland has insisted that it has no intention of trading sanders but coach todd monken hasn t seemed to be in the former colorado quarterback s corner at any point in the process sanders has his warts but he could bring more pop to the ravens offense than huntley or fagnano the browns shipped joe flacco to cincinnati last year so intra division trades can t be ruled out we know the browns brass will take a pick if it makes sense kirk cousins i don t think the raiders would trade him while they re still in contention at 4 4 if they were willing to the cost would probably be prohibitive however for the next week any qb trade list should at least mention the veteran playing at a high level in front of no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza two non trade options easton stick currently on the tampa bay buccaneers practice squad stick was in l a in 2024 with minter so at least there would be some familiarity jimmy garoppolo the veteran hasn t officially retired if he wants a shot to play again baltimore could be his last best chance cowboys collapse in stunning loss credit gardner minshew for bringing the mania once again credit tyler allgeier for gashing the cowboys defense and powering the cards back into the game credit michael wilson for continuing to do his best puka nacua impression credit the cardinals defense for forcing field goals late and getting a three and out in overtime credit mike lafleur s club for not quitting when quitting could have been easy and credit the first year coach for being willing to make a second half qb change in the heat of the moment credit the cards but let s be real this was an epic collapse for which dallas should be crushed brian schottenheimer s club held a 24 10 fourth quarter lead before disintegrating like walter donovan drinking from the wrong chalice he chose poorly could be the title of every cowboys move on sunday a confluence of ineptitude caused dallas to collapse at home to drop to 3 5 on the season the defense became a sieve in the fourth quarter and couldn t tackle i understand that the cowboys had some injuries but letting allgeier look like jim brown is not a product of a few missing players the secondary inexplicably got burned late when all the cowboys needed to do was keep everything in front of them frankly arizona could have scored quicker in the fourth quarter if not for a few misses the defensive breakdowns continue to perplex dallas this season the offense also did its part in the collapse stalling out inside the red zone early then failing to get a first down after the cardinals failed on the onside kick an explosive offense should be able to move the chains to secure a victory then there was the depressing three and out to begin overtime dallas got outgained in yardage 467 261 on sunday that should not happen despite the latest example of schottenheimer s teams playing below their talent jerry jones stuck by his coach after the game that s not in my mind at this time jones said when asked about a potential coaching change per espn com a lot of people let brian down today and so for whatever criticism we want to have of brian we can all get in line the line for blame in dallas is long it starts at the top vikings qb problems can t be brushed aside brian flores defense had done the heavy lifting to build minnesota s 6 0 start but sunday s divisional loss to the lions showed that the ferocious unit can t do it alone detroit went big and ran over the vikings in the second half wearing down the stout defense to the tune of 164 rushing yards after halftime by the end flores group was gassed and couldn t stop jahmyr gibbs and the lions from grinding out the w if the vikings offense had any semblance of consistency the end game scenario would have played out much differently kyler murray continues to struggle with his consistency despite facing the worst passing defense in the nfl on sunday he couldn t keep the vikings on the field he sailed more than a few balls way too high never seemed comfortable and rarely moved the chains on nine third down throws he completed four three went for first downs murray connected on some deep balls and averaged 11 2 air yards per attempt the second highest mark of his career but he also missed a host of shots per next gen stats on downfield attempts 10 plus air yards murray threw for a season high 115 yards despite only completing four of his 13 attempts 30 8 his lowest downfield completion rate in a game since 2023 min 10 downfield attempts the inability to keep the chains moving sits in stark contrast to the best offenses under kevin o connell we ll see if koc pulls the plug and gives carson wentz a shot at least we know he ll force feed justin jefferson if the struggles persist the j j mccarthy trade probably needed to happen but seeing the 2024 first rounder look like a different qb in new york while murray struggles has to sting minnesota with a tough trio of games on tap vs buffalo 6 1 at green bay 5 3 and against san francisco 6 1 in mexico city the vikings must get more production from the qb position or they ll see their once strong nfc north lead evaporate editor s update on monday after publishing kevin o connell said kyler murray is dealing with hamstring tightness is the bucs offense sustainable the monsoon in tampa fla dictated the run heavy approach from zac robinson s offense but even in pristine weather the buccaneers would have leaned on the ground game the slop tipped the scales even harder with baker mayfield attempting just three passes all falling incomplete in the 16 0 win we knew it was going to be a nasty day and what kind of conditions it was going to be bucs coach todd bowles said we were worried about ball security and we took care of it other than the fumble in the end zone bowles added i didn t say we were not going to throw the ball the conditions told robinson that you could see it it s a downpour and the wind was blowing you can kind of see the ball wasn t going anywhere tampa became just the second team in the super bowl era to have zero completed passes in a single game joining the 1974 bills who did so in a win over the jets per nfl research three of the four teams to not have a completion in a game since 1950 have gone on to win including the buccaneers on sunday they are the first team to win by 10 points without completing a pass since the 1945 pittsburgh steelers beat the chicago cardinals the ground game has gotten the bucs back in the nfc south race in week 7 against carolina tampa bay rushed for 258 yards while mayfield attempted just 11 passes completing seven for 64 yards and a td bucky irving has been sensational making defenders miss and has the pop to turn those broken tackles into big runs all 170 of irving s rushing yards came after contact on sunday per next gen stats one of the more inexplicable issues with the bucs early struggles when they started 1 5 was the offensive line s play the veteran crew missed far too many blocks and committed too many penalties over the last couple weeks the group has gotten back on track by smashing defenses in the face tampa s rushing attack is absolutely replicable i expect irving to keep motoring through defenses slithering through holes and ripping chunk gains that said it s 2026 at some point mayfield will be asked to win a game through the air with the bears and lions on tap in weeks 9 and 11 the bucs will have to keep pace with higher powered offenses after thumping two division rivals though tampa is back on track in a moribund division and the bucs feel like the most stable nfc south club as we head into the second half of the season broncos take command in afc west race it s not pretty but who cares when you stack a w bo nix earned his 15th career game winning drive in denver s 28 24 win over kansas city on sunday breaking a tie with dak prescott for the most such drives in a player s first three seasons since at least 1950 according to nfl research the broncos came back to win after trailing the rival chiefs by 11 points in the fourth quarter it marked the third victory in nix s career in which denver erased a fourth quarter deficit of 10 points the most such wins in the nfl since 2024 conversely sunday marked the third game in patrick mahomes career in which the chiefs blew a fourth quarter lead of 10 points and the first since over five years ago in week 2 of 2021 at the ravens harrison butker s missed fourth quarter field goal opened the door for denver and nix immediately cashed in hitting running back jonah coleman for a 51 yard catch and run to set up the go ahead 5 yard td the 15 point fourth quarter explosion came after nix and the offense once again struggled to stay on the field denver went three and out on three third quarter drives entering the final frame the home fans were frustrated then boom big plays galore and the broncos not only escaped with a win but took control of the afc west race the big plays included a massive goal line stand by the denver defense which held the chiefs out of the end zone in the game s final seconds after they got a first and goal at the 4 the sequence was aided by a k c false start but a denver d that once again missed too many tackles ultimately stood tall when needed with malcolm roach taking down mahomes for the game ending sack it was ball out or go home edge rusher que robinson said of the dramatic finish via the denver post and we weren t going home without that dub the loss stings k c which could have taken complete control of the division race with a sweep over the broncos denver 6 2 has now won four straight while the chiefs 5 2 have lost back to back games after taking advantage of a soft early slate andy reid s trust in butker came back to bite him according to the next gen stats fourth down decision guide with kansas city leading 24 21 and facing fourth and 8 from the broncos 36 yard line with 2 36 remaining a punt would have given the chiefs the highest win probability 74 3 1 8 percentage points ahead of going for it 72 5 while a field goal attempt ranked last 71 5 reid elected for the fg butker missed the 54 yard attempt giving the ball back to the broncos who scored two plays later sometimes analytics does suggest punting week 8 sunday spotlight

news_mentions.headline: NFL experts' Week 8 takeaways: Do Ravens need drastic QB measures? Plus, Cowboys collapse
news_mentions.body_text: each sunday three of the athletic 39 s nfl writers react to the biggest news plays and performances from the day 39 s games every sunday matters in the nfl that 39 s what makes the league so popular but this sunday seemed especially consequential with a significant quarterback injury a stunning comeback and several key division matchups the biggest news of the day came early as the return of baltimore ravens quarterback lamar jackson lasted one play before he left with a thumb injury it got worse when backup tyler huntley also left with an injury in the end emergency quarterback joe fagnano gave a game performance but it wasn 39 t nearly enough in a 36 10 loss to the buffalo bills now the ravens will have to hold their breath and see if their franchise quarterback is going to miss the rest of the season the most important game of the day was in detroit as the lions handed the minnesota vikings their first loss of the season detroit 39 s offense did just enough against the dominant minnesota defense in a 19 15 win the wildest game of the day was in dallas as the arizona cardinals scored two touchdowns in the final three minutes of regulation and won 33 30 in overtime it was another stunning collapse by the cowboys in a season that is getting away from them the season has already gotten away from the indianapolis colts who suffered a humiliating 42 7 loss to the jacksonville jaguars the fire sale that started earlier this week could accelerate with the trade deadline looming nfl writers mike jones austin mock and ted nguyen share their thoughts on the ravens 39 quarterback mess the stumbling cowboys the surging lions and the hapless indianapolis colts should the ravens trade serious draft capital for a quarterback in an attempt to save their season if lamar jackson misses a significant amount of time jones if tyler huntley will not miss time then the ravens don 39 t even need to consider this if both jackson and huntley will miss time baltimore needs to do something but there 39 s not really a quarterback worthy of serious draft capital on the trading block when it comes to veterans capable of stepping in and leading a team effectively the pickings are rather slim the cincinnati bengals aren 39 t going to trade joe flacco to a divisional rival the san francisco 49ers aren 39 t going to part with mac jones andy dalton would seem to have a little left in the tank and is a member of the atlanta falcons 39 crowded quarterback room but he wouldn 39 t seemingly command 34 serious draft capital 34 another option josh johnson who is in his 19th professional season and is a member of the bengals 39 practice squad baltimore wouldn 39 t have to trade for him to add him to their roster mock i don 39 t think so and am pretty sure that would be a poor decision in the long run first being desperate and turning to the trade market is a dangerous combination second i 39 m not even sure who you 39 d trade for at this point kirk cousins is probably the only starter that makes sense but i 39 m not sure if the las vegas raiders would be willing to do that mac jones will certainly be buzzy but i 39 m skeptical what we saw in half a season under kyle shanahan in the 49ers 39 system is the type of production you 39 ll get in baltimore at the end of the day you have to be content with understanding that the future is more important than the now and that 39 s where i 39 m at with the ravens maybe you can win some games down the stretch with poor quarterback play but if not you get a better draft pick to supplement lamar jackson for 2027 and beyond nguyen i 39 m not sure who would be available that could help them at this point cousins is leading the league in touchdown passes but i think the raiders are intent on keeping him as fernando mendoza 39 s mentor maybe the bears would be willing to trade tyson bagent and go with case keenum as their backup bagent knows offensive coordinator declan doyle 39 s system and the transition should be relatively simple it would take maybe a second round pick for the 49ers to trade mac jones there just aren 39 t a lot of options i 39 m not sure if the ravens defense is good enough to hold things together during a qb transition period sometimes you just have to accept your fate at the very least they may get to keep doyle longer who 39 s most to blame for the cowboys 39 stunning collapse against the cardinals jones there 39 s plenty of blame to go around a defense that let gardner minshew come off the bench to carve them up for three touchdown passes while completing 17 of 23 passes for 188 yards in less than 17 minutes of play a defense that let tyler allgeier gash them for 147 rushing yards and a touchdown on just 11 touches a defense that let michael wilson rack up 111 receiving yards and a touchdown on eight catches a defense that surrendered 30 points after halftime or do we want to go with a cowboys offense that got out gained 467 261 while averaging just 3 6 yards per play this was a bad day all around for coach brian schottenheimer and his team mock can i say everyone because it 39 s not that simple the easy answer is the defense because they 39 ve been horrendous for two seasons now and the offseason moves to address that side of the ball haven 39 t come to fruition the defense isn 39 t even close to being a respectable unit right now and you can 39 t consistently win games in the nfl with a unit that bad but the offense deserves some blame too with their inability to run the ball 34 percent success rate against the cardinals which resulted in them being unable to put away the cardinals with a lead so that comes back to the blame on everyone the coaching staff on both sides of the ball the front office it 39 s all bad right now the coaching staff isn 39 t elevating the talent they have and the front office hasn 39 t given them the talent to be a winning football team so while it 39 s easy to point fingers at one person or one unit the blame is shared and goes the whole way to the top of the organization nguyen the offense certainly deserves blame for not putting away the game against a cardinals defense that had been struggling however the defense gave up 20 points in the fourth quarter to a minshew led offense without any timeouts the cardinals drove 80 yards in just over a minute and should have won the game in regulation but missed an extra point and there were wide open receivers the cardinals weren 39 t making a bunch of amazing catches in overtime the offense went three and out and the cardinals drove right down the field the detroit lions didn 39 t light up the scoreboard against the minnesota vikings 39 fearsome defense but jared goff led the game winning drive in the fourth quarter goff has 15 touchdown passes and one interception is he the mvp so far this season jones if you ask vegas goff doesn 39 t even crack the top five in the mvp race the popular picks josh allen brock purdy joe burrow patrick mahomes and trevor lawrence lead the way according to most books however goff certainly deserves consideration sunday was a big statement game for the lions and the 11th year veteran goff has been masterful this season especially against the blitz where entering sunday 39 s game he had completed roughly 77 percent of his passes the vikings definitely got to him on sunday but when it mattered most goff came through goff has provided stability and effectiveness despite a change at offensive coordinator and injuries on that side of the ball and despite all the change detroit boasts one of the most prolific offenses in the league thanks largely to goff mock goff came into this week sixth in quarterback index qbi heading into the week and i 39 m not sure his stat line against the vikings will improve that number but it 39 s the vikings so we are happy to give him a pass but with the weapons that they have on offense it 39 s hard for me to see goff getting enough credit to win the award the lions have a ton of talent going around with jahmyr gibbs amon ra st brown and even on the offensive line with penei sewell and then you factor in that allen is still doing otherworldly things in buffalo i don 39 t know if he can be the favorite with goff being non existent in the run game his passing numbers would need to be above and beyond allen and others and with gibbs in the backfield i 39 m not sure we will see that in the conversation sure but he 39 s in that second tier right now and likely behind allen purdy and mahomes if i was in charge nguyen he should definitely be in the conversation the hiring of offensive coordinator drew petzing and passing game coordinator mike kafka has gotten this offense back on track the lions still are a run first team and gibbs might win offensive player of the year goff has been extremely productive but it 39 s hard to overlook the super human play of allen this season goff 39 s final numbers would have to be substantially better than allen 39 s for him to win in my opinion after trading two of their best players the colts were crushed by the jaguars they don 39 t own their first round pick and daniel jones looks lost after getting a huge contract extension is this the most bleak situation in the nfl right now jones the colts have two more wins than the winless chargers but it 39 s clear indianapolis is headed toward a franchise reset this offseason they 39 ve already fired their general manager and unloaded two key players in quenton nelson and deforest buckner they really should go ahead and move jonathan taylor and josh downs and anyone else they can to stockpile picks for their next gm to work with in the spring mock i think so yes and if i were in charge i 39 d be selling off just about every player i could to try and maximize my draft capital in the coming years considering the colts don 39 t have their first rounder and with new ownership will a promising general manager and or coaching staff be willing to come in for a rebuild if head coach shane steichen isn 39 t around next season you 39 d have to really sell the new front office and staff on this being a long rebuild and preach patience because the roster is void of talent on both sides of the ball and there is no future quarterback at the moment and even then if you hit on a quarterback how long does it take to surround your rookie with enough talent to compete for titles before you have to pay him a gaudy amount with the lack of draft capital this is certainly the franchise furthest from winning and will need a full rebuild and most importantly time to get this thing turned around nguyen can 39 t think of many worse than the colts right now who don 39 t have a first round pick the sauce gardner trade for two first round picks could be the worst trade since the browns 39 for deshaun watson maybe the colts could recoup a first for taylor extending jones from a small sample of successful play after a career 39 s worth of underwhelming play was a bad mistake chris ballard put this team in dire straits before his firing which is one of the dangers of having a gm on the hot seat they start to make desperate moves to save their job this article originally appeared in the athletic
