news_mentions.description: Lions All-Pro linebacker Jack Campbell remained hospitalized Monday for evaluation and monitoring of a neck injury, the team said.
news_mentions.body_text: detroit detroit lions all pro linebacker jack campbell remained hospitalized monday for evaluation and monitoring of a neck injury the team said campbell was placed on a backboard and carted off the field early in the fourth quarter of a 19 15 win over the minnesota vikings on sunday he was alert and breathing when he was taken to the hospital jack campbell continues to rest and recover at a local hospital the lions said in a statement monday preliminary indications are positive and out of respect for jack and his family we will not share further information at this time campbell was face down on the turf and was not moving after hitting tight end t j hockenson for his third tackle of the game he was evaluated by medical personnel before being strapped to a board and carefully lifted onto the cart to a round of applause detroit s entire team and most of the coaching staff surrounded the cart we re thinking about him coach dan campbell said after the game the former iowa star was drafted by the lions with no 18 overall pick in 2023 last season campbell was an all pro selection after becoming the first nfl player in seven years to have 150 plus tackles and at least five sacks and three forced fumbles the lions signed campbell last may to a four year contract extension that runs through the 2030 season copyright 2026 by the associated press

news_mentions.headline: Matt LaFleur says Packers anticipate keeping RB Josh Jacobs on roster
news_mentions.description: Green Bay coach Matt LaFleur says the Packers plan to keep Josh Jacobs on their roster following the news of previous allegations against the running back.
news_mentions.body_text: green bay wis green bay coach matt lafleur says the packers plan to keep josh jacobs on their roster following the news of previous allegations against the running back who has pleaded no contest to two misdemeanor charges stemming from a may altercation with his then girlfriend we re going to allow the nfl to do its process but i would anticipate him being a member of us moving forward lafleur said monday that s really all i have to speak on lafleur was asked why the packers weren t cutting ties with jacobs because we re just going to let everything kind of play out and obviously go from there he replied jacobs pleaded no contest on sept 10 to misdemeanor charges of battery and criminal damage to property he was arrested may 26 after his then girlfriend said he had thrown her to the ground three days earlier in response to a public records request the hobart lawrence wisconsin police department released records from their investigation friday night that included the accounts of three other women who reported similar incidents from years before after spending the first six games of the season on the commissioner s exempt list which prevented him from playing or practicing jacobs returned to play in the packers last two games the nfl has said its investigation into jacobs is ongoing which means he still could be subject to more discipline from the league lawyers representing jacobs said he has a substantial body of tangible evidence disputing the allegations that surfaced in friday s records release josh took responsibility for what happened in may david z chesnoff richard a schonfeld and clarence f duchac said sunday in a statement he entered into an agreement with prosecutors for two misdemeanors and he is meeting the court s requirements the three accounts are old are hearsay and easily disproven yet released to the media by police without any investigation to determine whether they were accurate or contradicted by evidence josh is answering them in detail because of the character assassination that is occurring unfairly threatening his career jacobs lawyers said that one of the three women made a claim to the nfl which reviewed it and decided no action was warranted they said jacobs has kept evidence that supports his accounts and the nfl s decision the nfl declined comment sunday on the lawyers statement after hobart lawrence police released the records that detailed the accounts from the other women nfl spokesman brian mccarthy had said saturday that the league would review these allegations as part of its investigation after charges were initially filed against jacobs lafleur said on sept 1 that i believe him and i trust him and added that i m going to do that until proven otherwise when jacobs came off the commissioner s exempt list and started practicing with the packers again two weeks ago lafleur said that i think people learn from their mistakes and i think he s extremely remorseful and i do believe that he s a good person lafleur was asked monday about his support for jacobs and whether anything had changed in that regard i m not going to get into that up here right now lafleur said we ll just let the process play out jacobs arrest followed a may 23 incident in which police officers came to his wisconsin home to investigate a disturbance according to police a woman told them jacobs grabbed her and threw her to the ground as she was trying to exit a garage door causing her to hit her head police said jacobs also took her phone from her while she was on the ground police said they noticed redness on her face and neck and could feel a bump on the back of her head since returning to the packers jacobs has 32 carries for 75 yards and a touchdown plus 11 catches for 68 yards and two more scores jacobs scored two touchdowns in a 27 19 victory over the carolina panthers on thursday and celebrated the first of those scores by briefly putting his hands together behind his back jacobs said after the game that he was paying homage to a gospel song titled break every chain but he was criticized on social media by people who believed he was simulating getting handcuffed that s something that he and i talked about lafleur said i know he had his explanation and i wasn t even aware of what happened until i saw the tape but we had a conversation about that and i m going to keep the conversation between him and i and you know we re going to move forward copyright 2026 the associated press

news_mentions.headline: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson to undergo surgery on right thumb, will be placed on IR
news_mentions.description: Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson will undergo surgery after suffering a right thumb injury on his first offensive snap of Sunday's 36-10 loss to the Buffalo Bills, Baltimore head coach Jesse Minter announced.
news_mentions.body_text: ravens quarterback lamar jackson will undergo surgery after suffering a right thumb injury on his first offensive snap of sunday s 36 10 loss to the buffalo bills baltimore head coach jesse minter announced after the game minter said that jackson will be placed on injured reserve which will sideline the two time mvp at least four games minter said we ll see when asked if jackson s injury could be season ending per espn com jackson who missed the ravens previous three games due to an ankle injury suffered his latest injury when his throwing hand collided with a bills defender on a pass attempt to zay flowers in the first quarter jackson immediately walked to the sideline following the play and was later seen headed to the locker room on the cbs broadcast the ravens qb situation continued to deteriorate after jackson s injury when backup tyler huntley hurt his toe in the first half which thrust undrafted rookie joe fagnano onto the field for the first time this season huntley was ruled out after halftime and espn s adam schefter reported that huntley s injury is believed to be turf toe huntley will undergo an mri exam on monday to determine how much time he could miss schefter added huntley went 2 of 4 for zero yards in limited action on sunday while fagnano went 10 of 21 for 91 yards with an interception the loss dropped baltimore to 4 4 on the season the ravens next face the jacksonville jaguars on thursday night football

news_mentions.headline: Colts' Shane Steichen to 'evaluate everything, every position' after embarrassing loss in Jacksonville
news_mentions.description: The Indianapolis Colts lost their fourth straight game, this one in embarrassing fashion in a 42-7 loss in Jacksonville.
news_mentions.body_text: it s getting dark early in indianapolis the colts suffered another embarrassing loss on sunday getting their doors blown off 42 7 by rival jacksonville already amid a teardown it s the type of loss that puts more jobs in question coach shane steichen sits in the crosshairs after indy already parted ways with general manager chris ballard and traded away quenton nelson and deforest buckner it s one thing to be 2 6 it s a different matter to get walloped by a rival in disheartening fashion for a fourth straight loss it wasn t good enough flat out wasn t good enough steichen said via the indianapolis star we got outcoached we got outplayed and we ve got to freaking learn from our mistakes in a hurry the effort and the energy has to be there every week if not you re going to get beat like that the colts played like a team whose players know there is no coming back this season missed tackles botched offensive plays leading to turnovers ineffective quarterback play questionable play calls everything was a mess those issues fall squarely on steichen clearly i ve got to do a better job plain and simple steichen said it starts with me as the head coach i ve got to do a better job to get these guys ready to go that wasn t it today the question is how much longer steichen is the head coach clearly he couldn t get his players ready for a division opponent after the week of trades might indy be better served severing ties now than waiting until the new year i m focused on getting better steichen said that s what i m focused on right now beyond steichen s future the colts have several big questions between now and next week jonathan taylorcould be traded the rb had a big 19 yard run out of the gate on sunday but did little else the rest of the way earning 23 rushing yards on eight carries and a fumble on a botched trick play the colts may not have wanted to put taylor in harm s way with the trade deadline looming but once indy was down big there was little point in putting more tread on his tires regardless of how things play out then there is daniel jones who has struggled mightily this season on sunday he completed 19 of 28 passes for 144 yards with one touchdown and two interceptions before being sat in the blowout jones play has sunk like a rock this season he has missed passes and gets rattled any time there is pressure he looks like the jones who earned his ticket out of new york in 2024 his dismal play has jump started questions about whether the colts should give anthony richardson a shot i m going to evaluate everything every position going forward steichen said when asked if jones would remain his team s starting quarterback that evaluation should start with how he prepares his team to play

news_mentions.headline: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley assured he won't be traded: 'I want to be one of the reasons why we fix it'
news_mentions.description: The Philadelphia Eagles relayed to star running back Saquon Barkley that he won't be traded before the Nov. 10 deadline
news_mentions.body_text: philadelphia eagles running back saquon barkley was reassured by the front office that he won t be traded ahead of the nov 10 deadline when that message was relayed to me it definitely does mean a lot barkley said following sunday night s 27 10 loss to the washington commanders via espn the whole time my mindset was we have a little issue going on right now and i feel like i m the type of player and the type of leader that can help us get out of it and i want to be one of the reasons why we fix it nfl network reported sunday that the eagles won t trade barkley despite a six game losing skid that has sent them to the bottom of the nfc east barkley wants to stay in philly as they work to turn things around i would love to be here barkley said via the philadelphia inquirer i plan on being here the way the season s going i m not one of those guys that s like oh the season s not going the way we want let s just jump ship that s not the type of person i am barkley s injury issues continue to plague him during the eagles losing streak sunday night he was on a pitch count once again generating 14 total touches 13 carries for 30 yards with a touchdown and one catch for 24 yards on 22 snaps elijah mitchell took the bulk of the snaps 38 i m just frustrated because my mind is there but with the hammy and all that stuff my body s not really where i need it to be right now barkley said but i ve just got to keep grinding rehabbing and just continue to try to get stronger and get better the eagles are expected to be sellers ahead of next tuesday s trade deadline but barkley who signed an extension in philly in 2025 that keeps him under contract through 2028 plans to be around beyond this season

news_mentions.headline: Buccaneers' Todd Bowles on zero-completion win over Falcons: There's a 'first time for everything'
news_mentions.description: The Buccaneers outlasted the Falcons in a rain-soaked affair despite Baker Mayfield attempting only three passes and converting on none of them, becoming the second team in the Super Bowl era to win a game without a single completion.
news_mentions.body_text: conventional wisdom said baker mayfield would need to throw for more than the 64 yards he managed in last week s victory if the buccaneers hoped to begin a winning streak on sunday conventional wisdom was wrong tampa bay instead outlasted the falcons 16 0 in a rain soaked affair at raymond james stadium despite mayfield attempting only three passes and converting on none of them as the bucs became the second team 1974 bills in the super bowl era to win a game without a single completion i have not head coach todd bowles said when asked if he s ever won without a completion per the team s transcript but there is a first time for everything as noted it s the second such occurrence since the league merger but it s certainly a first for bowles who would ve been only 10 years old when the 74 bills accomplished the unthinkable feat a torrential downpour set the stage for such an odd accomplishment the falcons were especially affected by the storm attempting to throw their way through it to disastrous results michael penix tossed three interceptions in the first 18 minutes of the game frequently missing his pass catchers as he delivered a slippery football with little to no authority over its destination tampa bay conversely took to the ground again and again attacking an atlanta defense that entered the weekend fourth against the run i didn t say we were not going to throw the ball the conditions told him that bowles said when asked about game plan discussions with offensive coordinator zac robinson you could see it it s a downpour and the wind was blowing you can kind of see the ball wasn t going anywhere mayfield attempted his first pass with 7 53 remaining in the first quarter nearly a 28 yard touchdown that ted hurst dropped after throwing another pass with 4 10 left in the opening frame he wouldn t record another one until his third snap of the third quarter that was it there was a dropback in the second quarter during which mayfield had the ball slip out his grasp while trying to throw a good representation of the sloppiness that contributed to five fumbles and three ints between the teams but it was otherwise all runs the buccaneers simply didn t need to take any of the risks involved with airing it out further their defense was that stifling and their running game was that dominant bucky irving and kenneth gainwell gashed the falcons for a combined 310 rushing yards on 52 attempts on tampa bay s lone td drive the two combined to go 90 yards on six carries with both breaking off big runs irving for 46 and gainwell for 28 including mayfield s 14 rushing yards the buccaneers set a new franchise single game record with 324 it s winning that s the way i think about it mayfield said we won it s getting our guys lined up making sure we are running the right run plays obviously ball security is crucial in these conditions we had some early ones we decided to go to the shotgun and pistol sets it s just easier to receive the snaps instead of it coming back through your hands under center so going from there and just trying to manage the game it s time management and just trying to bleed the clock as much as possible just get everybody on the same page and go from there that s my job in these conditions and listen i will do whatever it takes to win that s all that matters to me offensive lineman luke goedeke who helped pave the way for tampa bay s historic rushing performance said of mayfield only attempting three passes yeah i mean it s great it s just a testament to the offense the o line the tight ends the wide receivers running backs it s just everyone doing their job and bake he hands off a mean ball so really hats off to him as well the buccaneers have now won two straight both against divisional opponents to inch back to 3 5 they re right in the thick of it in the nfc south knotted in the win column with the falcons 3 5 and panthers who sit atop the standings at 3 4 they ve still got a long ways to go and surely mayfield will be called on to pass a lot more than he did on sunday moving forward but the potential turnaround has begun on the strength of a punishing run game we did a lot to dig ourselves out of it bowles said of being back in contention for the division we re still in it being 3 5 not being 500 or anything else i told them to keep their shovels close because we have a lot more digging to do but it gets us back in it

news_mentions.headline: Lawyers say Packers' Josh Jacobs has 'tangible evidence' disputing allegations from other women
news_mentions.description: Lawyers for Green Bay Packers running back Josh Jacobs say he has a “substantial body of tangible evidence” disputing the allegations three women made against him while police were investigating his battery case.
news_mentions.body_text: lawyers for green bay packers running back josh jacobs say he has a substantial body of tangible evidence disputing the allegations three women made against him while police were investigating his battery case jacobs pleaded no contest on sept 10 to misdemeanor charges of battery and criminal damage to property stemming from a may altercation with his then girlfriend who said he threw her to the ground in response to a public records request the hobart lawrence wisconsin police department released records from their investigation friday night that included the accounts of three other women who reported similar allegations from years before after spending the first six games of the season on the commissioner s exempt list which prevented him from playing or practicing jacobs has returned to play in the packers last two games the nfl has said its investigation into jacobs is ongoing which means he still could be subject to more discipline from the league jacobs lawyers david z chesnoff richard a schonfeld and clarence f duchac issued a statement saturday noting that the brown county district attorney s office had these uncorroborated old and previously unreported allegations for months they issued another statement sunday that went into more detail josh took responsibility for what happened in may the lawyers said he entered into an agreement with prosecutors for two misdemeanors and he is meeting the court s requirements the three accounts are old are hearsay and easily disproven yet released to the media by police without any investigation to determine whether they were accurate or contradicted by evidence josh is answering them in detail because of the character assassination that is occurring unfairly threatening his career jacobs lawyers said that one of the three women made a claim to the nfl which reviewed it and decided no action was warranted they said jacobs has kept evidence that supports his accounts and the nfl s decision the nfl declined comment sunday on the lawyers statement after hobart lawrence police released the records that detailed the accounts from other women nfl spokesman brian mccarthy had said saturday that the league would review these allegations as part of its investigation jacobs lawyers said another woman made a claim only after jacobs had called las vegas police to his home to report her for misconduct jacobs played for the las vegas raiders before joining the packers in 2024 jacobs also denied any physical altercation with the third woman jacobs lawyers said she contacted jacobs to ask to visit came to las vegas and stayed at his home and that another person was present in the house for part of her stay according to the records released friday one woman contacted police after jacobs arrest to say she had experienced a similar incident with him around 2023 she later would say the incident actually occurred on jan 5 2022 the woman said she had communicated with jacobs for about six months before spending around 11 hours at his home the woman said that after she told jacobs she hadn t come there for sex he became angry slapped her and told her not to disrespect him she said he took her phone and threw it into a swimming pool when she attempted to leave and that he grabbed her by the hair threw her onto a bed pinned her down threw her to the floor and said i should kill you right now she said jacobs also spit on her the woman said she hadn t previously reported the incident to law enforcement because she remained friends with jacobs afterward and was concerned her allegations wouldn t be believed the woman said she contacted police this time because she believed it showed a pattern of behavior similar to the allegations in the may case another woman told police she had sex with jacobs in april 2021 the woman said his condom broke so she told jacobs to get tested for sexually transmitted diseases because they both had been involved with other people the woman said jacobs later removed her from the residence grabbed her by the arms and bicep area pushed her against a wall and threw her belongings out she told police that she sustained bruises to her arms and swelling in her rib area hobart lawrence police said they obtained records from that incident indicating that officers observed no visible signs of injury bruising or damage consistent with a physical altercation another woman said she met jacobs through social media and that he flew her to a residence in may 2022 she described an altercation in which jacobs grabbed her by the hair placed his hands on her head and neck dragged her scratched her chest and took her phone after it fell to the floor she said she didn t report the incident to police because she wasn t a u s citizen at the time and jacobs told her she could be deported jacobs was arrested may 26 three days after hobart lawrence police officers came to his wisconsin home to investigate a disturbance according to police the woman told them jacobs grabbed her and threw her to the ground as she was trying to exit a garage door causing her to hit her head police said jacobs also took her phone from her while she was on the ground police said they noticed redness on her face and neck and could feel a bump on the back of her head according to a criminal complaint the woman s statement was corroborated by surveillance footage from the camera system in the garage where the incident occurred both jacobs and the victim have gone to court in an attempt to permanently seal evidence from the case including video footage copyright 2026 the associated press

news_mentions.headline: Notable injuries, news from Sunday's Week 8 games: Cardinals bench QB Jacoby Brissett vs. Cowboys
news_mentions.description: Here are the injuries and news developments we're monitoring around the league on this Week 8 Sunday.

news_mentions.headline: Wu-Tang Clan to headline Thanksgiving halftime show for Bears-Lions game at Ford Field
news_mentions.description: The Lions announced that the 87th annual Thanksgiving Day Classic on Thurs., Nov. 26 against the Bears will feature Wu-Tang Clan as headliner of the Thanksgiving Halftime Show powered by Verizon.
news_mentions.body_text: the detroit lions announced today that the 87th annual thanksgiving day classic on thursday nov 26 against the chicago bears will feature wu tang clan as headliner of the thanksgiving halftime show powered by verizon film television and broadway actor and recording artist antonio cipriano will perform the national anthem this marks the second year of a multi year partnership where global rap icon eminem and his long time manager and president of shady records paul rosenberg will serve as executive producers of the show and select the talent the detroit lions thanksgiving day classic presented by ford will be nationally televised on cbs at 1 p m et our thanksgiving day classic is one of the greatest traditions in sports and wu tang clan is one of the greatest performers in music said rich haddad detroit lions president and ceo we are thrilled to have wu tang headlining our thanksgiving halftime show and grateful to marshall and paul for their partnership the lions thanksgiving day classic halftime show performance arrives as wu tang clan wraps its global farewell tour wu tang forever the final chamber and on the heels of the group being inducted into the rock roll hall of fame wu tang clan has released eight group albums three of them quadruple platinum releases and the collective s full catalog including solo projects spans more than 85 full length releases beyond music the members have built a cultural empire that includes clothing lines videogames books and film and television work wu tang clan has toured as a unit since its debut in 1993 founded on staten island new york in the early 1990s wu tang clan is rza gza method man raekwon ghostface killah u god masta killa inspectah deck cappadonna and the late ol dirty bastard odb we often like to do things that are both exciting and unexpected a wu tang clan thanksgiving performance in detroit certainly fits that description said paul rosenberg president of shady records both eminem and myself have been wu fans since the early 90 s along with a whole generation of detroit football fans and we are honored to bring them to this year s stage cipriano a grosse pointe woods mi native can currently be seen playing john logan in the amazon prime hit series off campus on stage he appeared on broadway at the broadhurst theatre in jagged little pill as phoenix cipriano won the 2017 sutton foster ovation award for best high school theater actor and was a finalist in the 2017 nhsmta jimmy awards his newly released single babydoll with singer jamie miller just hit 1 on the uk singles charts

news_mentions.headline: NFL Network: Eagles won't trade RB Saquon Barkley ahead of Nov. 10 deadline
news_mentions.description: If GM Howie Roseman is willing to wheel and deal in the coming weeks, at least one major name won't be on the move. The Eagles will not be trading former Offensive Player of the Year Saquon Barkley.
news_mentions.body_text: as the eagles losses continue to pile up the nov 10 trade deadline nears begging the question will philadelphia sell its stars if general manager howie roseman is willing to wheel and deal in the coming weeks at least one major name won t be on the move the eagles will not be trading former offensive player of the year saquon barkley nfl network insiders mike garafolo and ian rapoport reported sunday barkley is under contract through the 2028 season in philadelphia making him an attractive trade piece but the eagles are set to retain the star running back amid what is turning out to be a lost season while philly has stumbled to a 2 5 start due to a confluence of poor play injuries a retirement and trades barkley has underperformed in his five games played while missing two games with a hamstring injury the 29 year old rb has tallied 244 yards and a touchdown on 43 carries in those appearances topping out at 80 yards from scrimmage in a game barkley s most recent appearance on monday night against dallas was cut short due to a back issue that resulted from compensating for the hamstring injury that held him out the previous two games barkley logged just nine snaps picking up 71 yards on nine touches the eagles rb said his hamstring came out great after the game but barkley missed most of practice this week before returning on friday he is off the injury report for sunday night s game against washington the eagles have already participated in a trade this season sending center cam jurgens to baltimore earlier this month other players possibly at risk of being dealt by nov 10 are tight end dallas goedert linebacker zack baun and defensive lineman moro ojomo barkley however is staying put as roseman and the eagles look to rebuild on the fly as their season spirals out of control barkley and philly take on the commanders 1 4 1 at 8 20 p m et on sunday

news_mentions.headline: Seahawks RB Zach Charbonnet (knee) off injury report, set for season debut vs. Bears
news_mentions.description: Seahawks running back Zach Charbonnet (knee) has no designation ahead of Monday's game against the Bears and is set to make his season debut.
news_mentions.body_text: zach charbonnet will make his long awaited return in prime time the seahawks running back has no designation ahead of monday s game against the bears and is set to play coming off a torn acl rookie jadarian price also has no injury designation ahead of the showdown though he is currently on injured reserve after missing the past four weeks with a chest injury and would still need to be activated to face chicago if we were to make a move i think that would happen on monday to my knowledge head coach mike macdonald said regarding activating price so we ll see if that s what we do we ve got some things going on roster wise that we re working through right now charbonnet and price both logged two full practices and one limited session this week charbonnet has made an impressively speedy recovery after tearing his acl during seattle s divisional round win over the 49ers on jan 17 he ll suit up just nine months and change post injury the 25 year old served as seattle s power back last year tallying 730 rushing yards and a team leading 12 rushing touchdowns while splitting work alongside kenneth walker with walker now a member of the chiefs charbonnet will mix back into a backfield that s been led by emanuel wilson and george holani the past couple weeks wilson has made the most of his opportunity he has three rushing touchdowns and 403 rushing yards on the season buoyed by his 100 yard effort on the ground in seattle s week 7 win over the chiefs while walker was held to 36 yards against his former squad holani has 108 yards and a score on 36 carries the group will face a difficult test as chicago ranks third in the league in defending the run price the no 32 overall pick in the 2026 draft is roughly in the same ballpark as holani stat wise he s seen 28 carries for 119 yards in what s been a slow start to his rookie year the seahawks have another couple of days to move him to the active roster if that s what they choose to do chicago 5 2 and seattle 4 3 square off at 8 15 p m et on monday night football

news_mentions.headline: Broncos RB Jonah Coleman 'ready for any opportunity' vs. Chiefs with RJ Harvey ruled out
news_mentions.description: Broncos running back Jonah Coleman didn't log a carry against the Chiefs in Denver's season-opening loss. That's in line to change heading into the team's Week 8 rematch, especially now that RJ Harvey (knee) has been ruled out.
news_mentions.body_text: broncos running back jonah coleman didn t log a carry against the chiefs in denver s season opening loss that s in line to change heading into the team s week 8 rematch especially after denver ruled out rj harvey knee and on saturday placed him on injured reserve i m ready for any opportunity i m given coleman said friday via the denver post whenever i m out there on the field i m going to give the team my all coleman commandeered the rb snap share last week during a win over the cardinals his first game back after a stint on ir due to a high ankle sprain he played 28 offensive snaps compared to harvey and j k dobbins combined 26 and he was by far denver s most efficient runner in the contest he turned nine carries into 54 yards 6 0 yards per carry while dobbins had 23 yards on six carries 3 8 ypc and harvey managed only 6 yards on three attempts 2 0 ypc of course dobbins and harvey both scored a td with dobbins plunging in from the 1 and harvey breaking free untouched on a magnificent 52 yard reception but coleman s usage was notable coming directly off an injury during the week 2 game against the jaguars in which coleman injured his ankle another game harvey missed he similarly led the running backs with 25 snaps on offense dobbins saw 19 and tyler badie currently on ir was on the field for 15 coleman and dobbins each handled 10 carries apiece that day with coleman going for 39 yards and a score while dobbins had 36 coleman also collected three receptions for 19 yards might the split lean even more coleman s way in a second game sans harvey it s certainly possible the rookie is now another month plus into his first season and he just handled 50 of the play time versus arizona when each member of denver s three pronged rushing attack was active more importantly though will whatever workload coleman receives help tilt the results in denver s favor after he went without a touch in the broncos week 1 loss to kansas city that opening defeat was a complete drubbing a 31 10 statement by the 2026 chiefs in response to the 2025 broncos snapping their nine year streak of afc west titles but a win by denver on sunday would propel coleman and co the top of the division for the first time this season it s definitely going to feel good to play against the chiefs coleman said obviously they re no 1 in the division and that s where we want to be

news_mentions.headline: Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love 'back to myself' after two-game absence, eager to set tone vs. Cowboys
news_mentions.description: Jeremiyah Love is back and feeling better ahead of the Cardinals' Week 8 game against the Cowboys, noting that two weeks of rest helped him get back to himself after dealing with an ankle injury.
news_mentions.body_text: jeremiyah love is back and feeling better ahead of the cardinals week 8 game against the cowboys following a two game absence to rest his ailing ankle the rookie running back finally feels more like himself hopefully now able to contribute in full to a rushing attack that ranks 23rd in the nfl the rest was needed love said friday via the team website it helped me get back to myself the lessened version of love came about due to a sprained ankle in his first preseason game then another tweak in week 2 against the seahawks his injury affected him over the next three contests before arizona elected to sit him down so he could get right really the whole season i haven t been able to feel like myself love explained i haven t felt like jeremiyah love that the people see i couldn t do what i wanted to do you ain t see me hurdle anybody any f spin move none of that stuff although he s certainly made splashes here and there love hasn t hit the ground running in the same way he or others might have envisioned for the no 3 overall pick the 21 year old who rushed for 2 497 yards with a 6 9 yards per carry average and scored 40 total touchdowns over his last two seasons at notre dame has 245 yards and an end zone trip on 67 attempts 3 7 ypc in five outings with the cards he s also added another 11 catches for 36 yards and a td the production dip is a product of facing better talent but it s also been clear that love was hampered by an injury he nonetheless leads the team in rushing despite missing two games tyler allgeier has often been stymied managing only 2 9 yards per tote for 176 yards and a touchdown while bam knight has filled in admirably in recent weeks with 25 carries for 160 yards against the cowboys they all have a chance to attack a rushing defense that currently stands as the worst in the league we have to be the tone setters love said we are growing the identity as a running back room that we have to go out and set the tone we have to be the backbone of the offense love has confidence in arizona s corps of ball carriers and with seemingly a clean bill of health is ready to put words into action i ain t myself if i ain t got my ankles love said he s got his ankles back next on the agenda is snatching some from dallas defenders come sunday afternoon

news_mentions.headline: Patriots rule out A.J. Brown (ankle/knee), TreVeyon Henderson (illness) for Sunday vs. Dolphins
news_mentions.description: Not long after he returned from injured reserve, the New England Patriots will again be without wide receiver A.J. Brown on Sunday. Brown has been downgraded to out for New England's game against the Miami Dolphins, the team announced Saturday.
news_mentions.body_text: not long after he returned from injured reserve the new england patriots will again be without wide receiver a j brown on sunday brown has been downgraded to out for new england s game against the miami dolphins the team announced saturday the 29 year old wideout missed four games previously with a high ankle sprain and although the ankle ailment is still included on the injury report the reason brown missed the past two days of practices was due to a knee issue flaring up according to nfl network insider ian rapoport brown received a questionable designation on friday but it was determined on saturday that he d be unable to go meaning he ll have appeared in three of new england s first eight games after coming to foxborough via offseason trade from the philadelphia eagles running back treveyon henderson illness and offensive tackle marcus bryant who practiced in full all week with an ankle injury were also both ruled out brown s tenure in new england has not at all gotten off to the start so many had hoped for he s caught only three passes in each of his three games bringing his tally nearing the midway point of the season to nine receptions for 101 yards his speed and movement looked to still be somewhat affected by his high ankle sprain the past two weeks as he s averaged 8 3 yards per reception since returning a far cry from his career average of 15 3 yards per catch with romeo doubs new england s other big offseason acquisition at wr on injured reserve drake maye will need to turn to demario douglas efton chism and kyle williams a heavy dose of rhamondre stevenson can also be expected in henderson s absence plus a mixing in of corey kiner the pats are banged up but they face an exploitable miami defense that ranks 25th in points allowed it s important they still find ways to capitalize and win they re coming off a loss and sitting at 4 3 want to avoid falling any farther behind the afc east leading buffalo bills 5 1 new england squares off against miami at 4 25 p m et on sunday

news_mentions.headline: NFL Network: Colts willing to trade RB Jonathan Taylor; talks are active, ongoing
news_mentions.description: The Indianapolis Colts are open to trading Jonathan Taylor, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport and ESPN's Adam Schefter reported, adding that multiple teams have reached out to Indy and discussions are active and ongoing.
news_mentions.body_text: one of the best running backs in the nfl is definitively available the indianapolis colts are open to trading jonathan taylor nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter reported saturday adding that multiple teams have reached out to indy and discussions are active and ongoing rapoport and schefter identified the denver broncos green bay packers minnesota vikings new york giants and seattle seahawks as clubs that have shown some level of interest in the three time pro bowler per sources it was previously reported that colts ownership didn t want to trade the star ball carrier but while the organization would still prefer for him to be part of its rebuild indianapolis trajectory is very much that of a trade deadline seller in fact the colts are ahead of schedule in that regard just this week with the nov 10 deadline still a ways away they shipped guard quenton nelson to the seahawks and defensive lineman deforest buckner to the 49ers wide receiver josh downs also requested a trade though his ask doesn t seem entirely necessary considering the colts are already wheeling and dealing anyway the moves come with the colts sitting at 2 5 having fired general manager chris ballard after a loss to the previously winless tennessee titans in week 6 taylor for his part recently said he s proud to be with the colts but acknowledged the possibility a trade might occur such a transaction would represent a seismic shift both for indianapolis and whatever team landed him taylor who has rushed for 587 yards and a league leading eight touchdowns this season has amassed 9 832 total yards and 84 tds over his seven year career he signed a two year 44 million extension just this august meaning the 27 year old wouldn t just be a rental for a club making a championship push he s an expensive addition third among running backs at 22 million per year but he s in his prime and under contract through 2028 any team would be made instantly better by adding him and after being reticent to part with him the colts have apparently opened the door a bit more to making it happen

news_mentions.headline: NFL Network: Packers, Micah Parsons (knee) targeting Thanksgiving Eve return vs. Rams
news_mentions.description: The Packers and Micah Parsons are targeting Green Bay's Thanksgiving Eve game against the Rams as the first game the three-time All-Pro will take the field since tearing his ACL in Week 15 of last year, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport reported.
news_mentions.body_text: there s now a clear date in mind for micah parsons s return the packers and parsons are targeting green bay s thanksgiving eve showdown with the rams as the first game the three time all pro will take the field for since tearing his acl in week 15 of last year nfl network insider ian rapoport reported parsons who is currently on the physically unable to perform list is expected to start practicing next week per rapoport who added the team plans to have him participate in individual drills during his first week back before moving on to team drills the following week assuming all goes well green bay then has a week 11 bye before a matchup with los angeles on nov 25 parsons has been working his way back from the torn acl as well as a meniscus repair at his pace ensuring he s fully healthy when he takes the field rather than rushing back before his body is ready green bay has held serve adequately enough without him although they currently sit at the bottom of the nfc north the packers are 5 3 and their defense has been far from a weakness the unit has held opponents to 20 or fewer points in five straight outings has proven opportunistic with 15 takeaways and only two days ago wrecked a leaky panthers offensive line to score six sacks while pressuring bryce young on 48 9 of his dropbacks returning a talent of parsons caliber will presumably elevate green bay s d to another level though the 27 year old pass rusher logged at least 12 sacks in each of his first five seasons in the league including a 12 5 sack campaign while making the pro bowl and all pro team during his first year in green bay despite missing the club s final three games the provided timeline for parsons return currently has him missing two more games week 9 at the patriots and week 10 versus the vikings if the packers find another win or two ahead of their bye they could come out of it in good shape as their star defender hopefully returns for the stretch run

news_mentions.headline: Other women contacted police about previous incidents with Packers’ Josh Jacobs; NFL will review allegations
news_mentions.description: As police investigated whether to file charges against Green Bay Packers running back Josh Jacobs following a May altercation with his then-girlfriend, multiple other women contacted them to detail their own allegations against him.
news_mentions.body_text: as police investigated the battery case involving green bay packers running back josh jacobs following a may altercation with his then girlfriend multiple other women contacted them to detail their own allegations against him those accounts were included in evidence regarding jacobs battery case that the hobart lawrence police department released friday night in response to a public records request green bay tv station nbc 26 first reported the records release jacobs pleaded no contest on sept 10 to misdemeanor counts of battery and criminal damage to property he was arrested may 26 three days after an incident in which a woman said he threw her to the ground it s unclear how the latest allegations will play into the nfl s investigation into jacobs the league placed him on the commissioner s exempt list in august after charges were filed against him and that caused jacobs to miss the packers first six games of the season nfl spokesman brian mccarthy said saturday that the league would review these allegations as part of its investigation which has remained open jacobs lawyers david z chesnoff richard a schonfeld and clarence f duchac issued a statement saturday on their client s behalf the brown county district attorney s office had these uncorroborated old and previously unreported allegations for months they conducted their own exhaustive investigation along with the police department and the d a determined that only two misdemeanor charges were warranted they then entered into a plea agreement with josh jacobs josh has repeatedly expressed his remorse and is honoring the terms of the agreement the packers had no immediate comment according to the records released friday one woman contacted police after jacobs arrest to say she had experienced a similar incident with him around 2023 she later would say the incident actually occurred on jan 5 2022 the woman said she had communicated with jacobs for about six months before spending around 11 hours at his home the woman said that after she told jacobs she hadn t come there for sex he became angry slapped her across the face and told her not to disrespect him she said he took her phone and threw it into a swimming pool when she attempted to leave and that he grabbed her by the hair threw her onto a bed pinned her down threw her to the floor and said i should kill you right now she said jacobs also spit on her the woman said she hadn t previously reported the incident to law enforcement because she remained friends with jacobs afterward and was concerned her allegations wouldn t be believed the woman said she contacted police this time because she believed it showed a pattern of behavior similar to the allegations in the may case another woman told police she had sex with jacobs in april 2021 the woman said his condom broke so she told jacobs to get tested for sexually transmitted diseases because they both had been involved with other people the woman said jacobs later removed her from the residence grabbed her by the arms and bicep area pushed her against a wall and threw her belongings out she told police that she sustained bruises to her arms and swelling in her rib area hobart lawrence police said they obtained records from that incident indicating that officers observed no visible signs of injury bruising or damage consistent with a physical altercation another woman said she met jacobs through social media and that he flew her to a residence in may 2022 she described an altercation in which jacobs grabbed her by the hair placed his hands on her head and neck dragged her scratched her chest and took her phone after it fell to the floor the woman said she got bruises on her arm and scratches to her chest and neck she said she didn t report the incident to police because she wasn t a u s citizen at the time and jacobs told her she could be deported jacobs is a three time pro bowl selection who led the nfl in rushing in 2022 for the las vegas raiders where he played when the three previous incidents were alleged to have occurred he joined the packers in 2024 he returned two weeks ago and scored twice in the team s thursday night win over the carolina panthers celebrating one of the touchdowns by briefly placing his hands behind his back the move drew immediate backlash from viewers in light of his offseason arrest but jacobs said he was modeling his celebration after a gospel song called break every chain the records released friday also offered more details of the may 23 incident that led to jacobs arrest according to the criminal complaint released in august the woman told them that jacobs grabbed her and threw her to the ground as she was trying to exit a garage door causing her to hit her head police said jacobs also took her phone from her while she was on the ground the records released friday noted the woman said that while they were still in the home jacobs lunged at her pinned her on the bed with his body weight on her chest and put his hand on her mouth and nose so that she felt she couldn t breathe she also indicated that she believed she lost consciousness for a brief time when the confrontation moved to the garage copyright associated press 2026

news_mentions.headline: New Bears DT Jeffery Simmons understands Super Bowl goal in Chicago: 'They want it right now'
news_mentions.description: Jeffery Simmons has gone from cellar-dweller to title contender in one week. The magnitude of the moment was not lost on him when he learned he was leaving the Tennessee Titans for the Chicago Bears.
news_mentions.body_text: jeffery simmons has gone from cellar dweller to title contender in one week the magnitude of the moment was not lost on him when he learned he was leaving tennessee for the chicago bears the trade told me everything i needed to know especially the value from giving away two first round picks simmons said friday i could also look on the other side of that and be like man i just got traded but i could also look at the bright side of things of this team believes in what they have here and they want it right now if a mid season acquisition wasn t enough to send such a signal the two first round picks the bears sent to the titans certainly did it was a bit out of character for general manager ryan poles who hasn t built his reputation on sending significant draft capital for an instant return but the circumstances called for it with quarterback caleb williams playing on a rookie contract and the bears title window being as open as it might ever be poles knew it was time to take a big swing with the hopes of hitting a lombardi trophy sized home run you do this type of move when you have a combination of an impact player on the grass as well as someone that can enhance your culture as well poles explained friday i don t think it can be either or when you talk about a move this size you need to have both and that s what jeffery does we believe he s going to impact us at a high level on the grass but also in the locker room too a wary bears fan might point to the trade as a major risk in theory it is sending future high value picks elsewhere in exchange for a talent who can instantly upgrade an area of need for the bears is a win now move that carries the possibility of mortgaging the future for the present much of that fear exists in a hypothetical realm though first round picks are only as valuable as the players on which a team spends its selections poles believes his front office has proven itself worthy of making such a move and he expects his personnel department to capitalize on the team s remaining picks one thing i want to hit i know it s kind of a joke that kind of goes around but like f them picks is a big thing poles said referencing the los angeles rams win now style of roster construction that s really not what we re about i know it took a lot to get this done but we absolutely believe that the draft and bringing young talent is a way that you sustain success around here i m challenging myself and our crew for the picks that we do have we have to hit we have to be great with our undrafted free agent process and whatever tier of free agency we re working in which will have constraints we got to hit there too we have a good track record it continues to get better every year so i ve got a lot of faith that we ll be able to get that done and again sustain success those are largely tomorrow s problems it s week 8 in the 2026 season the bears are 5 2 in a highly competitive nfc north and they need to be as strong as possible if they hope to repeat as division champions poles made the simmons trade with this in mind and as the paperwork was filed to the league office in new york simmons quickly understood the intent my game my passion my energy my leadership i can only help this team even more than what it s got he said this is a great locker room from quarterback all the way down my job is not trying to come in here and be nothing than but myself i m excited to be able to help this team compete for a championship that s every team in the nfl s goal i think right now with the way this team has been competing i ve been watching these guys from afar it s a great team great locker room and i m excited to do my part to help this team get to its goal

news_mentions.headline: 2026 NFL trade deadline: Potential landing spots for RB Jonathan Taylor, S Budda Baker and more
news_mentions.description: With the trade deadline set for 4 p.m. ET on Tuesday, Nov. 10, Bucky Brooks spotlights eight useful players who could be on the block, providing three practical team fits for each. Where might RB Jonathan Taylor, S Budda Baker and WR Brian Thomas Jr. end up?
news_mentions.body_text: former nfl player and scout bucky brooks knows the ins and outs of this league providing keen insight in his notebook in today s installment he spotlights eight useful players who could be on the trade block with the trade deadline set for 4 p m et on tuesday nov 10 the window is closing for contenders to fill pressing needs with proven veterans today i m digging into a series of notable players who could be available examining what each brings to the table for possible suitors and then i m playing matchmaker identifying three practical team fits for each potential trade candidate

news_mentions.headline: NFL Week 8 fantasy sleepers: QB Sam Darnold, RB Rico Dowdle, WR Ja'Kobi Lane among upside plays
news_mentions.description: Will Sam Darnold enjoy his best performance in weeks against the Bears on Monday night? Which two receivers have sneaky upside? Raza Umerani highlights nine sleepers to consider for your fantasy football lineup in Week 8.
news_mentions.body_text: fantasy football is a lot like trick or treating oftentimes you put together what you think is an excellent costume like having a great draft on paper only to realize that it s falling apart at the seams akin to fantasy busts and injuries some candies are can t miss classics jahmyr gibbs is m m s jaxon smith njigba is snickers josh allen is kitkat others leave a little to be desired but every year there s a candy that s handed out at one or two houses that wiggles down to the bottom of your pillow case you don t initially notice it amidst all the twix and mars bars but once you find it you re pleasantly surprised enough to go buy more from the store for me back in my halloween heyday that candy was milk duds no i won t apologize these sleepers are that proverbial candy of your choice they might not be reese s peanut butter cups or milky ways but they ll do enough to satisfy you over halloween weekend and perhaps beyond note all statistics come courtesy of next gen stats unless otherwise noted quarterbacks running backs wide receivers tight end defenses

news_mentions.body_text: here are the injuries and news developments we re monitoring around the league on this week 7 sunday baltimore ravens guard olaivavega ioane knee was ruled out of sunday s loss to cincinnati carolina panthers offensive tackle taylor moton suffered a fractured fibula in sunday s loss to tampa bay and will be out for a while head coach dave canales said cincinnati bengals tight end erick all knee and safety kyle dugger quadricep were ruled out of sunday s win over baltimore cleveland browns cornerback myles harden hamstring did not return to sunday s win over tennessee detroit lions cornerback ennis rakestraw ankle did not return to sunday s win over the packers green bay packers center sean rhyan ankle and offensive lineman jacob monk quad did not return to sunday s loss to the lions houston texans wide receiver jaylin noel has a turf toe injury head coach demeco ryans told reporters after sunday s loss to the giants las vegas raiders defensive end patrick johnson stinger neck did not return to sunday s loss to the rams miami dolphins cornerback julius brents stinger did not return to sunday s win over the jets minnesota vikings running back aaron jones knee did not return to sunday s win over indianapolis new orleans saints safety justin reid concussion and running back cj donaldson shoulder were ruled out of sunday s loss to pittsburgh in paris new york giants running back tyrone tracy hamstring did not return to sunday s win over houston running back cam skattebo said after the game that he felt something in his hamstring on his 42 yard run in overtime skattebo added that he did not slide on purpose on the play per espn new york jets defensive tackle t 39 vondre sweat knee was ruled out of sunday s loss to miami seattle seahawks wide receiver rashid shaheed knee was ruled out against the chiefs rb velus jones hamstring was also ruled out

news_mentions.headline: Notable injuries, news from Sunday's Week 6 games: Bills S C.J. Gardner-Johnson ejected
news_mentions.description: Here are the injuries and news developments we're monitoring around the league on this Week 6 Sunday.
news_mentions.body_text: here are the injuries and news developments we re monitoring around the league on this week 6 sunday atlanta falcons linebacker divine deablo arm was ruled out of sunday s loss to chicago linebacker kendal daniels neck was ruled out after he exited the game on a stretcher in the third quarter the falcons later announced that daniels is alert and has movement in his extremities daniels was taken to a local hospital for further evaluation baltimore ravens wide receiver rashod bateman shoulder was ruled out of sunday s loss to cleveland buffalo bills safety c j gardner johnson was ejected in the second quarter of sunday s game after appearing to spit at a raiders player chicago bears offensive lineman jonah jackson hip did not return to sunday s win over atlanta cleveland browns safety grant delpit concussion was ruled out of sunday s win over baltimore dallas cowboys wide receiver kavontae turpin rib was ruled out of sunday s game against the packers lb dee winters ankle did not return against the packers green bay packers cb brandon cisse stinger did not return against the cowboys houston texans safety reed blankenship concussion was ruled out of sunday s win over jacksonville indianapolis colts cornerback sauce gardner calf did not return to sunday s loss to tennessee jacksonville jaguars safety antonio johnson ankle did not return to sunday s loss to houston kansas city chiefs right tackle jaylon moore left sunday s game against the chargers and is in the concussion protocol per the team cornerback christian roland wallace was ejected in the fourth quarter after appearing to throw a punch at a chargers player los angeles chargers wide receiver ladd mcconkey and defensive back deane leonard were ruled out of sunday s game against kansas city after suffering concussions los angeles rams kicker blake grupe who was signed this week to replace harrison mevis suffered a knee injury in the first quarter and was ruled out against the cardinals new england patriots wide receiver romeo doubs shoulder and guard alijah vera tucker hamstring were ruled out of sunday s win over the jets offensive tackle morgan moses ankle and center ben brown knee were also ruled out new orleans saints guard cesar ruiz knee did not return to sunday s win over the giants new york giants cornerback greg newsome concussion was ruled out of sunday s loss to the saints wide receiver darnell mooney neck also did not return new york jets linebacker kiko mauigoa thigh did not return to sunday s loss to new england philadelphia eagles linebacker nolan smith was ruled out after suffering a concussion in the first half of sunday s loss to carolina defensive tackle jordan davis ankle and running back carson steele shoulder were also ruled out tennessee titans safety tony adams ankle did not return to sunday s win over indianapolis

news_mentions.headline: Christian McCaffrey: Absence from practices was 'part of the plan from the jump'
news_mentions.description: San Francisco 49ers running back Christian McCaffrey returned to practice on Sunday for the first time since Aug. 8.
news_mentions.body_text: george kittle getting activated from the physically unable to perform list wasn t the only positive news from san francisco on sunday star 49ers running back christian mccaffrey also returned to the practice field cmc participated in team drills for the first time since aug 8 as he dealt with tightness for a fortnight the running back said that the time off was part of the plan to ensure he s ready for another long season obviously when you don t practice the way the media works now is a firestorm mccaffrey said via nbc sports bay area this was kind of part of the plan from the jump to ramp up pretty big get nine or 10 practices in kind of come back down and then ramp up again so we re fresh for the duration our staff has done a great job of coming up with specific plans and i feel great i feel fresh and it s great to get back out there with mccaffrey sitting out practices rumors began to fly from questions about his injury status to speculation that his absence was contract related interestingly the 49ers brass could have simply said the rb s absence was a plan of sorts from the beginning but did not mccaffrey dismissed the stories and noted that sometimes he needs to be protected from his own competitive nature sometimes i can probably be my own worst enemy in how much i love being out there mccaffrey said i want to run i want to go i want every play i m a competitor i love it and i think when you have people smarter than you that understand not just what you ve been through but what we plan on doing this season it s about being fresh for the duration and it s about 17 sundays and god willing more weeks after that following an injury plagued 2024 season in which he played just four games cmc touched the pigskin 413 times including 311 carries a career high last season managing the offseason makes sense for a player vital to the niners success in 2026

news_mentions.headline: NFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for 49ers, Cardinals, Rams, Seahawks
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Arizona Cardinals, Los Angeles Rams, San Francisco 49ers and Seattle Seahawks.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers and seattle seahawks catch up on each nfc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks three key storylines 1 sorting out brissett s contract drama installing rookie head coach mike lafleur s offense certainly hasn t gone off without a hitch jacoby brissett who took the quarterbacking reins from an injured kyler murray last season and never gave them back is the presumed starter and wants to get paid like one having skipped voluntary workouts brissett reported for mandatory minicamp to avoid fines but just how much actual work he got in isn t all that apparent will brissett hold out or hold in during training camp that threatens to become a prevailing topic in arizona even if it all gets sorted out the whole matter of getting ready for the football season remains lafleur has downplayed brissett s lack of offseason involvement citing the 33 year old s experience in the league but this is hardly a splendid way to kick off your head coaching career the good news is brissett threw for a career best 3 366 yards in 12 starts during a tumultuous 3 14 season in 2025 if the journeyman settles harmoniously into lafleur s offense perhaps improvement or at least a little excitement lies ahead for the cards 2 a whole lotta love right jeremiyah love could be the most anticipated 2026 rookie in the league at least on the offensive side all due respect to no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza but love s talent and eye popping ability is off the charts so much so that the cardinals used the third overall selection of the draft on him guaranteeing the 21 year old more money than any running back in nfl history there were plenty of question marks with the pick though the cardinals have holes aplenty on their roster but having signed tyler allgeier as a free agent and bringing back veteran banger james conner running back was far from the most glaring weakness in the end love was just too special a talent to pass up so how will lafleur handle his rookie love has made it clear he s a team first guy and on the franchise s current timeline immediately using love as a bell cow might not be wise even if it makes sense monetarily and to a fan base that would love to do nothing more than get behind a bona fide star we shall see 3 time for a new era over the previous two years the cardinals plucked three first round picks wide receiver marvin harrison 2024 no 4 overall and defensive linemen darius robinson 2024 no 27 and walter nolen 2025 no 16 that trio has combined to play 53 of a potential 85 games robinson 21 games in two years and nolen six games as a rookie have combined for four sacks and 12 starts harrison 103 receptions 1 493 yards and 12 touchdowns in 29 games has likely been the most disappointing seen as a can t miss selection who s floundered or at the least failed to live up to his pedigree as a top five pick after seven seasons kyler murray is gone after three years jonathan gannon is gone there s a new coach in lafleur and whether it s brissett more than likely gardner minshew or rookie carson beck there will be a new week 1 starting quarterback love looks every bit the can t miss sensation harrison seemed to be it s pivotal for the homegrown talent to blossom staying healthy is the first step meshing with lafleur is the next and that ll begin in earnest later this month back to top three key storylines 1 refacing defense around garrett the rams don t mess around when it comes to making a super bowl push having traded for then broncos pass rusher von miller before adding wide receiver odell beckham ahead of their run to super bowl lvi triumph the rams shook up this offseason by trading for myles garrett already an all time pass rushing great who s coming off a year in which he set a new single season sack record that move put an enormous cherry on top of an already rich roster but you can t crown a champion before the super bowl and just how well garrett meshes in defensive coordinator chris shula s system will be something to monitor during camp shula s already stated he s going to let garrett do what he does best while still sticking to his schematic principles byron young team high 12 sacks kobie turner seven and braden fiske three combined for 22 sacks last season with garrett s record breaking 23 ostensibly replacing jared verse s 7 5 as verse was sent to the browns nothing s easy in the nfl though this isn t copy and paste under former cleveland defensive coordinator jim schwartz garrett was a one man pass rushing gang racking up 51 sacks over the past three seasons he s arguably the finest quarterback menace of this century just how brightly he ll shine in l a will start to come into focus over the next few weeks 2 time to make the offseason count if there were offseason trophies to hand out los angeles would likely be first in line still for as loaded as this roster is it s imperative the rams stiff arm distractions and keep their heads from getting too high into the clouds puka nacua has a looming potentially top of the market extension and he needs to continue working on himself after a stint in rehab l a already caused a stir when it shocked the nfl world by drafting quarterback ty simpson with the 13th overall pick simpson who remains unsigned is battling it out with stetson bennett to back up reigning mvp matthew stafford who s coming back for his age 38 season there were also trade rumblings regarding davante adams but it seems like those are in the past meanwhile the rams added cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson from the chiefs corners who shine in kansas city don t always star elsewhere speaking of the chiefs their head coach andy reid once helmed an eagles squad dubbed the dream team after a haul of splendid offseason adds said dream team nightmarishly missed the playoffs nothing from an nfl offseason is guaranteed this l a story is all about winning a super bowl no reason for subplots with so much potential for greatness sean mcvay needs to keep his boys eyes on the prize 3 even with the reigning mvp rams have offensive questions regardless of how long in the tooth stafford is the 2025 nfl mvp is still brilliant in the arm like few others in the league he can spin it and make the mesmerizing look normal his league leading 4 707 yards and 46 touchdown tosses last season came with a talented but shallow receiver stable nacua led the nfl with 129 receptions adams contributed 60 grabs with an nfl high 14 going for tds l a didn t have another receiver with more than 18 catches that s one of the reasons drafting simpson when wide receivers makai lemon kc concepcion and omar cooper were still available was so puzzling konata mumpfield jordan whittington and sixth round rookie cj daniels could be the main depth pieces at wr leaders of the league s 13 personnel movement the rams have a staggering herd of tight ends with the most notable being colby parkinson tyler higbee terrance ferguson and rookie max klare ferguson only caught 11 passes as a rookie but he and parkinson could offer the most upside in the receiving game the nfl s no 1 offense in 2025 is expected to run it back in precision form but some fine tuning might lay ahead back to top three key storylines 1 getting healthy staying healthy is key conspiracy theorists can place the blame on electromagnetic fields from a nearby substation but for whatever reason injury woes have plagued kyle shanahan s squads for years niners starters missed north of 50 games in 2025 at the moment the anticipated returns of defensive end nick bosa torn acl missed 14 games tight end george kittle hamstring tear ankle sprain achilles tear six games and linebacker fred warner broken and dislocated ankle 11 games are atop the queue san francisco went 12 5 last season and advanced to the divisional round with those three who are each perennially regarded as among the best at their respective positions missing significant time warner is good to go bosa expects to be ready around the start of camp and kittle is working to return for week 1 however maintaining health is the key christian mccaffrey missed 13 games in 2024 but rebounded with an nfl high and career high 413 touches keeping cmc and the rest of the 49ers all star cast healthy has to be the top priority in camp and beyond there is no shortage of talent on the team san francisco just needs to keep it on the field to stay on pace in the shark infested nfc west 2 figuring out the wr room signing away mike evans from the buccaneers was a immense boon but he s missed 12 games over the past two seasons and will celebrate his 33rd birthday in august it s imperative that the stockpile of younger wideouts improves and the veteran adds of evans and christian kirk still have tread on the tires previous mainstays jauan jennings and deebo samuel are gone the latter is a free agent after a year with washington and it wouldn t be a shocker to see a reunion in san francisco jennings signed late in the offseason with the vikings brandon aiyuk is still technically with the team but is on the reserve left squad list while continually trolling the 49ers and plenty of others in video missives as evans and kirk get acclimated to quarterback brock purdy and shanahan s offense 2024 first rounder ricky pearsall faces a crucial camp needing to overcome past injuries and calamity to truly emerge similar things can be said about recent picks jacob cowing 2024 fourth rounder and jordan watkins 25 fourth rounder de 39 zhaun stribling taken in the second round this spring as the team s top draft choice profiles as perhaps the best replacement yet for samuel it s time for the fresh faces to step up in the passing game 3 defense must improve under a nother new dc from 2021 through 23 the 49ers were a top 10 defense in points and yards allowed the first two years in that span featured demeco ryans as defensive coordinator the current texans head coach has clearly left a large void steve wilks lasted just the 2023 season despite the team s super bowl run and overall great statistics third in points eighth in yards raheem morris is the next defensive coordinator up replacing robert saleh who was hired as the titans head coach after replacing 2024 dc nick sorensen as the fifth niners defensive play caller in five seasons morris should be helped hugely by the returns of fred warner and nick bosa but developing young talent ranks right up there with staying healthy when it comes to improving on last year s no 20 ranking in total d most glaringly the 2025 49ers finished dead last in team sacks with just 20 myles garrett now a division rival had 23 sacks on his own also on the injury comeback trail 2025 first rounder mykel williams bosa and williams getting healed up is a start the acquisition of defensive tackle osa odighizuwa in a trade with the cowboys might prove to be a pivotal move while the return of linebacker dre greenlaw after a lost year in denver could also bode well rookie third rounder romello height has already garnered some positive reports and alfred collins made a great first year impression morris might well be joining the 49ers at the right time back to top three key storylines 1 darnold staying on point sam darnold authored a storybook tale last season once viewed as a mega bust darnold quarterbacked the seahawks his fourth nfl team following the jets who used the 2018 nfl draft s third overall pick on him to a super bowl title darnold seemingly exorcised the ghosts of his past but he is still only 29 and has plenty to play for he s back with the pressure of defending a championship can he provide an encore earn a lucrative extension and keep seattle atop the league new offensive coordinator brian fleury s system is similar to the departed klint kubiak s but change is change and darnold must learn the differences continuity in the receiving corps should help with jaxon smith njigba leading a group that also includes cooper kupp jake bobo and rashid shaheed the last of whom should command a bigger role in the aerial attack after re signing on a lucrative deal in march furthermore tory horton flashed as a rookie last season before suffering a shin injury the speedster s return could have a dynamic domino effect adding another bona fide threat at receiver and another big play option in the return game which could open up more possibilities for shaheed in both avenues there s also optimism for a major breakout at tight end aj barner who scored the seahawks only offensive touchdown in the super bowl became a dude in his second season 52 receptions 519 yards six tds and might well become a pro bowl caliber player in year 3 if his chemistry with darnold continues 2 what s the frequency without kenneth with kenneth walker having signed with kansas city and zach charbonnet acl most likely absent to begin the season all eyes will be on first round draft pick jadarian price the notre dame product is a smooth runner who averaged 6 yards per carry in his career with the fighting irish however he was jeremiyah love s understudy and had 15 plus touches just once in his 41 games at nd the seahawks were adamant in balancing walker and charbonnet last season before the latter was injured asking price to take on a bell cow workload would seem unlikely camp could preview what kind of roles are in store for other backs like george holani and emanuel wilson perhaps rashid shaheed could be used a bit in the run game too the wide receiver corps along with the charles cross led offensive line are the offensive strengths but seattle wants balance that starts with price and will take shape before week 1 3 can seahawks avoid noise again in case you might have forgotten and judging by the lack of offseason pomp and circumstance many have the seahawks are the reigning super bowl champions for a franchise that boasts one of the loudest home field advantages the volume for a post lombardi offseason has seemingly been turned down to negative 11 that seems to be the preference for mike macdonald s seahawks though they snuck up on some people last season and after winning the most arduous division in football trounced the patriots in the super bowl this year jaxon smith njigba s not going to catch anyone by surprise the reigning offensive player of the year had a fine 2024 hitting 100 catches and exceeding 1 100 yards but he was an absolute force last season leading the league with 1 793 receiving yards and quickly erasing any doubt as to how the passing game would fare without dk metcalf also while jsn got paid this offseason his fellow 2023 first rounder devon witherspoon has yet to posing a potential problem for the seahawks right guard anthony bradford started all 17 games last year his third season in a row of starting the majority of the seahawks games he garnered a 51 9 overall pff grade which ranked 70th among the 81 guards who took at least 300 snaps could fifth rounder beau stephens replace him and solidify a longtime sore spot for seattle s starting lineup general manager john schneider was able to keep most of the lombardi band together but losing walker outside linebacker boye mafe cornerback tariq woolen and safety coby bryant isn t nothing keeping everything quiet and copacetic is far more difficult when you re defending champs so it s paramount for macdonald and schneider to figure out any issues before they grow into problems back to top

news_mentions.headline: NFC South training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Buccaneers, Falcons, Panthers, Saints
