news_mentions.headline: NFL Week 8 Sunday aftermath: Ravens' season on the brink; can Vikings trust Kyler Murray?
news_mentions.description: Kevin Patra breaks down Sunday's Week 8 action in the latest edition of The Aftermath. Is the Ravens' season on the brink of collapse? Can the Vikings trust Kyler Murray?
news_mentions.body_text: now that it s november the playoff picture is starting to emerge and week 8 featured a number of key divisional matchups that could have lasting effects on the rest of the season the broncos and steelers notched revenge wins over the chiefs and browns respectively the lions asserted themselves in the uber tough nfc north while the jaguars handed the colts a potentially fatal blow in a season cratering toward disaster let s examine some key storylines in sunday s aftermath including another concerning loss for schottenheimer s boys minnesota s qb issues rear their ugly head in detroit buccaneers lean on run game in historic win broncos take over driver s seat in afc west race burrow channels norm van brocklin against tennessee but first we start with lamar jackson suffering a potential season ending injury and where the ravens go from here ravens season on the brink after jackson injury the baltimore ravens find themselves in quite the quandary lamar jackson s return was supposed to buoy a club coming off back to back divisional defeats it lasted one play on sunday in buffalo jackson s right thumb injury which will require surgery leaves the 4 4 ravens floundering in the afc north cellar before we hit thanksgiving jesse minter told reporters after the 36 10 loss to buffalo that jackson will be placed on injured reserve knocking him out for at least four games asked if the setback ultimately could end jackson s season the ravens first year head coach admitted that it s possible potentially but we ll see where it s at minter said without the two time mvp qb the ravens offense is clipped baltimore is 7 14 in games in which jackson has not started since 2019 averaging just 17 6 points in 2026 the team has scored six touchdowns in the 18 quarters jackson has missed jackson s latest injury shrouds his future in baltimore we ll have plenty of time to delve into the contract situation later right now the focus is on how the ravens survive it would be bad enough if jackson s thumb issue were baltimore s only qb injury but backup tyler huntley also exited sunday s game and didn t return espn reported that huntley suffered a possible turf toe injury and will undergo an mri on monday to determine how much time if any he could miss undrafted rookie third stringer joe fagnano battled against the bills but given the situation trying to keep up with josh allen on the road with no prep time he performed as expected completing 10 of his 21 pass attempts for 91 yards with a pick and three sacks taken the ravens are in a rough spot with a short week before thursday night s game against the rolling jaguars even if huntley doesn t miss much time is it worth baltimore trading for a qb ahead of the nov 10 deadline would shelling out more assets in a potentially lost season be wise let s rip through some of the potential qb options for the ravens if they decide to go the trade route tyson bagent the bears qb2 struggled in his last outing against green bay in week 5 and was eventually benched for case keenum but his familiarity with declan doyle would benefit baltimore considered one of the league s better backups by many bagent could be a long term play for the ravens i have my doubts about if the bears would be willing to part with their no 2 but such a move could help recoup some of the trade capital sent away in last week s jeffery simmons deal the cost to pry bagent away from chicago could prove prohibitive for a ravens team on the brink jacoby brissett benched in favor of gardner minshew during the cardinals stirring comeback win over dallas on sunday brissett has experience while inconsistencies have plagued him this season in arizona he is a professional qb who could pick up the offense quickly editor s update on monday mike lafleur named minshew as the cardinals starter moving forward shedeur sanders cleveland has insisted that it has no intention of trading sanders but coach todd monken hasn t seemed to be in the former colorado quarterback s corner at any point in the process sanders has his warts but he could bring more pop to the ravens offense than huntley or fagnano the browns shipped joe flacco to cincinnati last year so intra division trades can t be ruled out we know the browns brass will take a pick if it makes sense kirk cousins i don t think the raiders would trade him while they re still in contention at 4 4 if they were willing to the cost would probably be prohibitive however for the next week any qb trade list should at least mention the veteran playing at a high level in front of no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza two non trade options easton stick currently on the tampa bay buccaneers practice squad stick was in l a in 2024 with minter so at least there would be some familiarity jimmy garoppolo the veteran hasn t officially retired if he wants a shot to play again baltimore could be his last best chance cowboys collapse in stunning loss credit gardner minshew for bringing the mania once again credit tyler allgeier for gashing the cowboys defense and powering the cards back into the game credit michael wilson for continuing to do his best puka nacua impression credit the cardinals defense for forcing field goals late and getting a three and out in overtime credit mike lafleur s club for not quitting when quitting could have been easy and credit the first year coach for being willing to make a second half qb change in the heat of the moment credit the cards but let s be real this was an epic collapse for which dallas should be crushed brian schottenheimer s club held a 24 10 fourth quarter lead before disintegrating like walter donovan drinking from the wrong chalice he chose poorly could be the title of every cowboys move on sunday a confluence of ineptitude caused dallas to collapse at home to drop to 3 5 on the season the defense became a sieve in the fourth quarter and couldn t tackle i understand that the cowboys had some injuries but letting allgeier look like jim brown is not a product of a few missing players the secondary inexplicably got burned late when all the cowboys needed to do was keep everything in front of them frankly arizona could have scored quicker in the fourth quarter if not for a few misses the defensive breakdowns continue to perplex dallas this season the offense also did its part in the collapse stalling out inside the red zone early then failing to get a first down after the cardinals failed on the onside kick an explosive offense should be able to move the chains to secure a victory then there was the depressing three and out to begin overtime dallas got outgained in yardage 467 261 on sunday that should not happen despite the latest example of schottenheimer s teams playing below their talent jerry jones stuck by his coach after the game that s not in my mind at this time jones said when asked about a potential coaching change per espn com a lot of people let brian down today and so for whatever criticism we want to have of brian we can all get in line the line for blame in dallas is long it starts at the top vikings qb problems can t be brushed aside brian flores defense had done the heavy lifting to build minnesota s 6 0 start but sunday s divisional loss to the lions showed that the ferocious unit can t do it alone detroit went big and ran over the vikings in the second half wearing down the stout defense to the tune of 164 rushing yards after halftime by the end flores group was gassed and couldn t stop jahmyr gibbs and the lions from grinding out the w if the vikings offense had any semblance of consistency the end game scenario would have played out much differently kyler murray continues to struggle with his consistency despite facing the worst passing defense in the nfl on sunday he couldn t keep the vikings on the field he sailed more than a few balls way too high never seemed comfortable and rarely moved the chains on nine third down throws he completed four three went for first downs murray connected on some deep balls and averaged 11 2 air yards per attempt the second highest mark of his career but he also missed a host of shots per next gen stats on downfield attempts 10 plus air yards murray threw for a season high 115 yards despite only completing four of his 13 attempts 30 8 his lowest downfield completion rate in a game since 2023 min 10 downfield attempts the inability to keep the chains moving sits in stark contrast to the best offenses under kevin o connell we ll see if koc pulls the plug and gives carson wentz a shot at least we know he ll force feed justin jefferson if the struggles persist the j j mccarthy trade probably needed to happen but seeing the 2024 first rounder look like a different qb in new york while murray struggles has to sting minnesota with a tough trio of games on tap vs buffalo 6 1 at green bay 5 3 and against san francisco 6 1 in mexico city the vikings must get more production from the qb position or they ll see their once strong nfc north lead evaporate editor s update on monday after publishing kevin o connell said kyler murray is dealing with hamstring tightness is the bucs offense sustainable the monsoon in tampa fla dictated the run heavy approach from zac robinson s offense but even in pristine weather the buccaneers would have leaned on the ground game the slop tipped the scales even harder with baker mayfield attempting just three passes all falling incomplete in the 16 0 win we knew it was going to be a nasty day and what kind of conditions it was going to be bucs coach todd bowles said we were worried about ball security and we took care of it other than the fumble in the end zone bowles added i didn t say we were not going to throw the ball the conditions told robinson that you could see it it s a downpour and the wind was blowing you can kind of see the ball wasn t going anywhere tampa became just the second team in the super bowl era to have zero completed passes in a single game joining the 1974 bills who did so in a win over the jets per nfl research three of the four teams to not have a completion in a game since 1950 have gone on to win including the buccaneers on sunday they are the first team to win by 10 points without completing a pass since the 1945 pittsburgh steelers beat the chicago cardinals the ground game has gotten the bucs back in the nfc south race in week 7 against carolina tampa bay rushed for 258 yards while mayfield attempted just 11 passes completing seven for 64 yards and a td bucky irving has been sensational making defenders miss and has the pop to turn those broken tackles into big runs all 170 of irving s rushing yards came after contact on sunday per next gen stats one of the more inexplicable issues with the bucs early struggles when they started 1 5 was the offensive line s play the veteran crew missed far too many blocks and committed too many penalties over the last couple weeks the group has gotten back on track by smashing defenses in the face tampa s rushing attack is absolutely replicable i expect irving to keep motoring through defenses slithering through holes and ripping chunk gains that said it s 2026 at some point mayfield will be asked to win a game through the air with the bears and lions on tap in weeks 9 and 11 the bucs will have to keep pace with higher powered offenses after thumping two division rivals though tampa is back on track in a moribund division and the bucs feel like the most stable nfc south club as we head into the second half of the season broncos take command in afc west race it s not pretty but who cares when you stack a w bo nix earned his 15th career game winning drive in denver s 28 24 win over kansas city on sunday breaking a tie with dak prescott for the most such drives in a player s first three seasons since at least 1950 according to nfl research the broncos came back to win after trailing the rival chiefs by 11 points in the fourth quarter it marked the third victory in nix s career in which denver erased a fourth quarter deficit of 10 points the most such wins in the nfl since 2024 conversely sunday marked the third game in patrick mahomes career in which the chiefs blew a fourth quarter lead of 10 points and the first since over five years ago in week 2 of 2021 at the ravens harrison butker s missed fourth quarter field goal opened the door for denver and nix immediately cashed in hitting running back jonah coleman for a 51 yard catch and run to set up the go ahead 5 yard td the 15 point fourth quarter explosion came after nix and the offense once again struggled to stay on the field denver went three and out on three third quarter drives entering the final frame the home fans were frustrated then boom big plays galore and the broncos not only escaped with a win but took control of the afc west race the big plays included a massive goal line stand by the denver defense which held the chiefs out of the end zone in the game s final seconds after they got a first and goal at the 4 the sequence was aided by a k c false start but a denver d that once again missed too many tackles ultimately stood tall when needed with malcolm roach taking down mahomes for the game ending sack it was ball out or go home edge rusher que robinson said of the dramatic finish via the denver post and we weren t going home without that dub the loss stings k c which could have taken complete control of the division race with a sweep over the broncos denver 6 2 has now won four straight while the chiefs 5 2 have lost back to back games after taking advantage of a soft early slate andy reid s trust in butker came back to bite him according to the next gen stats fourth down decision guide with kansas city leading 24 21 and facing fourth and 8 from the broncos 36 yard line with 2 36 remaining a punt would have given the chiefs the highest win probability 74 3 1 8 percentage points ahead of going for it 72 5 while a field goal attempt ranked last 71 5 reid elected for the fg butker missed the 54 yard attempt giving the ball back to the broncos who scored two plays later sometimes analytics does suggest punting week 8 sunday spotlight

news_mentions.headline: The Chiefs were seconds from a huge win in Denver. Instead, they're searching for answers.
news_mentions.body_text: denver kansas city chiefs tight end travis kelce was almost fully dressed when he turned to a group of reporters gathering near his locker 34 give me one second guys 34 kelce said heading around a corner and briefly disappearing this was minutes after the chiefs 39 crushing fall from ahead 28 24 road loss to the denver broncos on sunday afternoon at mile high and with those five words kelce did more than promise he 39 d be back he also acknowledged that he specifically needed to speak on the defeat the 37 year old kelce returned a few minutes later his eyes red and spoke with the type of emotion that he hasn 39 t always shared after games 34 the reality of things is we got to fix a lot 34 kelce said 34 the little things mistakes and it starts with the person you 39 re looking at i 39 m one of them 34 kelce went on to talk about a small detail that has become a big issue for these chiefs penalties and for the past three weeks kelce said he 39 s been a problem he had a false start sunday making it three consecutive games he 39 s hurt his team with an infraction the chiefs had 11 penalties for 105 yards in all sunday including one in the final seconds that literally cost them a victory as it wiped away a game winning touchdown again kelce said that type of discipline needs to start with him 34 it 39 s frustrating you just can 39 t f ing do it excuse my language 34 kelce said 34 i 39 ve got to be better for my teammates and that sets the tone for a lot of people in this room 34 it was just one scene inside a stunned locker room following a defeat that never seemed imminent until the game 39 s final play according to the win probability calculator at rbsdm com the chiefs had a 93 percent chance of winning with 13 40 left in the fourth quarter at that point they led 24 13 and had the ball 34 we just didn 39 t finish 34 kelce said 34 we just didn 39 t finish the way we should 39 ve 34 the collapse from there took all three phases kicker harrison butker missed a 54 yard field goal the team surely will evaluate its options at that position again this week meanwhile a defense that prides itself on tackling and limiting big plays surrendered two long touchdown drives in the final nine minutes one aided by a 51 yard catch and run from broncos running back jonah coleman 34 missed two tackles then we 39 re playing on the goal line 34 said defensive tackle chris jones of that sequence 34 i think more so if we can have some things back it 39 s the missed tackles 34 even after all that quarterback patrick mahomes moved his team to first and goal on the broncos 39 4 yard line in the closing seconds only for k c to be held short on four consecutive plays well five if you count the penalty mahomes completed what appeared to be a game winning touchdown pass to receiver rashee rice on fourth and goal from the 1 only for it to be waved off as right tackle jaylon moore was whistled for a false start replays showed a slight flinch back from moore then a turn of his head it wasn 39 t much but it was enough to draw a flag the chiefs had a wide array of reactions to that infraction in particular after the game moore 34 just got to look at the tape it was called there 39 s nothing else we can do about it now so it was on me just got to be better about it 34 coach andy reid 34 i didn 39 t see it but that 39 s one man 39 s opinion i saw him move his head but i didn 39 t see a false start 34 mahomes 34 i have not seen it but it didn 39 t catch me it didn 39 t surprise me or catch me or anything like that so it couldn 39 t have been big but it was called at the end of the day you have to go with whatever 39 s called but a lot of times in those big moments the little stuff doesn 39 t get called like that 34 the chiefs moved back 5 yards and mahomes then faced pressure on the final snap with his last ditch pass attempt officially recorded as a sack in the box score per nfl next gen stats it was just the third game in mahomes 39 career in which his chiefs blew a lead of 10 plus points in the fourth quarter it hadn 39 t happened since week 2 of the 2021 season the confluence of events left mahomes dazed afterward he faced his locker minutes after the game socks pulled half down elbows on knees leaning forward to review video of the chiefs 39 final plays on his phone some time passed before he eventually set his phone face down in his locker having analyzed those snaps long enough to move on 34 you want to score you 39 re on the 1 yard line you 39 re in the red zone you got down there 34 mahomes said 34 you want to go out and capitalize 34 the mistakes though have become a frustrating and familiar theme mahomes said that at a team meeting the night before sunday 39 s game he had been asked what play he 39 d want to run with the game on the line he chose the pass the chiefs ultimately called on their initial fourth and goal attempt which used kelce as a decoy to free up rice over the middle it was perfect it worked against a great broncos defense and it was all for naught because the chiefs couldn 39 t avoid a flag in that critical moment 34 we had to go to a different play on that last one and they covered it well 34 mahomes said 34 whenever you get there you get that close and you don 39 t capitalize you take that on yourself and you learn from it 34 the harsh reality can 39 t be ignored the chiefs blew an opportunity to alter their season 39 s course by choking away this one with a win they would have had roughly an 83 percent chance of winning the afc west according to the athletic 39 s nfl playoff simulator a few more victories and they could 39 ve turned their sights to positioning for the no 1 seed a home playoff game all but guaranteed now the chiefs are actually slight underdogs for the division title per the playoff simulator behind these broncos both teams sit at around 48 percent to capture the afc west the simplest math however coming out of sunday 39 s game denver is 6 2 k c is 5 2 the chiefs have ground to make up and the most difficult part of their schedule remaining 34 obviously it was a big game i 39 m not going to hide from that 34 mahomes said 34 but now you 39 re in a dogfight for the division 34 mahomes said he hopes his team will focus on process over results next give attention to the daily grind get a little better each day work to be in a position to play your best football late as for kelce he promised his teammates would respond after sunday 39 s loss left a 34 sour taste 34 in his mouth 34 we 39 ve got a lot of men in here that give a damn about this season and care about each other i think that 39 s a winning formula in itself 34 kelce said 34 we 39 ve just got to go out there and do it 34 this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: NFL experts' Week 8 takeaways: Do Ravens need drastic QB measures? Plus, Cowboys collapse
news_mentions.body_text: each sunday three of the athletic 39 s nfl writers react to the biggest news plays and performances from the day 39 s games every sunday matters in the nfl that 39 s what makes the league so popular but this sunday seemed especially consequential with a significant quarterback injury a stunning comeback and several key division matchups the biggest news of the day came early as the return of baltimore ravens quarterback lamar jackson lasted one play before he left with a thumb injury it got worse when backup tyler huntley also left with an injury in the end emergency quarterback joe fagnano gave a game performance but it wasn 39 t nearly enough in a 36 10 loss to the buffalo bills now the ravens will have to hold their breath and see if their franchise quarterback is going to miss the rest of the season the most important game of the day was in detroit as the lions handed the minnesota vikings their first loss of the season detroit 39 s offense did just enough against the dominant minnesota defense in a 19 15 win the wildest game of the day was in dallas as the arizona cardinals scored two touchdowns in the final three minutes of regulation and won 33 30 in overtime it was another stunning collapse by the cowboys in a season that is getting away from them the season has already gotten away from the indianapolis colts who suffered a humiliating 42 7 loss to the jacksonville jaguars the fire sale that started earlier this week could accelerate with the trade deadline looming nfl writers mike jones austin mock and ted nguyen share their thoughts on the ravens 39 quarterback mess the stumbling cowboys the surging lions and the hapless indianapolis colts should the ravens trade serious draft capital for a quarterback in an attempt to save their season if lamar jackson misses a significant amount of time jones if tyler huntley will not miss time then the ravens don 39 t even need to consider this if both jackson and huntley will miss time baltimore needs to do something but there 39 s not really a quarterback worthy of serious draft capital on the trading block when it comes to veterans capable of stepping in and leading a team effectively the pickings are rather slim the cincinnati bengals aren 39 t going to trade joe flacco to a divisional rival the san francisco 49ers aren 39 t going to part with mac jones andy dalton would seem to have a little left in the tank and is a member of the atlanta falcons 39 crowded quarterback room but he wouldn 39 t seemingly command 34 serious draft capital 34 another option josh johnson who is in his 19th professional season and is a member of the bengals 39 practice squad baltimore wouldn 39 t have to trade for him to add him to their roster mock i don 39 t think so and am pretty sure that would be a poor decision in the long run first being desperate and turning to the trade market is a dangerous combination second i 39 m not even sure who you 39 d trade for at this point kirk cousins is probably the only starter that makes sense but i 39 m not sure if the las vegas raiders would be willing to do that mac jones will certainly be buzzy but i 39 m skeptical what we saw in half a season under kyle shanahan in the 49ers 39 system is the type of production you 39 ll get in baltimore at the end of the day you have to be content with understanding that the future is more important than the now and that 39 s where i 39 m at with the ravens maybe you can win some games down the stretch with poor quarterback play but if not you get a better draft pick to supplement lamar jackson for 2027 and beyond nguyen i 39 m not sure who would be available that could help them at this point cousins is leading the league in touchdown passes but i think the raiders are intent on keeping him as fernando mendoza 39 s mentor maybe the bears would be willing to trade tyson bagent and go with case keenum as their backup bagent knows offensive coordinator declan doyle 39 s system and the transition should be relatively simple it would take maybe a second round pick for the 49ers to trade mac jones there just aren 39 t a lot of options i 39 m not sure if the ravens defense is good enough to hold things together during a qb transition period sometimes you just have to accept your fate at the very least they may get to keep doyle longer who 39 s most to blame for the cowboys 39 stunning collapse against the cardinals jones there 39 s plenty of blame to go around a defense that let gardner minshew come off the bench to carve them up for three touchdown passes while completing 17 of 23 passes for 188 yards in less than 17 minutes of play a defense that let tyler allgeier gash them for 147 rushing yards and a touchdown on just 11 touches a defense that let michael wilson rack up 111 receiving yards and a touchdown on eight catches a defense that surrendered 30 points after halftime or do we want to go with a cowboys offense that got out gained 467 261 while averaging just 3 6 yards per play this was a bad day all around for coach brian schottenheimer and his team mock can i say everyone because it 39 s not that simple the easy answer is the defense because they 39 ve been horrendous for two seasons now and the offseason moves to address that side of the ball haven 39 t come to fruition the defense isn 39 t even close to being a respectable unit right now and you can 39 t consistently win games in the nfl with a unit that bad but the offense deserves some blame too with their inability to run the ball 34 percent success rate against the cardinals which resulted in them being unable to put away the cardinals with a lead so that comes back to the blame on everyone the coaching staff on both sides of the ball the front office it 39 s all bad right now the coaching staff isn 39 t elevating the talent they have and the front office hasn 39 t given them the talent to be a winning football team so while it 39 s easy to point fingers at one person or one unit the blame is shared and goes the whole way to the top of the organization nguyen the offense certainly deserves blame for not putting away the game against a cardinals defense that had been struggling however the defense gave up 20 points in the fourth quarter to a minshew led offense without any timeouts the cardinals drove 80 yards in just over a minute and should have won the game in regulation but missed an extra point and there were wide open receivers the cardinals weren 39 t making a bunch of amazing catches in overtime the offense went three and out and the cardinals drove right down the field the detroit lions didn 39 t light up the scoreboard against the minnesota vikings 39 fearsome defense but jared goff led the game winning drive in the fourth quarter goff has 15 touchdown passes and one interception is he the mvp so far this season jones if you ask vegas goff doesn 39 t even crack the top five in the mvp race the popular picks josh allen brock purdy joe burrow patrick mahomes and trevor lawrence lead the way according to most books however goff certainly deserves consideration sunday was a big statement game for the lions and the 11th year veteran goff has been masterful this season especially against the blitz where entering sunday 39 s game he had completed roughly 77 percent of his passes the vikings definitely got to him on sunday but when it mattered most goff came through goff has provided stability and effectiveness despite a change at offensive coordinator and injuries on that side of the ball and despite all the change detroit boasts one of the most prolific offenses in the league thanks largely to goff mock goff came into this week sixth in quarterback index qbi heading into the week and i 39 m not sure his stat line against the vikings will improve that number but it 39 s the vikings so we are happy to give him a pass but with the weapons that they have on offense it 39 s hard for me to see goff getting enough credit to win the award the lions have a ton of talent going around with jahmyr gibbs amon ra st brown and even on the offensive line with penei sewell and then you factor in that allen is still doing otherworldly things in buffalo i don 39 t know if he can be the favorite with goff being non existent in the run game his passing numbers would need to be above and beyond allen and others and with gibbs in the backfield i 39 m not sure we will see that in the conversation sure but he 39 s in that second tier right now and likely behind allen purdy and mahomes if i was in charge nguyen he should definitely be in the conversation the hiring of offensive coordinator drew petzing and passing game coordinator mike kafka has gotten this offense back on track the lions still are a run first team and gibbs might win offensive player of the year goff has been extremely productive but it 39 s hard to overlook the super human play of allen this season goff 39 s final numbers would have to be substantially better than allen 39 s for him to win in my opinion after trading two of their best players the colts were crushed by the jaguars they don 39 t own their first round pick and daniel jones looks lost after getting a huge contract extension is this the most bleak situation in the nfl right now jones the colts have two more wins than the winless chargers but it 39 s clear indianapolis is headed toward a franchise reset this offseason they 39 ve already fired their general manager and unloaded two key players in quenton nelson and deforest buckner they really should go ahead and move jonathan taylor and josh downs and anyone else they can to stockpile picks for their next gm to work with in the spring mock i think so yes and if i were in charge i 39 d be selling off just about every player i could to try and maximize my draft capital in the coming years considering the colts don 39 t have their first rounder and with new ownership will a promising general manager and or coaching staff be willing to come in for a rebuild if head coach shane steichen isn 39 t around next season you 39 d have to really sell the new front office and staff on this being a long rebuild and preach patience because the roster is void of talent on both sides of the ball and there is no future quarterback at the moment and even then if you hit on a quarterback how long does it take to surround your rookie with enough talent to compete for titles before you have to pay him a gaudy amount with the lack of draft capital this is certainly the franchise furthest from winning and will need a full rebuild and most importantly time to get this thing turned around nguyen can 39 t think of many worse than the colts right now who don 39 t have a first round pick the sauce gardner trade for two first round picks could be the worst trade since the browns 39 for deshaun watson maybe the colts could recoup a first for taylor extending jones from a small sample of successful play after a career 39 s worth of underwhelming play was a bad mistake chris ballard put this team in dire straits before his firing which is one of the dangers of having a gm on the hot seat they start to make desperate moves to save their job this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: 2026 NFL season, Week 8: What We Learned from Sunday's games
news_mentions.description: Around The NFL breaks down what you need to know from Sunday's action in Week 8 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 8 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below early window buffalo bills 36 baltimore ravens 10 cincinnati bengals 43 tennessee titans 36 ot arizona cardinals 33 dallas cowboys 30 ot detroit lions 19 minnesota vikings 15 jacksonville jaguars 42 indianapolis colts 7 las vegas raiders 38 new york jets 33 pittsburgh steelers 27 cleveland browns 6 tampa bay buccaneers 16 atlanta falcons 0 late window los angeles rams 24 los angeles chargers 9 denver broncos 28 kansas city chiefs 24 new england patriots 24 miami dolphins 19 sunday night washington commanders 27 philadelphia eagles 10 nick shook s takeaways bills let hunters loose buffalo s biggest underlying question mark was its defense a leaky unit that struggled to get stops and limit opposing offenses in what became weekly shootouts for the bills that finally changed for the better on sunday with lamar jackson exiting quickly and tyler huntley back in the lineup buffalo decided it was time to hunt the quarterback dialing up blitzes and registering pressures on half of huntley s four passes which also incidentally forced huntley out of the game due to injury once undrafted rookie joe fagnano took over the carnivorous bills saw nothing but red meat blitzing on 64 5 of their total defensive snaps logging qb pressures at a rate of 61 3 and short circuiting baltimore s offense all afternoon the ravens finished with just 144 net yards of offense scored their only touchdown via a short field earned by a broderick washington interception and couldn t piece together more than one drive of significance which ended in a 26 yard tyler loop field goal buffalo s defense made sure it wouldn t allow derrick henry to carry the ravens and denied fagnano the space to breathe overwhelming the inexperienced signal caller in a runaway win quarterback injuries decimate ravens lamar jackson s anticipated return lasted just one snap his first pass attempt fell incomplete and on the follow through to his throw jackson s thumb collided with a defender s hand resulting in an injury that will land jackson on injured reserve for the foreseeable future after a few weeks of backup turned starter duty tyler huntley found himself on the field sunday appearing skittish and struggling to gain a single yard through the air before an injury knocked him out of action as well leaving the ravens with their emergency third qb joe fagnano as their only remaining option the uconn product gave his best effort but was constantly under duress leaving the ravens with little room to move the ball all afternoon zay flowers went without a catch on five targets rashod bateman s one catch for 22 yards accounted for the most receiving production for any raven and running back justice hill led baltimore in receptions with four it was a lifeless offense that left the ravens defense on the field for far too long buffalo won the time of possession battle 37 36 to 22 24 and sunday s display should rightfully worry ravens fans about their team s outlook for the remainder of 2026 it sounds as if jackson s season could be finished and recent results without him including sunday are discouraging at best moore delivers in return after missing a handful of weeks buffalo welcomed back its prized offseason acquisition d j moore who showed no signs of hesitancy and delivered a strong outing four catches 82 yards including a spectacular grab for 49 yards to set up a james cook touchdown and a touchdown catch moore s return helped draw some attention away from buffalo s tight ends dalton kincaid finished with a team best 86 yards and a touchdown on four catches took a bit of pressure off cook and unlocked enough of the unit s attack to help the bills climb out of a grind it out start to pour it on in the second half moore s rapport with josh allen remains strong even after the time off and helped allen pass jim kelly for the franchise s all time lead in touchdowns 260 now moore will need to prove he can be this reliable on a weekly basis next gen stats insight for ravens bills via nfl pro the bills blitzed on 64 5 of opposing dropbacks against the ravens in week 8 their highest blitz rate since 2021 and the highest blitz rate ravens quarterbacks have faced this season the bills blitz rate had not exceeded 39 in any of their prior six games this season when blitzing the bills generated 11 pressures including a season high seven quick pressures under 2 5 seconds and three sacks including a strip sack fumble recovery in the second quarter nfl research josh allen and james cook each had a rushing touchdown in week 8 marking the 16th time that allen and cook have scored a rushing touchdown in the same game sixteen games breaks a tie with dak prescott and ezekiel elliott for the most games by any teammate duo in nfl history in which both players had a rushing touchdown back to top bobby kownack s takeaways burrow was everything good bad about bengals offense what a roller coaster performance by joe burrow the cincy quarterback unquestionably served as the team s hero accounting for six touchdowns in an unexpected shootout with the titans but his three interceptions contributed initially to a slow start and later allowed tennessee to stay in it two of those picks were deep heaves to ja 39 marr chase with one way overthrown and another that came up far too short if you re going to make mistakes though make sure you make up for them burrow did that and more piling on the points and feeding his top two receivers to great success tee higgins had 10 catches for 155 yards and two tds on 11 targets while chase tallied 11 receptions for 141 yards and a score on 16 looks burrow also importantly cleaned it up in crunch time of his five drives that took place in the fourth quarter or overtime one ended in a chase brown fumble and the other ticked down the final 17 seconds to the extra frame on the other three burrow marched his bengals 73 81 and 70 yards throwing two touchdowns and scoring the game winner on a 9 yard scramble he finished with 426 yards five tds and three ints on 38 of 48 passing marking his third consecutive game with at least four passing touchdowns it s a bit scary how many points the bengals put up despite four giveaways and that s all credit to burrow standout performances not enough for tennessee there was not an ounce of quit in the titans after trading away their best player defensive tackle jeffery simmons on thursday the defense still generated four takeaways the most it has had in a game this season safety amani hooker had joe burrow s number intercepting him a whopping three times while defensive end jacob martin tallied three sacks and linebacker anthony hill was relentless with 14 tackles on offense cam ward enjoyed by far his best game of the season despite being without carnell tate ward dissected cincinnati s defense with regularity going 26 of 40 for 304 yards and two touchdowns snapping a five game interception streak and nearly doubling his average of 168 4 passing yards per game he led two separate go ahead td drives in the fourth quarter plus tony pollard continued his recent resurgence rushing for 117 yards and two scores after going for 129 and three tds in week 7 his 40 yard touchdown to open the scoring will be one of the highlights of the day in his or any game with pollard breaking multiple tackles before stiff arming one with denver the rest of the way oh and we already knew this but it was reaffirmed sunday harrison butker is marching toward unemployment his wide right miss from 54 yards loomed large in this contest and is just the latest of a growing string of misses from deep denver s defense shows cracks but holds up in biggest moment the broncos have built their 6 2 mark on the backs of their defenders who have collectively stifled opposing offenses by harassing quarterbacks relentlessly over the last month on sunday they weren t quite as effective for most of the afternoon patrick mahomes managed to lead one drive in which he repeatedly converted third downs by barely moving the ball beyond the line to gain showing flashes of what has made him a special quarterback in the post tyreek hill era in kansas city and dealing a few deflating blows to the denver defense in the process that wasn t enough to tear them down though in need of a stop denver managed to force a chiefs drive to stall in the fourth quarter leading to butker s 54 yard miss and granting the broncos a fresh opportunity to complete their comeback effort and even after letting mahomes drive the chiefs down the field rapidly in the final two minutes denver bowed up and denied the chiefs from entering the end zone in the game s final seconds as nix noted afterward the broncos have been leaning on their defense all season and they managed to prevent the opposition from gaining the one yard they needed most the fact they ended the game with a sack credited to malcolm roach but truly the product of a collective unified pass rush was fitting next gen stats insight for chiefs broncos via nfl pro on first and goal from the denver 4 yard line in the game s final minute the chiefs owned a 76 chance of winning per next gen stats win probability they did not score losing 28 24 nfl research the broncos came back to win in week 8 after trailing by 11 points in the fourth quarter against the chiefs the win was the broncos third in bo nix s career in which they came back from a double digit fourth quarter deficit to win which is the most such wins in the nfl since 2024 this was just the third game in patrick mahomes career in which the chiefs blew a double digit fourth quarter lead and the first since week 2 2021 in baltimore back to top brooke cersosimo s takeaways maye pats offense has big second half the patriots looked as if they were still feeling last week s loss to chicago in the first half of sunday s contest new england s receiving yards leader hunter henry remained drake maye s preferred option early against the dolphins catching all three of his targets for 30 yards but the veteran tight end left the game with a foot injury midway through the second quarter and never returned maye looked stumped without henry and his top three receivers a j brown ankle knee who s missing his fifth game this season romeo doubs and mack hollins both on injured reserve for the rest of the half the offense compiled less than 100 total yards and had a 13 3 deficit going into the locker room prompting too many mike vrabel eye rolls to count then came some much needed adjustments from offensive coordinator josh mcdaniels and maye after a three and out maye began stretching the field and finding the few pats receivers at his disposal to string together three straight touchdown drives that scoring avalanche opened with maye finding kyle williams on a 43 yard touchdown before maye stunned a defender when taking it in himself on an option from 2 yards out maye s third td saw him connect with demario douglas deep downfield for a 48 yard touchdown maye finished the day 16 of 20 passing for 199 yards with the three total tds it marked maye s fifth straight game with three or more total touchdowns the first time a patriots qb has done so since tom brady accomplished the feat in 10 consecutive games in 2007 despite some dicey moments early the pats appear to be back on track dormant third quarter sinks fins miami built some momentum offensively before halftime with 11 and 12 play scoring drives that gave it a 10 point lead heading into the locker room the latter was undoubtedly miami s most impressive march of the day as malik willis connected with greg dulcich caleb douglas jalen tolbert kevin coleman and finally malik washington in the end zone for a 1 yard score that s about when the fun stopped for miami as the third quarter saw it gain a piddly 13 net yards zero pass yards on eight plays credit the dolphins for trying to get out of the 11 point hole late with a nice 35 yard touchdown from willis to coleman late in the fourth quarter though a missed field goal failed two point try and an unsuccessful onside kick attempt all but sealed their fate willis finished the loss 21 of 32 passing for 211 yards two tds and an int which crazily launched off a defender s helmet at the line of scrimmage into kevin byard s hands downfield for the first time in several weeks the run game went away with ollie gordon racking up 69 yards on 19 carries 3 6 yards per attempt the game was ultimately decided by five points but it didn t feel all that close for much of the rainy second half some love for the defenses there were a handful of players on both teams that made notable plays the dolphins entered the contest with only six sacks dead last in the nfl but logged three sunday 2024 first round pick chop robinson led all players with two takedowns of drake maye while josh uche a former patriot had one miami also received solid contributions from jordyn brooks 11 total tackles jacob rodriguez eight tackles forced fumble and julius brents fumble recovery new england sacked malik willis five times in the win with gabe jacas and cory durden leading the way with 1 5 sacks apiece carlton davis nine tackles kaden elliss nine tackles 5 sacks two tfls and kevin byard int also deserve flowers for their performances next gen stats insight for patriots dolphins via nfl pro drake maye completed 16 of 20 passes for 199 yards and two tds against the dolphins in week 8 maye was perfect on throws of more than 10 air yards completing all five attempts for 149 yards and both of his touchdowns since week 4 maye has thrown six deep 20 air yards touchdown passes without an interception the most deep touchdowns in the nfl over that span nfl research with sunday s win over the miami dolphins patriots head coach mike vrabel is 13 4 in his career in games with eight or more days of rest back to top grant gordon s takeaways daniels gets long awaited win in a battle of attrition for the commanders eagles and those tuned in washington and jayden daniels emerged as survivors and victors there were zero style points but daniels and co rallied from a 10 point deficit in the first quarter as the quarterback stunningly earned his first win since oct 5 2025 battling through injuries in this season and the last daniels had gone 0 7 1 over his last eight starts with washington this one is unlikely to be a triumph he ll put on a highlight reel as the commanders and eagles entered sunday night on a combined eight game winless streak the product was emblematic of the teams travails for the most part daniels however largely avoided big mistakes throwing for 217 yards and an 8 yard touchdown pass to stefon diggs that led to a 10 all score in the second quarter and was part of a 27 0 run for washington daniels and washington have been desperate for a win at 2 4 1 the commanders are still within flailing distance of the nfc east s top spot though that s hard to fathom with the showing regardless dan quinn daniels and the commanders have something to celebrate at the expense of a division rival that is dealing with harder times eagles endure another ugly loss after 10 points and nearly 15 minutes of game time things looked sunny for philadelphia for the first time in a long time the eagles hadn t laid claim to a double digit lead since week 4 unfortunately during a trying season for the eagles in which injuries have taken hold they lost their sixth in a row for the first time in nick sirianni s tenure as a banged up saquon barkley was limited and fill in starter tanner mckee was bamboozled by washington pressure held scoreless following a 3 yard touchdown run by barkley with 4 27 to go in the first quarter the eagles mustered just 268 yards of offense the running game was held to 91 yards and mckee couldn t hold up against the commanders pressure washington racked up a season best five sacks as mckee was pressured 20 times 46 5 pressure rate and it seemed as though he was under duress far more than that despite a roster completely hobbled by injuries this was a winnable game for the eagles but mckee and the offense simply had no answers emblematic of the struggles was philadelphia s best drive of the second half a 15 play odyssey that took up 7 35 it ended with a jake elliott 41 yard field goal attempt clanging off the upright following back to back 5 yard penalties eight games into the season and residing in an nfc east that s hardly a heavyweight division it s still arduous to believe the eagles season isn t done washington wins in trenches in week 7 the eagles defense was shockingly held to six qb pressures no sacks and no tackles for loss in a setback against the cowboys the stats weren t so damning in this one but it still wasn t where it should be credit to the commanders offensive line for that guard samuel cosmi more than held his own against jalen carter carter had one of the eagles two sacks and it came versus cosmi but overall cosmi won this battle allowing the sack and one pressure in 19 matchups including 12 one on ones the pressure and the sack allowed to carter were cosmi s only blemishes in 33 pass block snaps former first round pick josh conerly and center lucas patrick also had commendable showings next gen stats insight for eagles commanders via nfl pro washington generated pressure on 46 5 of dropbacks against philadelphia a season high mark ten pressures and a sack came on 12 blitzes 83 3 the second highest pressure rate by any defense in a game this season minimum five blitzes nfl research the eagles have lost six straight games for the first time since 2012 when philadelphia lost eight in a row from weeks 5 13 it was also the eagles third loss in a row versus an nfc east opponent the first time they ve done so since weeks 9 11 in 2005 philadelphia s 2 6 start is its worst since 1999 andy reid s first year at the helm back to top

With training camps in full swing across the NFL, Kevin Patra spotlights the most interesting developments for all 32 teams.
news_mentions.body_text: the pads are on the competition is ramping up and so is the news cycle with all 32 teams in the throes of training camp juicy nuggets are flying fast and furious across the nfl diaspora consequently i want to spotlight the developments that really caught my eye in the first week or so of camp let s take a quick trip through the entire league afc east afc north afc south afc west nfc east nfc north nfc south nfc west

news_mentions.headline: AFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Broncos, Chargers, Chiefs, Raiders
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Bobby Kownack breaks down the top AFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Denver Broncos, Kansas City Chiefs, Las Vegas Raiders and Los Angeles Chargers.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams bobby kownack has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the denver broncos kansas city chiefs las vegas raiders and los angeles chargers catch up on each afc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below denver broncos kansas city chiefs las vegas raiders los angeles chargers three key storylines 1 nix s health receiving corps bo nix should be full go for training camp after suffering a broken ankle in last season s divisional round win but every step in the process bears watching when someone this important to a franchise is returning from injury once nix is out there eyes will also be glued to his pass catching group denver gifted its qb with a second no 1 wideout by trading for jaylen waddle to pair with courtland sutton and camp should provide the first hints as to whether the broncos will employ them as a 1a 1b combo or settle into a more defined pecking order plus can anyone from a proven supporting cast of troy franklin marvin mims and pat bryant emerge as the clear third option 2 denver has a new play caller reaching the doorstep of the super bowl didn t prevent sean payton from enacting sizable changes to the offensive staff he fired offensive coordinator joe lombardi two days after denver s afc title game loss and bumped davis webb up to replace him a month later payton publicly transferred play calling duties to the 31 year old former quarterback it s been a meteoric rise for webb who entered the coaching ranks as payton s qbs coach in 2023 webb has been learning under payton since then so nothing will be unrecognizable but nix still will need to get used to a new voice in his helmet any improvement for a 14th ranked scoring offense on a team that already won 14 games last season would be massive in the afc race 3 broncos are largely running it back roster wise the 2026 broncos are the personification of if it ain t broke don t fix it they took the big swing for waddle but barely signed any outside free agents denver instead focused on retaining talent losing defensive lineman john franklin myers and releasing linebacker dre greenlaw but basically keeping the band together even in the draft the club didn t make a pick until the third round apart from working waddle into the mix with webb now calling the shots the broncos can hit the ground running while many other contenders must start off with finding chemistry that s huge considering how unfriendly the first month and a half of denver s schedule appears at chiefs vs jaguars vs rams at 49ers at chargers and vs seahawks back to top three key storylines 1 when will mahomes be fully healthy patrick mahomes said during the offseason program that he s in a good spot in his acl lcl recovery and hopes to play in week 1 while andy reid told reporters the quarterback should be able to do some things at the start of training camp so how much will mahomes take on when the chiefs report and how quickly will he ramp up activity those questions don t have answers at the moment the chiefs hopes of returning to contention in 2026 and beyond rely heavily on the two time most valuable player so they ll be smart with him justin fields now on his fourth team in as many years could be one of the league s most intensely scrutinized backups as mahomes return timeline takes shape 2 kansas city s cb room begins anew again the chiefs have a habit of maximizing young cornerbacks talent and moving on before the bill comes due most recently they traded two time all pro trent mcduffie and let jaylen watson walk in free agency with both cover men going to the rams kansas city will call on 2025 third rounder nohl williams and mansoor delane this year s no 6 overall pick to fill the void fourth round rookie jadon canady should also be in competition for playing time with free agent signees kader kohou and l 39 jarius sneed the latter of whom returns to kansas city a couple of years after the team traded him to tennessee defensive coordinator steve spagnuolo s track record which includes three straight top six defenses in points allowed suggests things will work out just fine 3 bieniemy s back kansas city s offensive coordinator position has been devalued for years overshadowed by the prowess of patrick mahomes and andy reid perhaps it shouldn t have been during eric bieniemy s five years as the team s oc from 2018 through 2022 the chiefs never finished worse than sixth in the league in points or yards twice tallied the most points and three times amassed the most yards in the last three years without bieniemy the chiefs have ranked at average 17th in scoring and 15th in yardage there were obviously other factors in the decline such as tyreek hill exiting in a trade and travis kelce aging out of his prime but bieniemy returning still bodes well back to top three key storylines 1 mendoza s first camp the future of the raiders now rests on no 1 pick fernando mendoza s shoulders even if he isn t destined to start right away new head coach klint kubiak has communicated that his ideal scenario is to avoid putting a rookie under center in week 1 and by signing veteran kirk cousins las vegas essentially ensured mendoza s starting debut will come via choice rather than need still mendoza is coming off a perfect 16 0 season in which he took home the heisman trophy and led indiana to a national championship he s going to show up for the competition and all the buzz at raiders camp will revolve around him when he does 2 who steps up at wr las vegas has some starry names on offense quarterback fernando mendoza running back ashton jeanty and tight end brock bowers at wide receiver though there s work to do tre tucker was easily the team s most trustworthy wideout last year but he doesn t really profile as a wr1 jack bech and dont 39 e thornton 2025 second and fourth round picks respectively are looking to rebound from underwhelming rookie seasons free agent addition jalen nailor has a chance to show staying power in a larger role after flashing promise with 858 yards and 10 tds on 57 catches over the past two years with the vikings those are likely las vegas top four in some order but there s still a lot to shake out during the preseason 3 crosby s defense 2 0 in the four days between the raiders agreeing to send maxx crosby to the ravens and baltimore backing out of the trade las vegas spent a whole lot of dough rebuilding its defense for what was supposed to be the post crosby era now thanks to the blockbuster deal falling apart crosby is very much a part of the present the five time pro bowler returned to possibly the most talented unit the raiders have had during his career the linebacking corps has been rebuilt with nakobe dean and quay walker taron johnson brings more legitimacy to the cornerback room and kwity paye is set to line up on the edge opposite crosby reason for excitement in sin city extends far beyond the team s top picked qb back to top three key storylines 1 mcdaniel effect it was time for a change after the chargers scored 15 combined points in their last two wild card exits jim harbaugh fired offensive coordinator greg roman a longtime collaborator and replaced him with mike mcdaniel to hopefully supercharge the offense as the former dolphins coach did in his first couple years with miami mcdaniel s arrival as a quarterback whisperer is good news for justin herbert who already plays at a pro bowl level but the impact of his high octane system should be felt everywhere from the promising tight end trio of oronde gadsden david njoku and charlie kolar to omarion hampton in the backfield 2 fingers crossed for l a s o line los angeles offensive line should be a strength of the team in 2026 after disaster struck last season left tackle rashawn slater suffered a season ending patellar tendon tear in august while right tackle joe alt played just six games before requiring season ending ankle surgery herbert took a career high 54 sacks behind a patchwork offensive line leading the league with 268 pressures taken and a 43 3 pressure rate slater and alt are back but they ll also be joined on the line by free agent signings tyler biadasz and cole strange as well as second round rookie jake slaughter assuming the group stays healthy herbert should be well protected first though the bolts blockers have to jell together as a unit in august 3 chargers hope they have an edge rushing duo to build around the offseason didn t bring any sweeping changes for the chargers defense dalvin tomlinson 32 was their most notable signing to bulk up the interior and they lost a few pass rushers odafe oweh and da 39 shawn hand but largely maintained the status quo los angeles did however spend a first round pick on akheem mesidor the acc sack leader in 2025 with 12 5 there s enough pass rushing depth that mesidor won t have to take on too much too soon more importantly he has some stellar mentors in tuli tuipulotu who was sixth in the nfl last season with 13 sacks and nine time pro bowler khalil mack the hope is for a seamless transition from mack to mesidor alongside tuipulotu as the leaders of the l a edge rush back to top

news_mentions.headline: 2025 NFL position battles: Picks to win 10 notable training camp competitions across the league
news_mentions.description: With training camps opening across the NFL, which position battles demand your attention? Kevin Patra spotlights 10 intriguing competitions, including four quarterback derbies.
news_mentions.body_text: summer is over for pigskin professionals the nfl is back with training camps opening across the league it s time for the competitions for jobs to commence competition is the name of the game for every squad it s what breeds improvement and ultimately leads to winning certain positions with limited rep sharing lend themselves to more notable battles you won t see many defensive competitions highlighted mainly because the hefty rotations and matchup centric usage tend to make camp fights less impactful as the season approaches below are the top 10 camp battles i ll be monitoring throughout training camp and into the preseason

news_mentions.headline: Arizona Cardinals training camp 2025 preview: Key dates, notable additions, biggest storylines
news_mentions.description: With the start of NFL training camps just around the corner, Grant Gordon provides a refresher on the Arizona Cardinals' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc west catch up on the arizona cardinals offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 22 rookies and veterans location state farm stadium glendale ariz fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs kansas city chiefs 8 p m et on saturday aug 9 week 2 at denver broncos 7 p m et on saturday aug 16 week 3 vs las vegas raiders 4 30 p m et on saturday aug 23 2025 schedule note arizona plays san francisco and seattle in back to back weeks twice weeks 3 4 weeks 10 11 but doesn t play los angeles the reigning nfc west champion until week 14 and then again in week 18 nfl research what you need to know 1 beneficiaries of two first round draft picks in 2024 the cardinals were left wanting much more from marvin harrison and darius robinson in total harrison s 62 receptions for 885 yards and eight touchdowns as a rookie are pretty solid but many thought the no 4 overall selection would be a superstar out of the gate harrison and quarterback kyler murray furthering their chemistry could well be the team s prevailing storyline this season and that will get going in earnest during camp robinson picked 23 slots after harrison last year played in just six games because of a calf injury this will be a pivotal camp for him especially amid a revamped defensive front one that will offer him veterans to learn from and new faces to compete against for snaps 2 one of the easiest players in the nfl to root for calais campbell 38 returning to the team he began his illustrious career with in 2008 is more than just a feel great story campbell s leadership is just as important an addition as his talent to a club looking for its first winning season since 2021 this is a pivotal season for the monti ossenfort jonathan gannon regime and campbell pass rusher josh sweat and defensive tackle dalvin tomlinson should add some veteran moxie to a team lacking it outside of star safety budda baker gannon was hired for his defensive prowess coordinating the philadelphia eagles now his arizona d is finally stocked up at least on paper it s added some experienced talent and two high profile rookies in defensive lineman walter nolen first round no 16 overall and cornerback will johnson second no 47 johnson has the ceiling to become a massive draft steal how the cards defensive additions mesh with the starting staples begins this summer 3 james conner joined arizona in 2021 and has been a stellar fit who has exceeded his output and importance with the pittsburgh steelers for four years prior he s coming off career high tallies in carries 236 and rushing yards 1 094 but is entering his age 30 season 2024 third rounder trey benson 63 carries for 291 yards had a disappointing debut campaign but if he finds his footing could he push conner for touches it ll be interesting to see how camp develops in the arizona offensive backfield

news_mentions.headline: Kansas City Chiefs' late collapse vs. Denver Broncos opens up AFC West race
news_mentions.description: Prior to Sunday's game, the Chiefs were 80-2 when leading by 10 or more in the fourth quarter under Patrick Mahomes.
Patrick Mahomes

material_news_signals.headline: The Chiefs were seconds from a huge win in Denver. Instead, they're searching for answers.
material_news_signals.body_text: denver kansas city chiefs tight end travis kelce was almost fully dressed when he turned to a group of reporters gathering near his locker 34 give me one second guys 34 kelce said heading around a corner and briefly disappearing this was minutes after the chiefs 39 crushing fall from ahead 28 24 road loss to the denver broncos on sunday afternoon at mile high and with those five words kelce did more than promise he 39 d be back he also acknowledged that he specifically needed to speak on the defeat the 37 year old kelce returned a few minutes later his eyes red and spoke with the type of emotion that he hasn 39 t always shared after games 34 the reality of things is we got to fix a lot 34 kelce said 34 the little things mistakes and it starts with the person you 39 re looking at i 39 m one of them 34 kelce went on to talk about a small detail that has become a big issue for these chiefs penalties and for the past three weeks kelce said he 39 s been a problem he had a false start sunday making it three consecutive games he 39 s hurt his team with an infraction the chiefs had 11 penalties for 105 yards in all sunday including one in the final seconds that literally cost them a victory as it wiped away a game winning touchdown again kelce said that type of discipline needs to start with him 34 it 39 s frustrating you just can 39 t f ing do it excuse my language 34 kelce said 34 i 39 ve got to be better for my teammates and that sets the tone for a lot of people in this room 34 it was just one scene inside a stunned locker room following a defeat that never seemed imminent until the game 39 s final play according to the win probability calculator at rbsdm com the chiefs had a 93 percent chance of winning with 13 40 left in the fourth quarter at that point they led 24 13 and had the ball 34 we just didn 39 t finish 34 kelce said 34 we just didn 39 t finish the way we should 39 ve 34 the collapse from there took all three phases kicker harrison butker missed a 54 yard field goal the team surely will evaluate its options at that position again this week meanwhile a defense that prides itself on tackling and limiting big plays surrendered two long touchdown drives in the final nine minutes one aided by a 51 yard catch and run from broncos running back jonah coleman 34 missed two tackles then we 39 re playing on the goal line 34 said defensive tackle chris jones of that sequence 34 i think more so if we can have some things back it 39 s the missed tackles 34 even after all that quarterback patrick mahomes moved his team to first and goal on the broncos 39 4 yard line in the closing seconds only for k c to be held short on four consecutive plays well five if you count the penalty mahomes completed what appeared to be a game winning touchdown pass to receiver rashee rice on fourth and goal from the 1 only for it to be waved off as right tackle jaylon moore was whistled for a false start replays showed a slight flinch back from moore then a turn of his head it wasn 39 t much but it was enough to draw a flag the chiefs had a wide array of reactions to that infraction in particular after the game moore 34 just got to look at the tape it was called there 39 s nothing else we can do about it now so it was on me just got to be better about it 34 coach andy reid 34 i didn 39 t see it but that 39 s one man 39 s opinion i saw him move his head but i didn 39 t see a false start 34 mahomes 34 i have not seen it but it didn 39 t catch me it didn 39 t surprise me or catch me or anything like that so it couldn 39 t have been big but it was called at the end of the day you have to go with whatever 39 s called but a lot of times in those big moments the little stuff doesn 39 t get called like that 34 the chiefs moved back 5 yards and mahomes then faced pressure on the final snap with his last ditch pass attempt officially recorded as a sack in the box score per nfl next gen stats it was just the third game in mahomes 39 career in which his chiefs blew a lead of 10 plus points in the fourth quarter it hadn 39 t happened since week 2 of the 2021 season the confluence of events left mahomes dazed afterward he faced his locker minutes after the game socks pulled half down elbows on knees leaning forward to review video of the chiefs 39 final plays on his phone some time passed before he eventually set his phone face down in his locker having analyzed those snaps long enough to move on 34 you want to score you 39 re on the 1 yard line you 39 re in the red zone you got down there 34 mahomes said 34 you want to go out and capitalize 34 the mistakes though have become a frustrating and familiar theme mahomes said that at a team meeting the night before sunday 39 s game he had been asked what play he 39 d want to run with the game on the line he chose the pass the chiefs ultimately called on their initial fourth and goal attempt which used kelce as a decoy to free up rice over the middle it was perfect it worked against a great broncos defense and it was all for naught because the chiefs couldn 39 t avoid a flag in that critical moment 34 we had to go to a different play on that last one and they covered it well 34 mahomes said 34 whenever you get there you get that close and you don 39 t capitalize you take that on yourself and you learn from it 34 the harsh reality can 39 t be ignored the chiefs blew an opportunity to alter their season 39 s course by choking away this one with a win they would have had roughly an 83 percent chance of winning the afc west according to the athletic 39 s nfl playoff simulator a few more victories and they could 39 ve turned their sights to positioning for the no 1 seed a home playoff game all but guaranteed now the chiefs are actually slight underdogs for the division title per the playoff simulator behind these broncos both teams sit at around 48 percent to capture the afc west the simplest math however coming out of sunday 39 s game denver is 6 2 k c is 5 2 the chiefs have ground to make up and the most difficult part of their schedule remaining 34 obviously it was a big game i 39 m not going to hide from that 34 mahomes said 34 but now you 39 re in a dogfight for the division 34 mahomes said he hopes his team will focus on process over results next give attention to the daily grind get a little better each day work to be in a position to play your best football late as for kelce he promised his teammates would respond after sunday 39 s loss left a 34 sour taste 34 in his mouth 34 we 39 ve got a lot of men in here that give a damn about this season and care about each other i think that 39 s a winning formula in itself 34 kelce said 34 we 39 ve just got to go out there and do it 34 this article originally appeared in the athletic
