news_mentions.headline: NFC South training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Buccaneers, Falcons, Panthers, Saints
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Nick Shook breaks down the top NFC South training camp storylines to monitor for the Atlanta Falcons, Carolina Panthers, New Orleans Saints and Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams nick shook has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the atlanta falcons carolina panthers new orleans saints and tampa bay buccaneers catch up on each nfc south team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below atlanta falcons carolina panthers new orleans saints tampa bay buccaneers three key storylines 1 stefanski era begins despite a strong finish to the 2025 season the falcons dismissed raheem morris in january and replaced him with another recently fired head man in kevin stefanski shifting the organizational focus from a defensive minded coach to one with extensive experience on the other side of the ball amid the coaching change stefanski wisely chose to retain defensive coordinator jeff ulbrich attempting to maintain a sense of continuity for a unit that was the team s strength last year now the responsibility of pushing the falcons out of the 500 range falls on the shoulders of stefanski a coach with a point to prove after being unceremoniously dumped by the browns he s had success two playoff appearances a postseason win and two coach of the year awards but nothing would be sweeter to stefanski than immediately leading atlanta to the playoffs in his first season at the helm he ll need to produce results fairly quickly too given the falcons expectation of competing after consecutive 8 9 finishes 2 all eyes on the quarterbacks much of stefanski s first year success will depend on the quarterback situation tua tagovailoa hopped on board after he was cut by the dolphins bringing experience to a room that could use it while also providing the falcons with a second left handed quarterback tagovailoa might need to handle the starting duties early in the season too depending on how quickly michael penix can return from the season ending knee injury suffered in 2025 that dynamic could create its own intrigue or perhaps controversy if tagovailoa excels the fit makes sense too stefanski s wide zone rushing attack has traditionally paired with a timing based passing game the scheme that best matches tagovailoa s strengths with two options under center an optimist will say the falcons are in an advantageous position others will note two options usually means no answer at quarterback that is unless penix returns and gets back on track atlanta s former top 10 pick still needs to prove he s worth that draft status and year 3 is typically the pivotal season his progress or lack thereof will heavily influence the trajectory of this team in 2026 3 ulbrich s new look defense atlanta s defense has its work cut out the 2025 falcons improved to 15th in yards allowed per game and 19th in scoring d while finishing second in sacks numbers that suggest there s reason to feel encouraged entering 2026 plenty of departures have followed though leading tackler kaden elliss left for new orleans veteran arnold ebiketie departed for philadelphia david onyemata signed with the jets and dee alford joined the bills leading sack artist and 2025 first round pick james pearce returns but his status remains uncertain after he was arrested and subsequently entered a pretrial intervention program to resolve three felony charges during the offseason the nfl has yet to determine pearce s fate in 2026 but if he misses significant time the combined absences could be enough to sink the unit atlanta responded by adding linebacker christian harris and defensive tackle maason smith as projected starters and also signed da 39 shawn hand and samson ebukam as key rotational players preventing ulbrich from returning to an empty cupboard still the challenge exists fortunately atlanta s very strong in the secondary with the safety duo of jessie bates and xavier watts flanked by stout cover man a j terrell and in april the franchise spent a second round pick on a j s brother avieon terrell giving the defensive backfield another versatile piece if nickelback billy bowman can bounce back from an achilles tear that abruptly ended his promising rookie campaign last november the falcons are quite well equipped to handle opposing aerial attacks still following an offseason with notable roster churn the defense will need to jell quickly in order for atlanta to start off on the right foot back to top three key storylines 1 crunch time for young three seasons into his nfl career bryce young hasn t quite produced enough hard evidence to prove he s a franchise quarterback carolina s leadership will suggest otherwise publicly in late april general manager dan morgan said we really feel like the arrow is up with bryce but that sentiment will change quickly if young regresses in year 4 in 2025 he showed signs of blossoming but wasn t consistent in 2026 he needs to become more reliable on a weekly basis an outcome that should be more likely after another offseason spent under coach dave canales if this is young s breakout season the panthers will happily start discussing a long term extension with the former no 1 overall pick but even if they don t say it publicly they still need to be convinced young is headed in such a direction otherwise the fifth year of his deal could spell the beginning of a transition 2 upgrades in key defensive spots the panthers defense received some much needed offseason love it s only right that a former linebacker morgan spent much of his team s resources upgrading that side of the ball after fielding a middling unit in 2025 carolina should be better in the front seven thanks to the additions of edge rusher jaelan phillips signed for a four year 120 million deal linebacker devin lloyd three years 45 million and defensive tackle lee hunter a second round pick who has the potential to become an ideal run stuffing complement to derrick brown it s not a full scale overhaul because carolina didn t need one rather it was a measured reinforcement of a unit that will aim to improve especially in the pass rushing department if young can take a step or two forward and the panthers can evolve into a stronger more balanced team they ll be well positioned to defend their nfc south crown 3 backfield depth backfield questions linger in charlotte where the panthers benefited from a one year deal with rico dowdle in 2025 then watched him walk to pittsburgh in free agency their current running back situation is once again headlined by chuba hubbard who has eclipsed 1 000 yards once in five nfl seasons while averaging 4 1 yards per carry much of this position group depends on whether 2024 second rounder jonathon brooks who has played three games in his first two seasons due to two acl tears can prove he s healthy enough to contribute carolina attempted to build in some insurance by signing veteran aj dillon but his own injury history and minimal usage in philadelphia in 2025 make for an uncertain outlook trevor etienne also returns for his second season after spending most of his rookie snaps on special teams in total the picture appears unsure if not incomplete that can change if brooks contributes but that s a big question mark for a team expecting to contend for a division title back to top three key storylines 1 can shough build on promising finish tyler shough s late season rise inspired an offseason of optimism in the big easy where the saints larger vision became at least partially visible by the end of the 2025 campaign as new orleans closed the year with four wins in its final five games shough emerged as a promising quarterback with the potential to become a franchise signal caller under coach kellen moore perhaps quicker than most anyone expected now with a full offseason as qb1 under his belt shough enters year 2 with heightened expectations at 26 he s already older than the average sophomore starter and is paired with a former quarterback in moore who has demonstrated his ability to guide offenses toward fruitful futures both in dallas and philadelphia now moore is equipped with a quarterback he can mold a passer who appears wiser and more capable than the average second year starter thanks in part to his extensive collegiate experience there s legitimate reason to think the saints have already answered the most challenging question that comes with a rebuild now it s about proving those optimists right by continuing to build on the progress shough made as a rookie 2 new offensive weapons moore has some new toys in his offense upon the start of free agency new orleans quickly scooped up running back travis etienne giving the saints a much needed successor to alvin kamara with a similar three down skill set kamara is still on the roster too providing new orleans with some depth in a room that also includes kendre miller and devin neal the receiver position welcomed a prestigious addition too when the saints followed their hearts and selected arizona state star jordyn tyson at no 8 overall adding to an intriguing receiver room that includes chris olave and devaughn vele as has long been the case in new orleans health will be paramount for this club tyson and olave have a history of missing time due to injury and kamara played in a career low 11 games last season beyond olave tyson and vele the saints lack reliable depth at wr two more rookies bryce lance and barion brown are slated to compete for spots among a group that also includes trey palmer kevin austin and ja 39 lynn polk if they can keep their best healthy the saints could surprise some folks but as we ve learned in recent years that s far from guaranteed 3 jordan s last dance cam jordan is back for one final season after an offseason mostly spent unsigned the saints legend ultimately re upped on a one year deal in june signing up for one last run with the team he s helped define since entering the league as a first round pick back in 2011 with that comes a message to the rest of this ascending squad there s no time to waste jordan and chase young comprised a potent edge rushing duo in 2025 with each hitting double digit sacks with playmakers at all three levels the saints defense is ready to match its ninth place finish from 2025 it ll have a little extra to play for in 2026 too back to top three key storylines 1 mayfield entering pivotal season baker mayfield has enjoyed a career renaissance in florida over the last three seasons earning a three year 100 million deal with the team after a strong 2023 campaign and largely living up to the standards that come with such a contract when viewed from a league wide perspective baker deserves his spot and shouldn t worry about his future in tampa but those who have followed this team closely also understand that mayfield is a streaky player he s electrifying when at his best and can propel the buccaneers toward great success but he also struggles to get out of his own way at times in 2025 mayfield started white hot leading tampa bay to a 6 2 start and pushing the team into the national conversation as a possible super bowl contender then injuries struck sending mayfield into a stretch of struggles that coincided with roster losses elsewhere and resulted in a pile of defeats and a postseason spent at home for the first time since 2022 he finished with fewer than 4 000 passing yards instead of watching his offensive coordinator land a head coaching job elsewhere thanks in part to his successes as dave canales and liam coen had done before his play caller was fired now mayfield enters a contract year with a hard negotiating deadline the start of training camp without his favorite target mike evans who left for san francisco and with fresh questions to answer should things go well mayfield will remain the bucs franchise quarterback for the foreseeable future but if he encounters more struggles it could cost him millions and inspire changes beyond his control that drastically change the landscape in tampa 2 bowles seat is warm near the end of a frustrating somewhat inexplicable collapse in 2025 plenty of folks expected the buccaneers to move on from todd bowles and start fresh with a new coach that didn t happen of course and bowles is back to justify the organization s support in 2026 if the bucs struggle like they did last season with bowles defense finishing 20th in points allowed he ll likely be out of a job and tampa bay will be facing a potentially significant shift in identity for the first time since tom brady arrived in 2020 some thought it s precisely what the buccaneers needed after 2025 and pointed toward evans departure as proof that things weren t right at one buc place the team will have to embark on the new campaign without two franchise legends in evans and linebacker lavonte david who retired after 14 seasons another concerning sign about tampa s trajectory it will be up to bowles to prove the concerns are overblown 3 does tampa have enough on defense to win despite being led by a defensive minded head coach bowles buccaneers became an offense first team over the last few seasons as mayfield powered an explosive attack bowles units proved average at best finishing 23rd 18th and 19th in total yards allowed over the last three seasons the bucs haven t landed inside the top 10 since 2022 bowles first season as head coach entering 2026 the bucs seem to have an assortment of pieces that could form an improved defense the team wisely spent its first round pick on miami edge rusher rueben bain supplying bowles with a legitimate threat at the edge position opposite yaya diaby for the first time since the final few years of shaq barrett s career which ended with a one game campaign in 2024 tampa bay s secondary should benefit from another year of development for benjamin morrison jacob parrish and tykee smith but as of now it remains a unit carried by antoine winfield linebacker includes some questions too after david s retirement free agent addition alex anzalone arrives to great expectations and veteran christian rozeboom also entered the fray furthermore tampa spent its second round pick on lb josiah trotter with bowles in charge this defense could very well exceed expectations it could also determine the team s fate and the security of its coach s employment back to top

news_mentions.headline: NFC North training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Bears, Lions, Packers, Vikings
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Kevin Patra breaks down the top NFC North training camp storylines to monitor for the Chicago Bears, Detroit Lions, Green Bay Packers and Minnesota Vikings.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the chicago bears detroit lions green bay packers and minnesota vikings catch up on each nfc north team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below chicago bears detroit lions green bay packers minnesota vikings three key storylines 1 can caleb find consistency we could discuss the bears offense taking another leap forward in ben johnson s second season we could consider the burgeoning potential of luther burden alongside rome odunze or ponder who will win the primary wr3 duties we could chatter about how much higher tight end colston loveland could fly or how johnson will use his diverse te room none of that really strikes a chord without caleb williams taking his game to new heights the former no 1 pick showed what the highs can look like in year 1 under johnson the explosive jaw dropping plays were plentiful and the qb led a trove of comebacks now he must flatten out some of the lulls the drive stalling misfires and become a more potent every snap quarterback keep the extraordinary peaks and raise the floor and williams will be in the thick of the mvp discussion the madden nfl 27 cover athlete heads into year 3 with heightened expectations if he meets them there is no telling how far the bears can go 2 defensive uncertainty from front to back questions on defense will hover over training camp the bears did precious little to upgrade a wanting front four the club added a few rotational interior defenders but is counting significantly on bounce back campaigns from grady jarrett and gervon dexter montez sweat still doesn t have a proven pass rusher on the opposite side austin booker showed signs down the stretch last year but can he take his game to another level is there enough down the line will shemar turner be healthy following last october s acl tear the questions up front are echoed on the back end where the bears are replacing both starting safeties coby bryant and cam lewis are solid but can they produce as many turnovers as the previous crew the key is first round pick dillon thieneman will the rookie be ready to thrive in dennis allen s scheme by week 1 3 two questions on the offensive line ozzy trapilo s patellar tendon injury in the wild card round means the bears can t count on the left tackle for at least the beginning of the season veteran braxton jones is penciled into the starting lineup but he will have to win the battle with jedrick wills and theo benedet to earn the week 1 assignment the position is one to keep an eye on the rest of the o line profiles as one of the better units in the nfl but if the left side becomes leaky it could be a cascading problem also i m going to keep tabs on the center spot the bears replaced drew dalman who abruptly retired this offseason with garrett bradbury as the presumptive starter however second round rookie logan jones could push the veteran for the starting gig during camp back to top three key storylines 1 offensive line overhaul the lions offensive line collapsed last season swiftly going from asset to liability detroit attacked the unit flipping penei sewell to left tackle drafting blake miller to man the right edge signing center cade mays and adding veteran depth at each spot how the line shakes out will be the main storyline to track during camp is sewell s transition going smoothly is miller a plug and play rookie or does he need time to adjust the key will be young guards christian mahogany and tate ratledge who struggled with consistency in 2025 will the duo improve or could they get pushed out of the starting lineup if the lions don t get better blocking in 2026 the explosive potential will be squandered 2 this is gibbs backfield sonic is now the featured character in detroit the offseason trade of david montgomery calcified the reality that jahmyr gibbs bell cow era is full go gibbs began to take over the majority of the backfield touches last season and his reps should continue to grow the lions likely won t want the dual threat back to creep to the 300 carry threshold but barring injury he ll blast past his career high of 250 totes gibbs should also see his role in the passing game continue to rise after posting a career best 77 catches for 616 yards and five touchdowns in 2025 gibbs combination of shiftiness speed and ability to make hay between and outside the tackles makes him a dynamic threat the lions want to ensure that threat stays on the field as much as possible he profiles for a christian mccaffrey type workload and should be in the offensive player of the year discussion by the end of the season with the expected rise in reps gibbs extension is also one we ve been waiting to see this offseason the lions have gotten in front of extensions in recent years so everyone expects a top of the rb market contract for gibbs to come barreling down the pike 3 can detroit return to health detroit has significant injuries to track at the onset of camp tight end sam laporta is the name to watch on offense but the defense has greater concerns brian branch suffered a late season achilles tear and while the lions haven t put a hard timeline on the safety s recovery it will be a surprise if he s good to go to open the season the bigger question is whether given the type of injury he sustained branch will be his normal buzzing self at all this season then there is kerby joseph whose knee injury limited him to just six games last season the lions have given few tangible updates on the safety s status while taking a wait and see approach without certainty from either starter the lions secondary sits in a precarious spot couple that with the release of cb terrion arnold and detroit could be relying once again on filler and journeymen in the defensive backfield back to top three key storylines 1 who rushes the passer until micah returns after tearing up his knee last december micah parsons is set to start camp on the physically unable to perform list and in all likelihood he ll start the season on pup wiping out his first four games there is always the chance parsons gets back earlier but given how he spoke about his timetable last month i expect him and the club to play it safe sans the dynamic pass rusher for the opening gambit there are significant questions up front in green bay the offseason trade of rashan gary made sense for the club but his absence further highlights a shallow edge group the packers need former first round pick lukas van ness to finally find his footing how he looks early in camp could tell us if green bay needs to add another veteran fourth round rookie dani dennis sutton also could have some say in that plan until parsons returns this might be a mix and match crew van ness is the key to whether the pack can survive the early portion of the calendar 2 jacobs uncertainty looms large josh jacobs situation continues to hover over the franchise after he was arrested in may at this stage it s unclear how local authorities will handle the situation in turn we don t know whether the league will take disciplinary action jacobs was on the field with his team last month and if things remain unchanged he should be there for camp if any action is taken against jacobs it could have a significant impact on the on field product in green bay jacobs is the workhorse and engine of the ground attack if he s unavailable or gets injured during the season matt lafleur s offense could be in some trouble next up are former undrafted free agent chris brooks a third down back and marshawn lloyd who has been unable to stay healthy the packers believe lloyd finally has turned a corner but until we see it in action that s a projection we can t assume we need to see the third year back produce during camp and into the preseason while staying healthy in the process 3 pass catching puzzle solved the pass catching unit in green bay is also something i m intrigued by the packers watched romeo doubs leave in free agency and traded dontayvion wicks then they inked jayden reed and christian watson to extensions those two and 2025 first rounder matthew golden comprise the top receiving trio with a clearer rotation at wr i believe the three can each thrive golden is the one to watch after he finished an uneven rookie campaign with a productive effort four catches for 84 yards and a score in the packers wild card weekend loss at chicago there are some depth questions particularly given the crew s injury history so that battle among reserves will be worth tracking tucker kraft s health is another piece to keep an eye on despite tearing his acl last november the pivotal playmaker is aiming to be ready for week 1 could he return with a new contract as well back to top three key storylines 1 kyler vs j j competition or coronation vikings coach kevin o connell continues to insist he s running a legitimate quarterback competition he keeps having to say it because frankly not many believe that j j mccarthy has a shot to keep kyler murray out of the starting lineup perhaps we ll be stunned but every indicator suggests it s murray s job to lose the former no 1 overall pick enters with proven ability while mccarthy has struggled when on the field and had issues staying healthy murray could open up the offense and his propensity to force feed his top targets could be a harbinger of a justin jefferson bounce back this competition in whatever form that takes will be tracked daily come camp within that context i m interested in how murray fits into koc s system and whether his mobility adds an element we haven t seen much of in minnesota over the past few years 2 next men up on the edge the trade of jonathan greenard took a chunk out of the defense not only because greenard was a proven disruptor but also due to the fact that the vikings now aren t very flush at the position dallas turner whom the club is counting on to have a full breakout in year 3 and andrew van ginkel sit atop the edge rusher corps but bo richter chaz chambliss and tyler batty are the next three players up on the depth chart they ve combined for one career sack chambliss defensive lineman tyrion ingram dawkins has also taken some reps on the edge the vikings could look to add another veteran rusher during camp or early in the season we trust brian flores defense but a coach who generally relies on vets who understand his system will be asking a lot out of youngsters how rookies caleb banks domonique orange jakobe thomas and charles demmings make the transition will have a significant say in the vikings outcome this season 3 one last dance with hitman we expected to have a resolution one way or the other on harrison smith s future surprisingly the situation still lingers will he return for another go or will he officially retire the club has made it clear they d welcome a return and didn t add a veteran to take smith s place jakobe thomas a third round pick was the only significant addition the club made to the safety crew given how much flores relies on the versatility of his safeties a return by smith would have a significant impact if he decides to retire jay ward theo jackson and thomas will battle for reps keep an eye on thomas and charles demmings in camp and preseason each could play key roles in 2026 back to top

news_mentions.description: Around The NFL breaks down what you need to know from Sunday's action in Week 8 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 8 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below early window buffalo bills 36 baltimore ravens 10 cincinnati bengals 43 tennessee titans 36 ot arizona cardinals 33 dallas cowboys 30 ot detroit lions 19 minnesota vikings 15 jacksonville jaguars 42 indianapolis colts 7 las vegas raiders 38 new york jets 33 pittsburgh steelers 27 cleveland browns 6 tampa bay buccaneers 16 atlanta falcons 0 late window los angeles rams 24 los angeles chargers 9 denver broncos 28 kansas city chiefs 24 new england patriots 24 miami dolphins 19 sunday night washington commanders 27 philadelphia eagles 10 nick shook s takeaways bills let hunters loose buffalo s biggest underlying question mark was its defense a leaky unit that struggled to get stops and limit opposing offenses in what became weekly shootouts for the bills that finally changed for the better on sunday with lamar jackson exiting quickly and tyler huntley back in the lineup buffalo decided it was time to hunt the quarterback dialing up blitzes and registering pressures on half of huntley s four passes which also incidentally forced huntley out of the game due to injury once undrafted rookie joe fagnano took over the carnivorous bills saw nothing but red meat blitzing on 64 5 of their total defensive snaps logging qb pressures at a rate of 61 3 and short circuiting baltimore s offense all afternoon the ravens finished with just 144 net yards of offense scored their only touchdown via a short field earned by a broderick washington interception and couldn t piece together more than one drive of significance which ended in a 26 yard tyler loop field goal buffalo s defense made sure it wouldn t allow derrick henry to carry the ravens and denied fagnano the space to breathe overwhelming the inexperienced signal caller in a runaway win quarterback injuries decimate ravens lamar jackson s anticipated return lasted just one snap his first pass attempt fell incomplete and on the follow through to his throw jackson s thumb collided with a defender s hand resulting in an injury that will land jackson on injured reserve for the foreseeable future after a few weeks of backup turned starter duty tyler huntley found himself on the field sunday appearing skittish and struggling to gain a single yard through the air before an injury knocked him out of action as well leaving the ravens with their emergency third qb joe fagnano as their only remaining option the uconn product gave his best effort but was constantly under duress leaving the ravens with little room to move the ball all afternoon zay flowers went without a catch on five targets rashod bateman s one catch for 22 yards accounted for the most receiving production for any raven and running back justice hill led baltimore in receptions with four it was a lifeless offense that left the ravens defense on the field for far too long buffalo won the time of possession battle 37 36 to 22 24 and sunday s display should rightfully worry ravens fans about their team s outlook for the remainder of 2026 it sounds as if jackson s season could be finished and recent results without him including sunday are discouraging at best moore delivers in return after missing a handful of weeks buffalo welcomed back its prized offseason acquisition d j moore who showed no signs of hesitancy and delivered a strong outing four catches 82 yards including a spectacular grab for 49 yards to set up a james cook touchdown and a touchdown catch moore s return helped draw some attention away from buffalo s tight ends dalton kincaid finished with a team best 86 yards and a touchdown on four catches took a bit of pressure off cook and unlocked enough of the unit s attack to help the bills climb out of a grind it out start to pour it on in the second half moore s rapport with josh allen remains strong even after the time off and helped allen pass jim kelly for the franchise s all time lead in touchdowns 260 now moore will need to prove he can be this reliable on a weekly basis next gen stats insight for ravens bills via nfl pro the bills blitzed on 64 5 of opposing dropbacks against the ravens in week 8 their highest blitz rate since 2021 and the highest blitz rate ravens quarterbacks have faced this season the bills blitz rate had not exceeded 39 in any of their prior six games this season when blitzing the bills generated 11 pressures including a season high seven quick pressures under 2 5 seconds and three sacks including a strip sack fumble recovery in the second quarter nfl research josh allen and james cook each had a rushing touchdown in week 8 marking the 16th time that allen and cook have scored a rushing touchdown in the same game sixteen games breaks a tie with dak prescott and ezekiel elliott for the most games by any teammate duo in nfl history in which both players had a rushing touchdown back to top bobby kownack s takeaways burrow was everything good bad about bengals offense what a roller coaster performance by joe burrow the cincy quarterback unquestionably served as the team s hero accounting for six touchdowns in an unexpected shootout with the titans but his three interceptions contributed initially to a slow start and later allowed tennessee to stay in it two of those picks were deep heaves to ja 39 marr chase with one way overthrown and another that came up far too short if you re going to make mistakes though make sure you make up for them burrow did that and more piling on the points and feeding his top two receivers to great success tee higgins had 10 catches for 155 yards and two tds on 11 targets while chase tallied 11 receptions for 141 yards and a score on 16 looks burrow also importantly cleaned it up in crunch time of his five drives that took place in the fourth quarter or overtime one ended in a chase brown fumble and the other ticked down the final 17 seconds to the extra frame on the other three burrow marched his bengals 73 81 and 70 yards throwing two touchdowns and scoring the game winner on a 9 yard scramble he finished with 426 yards five tds and three ints on 38 of 48 passing marking his third consecutive game with at least four passing touchdowns it s a bit scary how many points the bengals put up despite four giveaways and that s all credit to burrow standout performances not enough for tennessee there was not an ounce of quit in the titans after trading away their best player defensive tackle jeffery simmons on thursday the defense still generated four takeaways the most it has had in a game this season safety amani hooker had joe burrow s number intercepting him a whopping three times while defensive end jacob martin tallied three sacks and linebacker anthony hill was relentless with 14 tackles on offense cam ward enjoyed by far his best game of the season despite being without carnell tate ward dissected cincinnati s defense with regularity going 26 of 40 for 304 yards and two touchdowns snapping a five game interception streak and nearly doubling his average of 168 4 passing yards per game he led two separate go ahead td drives in the fourth quarter plus tony pollard continued his recent resurgence rushing for 117 yards and two scores after going for 129 and three tds in week 7 his 40 yard touchdown to open the scoring will be one of the highlights of the day in his or any game with pollard breaking multiple tackles before stiff arming one bengals defender into another s path in a keystone cops sequence on the way to pay dirt of course it was still not enough for the 1 7 titans but the fight they showed was admirable regardless of the nfl s aversion to moral victories concerning trends taking shape for bengals the most important result from sunday is the bengals moving to 5 2 in a highly competitive afc north however there are some underlying issues still plaguing cincinnati the bengals found themselves trailing 13 0 for the second straight week this deficit came at the end of the first quarter unlike last week s halftime hole against the ravens and the bengals started picking it up much earlier to go into intermission with a lead but they couldn t pull away like they did in baltimore instead the titans pushed them to overtime taking advantage of a defense that forced a pair of turnovers but couldn t get enough stops to make things easy in the past three games the bengals have needed to outlast a one win titans team in overtime looked asleep for far too long facing backup quarterback tyler huntley and let a then winless dolphins squad make things uncomfortable late before that it was two straight losses those who choose optimism will point to the bengals record and their three game winning streak but venturing through a season as escape artists typically catches up down the line next gen stats insight for titans bengals via nfl pro amani hooker picked off joe burrow three times which included 15 3 expected points added across five targets in coverage the second most coverage epa by a player in a game this season hooker allowed only 12 yards in coverage on the day nfl research joe burrow became just the second quarterback in league history to have 450 plus passing yards five plus passing tds and a rushing td in a game joining norm van brocklin week 1 1951 back to top nick shook s takeaways qb change sparks comeback through nearly three quarters the cardinals were repeating the same frustrating offensive performance that had become all too familiar in recent weeks jacoby brissett was under constant pressure and resorting to throws that amounted to little more than prayers and after watching brissett take two consecutive sacks for double digit negative yardage in the third quarter coach mike lafleur had enough calling for gardner minshew to replace the battered brissett oddly enough the quarterback change coincided with a revival of the running game that depended solely on tyler allgeier after jeremiyah love left with another ankle injury and bam knight was knocked out of action due to a concussion allgeier put the team on his back rushing 11 times for 147 yards and a touchdown and repeatedly turning to the sideline oxygen tank as a means of survival minshew meanwhile created a rhythm in the passing game that the cardinals haven t enjoyed in over a month completing 17 of 23 passes for 188 yards and three touchdowns including a magnificent final touchdown drive that covered 80 yards in eight plays and 1 03 to tie the game and balancing the offense by turning to michael wilson plenty eight catches 111 yards one touchdown arizona pulled off this 23 point outburst and improbable comeback after losing love knight and receiver kendrick bourne maximizing its returns with its remaining contributors with just enough time to escape defeat it will likely prompt a quarterback change and could be a minor springboard forward for a team that was desperate for a morale boosting win like this cowboys collapse could have devastating effect dallas will look back at this game and have no choice but to admit this was its worst loss of 2026 entering the final minute of the third quarter the cowboys were in control holding a 17 3 lead that was all but guaranteed to eventually become 20 3 or larger in that moment though their defense broke down surrendering a rumbling 63 yard touchdown run to tyler allgeier the first of a few massive chunks gained by allgeier in the final 16 minutes of regulation on a 52 yard allgeier run in the fourth quarter safety caleb downs got pancaked by hjalte froholdt twice in the same play typifying arizona s sudden takeover with the image of downs tumbling across the turf like a runaway cheese wheel speeding down a hill this all happened after dallas had suffocated arizona s offense for the first 44 minutes of the game and the cardinals awakening delivered repeated violent blows to the ribcage of the cowboys defense landing a liver punch in the form of a michael wilson dependent touchdown drive to tie the game in the final six seconds of regulation a quick defensive stop and a 44 yard scoring drive in overtime sent the cowboys to the mat for good resulting in one of the most stunning outcomes of the entire nfl season this type of loss can send a team into a spiral could cost defensive coordinator christian parker his job and will undoubtedly cause cowboys fans to angrily punch the air the same problems persist they still can t beat the lowly cardinals in texas and the solutions continue to prove fleeting arizona s rebuilt backfield disintegrates but one pillar remains standing tyler allgeier s second half outburst produced a victory for the cardinals but it was even more triumphant for a workhorse who has often been left to the shadows of more recognizable running mates in atlanta and arizona the talk at the start of the season revolved around first round pick jeremiyah love and when the cardinals couldn t generate consistently on the ground love s absence was quickly blamed allgeier never quite saw the chances he needed to blossom but found himself in an unexpected moment of opportunity sunday when love and bam knight exited due to injury he could have played an average brand of football as the lone remaining runner available but that s not allgeier those who were unfamiliar with his style were reminded rudely on his 63 yard touchdown run in which he broke three tackles and followed a trio of teammates who escorted him to the goal line where he fell across it for a score while finally being brought down that touchdown made it a 17 10 game but more importantly it gave the cardinals reason to believe his ensuing 52 yarder saw hjalte froholdt get out in front and wreck caleb downs in open space setting an aggressive tone embodied by the runner benefitting from the blocking in those two plays and gardner minshew s stint as a mid game replacement the cardinals brought the fight to the cowboys refusing to lay down despite a double digit deficit and little reason to believe they d turn things around because of allgeier s toughness determination and relentless desire to produce when called upon he also caught five passes for 44 yards and an incredibly gritty touchdown reception the cardinals pulled off the stunning win and might have found a new identity in the process next gen stats insight for cardinals cowboys via nfl pro tyler allgeier carried the ball 11 times for 147 yards and a touchdown in week 8 against the cowboys including three explosive gains of 10 or more yards after totaling just two explosive gains across 61 carries over the first seven weeks of the season allgeier recorded a 63 yard touchdown run on arizona s final play from scrimmage in the third quarter before opening the cardinals next drive with a 52 yard scamper he gained 96 rushing yards over expected the most by a cardinals rusher in a game since at least 2018 additionally allgeier finished as the cardinals third leading receiver catching all five targets for 44 yards and a touchdown nfl research the cardinals last second touchdown positioned them to kick a go ahead extra point with 0 06 remaining sunday but chad ryland pushed his attempt wide left entering the cardinals into some exclusive and undesirable company they became the third team to miss a go ahead pat in the final 10 seconds of regulation joining the bengals week 1 2022 and buccaneers week 2 2003 back to top kevin patra s takeaways lions run over undefeated vikings to close gap in nfc north detroit figured out the best way to combat brian flores relentless pressure packages go to the ground after falling behind 15 12 midway through the fourth quarter detroit ran the ball on 11 of its final 13 non kneel plays one of those two jared goff throws was the go ahead touchdown toss to jameson williams detroit leaned on jahmyr gibbs and bruising backup sione vaki gibbs blasted his way to 153 rushing yards and a td on 23 carries while vaki chipped in 11 totes for 65 yards detroit getting production from vaki is a positive sign for the lions down the stretch the lions couldn t get out of their way early with miscues hampering dan campbell s club including some bad penalties goff missed passes early and threw his first interception of the season when williams slipped on a route detroit put up just six points and goff was sacked four times through two quarters then the run game took over allowing the qb to utilize play action and wear down the vikings d it wasn t a perfect game for the home squad but the offense perked up late when needed to close out a big win that bunches the division even closer it was a need to have home game for detroit dan campbell s crew came up clutch in the end vikings offensive struggles continued it was only a matter of time before brian flores defense couldn t carry the day minnesota has been playing on the razor s edge through its first six wins with the defense spearheading wins while the offense was along for the ride against a high powered lions offense flores defense did enough forcing a turnover early field goals and a pivotal late three and out yes the defense ran out of gas against jahmyr gibbs late but kevin o connell s offense needed to do more kyler murray managed the game early but missed too many throws particularly high which led to stalled drives nearly a quarter of murray s 210 yards 24 3 came on a 51 yard bomb to jordan addison the qb missed several other shots right now murray isn t a station to station passer when the big plays don t connect the vikings offense struggles against a lions defense that entered with the worst pass d in the nfl and allowing the most yards murray came up small the vikings generated just 266 yards and 15 first downs going 3 for 10 on third down and 0 for 1 on fourth down isn t winning offense koc needs his offense to find itself at the start of a tough stretch of games right now it s not close detroit s defense stepped up for the second straight week kelvin sheppard s defense has played up a level the defensive line particularly the interior pestered kyler murray alim mcneill led the way with four qb pressures and one sack the secondary did a better job sticking with vikings receivers where we d seen wrs scamper wide open early in the season detroit s secondary at least challenged most plays cornerback d j reed was having his best game including a diving int and a big late pass breakup before leaving with an injury when the defensive line is getting pressure and the secondary plays on a string it s a workable defense the issue sheppard faces now is that he lost a trove of players on sunday star linebacker jack campbell was taken to a local hospital after suffering a neck injury d j wonnum and brian branch each exited with concussions after a collision rookie linebacker jimmy rolder suffered a hamstring injury reed s was a hip can an already shaky unit overcome injuries moving forward next gen stats insight for lions vikings via nfl pro the vikings blitzed on 26 of 29 dropbacks 89 7 in their week 8 loss against the lions the highest blitz rate by a team since at least 2018 breaking the previous record held by the vikings set last week against the colts 85 2 when blitzed jared goff completed 17 passes tied for the most against the blitz in a game this season for 130 yards a touchdown and an interception goff was sacked a season high three times on six pressures when blitzed nfl research jahmyr gibbs became the fifth player in nfl history prior to age 25 to have at least 1 000 scrimmage yards and 10 plus touchdowns in their team s first seven games of a season joining christian mccaffrey 2019 edgerrin james 2000 eric dickerson 1983 and jim brown 1958 back to top kevin patra s takeaways jags stampede floundering colts good teams don t just beat bad ones they take their soul jacksonville is a good team liam coen s squad walloped its division rival in every facet from the start the jaguars blasted indianapolis with an offensive barrage and smothering defense for a team that s struggled at times in the red zone coen s club simply avoided that area splashing scores from distance of the jags five offensive touchdowns only one came inside the red zone jacksonville ripped through a limp colts defense for scores of 31 yards 39 28 and 25 yards pass protection had some concerns but trevor lawrence overcame them side stepping pressure and ripping passes to wide open targets the mvp candidate generated 210 yards and three touchdowns on 10 of 14 attempts before taking a seat for the bulk of the fourth quarter jacksonville ran over the colts earning 183 rushing yards and two tds with bhayshul tuten leading the way 16 104 1 tuten was a tackle breaking maven earning 159 scrimmage yards and two scores have a day rayuan lane jaguars safety rayuan lane snagged a flubbed catch by colts tight end tyler warren and scampered the other way for a 92 yard pick six late in the second quarter the play was the cherry on top of a big day for the navy product who made his second career start and netted three tackles a qb hit and three passes defensed lane making plays after being thrust into significant action highlights a defense that came in waves sunday anthony campanile s defense forced three turnovers held the colts to 243 total yards and 4 1 yards per play jacksonville stymied jonathan taylor holding the veteran back to 2 9 yards per carry and discombobulated daniel jones a stingy run defense combined with sticky coverage on the back end is a recipe for a smothering unit a defense that forces turnovers and an offense that can generate explosives is a formula for blowout wins colts crumbling amid a fire sale shane steichen s squad played like a crew that knows the season is all but over awful tackling missed reps terrible penalties flubbed catches head scratching passes bad blocking porous coverage you name it the colts messed it up daniel jones continued to struggle missing passes and looking flustered in the pocket the first int wasn t his fault the second certainly was jones has been unable to overcome bad surroundings looking like the quarterback who wore out his welcome in new york jones finished 19 of 28 passing for 144 yards one td and two ints before being replaced by anthony richardson jonathan taylor scampered for 19 yards on his first touch he did little else the rest of the contest earning eight rushes for 23 yards and catching four passes for 24 yards he also fumbled on a trick play it might have been taylor s last game in indy most colts players seemed to play like their time in town could be coming to an end if steichen keeps his job beyond monday morning he ll have to do a much better job preparing and motivating his players next gen stats insight for jaguars colts via nfl pro trevor lawrence generated 15 0 yards per attempt the most in a game in his career much of that production came against zone coverage where he completed seven of nine passes for 167 yards and all three of his touchdowns lawrence was also efficient on play action connecting on four of five attempts for 124 yards and a touchdown nfl research bhayshul tuten is the first jaguars player to rush for 100 plus yards score a rushing touchdown record 50 plus receiving yards and a receiving td in the same game back to top jeremy bergman s takeaways raiders snap losing streak as cousins staves off mendoza klint kubiak gave kirk cousins a vote of confidence early in the week definitively declaring him the starting qb as calls for no 1 pick fernando mendoza increased amid las vegas four game skid consider kubiak and cousins vindicated the only thing that had been working for the raiders worked again on sunday afternoon picking up a leaky sometimes absent defense cousins was efficient and error free completing 19 of 26 passes for 247 yards to just four pass catchers two tight ends one running back one wide receiver after leading just one scoring drive in the first half the raiders offense under cousins was nearly flawless in the final two frames scoring three straight touchdowns out of the half and finding a game sealing field goal at the end of a clock killing drive at the end of the fourth quarter as much as we would all like to see mendoza get some reps just for curiosity s sake it s not prudent for the raiders to move away from kirko chainz as long as he s still moving the chains he s a steadying presence and a rising tide and las vegas gauntlet only gets tougher from here games against san francisco seattle denver and cleveland await before its december bye it s kirk s offense until the wheels call off jets run out of fuel again a running theme of the aaron glenn jets has been their inability to finish plays possessions games awareness of the problem has yet to lead to a remedy sunday s loss to las vegas was the latest example geno smith and the jets came out of the gates on fire reaching at least the raiders 21 yard line on each of their first six drives a run that extended into the third quarter in place of breece hall braelon allen was a force again running for 121 yards in the first half alone finished with 147 yards on 21 totes adonai mitchell career high 142 yards and garrett wilson 83 yards were big time chain movers all day but of those six opening scoring drives new york found the end zone just thrice keeping the game within reach for the raiders into the second half by the time las vegas forced its first punt with 1 33 to go in the third it was in striking distance to take the lead which it did because of course the jets found themselves back in the raiders red zone down four points with 5 24 to go in position to take a lead deep in the fourth but after three plays with no gain new york kicked its fourth field goal of the day of under 40 yards the jets had little time to launch a game winning drive after the raiders pushed their lead to five but reached las vegas 35 before smith launched an ill advised interception with seven seconds remaining new york s second half collapse would be more frustrating if it was more out of character but blowing opportunities in the red zone and in the win column is gang green s calling card at this point it doesn t get any easier for the 2 6 jets with the chiefs and bills up next an 11th straight losing season is in sight jeanty takes back seat to rookie ashton jeanty spent the week calling out the jets defense as a get right unit for the raiders run game he was right just not for him jeanty was relegated to a third down role against new york ceding starting reps to mike washington the fourth round rookie logged a career high 83 yards on 25 carries the most by any raiders rb this season it wasn t the most efficient outing but washington was a much more solid contributor in the lead role than jeanty had been in his previous three games 64 yards on 28 carries jeanty wasn t completely absent from the game however and played a crucial role on las vegas fourth quarter drive to take the lead breaking free for a 45 yard catch and run to flip the field he finished with just 9 rushing yards on two carries season low 22 snaps but jeanty proved once again that he is more useful to this offense in a pass catching role will las vegas solidify these roles in the weeks to come and if so how will the former top 10 pick handle the apparent demotion next gen stats insight for raiders jets via nfl pro brock bowers caught seven of 10 targets for 92 yards and two touchdowns in the raiders win recording six of wide receiver has caught six passes lined up outside in a game this season nfl research the raiders and jets each had season highs in points scored while combining for 71 points the third highest defense pittsburgh s most lopsided victory of the season was fueled by a season high 200 rushing yards running backs jaylen warren and rico dowdle each chipped in a rushing touchdown with warren running for 143 yards tying his career high on his 28th birthday aaron rodgers was held to 13 of 25 passing for 172 yards no touchdowns and one interception on a pass that was dropped by dk metcalf first quarter with negative 1 yard on 10 plays and two lost fumbles it s part of a troubling trend for todd monken whose team has been outscored 65 13 in the first quarter of games this season the key to the browns surprising 5 2 start to the season was their ability to bounce back from those rough starts but sunday offered cleveland a stark reminder of what it s like to fall behind and stay behind it was the first time the browns have never held a lead since the jaguars blew them out in week 1 and the first time they were held to zero touchdowns in a game since week 15 of last season second year tight end harold fannin was one of the few bright spots making a career high 10 catches for 154 yards of course the combination of not being able to run the ball protect the passer or stop the run on defense is a recipe for disaster the browns had allowed one rushing touchdown in their first six games they have now allowed six such scores in their last two games including three on sunday they ll play their third straight road game next week against a desperate saints team that will be coming off a bye steelers hit bye week in driver s seat of afc north pittsburgh will be alone at the top of the division entering week 9 the browns are the only team with a winning record the steelers have faced during their four game winning streak but the goal is to stack wins and that s what pittsburgh is doing under head coach mike mccarthy the steelers will want to find a way to get aaron rodgers going again though after the 42 year old was held to a season low 172 yards passing on sunday he s now thrown only one touchdown over the last two games the going could get tougher coming out of the bye with a trip to visit the bengals awaiting the steelers in week 10 then again cincinnati needed overtime at home on sunday to beat the lowly titans in a 43 36 shootout next gen stats insight for browns steelers via nfl pro steelers linebacker alex highsmith generated six qb have failed to sweep the steelers in the season series for the 35th straight season last accomplishing the feat in 1988 back to top bobby kownack s takeaways bucky puts bucs on his back handed a box score with the player names and teams redacted one would be forgiven for guessing sunday s nfc south showdown took place in 1926 rather than a century later the buccaneers ran the ball 55 times excluding kneeldowns part of a combined 83 carries by the two clubs in a bad weather game baker mayfield recorded just three pass attempts and completed none of them as tampa bay joined the 1974 bills as only the second team in the super bowl era to complete zero passes in a game and emerge victorious not only that but the bucs became the first team to win a game by 10 plus points without completing a pass since the 1945 pittsburgh steelers over the chicago cardinals so how did they pull out such an unlikely victory bucky irving his cuts were vicious and precise allowing him to weave through an atlanta defense that appeared to be on skates at times on a field flooded by rainwater he rushed for 170 yards and a touchdown on 27 carries eclipsing 100 yards in a first half for his first time as a pro and eventually setting a career high the operation also didn t slow down at all with kenneth gainwell occasionally mixing in and later on taking over to milk clock the backup back logged 25 carries for 140 yards it was a similar smashmouth formula that tampa bay used in last week s 43 13 pummeling of the panthers when mayfield only threw for 64 yards and the buccaneers have now produced three of the franchise s top 10 single game rushing outputs over the last four weeks at some point mayfield will need to air it out but it s been a remarkable run and remarkable running by tampa bay of late to reenter the nfc south race penix implodes atlanta ultimately lost for two reasons it couldn t stop bucky irving and michael penix couldn t stop giving the ball away while the bucs basically gave up trying to throw under a heavy rain that persisted for most of the contest penix accepted the challenge and promptly failed he couldn t find his targets especially during the first half spraying the ball around but not to his targets far too often he sailed one over drake london s head during atlanta s first drive into jacob parrish s hands but the corner couldn t handle it even provided that little bit of luck though he still threw three picks over the subsequent four possessions becoming the first quarterback to toss three interceptions in the first 18 minutes of a game since bailey zappe in 2023 and the first falcons qb to do it since matt ryan in 2012 penix threw his fourth int of the game after atlanta had finally found some momentum in better conditions ruining a 43 yard drive down to tampa bay s 24 yard line by leaving one behind tight end charlie woerner for zyon mccollum to collect the falcons had been averaging 31 0 points per game with penix starting which ranked behind only the bills 32 8 entering week 8 but he was a difference maker in the negative sense against tampa bay he finished 8 of 24 for 125 yards and an ugly 12 0 passer rating in a messy game like sunday s was the best thing quarterbacks can do is protect the ball he didn t and he lost miserable conditions lead to slopfest the true victor of sunday s game might have been the elements atlanta and tampa bay spent most of the day just trying to get through a torrential downpour the rain caused errors in every conceivable way there were overthrows botched snaps missed kicks fumbles and all varieties of dropped passes would be touchdowns easy pickups and interceptions there are too many examples to point to but perhaps the most emblematic football folly took place on the bucs second drive after the center quarterback exchange went wrong baker mayfield recovered the ball and improvised magnificently darting into traffic before throwing it backward to bucky irving who streaked toward the end zone and nearly made it there before jessie bates punched the ball out right at the goal line for a touchback by halftime the game had seen more fumbles five and interceptions three than completions two both teams tightened up on ball security out of half and the rain let up some toward the fourth quarter but tampa bay was able to outlast by stacking some successes despite the elements throughout the contest chase mclaughlin was money helping build a lead in the first half by going 3 of 3 on field goals of 46 34 and 42 yards alex anzalone picked off penix twice six plays apart jacob parrish made up for an earlier drop with a second quarter interception and the bucs shut out the falcons offense on third down 0 for 12 for such an ugly ugly day there will actually be a fair amount of pretty plays for todd bowles and co to rewatch next gen stats insight for falcons buccaneers via nfl pro bucky irving generated all 170 of his rushing yards against atlanta after sides of halftime seemed to break the chargers the successful rushing attack stabilized an offense that was stubbing its toe early after a wobbly start mcvay s squad has battled back to 500 with games against washington and arizona on tap chargers disaster season continues the chargers play poorly they also played scared jim harbaugh s winless club had multiple chances to strike an early big punch but repeatedly whiffed the chargers settled for three field goals on fourth and short situations deep in rams territory the final decision proved to be the worst facing a fourth and 2 at the rams 23 yard line with under 2 minutes left in the first half harbaugh elected to kick a field goal to go up 9 3 if the chargers went for and converted it they could have gone up double digits and perhaps burned the clock so the rams couldn t have scored late to jumpstart their offense winning teams make winning plays on winning decisions losing teams stay losing with a losing mentality speaking of mentality justin herbert s is lost in a blind wilderness the chargers qb threw a pair of ugly interceptions the type you can t believe that a 50 million player would make right to defenders herbert isn t trusting what he s seeing and isn t seeing what defenses are putting in front of him he s a mess mentally right now with little hope of digging out of the hole when the highest paid player on the team is making rookie level mistakes what can you expect from the rest of the club rams d takes advantage of herbert mistakes quentin lake jumped a first quarter justin herbert pass to the outside and scampered into chargers territory even after the offense generated just 8 yards the return was enough to give the rams an early three point lead after halftime trent mcduffie saw a pass tossed right to him in zone coverage which he returned 26 yards to set up a td that would put the game out of reach the rams stuffed the chargers run game 2 6 yards per carry and pestered herbert into mistakes in addition to two sacks and two picks the rams generated 20 qb pressures including three from defensive tackle aaron donald the rams early play keeping the chargers out of the end zone proved huge giving the offense time to figure things out without falling too far behind next gen stats insight for rams chargers via nfl pro matthew stafford averaged a time to throw of 2 38 seconds in the rams week 8 victory over the chargers his third quickest in a game since joining the rams in 2021 stafford was efficient on quick passes completing 13 of 14 passes for 94 yards and a touchdown 57 1 success rate when he held on to the ball for over 2 5 seconds he completed just four of 11 passes for 63 yards with an interception 33 3 success rate nfl research the chargers are the first team offensive output is slowly starting to improve bo nix completed 20 of 32 passes for 222 yards and two touchdowns took a few shots downfield and connected once with jaylen waddle for a big gain and mistake sink him he calmly executed a play action rollout later in the sequence and found fullback nate adkins for a touchdown then coolly converted the two point try by firing a bullet to waddle to make it a three point game jonah coleman later handled the rest ripping off a 51 yard gain after catching a short pass from nix to set up denver s go ahead touchdown a score that was ultimately the deciding trip to the end zone denver still finished 2 for 11 on third down and under 300 total yards of offense but when it needed to score late it found a way to get the job done in a high pressure drive of the season and appeared to be enough to keep the broncos at bay until denver s fourth quarter scoring outburst moved the broncos within three points of tying the chiefs and then ahead of kansas city in the game s final two minutes in years past that would have been too much time to give mahomes and co and it nearly was again sunday but kansas city s inability to finish off its frantic two minute drill reminded us of this offense s limitations mahomes wasn t able to scramble for a touchdown instead throwing away a pass a few yards shy of the goal line and kenneth walker s hesitant third down run preceded a sequence that will live in chiefs fans memories for a while facing fourth and goal from the 1 kansas city stacked three receivers in a tight bunch set on the left sent the shotgun snap to mahomes and let the route combination work freeing rashee rice for what should have been the game winning touchdown jaylon moore s slight movement before the snap drew a false start penalty though and mahomes crumbled beneath the denver pass rush on the game s final play there were things to like from this game including kansas city s ability to compete on the road without receiving stellar production from walker 25 touches 84 scrimmage yards but the frustrating result erased the chiefs grip on first place in the afc west race instead they ll have to try to keep pace with denver the rest of the way oh and we already knew this but it was reaffirmed sunday harrison butker is marching toward unemployment his wide right miss from 54 yards loomed large in this contest and is just the latest of a growing string of misses from deep denver s defense shows cracks but holds up in biggest moment the broncos have built their 6 2 mark on the backs of their defenders who have collectively stifled opposing offenses by harassing quarterbacks relentlessly over the last month on sunday they weren t quite as effective for most of the afternoon patrick mahomes managed to lead one drive in which he repeatedly converted third downs by barely moving the ball beyond the line to gain showing flashes of what has made him a special quarterback in the post tyreek hill era in kansas city and dealing a few deflating blows to the denver defense in the process that wasn t enough to tear them down though in need of a stop denver managed to force a chiefs drive to stall in the fourth quarter leading to butker s 54 yard miss and granting the broncos a fresh opportunity to complete their comeback effort and even after letting mahomes drive the chiefs down the field rapidly in the final two minutes denver bowed up and denied the chiefs from entering the end zone in the game s final seconds as nix noted afterward the broncos have been leaning on their defense all season and miami s most impressive march of the day as malik willis connected with greg dulcich caleb douglas jalen tolbert kevin coleman and finally malik washington in the end zone for a 1 yard score that s of the rainy second half some love for the defenses there were a handful of players on both teams that made notable plays the dolphins entered the contest with only six sacks dead last in the nfl but news_mentions.headline: Minnesota Vikings training camp 2025 preview: Key dates, notable additions, biggest storylines
news_mentions.description: With NFL training camp season upon us, Kevin Patra provides a refresher on the Minnesota Vikings' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc north catch up on the minnesota vikings offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 20 rookies july 22 veterans location tco performance center eagan minnesota fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs houston texans saturday aug 9 at 4 p m et nfl network week 2 vs new england patriots saturday aug 16 at 1 p m et week 3 at tennessee titans friday aug 22 at 8 p m et cbs 2025 schedule note the vikings will be the first team in nfl history to play a game in multiple international countries in the same season week 4 in ireland and week 5 in england nfl research what you need to know 1 it s all about j j mccarthy in minnesota the second year quarterback will be under the microscope as he takes over an offense that rejuvenated sam darnold s career last season the vikings decided not to buffer mccarthy with a veteran backup after daniel jones opted to sign with indianapolis apologies to the sam howell stans but he s not a threat to mccarthy the former first round pick inherited the porsche of offenses which has made almost every driver look good kevin o connell is a proven qb whisperer so the assumption is that mccarthy should have little trouble keeping things afloat with justin jefferson jordan addison t j hockenson and a remade offensive line the vikes offer weapons to aid the young signal caller minnesota is a 14 win club that on paper improved entering 2025 the loudest question is mccarthy and whether he can keep the engine humming after missing all of 2024 it s not hyperbole to suggest that mccarthy is the pendulum that could swing the course of the entire nfc north 2 the top camp battle in minnesota comes in the secondary heretofore the vikings have yet to add a veteran to the mix who could push for a starting gig next to byron murphy it feels as though the club could be waiting to see how mekhi blackmon bounces back after missing the entire 2024 season due to an acl tear isaiah rodgers blackmon and jeff okudah are in line to battle for the cb2 role elsewhere in the vikings secondary the club didn t replace no 3 safety camryn bynum who left for indianapolis this offseason defensive coordinator brian flores used three safeties liberally last season if he does so again would he trust the likes of theo jackson in that role could a veteran be added closer to the season 3 will the interior offensive line upgrades pay off the internal pressure proved to be sam darnold s undoing last year general manager kwesi adofo mensah set out to fix the issue signing veterans ryan kelly and will fries from indy then he drafted guard donovan jackson in the first round in theory the moves should solidify a leaky interior however kelly and fries are both coming off injury plagued seasons those concerns are coupled with star left tackle christian darrisaw coming off a season ending knee injury the offseason overhaul is excellent from a starter s perspective but there are questions among the second string crew should injuries strike again
