news_mentions.headline: NFL Week 8 Sunday aftermath: Ravens' season on the brink; can Vikings trust Kyler Murray?
news_mentions.description: Kevin Patra breaks down Sunday's Week 8 action in the latest edition of The Aftermath. Is the Ravens' season on the brink of collapse? Can the Vikings trust Kyler Murray?
news_mentions.body_text: now that it s november the playoff picture is starting to emerge and week 8 featured a number of key divisional matchups that could have lasting effects on the rest of the season the broncos and steelers notched revenge wins over the chiefs and browns respectively the lions asserted themselves in the uber tough nfc north while the jaguars handed the colts a potentially fatal blow in a season cratering toward disaster let s examine some key storylines in sunday s aftermath including another concerning loss for schottenheimer s boys minnesota s qb issues rear their ugly head in detroit buccaneers lean on run game in historic win broncos take over driver s seat in afc west race burrow channels norm van brocklin against tennessee but first we start with lamar jackson suffering a potential season ending injury and where the ravens go from here ravens season on the brink after jackson injury the baltimore ravens find themselves in quite the quandary lamar jackson s return was supposed to buoy a club coming off back to back divisional defeats it lasted one play on sunday in buffalo jackson s right thumb injury which will require surgery leaves the 4 4 ravens floundering in the afc north cellar before we hit thanksgiving jesse minter told reporters after the 36 10 loss to buffalo that jackson will be placed on injured reserve knocking him out for at least four games asked if the setback ultimately could end jackson s season the ravens first year head coach admitted that it s possible potentially but we ll see where it s at minter said without the two time mvp qb the ravens offense is clipped baltimore is 7 14 in games in which jackson has not started since 2019 averaging just 17 6 points in 2026 the team has scored six touchdowns in the 18 quarters jackson has missed jackson s latest injury shrouds his future in baltimore we ll have plenty of time to delve into the contract situation later right now the focus is on how the ravens survive it would be bad enough if jackson s thumb issue were baltimore s only qb injury but backup tyler huntley also exited sunday s game and didn t return espn reported that huntley suffered a possible turf toe injury and will undergo an mri on monday to determine how much time if any he could miss undrafted rookie third stringer joe fagnano battled against the bills but given the situation trying to keep up with josh allen on the road with no prep time he performed as expected completing 10 of his 21 pass attempts for 91 yards with a pick and three sacks taken the ravens are in a rough spot with a short week before thursday night s game against the rolling jaguars even if huntley doesn t miss much time is it worth baltimore trading for a qb ahead of the nov 10 deadline would shelling out more assets in a potentially lost season be wise let s rip through some of the potential qb options for the ravens if they decide to go the trade route tyson bagent the bears qb2 struggled in his last outing against green bay in week 5 and was eventually benched for case keenum but his familiarity with declan doyle would benefit baltimore considered one of the league s better backups by many bagent could be a long term play for the ravens i have my doubts about if the bears would be willing to part with their no 2 but such a move could help recoup some of the trade capital sent away in last week s jeffery simmons deal the cost to pry bagent away from chicago could prove prohibitive for a ravens team on the brink jacoby brissett benched in favor of gardner minshew during the cardinals stirring comeback win over dallas on sunday brissett has experience while inconsistencies have plagued him this season in arizona he is a professional qb who could pick up the offense quickly editor s update on monday mike lafleur named minshew as the cardinals starter moving forward shedeur sanders cleveland has insisted that it has no intention of trading sanders but coach todd monken hasn t seemed to be in the former colorado quarterback s corner at any point in the process sanders has his warts but he could bring more pop to the ravens offense than huntley or fagnano the browns shipped joe flacco to cincinnati last year so intra division trades can t be ruled out we know the browns brass will take a pick if it makes sense kirk cousins i don t think the raiders would trade him while they re still in contention at 4 4 if they were willing to the cost would probably be prohibitive however for the next week any qb trade list should at least mention the veteran playing at a high level in front of no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza two non trade options easton stick currently on the tampa bay buccaneers practice squad stick was in l a in 2024 with minter so at least there would be some familiarity jimmy garoppolo the veteran hasn t officially retired if he wants a shot to play again baltimore could be his last best chance cowboys collapse in stunning loss credit gardner minshew for bringing the mania once again credit tyler allgeier for gashing the cowboys defense and powering the cards back into the game credit michael wilson for continuing to do his best puka nacua impression credit the cardinals defense for forcing field goals late and getting a three and out in overtime credit mike lafleur s club for not quitting when quitting could have been easy and credit the first year coach for being willing to make a second half qb change in the heat of the moment credit the cards but let s be real this was an epic collapse for which dallas should be crushed brian schottenheimer s club held a 24 10 fourth quarter lead before disintegrating like walter donovan drinking from the wrong chalice he chose poorly could be the title of every cowboys move on sunday a confluence of ineptitude caused dallas to collapse at home to drop to 3 5 on the season the defense became a sieve in the fourth quarter and couldn t tackle i understand that the cowboys had some injuries but letting allgeier look like jim brown is not a product of a few missing players the secondary inexplicably got burned late when all the cowboys needed to do was keep everything in front of them frankly arizona could have scored quicker in the fourth quarter if not for a few misses the defensive breakdowns continue to perplex dallas this season the offense also did its part in the collapse stalling out inside the red zone early then failing to get a first down after the cardinals failed on the onside kick an explosive offense should be able to move the chains to secure a victory then there was the depressing three and out to begin overtime dallas got outgained in yardage 467 261 on sunday that should not happen despite the latest example of schottenheimer s teams playing below their talent jerry jones stuck by his coach after the game that s not in my mind at this time jones said when asked about a potential coaching change per espn com a lot of people let brian down today and so for whatever criticism we want to have of brian we can all get in line the line for blame in dallas is long it starts at the top vikings qb problems can t be brushed aside brian flores defense had done the heavy lifting to build minnesota s 6 0 start but sunday s divisional loss to the lions showed that the ferocious unit can t do it alone detroit went big and ran over the vikings in the second half wearing down the stout defense to the tune of 164 rushing yards after halftime by the end flores group was gassed and couldn t stop jahmyr gibbs and the lions from grinding out the w if the vikings offense had any semblance of consistency the end game scenario would have played out much differently kyler murray continues to struggle with his consistency despite facing the worst passing defense in the nfl on sunday he couldn t keep the vikings on the field he sailed more than a few balls way too high never seemed comfortable and rarely moved the chains on nine third down throws he completed four three went for first downs murray connected on some deep balls and averaged 11 2 air yards per attempt the second highest mark of his career but he also missed a host of shots per next gen stats on downfield attempts 10 plus air yards murray threw for a season high 115 yards despite only completing four of his 13 attempts 30 8 his lowest downfield completion rate in a game since 2023 min 10 downfield attempts the inability to keep the chains moving sits in stark contrast to the best offenses under kevin o connell we ll see if koc pulls the plug and gives carson wentz a shot at least we know he ll force feed justin jefferson if the struggles persist the j j mccarthy trade probably needed to happen but seeing the 2024 first rounder look like a different qb in new york while murray struggles has to sting minnesota with a tough trio of games on tap vs buffalo 6 1 at green bay 5 3 and against san francisco 6 1 in mexico city the vikings must get more production from the qb position or they ll see their once strong nfc north lead evaporate editor s update on monday after publishing kevin o connell said kyler murray is dealing with hamstring tightness is the bucs offense sustainable the monsoon in tampa fla dictated the run heavy approach from zac robinson s offense but even in pristine weather the buccaneers would have leaned on the ground game the slop tipped the scales even harder with baker mayfield attempting just three passes all falling incomplete in the 16 0 win we knew it was going to be a nasty day and what kind of conditions it was going to be bucs coach todd bowles said we were worried about ball security and we took care of it other than the fumble in the end zone bowles added i didn t say we were not going to throw the ball the conditions told robinson that you could see it it s a downpour and the wind was blowing you can kind of see the ball wasn t going anywhere tampa became just the second team in the super bowl era to have zero completed passes in a single game joining the 1974 bills who did so in a win over the jets per nfl research three of the four teams to not have a completion in a game since 1950 have gone on to win including the buccaneers on sunday they are the first team to win by 10 points without completing a pass since the 1945 pittsburgh steelers beat the chicago cardinals the ground game has gotten the bucs back in the nfc south race in week 7 against carolina tampa bay rushed for 258 yards while mayfield attempted just 11 passes completing seven for 64 yards and a td bucky irving has been sensational making defenders miss and has the pop to turn those broken tackles into big runs all 170 of irving s rushing yards came after contact on sunday per next gen stats one of the more inexplicable issues with the bucs early struggles when they started 1 5 was the offensive line s play the veteran crew missed far too many blocks and committed too many penalties over the last couple weeks the group has gotten back on track by smashing defenses in the face tampa s rushing attack is absolutely replicable i expect irving to keep motoring through defenses slithering through holes and ripping chunk gains that said it s 2026 at some point mayfield will be asked to win a game through the air with the bears and lions on tap in weeks 9 and 11 the bucs will have to keep pace with higher powered offenses after thumping two division rivals though tampa is back on track in a moribund division and the bucs feel like the most stable nfc south club as we head into the second half of the season broncos take command in afc west race it s not pretty but who cares when you stack a w bo nix earned his 15th career game winning drive in denver s 28 24 win over kansas city on sunday breaking a tie with dak prescott for the most such drives in a player s first three seasons since at least 1950 according to nfl research the broncos came back to win after trailing the rival chiefs by 11 points in the fourth quarter it marked the third victory in nix s career in which denver erased a fourth quarter deficit of 10 points the most such wins in the nfl since 2024 conversely sunday marked the third game in patrick mahomes career in which the chiefs blew a fourth quarter lead of 10 points and the first since over five years ago in week 2 of 2021 at the ravens harrison butker s missed fourth quarter field goal opened the door for denver and nix immediately cashed in hitting running back jonah coleman for a 51 yard catch and run to set up the go ahead 5 yard td the 15 point fourth quarter explosion came after nix and the offense once again struggled to stay on the field denver went three and out on three third quarter drives entering the final frame the home fans were frustrated then boom big plays galore and the broncos not only escaped with a win but took control of the afc west race the big plays included a massive goal line stand by the denver defense which held the chiefs out of the end zone in the game s final seconds after they got a first and goal at the 4 the sequence was aided by a k c false start but a denver d that once again missed too many tackles ultimately stood tall when needed with malcolm roach taking down mahomes for the game ending sack it was ball out or go home edge rusher que robinson said of the dramatic finish via the denver post and we weren t going home without that dub the loss stings k c which could have taken complete control of the division race with a sweep over the broncos denver 6 2 has now won four straight while the chiefs 5 2 have lost back to back games after taking advantage of a soft early slate andy reid s trust in butker came back to bite him according to the next gen stats fourth down decision guide with kansas city leading 24 21 and facing fourth and 8 from the broncos 36 yard line with 2 36 remaining a punt would have given the chiefs the highest win probability 74 3 1 8 percentage points ahead of going for it 72 5 while a field goal attempt ranked last 71 5 reid elected for the fg butker missed the 54 yard attempt giving the ball back to the broncos who scored two plays later sometimes analytics does suggest punting week 8 sunday spotlight

news_mentions.headline: 2026 NFL season, Week 8: What We Learned from Sunday's games
news_mentions.description: Around The NFL breaks down what you need to know from Sunday's action in Week 8 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 8 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below early window buffalo bills 36 baltimore ravens 10 cincinnati bengals 43 tennessee titans 36 ot arizona cardinals 33 dallas cowboys 30 ot detroit lions 19 minnesota vikings 15 jacksonville jaguars 42 indianapolis colts 7 las vegas raiders 38 new york jets 33 pittsburgh steelers 27 cleveland browns 6 tampa bay buccaneers 16 atlanta falcons 0 late window los angeles rams 24 los angeles chargers 9 denver broncos 28 kansas city chiefs 24 new england patriots 24 miami dolphins 19 sunday night washington commanders 27 philadelphia eagles 10 nick shook s takeaways bills let hunters loose buffalo s biggest underlying question mark was its defense a leaky unit that struggled to get stops and limit opposing offenses in what became weekly shootouts for the bills that finally changed for the better on sunday with lamar jackson exiting quickly and tyler huntley back in the lineup buffalo decided it was time to hunt the quarterback dialing up blitzes and registering pressures on half of huntley s four passes which also incidentally forced huntley out of the game due to injury once undrafted rookie joe fagnano took over the carnivorous bills saw nothing but red meat blitzing on 64 5 of their total defensive snaps logging qb pressures at a rate of 61 3 and short circuiting baltimore s offense all afternoon the ravens finished with just 144 net yards of offense scored their only touchdown via a short field earned by a broderick washington interception and couldn t piece together more than one drive of significance which ended in a 26 yard tyler loop field goal buffalo s defense made sure it wouldn t allow derrick henry to carry the ravens and denied fagnano the space to breathe overwhelming the inexperienced signal caller in a runaway win quarterback injuries decimate ravens lamar jackson s anticipated return lasted just one snap his first pass attempt fell incomplete and on the follow through to his throw jackson s thumb collided with a defender s hand resulting in an injury that will land jackson on injured reserve for the foreseeable future after a few weeks of backup turned starter duty tyler huntley found himself on the field sunday appearing skittish and struggling to gain a single yard through the air before an injury knocked him out of action as well leaving the ravens with their emergency third qb joe fagnano as their only remaining option the uconn product gave his best effort but was constantly under duress leaving the ravens with little room to move the ball all afternoon zay flowers went without a catch on five targets rashod bateman s one catch for 22 yards accounted for the most receiving production for any raven and running back justice hill led baltimore in receptions with four it was a lifeless offense that left the ravens defense on the field for far too long buffalo won the time of possession battle 37 36 to 22 24 and sunday s display should rightfully worry ravens fans about their team s outlook for the remainder of 2026 it sounds as if jackson s season could be finished and recent results without him including sunday are discouraging at best moore delivers in return after missing a handful of weeks buffalo welcomed back its prized offseason acquisition d j moore who showed no signs of hesitancy and delivered a strong outing four catches 82 yards including a spectacular grab for 49 yards to set up a james cook touchdown and a touchdown catch moore s return helped draw some attention away from buffalo s tight ends dalton kincaid finished with a team best 86 yards and a touchdown on four catches took a bit of pressure off cook and unlocked enough of the unit s attack to help the bills climb out of a grind it out start to pour it on in the second half moore s rapport with josh allen remains strong even after the time off and helped allen pass jim kelly for the franchise s all time lead in touchdowns 260 now moore will need to prove he can be this reliable on a weekly basis next gen stats insight for ravens bills via nfl pro the bills blitzed on 64 5 of opposing dropbacks against the ravens in week 8 their highest blitz rate since 2021 and the highest blitz rate ravens quarterbacks have faced this season the bills blitz rate had not exceeded 39 in any of their prior six games this season when blitzing the bills generated 11 pressures including a season high seven quick pressures under 2 5 seconds and three sacks including a strip sack fumble recovery in the second quarter nfl research josh allen and james cook each had a rushing touchdown in week 8 marking the 16th time that allen and cook have scored a rushing touchdown in the same game sixteen games breaks a tie with dak prescott and ezekiel elliott for the most games by any teammate duo in nfl history in which both players had a rushing touchdown back to top bobby kownack s takeaways burrow was everything good bad about bengals offense what a roller coaster performance by joe burrow the cincy quarterback unquestionably served as the team s hero accounting for six touchdowns in an unexpected shootout with the titans but his three interceptions contributed initially to a slow start and later allowed tennessee to stay in it two of those picks were deep heaves to ja 39 marr chase with one way overthrown and another that came up far too short if you re going to make mistakes though make sure you make up for them burrow did that and more piling on the points and feeding his top two receivers to great success tee higgins had 10 catches for 155 yards and two tds on 11 targets while chase tallied 11 receptions for 141 yards and a score on 16 looks burrow also importantly cleaned it up in crunch time of his five drives that took place in the fourth quarter or overtime one ended in a chase brown fumble and the other ticked down the final 17 seconds to the extra frame on the other three burrow marched his bengals 73 81 and 70 yards throwing two touchdowns and scoring the game winner on a 9 yard scramble he finished with 426 yards five tds and three ints on 38 of 48 passing marking his third consecutive game with at least four passing touchdowns it s a bit scary how many points the bengals put up despite four giveaways and that s all credit to burrow standout performances not enough for tennessee there was not an ounce of quit in the titans after trading away their best player defensive tackle jeffery simmons on thursday the defense still generated four takeaways the most it has had in a game this season safety amani hooker had joe burrow s number intercepting him a whopping three times while defensive end jacob martin tallied three sacks and linebacker anthony hill was relentless with 14 tackles on offense cam ward enjoyed by far his best game of the season despite being without carnell tate ward dissected cincinnati s defense with regularity going 26 of 40 for 304 yards and two touchdowns snapping a five game interception streak and nearly doubling his average of 168 4 passing yards per game he led two separate go ahead td drives in the fourth quarter plus tony pollard continued his recent resurgence rushing for 117 yards and two scores after going for 129 and three tds in week 7 his 40 yard touchdown to open the scoring will be one of the highlights of the day in his or any game with pollard breaking multiple tackles before stiff arming one bengals defender into another s path in a keystone cops sequence on the way to pay dirt of course it was still not enough for the 1 7 titans but the fight they showed was admirable regardless of the nfl s aversion to moral victories concerning trends taking shape for bengals the most important result from sunday is the bengals moving to 5 2 in a highly competitive afc north however there are some underlying issues still plaguing cincinnati the bengals found themselves trailing 13 0 for the second straight week this deficit came at the end of the first quarter unlike last week s halftime hole against the ravens and the bengals started picking it up much earlier to go into intermission with a lead but they couldn t pull away like they did in baltimore instead the titans pushed them to overtime taking advantage of a defense that forced a pair of turnovers but couldn t get enough stops to make things easy in the past three games the bengals have needed to outlast a one win titans team in overtime looked asleep for far too long facing backup quarterback tyler huntley and let a then winless dolphins squad make things uncomfortable late before that it was two straight losses those who choose optimism will point to the bengals record and their three game winning streak but venturing through a season as escape artists typically catches up down the line next gen stats insight for titans bengals via nfl pro amani hooker picked off joe burrow three times which included 15 3 expected points added across five targets in coverage the second most coverage epa by a player in a game this season hooker allowed only 12 yards in coverage on the day nfl research joe burrow became just the second quarterback in league history to have 450 plus passing yards five plus passing tds and a rushing td in a game joining norm van brocklin week 1 1951 back to top nick shook s takeaways qb change sparks comeback through nearly three quarters the cardinals were repeating the same frustrating offensive performance that had become all too familiar in recent weeks jacoby brissett was under constant pressure and resorting to throws that amounted to little more than prayers and after watching brissett take two consecutive sacks for double digit negative yardage in the third quarter coach mike lafleur had enough calling for gardner minshew to replace the battered brissett oddly enough the quarterback change coincided with a revival of the running game that depended solely on tyler allgeier after jeremiyah love left with another ankle injury and bam knight was knocked out of action due to a concussion allgeier put the team on his back rushing 11 times for 147 yards and a touchdown and repeatedly turning to the sideline oxygen tank as a means of survival minshew meanwhile created a rhythm in the passing game that the cardinals haven t enjoyed in over a month completing 17 of 23 passes for 188 yards and three touchdowns including a magnificent final touchdown drive that covered 80 yards in eight plays and 1 03 to tie the game and balancing the offense by turning to michael wilson plenty eight catches 111 yards one touchdown arizona pulled off this 23 point outburst and improbable comeback after losing love knight and receiver kendrick bourne maximizing its returns with its remaining contributors with just enough time to escape defeat it will likely prompt a quarterback change and could be a minor springboard forward for a team that was desperate for a morale boosting win like this cowboys collapse could have devastating effect dallas will look back at this game and have no choice but to admit this was its worst loss of 2026 entering the final minute of the third quarter the cowboys were in control holding a 17 3 lead that was all but guaranteed to eventually become 20 3 or larger in that moment though their defense broke down surrendering a rumbling 63 yard touchdown run to tyler allgeier the first of a few massive chunks gained by allgeier in the final 16 minutes of regulation on a 52 yard allgeier run in the fourth quarter safety caleb downs got pancaked by hjalte froholdt twice in the same play typifying arizona s sudden takeover with the image of downs tumbling across the turf like a runaway cheese wheel speeding down a hill this all happened after dallas had suffocated arizona s offense for the first 44 minutes of the game and the cardinals awakening delivered repeated violent blows to the ribcage of the cowboys defense landing a liver punch in the form of a michael wilson dependent touchdown drive to tie the game in the final six seconds of regulation a quick defensive stop and a 44 yard scoring drive in overtime sent the cowboys to the mat for good resulting in one of the most stunning outcomes of the entire nfl season this type of loss can send a team into a spiral could cost defensive coordinator christian parker his job and will undoubtedly cause cowboys fans to angrily punch the air the same problems persist they still can t beat the lowly cardinals in texas and the solutions continue to prove fleeting arizona s rebuilt backfield disintegrates but one pillar remains standing tyler allgeier s second half outburst produced a victory for the cardinals but it was even more triumphant for a workhorse who has often been left to the shadows of more recognizable running mates in atlanta and arizona the talk at the start of the season revolved around first round pick jeremiyah love and when the cardinals couldn t generate consistently on the ground love s absence was quickly blamed allgeier never quite saw the chances he needed to blossom but found himself in an unexpected moment of opportunity sunday when love and bam knight exited due to injury he could have played an average brand of football as the lone remaining runner available but that s not allgeier those who were unfamiliar with his style were reminded rudely on his 63 yard touchdown run in which he broke three tackles and followed a trio of teammates who escorted him to the goal line where he fell across it for a score while finally being brought down that touchdown made it a 17 10 game but more importantly it gave the cardinals reason to believe his ensuing 52 yarder saw hjalte froholdt get out in front and wreck caleb downs in open space setting an aggressive tone embodied by the runner benefitting from the blocking in those two plays and gardner minshew s stint as a mid game replacement the cardinals brought the fight to the cowboys refusing to lay down despite a double digit deficit and little reason to believe they d turn things around because of allgeier s toughness determination and relentless desire to produce when called upon he also caught five passes for 44 yards and an incredibly gritty touchdown reception the cardinals pulled off the stunning win and might have found a new identity in the process next gen stats insight for cardinals cowboys via nfl pro tyler allgeier carried the ball 11 times for 147 yards and a touchdown in week 8 against the cowboys including three explosive gains of 10 or more yards after totaling just two explosive gains across 61 carries over the first seven weeks of the season allgeier recorded a 63 yard touchdown run on arizona s final play from scrimmage in the third quarter before opening the cardinals next drive with a 52 yard scamper he gained 96 rushing yards over expected the most by a cardinals rusher in a game since at least 2018 additionally allgeier finished as the cardinals third leading receiver catching all five targets for 44 yards and a touchdown nfl research the cardinals last second touchdown positioned them to kick a go ahead extra point with 0 06 remaining sunday but chad ryland pushed his attempt wide left entering the cardinals into some exclusive and undesirable company they became the third team to miss a go ahead pat in the final 10 seconds of regulation joining the bengals week 1 2022 and buccaneers week 2 2003 back to top kevin patra s takeaways lions run over undefeated vikings to close gap in nfc north detroit figured out the best way to combat brian flores relentless pressure packages go to the ground after falling behind 15 12 midway through the fourth quarter detroit ran the ball on 11 of its final 13 non kneel plays one of those two jared goff throws was the go ahead touchdown toss to jameson williams detroit leaned on jahmyr gibbs and bruising backup sione vaki gibbs blasted his way to 153 rushing yards and a td on 23 carries while vaki chipped in 11 totes for 65 yards detroit getting production from vaki is a positive sign for the lions down the stretch the lions couldn t get out of their way early with miscues hampering dan campbell s club including some bad penalties goff missed passes early and threw his first interception of the season when williams slipped on a route detroit put up just six points and goff was sacked four times through two quarters then the run game took over allowing the qb to utilize play action and wear down the vikings d it wasn t a perfect game for the home squad but the offense perked up late when needed to close out a big win that bunches the division even closer it was a need to have home game for detroit dan campbell s crew came up clutch in the end vikings offensive struggles continued it was only a matter of time before brian flores defense couldn t carry the day minnesota has been playing on the razor s edge through its first six wins with the defense spearheading wins while the offense was along for the ride against a high powered lions offense flores defense did enough forcing a turnover early field goals and a pivotal late three and out yes the defense ran out of gas against jahmyr gibbs late but kevin o connell s offense needed to do more kyler murray managed the game early but missed too many throws particularly high which led to stalled drives nearly a quarter of murray s 210 yards 24 3 came on a 51 yard bomb to jordan addison the qb missed several other shots right now murray isn t a station to station passer when the big plays don t connect the vikings offense struggles against a lions defense that entered with the worst pass d in the nfl and allowing the most yards murray came up small the vikings generated just 266 yards and 15 first downs going 3 for 10 on third down and 0 for 1 on fourth down isn t winning offense koc needs his offense to find itself at the start of a tough stretch of games right now it s not close detroit s defense stepped up for the second straight week kelvin sheppard s defense has played up a level the defensive line particularly the interior pestered kyler murray alim mcneill led the way with four qb pressures and one sack the secondary did a better job sticking with vikings receivers where we d seen wrs scamper wide open early in the season detroit s secondary at least challenged most plays cornerback d j reed was having his best game including a diving int and a big late pass breakup before leaving with an injury when the defensive line is getting pressure and the secondary plays on a string it s a workable defense the issue sheppard faces now is that he lost a trove of players on sunday star linebacker jack campbell was taken to a local hospital after suffering a neck injury d j wonnum and brian branch each exited with concussions after a collision rookie linebacker jimmy rolder suffered a hamstring injury reed s was a hip can an already shaky unit overcome injuries moving forward next gen stats insight for lions vikings via nfl pro the vikings blitzed on 26 of 29 dropbacks 89 7 in their week 8 loss against the lions the highest blitz rate by a team since at least 2018 breaking the previous record held by the vikings set last week against the colts 85 2 when blitzed jared goff completed 17 passes tied for the most against the blitz in a game this season for 130 yards a touchdown and an interception goff was sacked a season high three times on six pressures when blitzed nfl research jahmyr gibbs became the fifth player in nfl history prior to age 25 to have at least 1 000 scrimmage yards and 10 plus touchdowns in their team s first seven games of a season joining christian mccaffrey 2019 edgerrin james 2000 eric dickerson 1983 and jim brown 1958 back to top kevin patra s takeaways jags stampede floundering colts good teams don t just beat bad ones they take their soul jacksonville is a good team liam coen s squad walloped its division rival in every facet from the start the jaguars blasted indianapolis with an offensive barrage and smothering defense for a team that s struggled at times in the red zone coen s club simply avoided that area splashing scores from distance of the jags five offensive touchdowns only one came inside the red zone jacksonville ripped through a limp colts defense for scores of 31 yards 39 28 and 25 yards pass protection had some concerns but trevor lawrence overcame them side stepping pressure and ripping passes to wide open targets the mvp candidate generated 210 yards and three touchdowns on 10 of 14 attempts before taking a seat for the bulk of the fourth quarter jacksonville ran over the colts earning 183 rushing yards and two tds with bhayshul tuten leading the way 16 104 1 tuten was a tackle breaking maven earning 159 scrimmage yards and two scores have a day rayuan lane jaguars safety rayuan lane snagged a flubbed catch by colts tight end tyler warren and scampered the other way for a 92 yard pick six late in the second quarter the play was the cherry on top of a big day for the navy product who made his second career start and netted three tackles a qb hit and three passes defensed lane making plays after being thrust into significant action highlights a defense that came in waves sunday anthony campanile s defense forced three turnovers held the colts to 243 total yards and 4 1 yards per play jacksonville stymied jonathan taylor holding the veteran back to 2 9 yards per carry and discombobulated daniel jones a stingy run defense combined with sticky coverage on the back end is a recipe for a smothering unit a defense that forces turnovers and an offense that can generate explosives is a formula for blowout wins colts crumbling amid a fire sale shane steichen s squad played like a crew that knows the season is all but over awful tackling missed reps terrible penalties flubbed catches head scratching passes bad blocking porous coverage you name it the colts messed it up daniel jones continued to struggle missing passes and looking flustered in the pocket the first int wasn t his fault the second certainly was jones has been unable to overcome bad surroundings looking like the quarterback who wore out his welcome in new york jones finished 19 of 28 passing for 144 yards one td and two ints before being replaced by anthony richardson jonathan taylor scampered for 19 yards on his first touch he did little else the rest of the contest earning eight rushes for 23 yards and catching four passes for 24 yards he also fumbled on a trick play it might have been taylor s last game in indy most colts players seemed to play like their time in town could be coming to an end if steichen keeps his job beyond monday morning he ll have to do a much better job preparing and motivating his players next gen stats insight for jaguars colts via nfl pro trevor lawrence generated 15 0 yards per attempt the most in a game in his career much of that production came against zone coverage where he completed seven of nine passes for 167 yards and all three of his touchdowns lawrence was also efficient on play action connecting on four of five attempts for 124 yards and a touchdown nfl research bhayshul tuten is the first jaguars player to rush for 100 plus yards score a rushing touchdown record 50 plus receiving yards and a receiving td in the same game back to top jeremy bergman s takeaways raiders basically gave up trying to throw under a heavy rain that persisted for most of the contest penix accepted the challenge and promptly failed he couldn t find his targets especially during the first half spraying the ball around but not to his targets far too often he sailed one over drake london s head during atlanta s first drive into jacob parrish s hands but the corner couldn t handle it even which ranked behind only the bills 32 8 entering week 8 but he was a difference maker in the negative sense against tampa bay he finished 8 of 24 for 125 yards and an ugly 12 0 passer rating in a messy game like sunday s was the best thing quarterbacks can do is protect the ball he didn t and he lost miserable conditions lead to slopfest the true victor of sunday s game might have been the elements atlanta and tampa bay spent most of the day just trying to get through a torrential downpour the rain caused errors in every conceivable way there were overthrows botched snaps missed kicks fumbles and all varieties of dropped passes would be touchdowns easy pickups and interceptions there are too many examples to point to but perhaps the most emblematic football folly took place on the bucs second drive after the center quarterback exchange went wrong baker mayfield recovered the ball and improvised magnificently darting into traffic before throwing it backward to bucky irving who streaked toward the end zone and nearly made it there before jessie bates punched the ball out right at the goal line for a touchback by halftime the game had seen more fumbles five and interceptions three than completions two both teams tightened up on ball security out of half and the rain let up some toward the fourth quarter but tampa bay was able to outlast by stacking some successes despite news_mentions.headline: NFC East training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Commanders, Cowboys, Eagles, Giants
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC East training camp storylines to monitor for the Dallas Cowboys, New York Giants, Philadelphia Eagles and Washington Commanders.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the dallas cowboys new york giants philadelphia eagles and washington commanders catch up on each nfc east team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below dallas cowboys new york giants philadelphia eagles washington commanders three key storylines 1 summer bliss with pickens and no drama in oxnard aside from some contract squabbles with george pickens and brandon aubrey that were tame by cowboys standards this has been a drama free offseason for dallas will that change during training camp in oxnard california it s been a breath of fresh air that s even drawn applause from one of the greatest cowboys ever nfl all time leading rusher emmitt smith with dallas locked in on snapping a two year playoff drought the on field focus bodes well avoiding major storylines might well be the biggest development of the summer for the boys july 28 looms large for the team as it s when players are set to report to camp and owner jerry jones traditionally addresses the media in a lengthy news conference the cowboys have been transparent about not negotiating an extension with pickens who has signed his franchise tag and stated he doesn t intend to hold out we ll see just how copacetic everything remains when camp kicks off 2 downs arrives with plenty of hype ohio state safety caleb downs was viewed as a top line talent in this year s draft the cowboys getting him at no 11 overall was a major boon since joining the team downs has garnered rave reviews the highest defensive selection for the franchise since morris claiborne at no 6 in 2012 downs fills a massive db need for dallas and could prove to be a steal how he looks when the pads are on will be must see viewing for the fans at camp and a pivotal point in the cowboys defensive reconstruction downs isn t the cowboys only 2026 first round selection though picked 23rd overall malachi lawrence is a pass rusher who some felt went earlier than he should ve he has plenty of upside though and the cowboys have plenty of pass rushing needs to fill after mustering just 35 sacks in 2025 tied for 22nd in the league 3 a whole new world on defense dallas defense was a sieve in 2025 finishing dead last in points allowed and 30th in total d perhaps it wasn t too surprising considering the cowboys traded away micah parsons just before the season arrived nonetheless the disastrous results led to matt eberflus ousting young whippersnapper christian parker has taken over as defensive coordinator and garnered plenty of positive buzz he ll helm a defense that has undergone a colossal facelift in the offseason in addition to a pair of first rounders added to the mix dallas has signed safeties jalen thompson and p j locke along with cornerback cobie durant whilst trading for pass rusher rashan gary and linebacker dee winters dallas also has a full season ahead with pro bowler quinnen williams after he too was acquired via trade last season 2025 third round corner shavon revel played just seven games as a rookie rallying from an acl tear in college with downs likely to start from the get go lawrence and a host of other defensive draft picks have replenished the depth the turnover on this side of the ball is staggering but a fresh coat was needed after such a trying 2025 how the finished product ultimately looks will begin to take shape at camp for as ballyhooed as the dak prescott led offense has been the cowboys 2021 23 run of playoff appearances came with an offense and a defense ranked in the top seven in scoring back to top three key storylines 1 can giants get healthy stay healthy in camp harbaugh john harbaugh after 18 years with the ravens has arrived in gotham with plenty of fanfare but his team has already dealt with an alarming amount of injury exits rookie cornerback thaddeus dixon wide receiver special teamer gunner olszewski and defensive lineman roy robertson harris each stunningly suffered a torn achilles during organized team activities robertson harris injury is especially problematic considering the team traded away standout defensive tackle dexter lawrence abdul carter sprained his ankle in june while top receivers malik nabers knee and darius slayton core muscle surgery and second year running back cam skattebo ankle are on the mend as well monitoring the availability of nabers and skattebo for week 1 will carry on through the summer even though the latter has deemed himself a sure bet for the opener with harbaugh reputed to run tough practices the giants healing up and emerging unscathed is paramount 2 this is dart s team now at the start of last season jaxson dart waited his turn behind russell wilson after eventually getting handed the starting reins the first round pick weathered a debut campaign that saw him deal with injuries scrutiny for his devil may care scrambling and the firing of head coach brian daboll daboll and interim head coach mike kafka took turns navigating dart s first season now it s up to matt nagy to shepherd dart s growth the floor for dart is staying healthy the ceiling is what the big blue faithful are most excited about dart s development as a franchise signal caller is arguably the most important factor for the 2026 giants hype and hope have early expiration dates in the nfl so dart s second season is already a pivotal one after the qb showed plenty of potential 24 total touchdowns in his career opening campaign 3 big blue youth movement taking shape over the past two drafts the giants have stockpiled four first round picks carter dart lb arvell reese and ol francis mauigoa rookie wr malachi fields and first year cb colton hood a pair of day 2 picks in april figure to be big contributors though there is sterling veteran talent such as lt andrew thomas and olb brian burns the giants are a young squad looking to lay a winning foundation in the first year under harbaugh high draft spots and hype can provide anticipation but seeing the youngsters round into form this summer will be crucial for 2026 and beyond back to top three key storylines 1 hurts newest offensive scheme sean mannion is the latest offensive coordinator for the eagles and jalen hurts who truly found offensive bliss in 2022 his second and final season with shane steichen since then hurts has had a different offensive coordinator in each season even with kellen moore during a super bowl winning 2024 campaign philadelphia s passing game ebbed and flowed while running back saquon barkley largely fueled the offense drama was more prevalent last season than offensive chemistry as the passing game ranked 23rd in yards and the sputtering running attack diminished from the previous season s dominance hurts had a career best 25 touchdown passes but snapped a four season streak of double digit rushing scores finishing with eight last year s offense was far too predictable and stagnated on a seemingly weekly basis held to 20 points or less in 10 games including a dismal 23 19 playoff loss to the 49ers with o line guru jeff stoutland no longer coaching a group that was really the heartbeat of both of the eagles super bowl squads under nick sirianni the offense is undergoing more change than the annual alterations everyone s accustomed to a j brown is gone traded to the patriots in an offseason storyline that lingered for months all eyes are on hurts whose past accomplishments don t seem to hold too much weight with a feisty fanbase that believes its strong roster should be vying for lombardi trophies every year 2 new look wide receivers after four seasons two super bowl appearances and one lombardi trophy a j brown has departed philadelphia while brown s disharmony commanded the headlines he topped 1 000 yards receiving in each of his four years with the team devonta smith is now the unquestioned top target but gm howie roseman restocked the wr room with a trade for dontayvion wicks the signing of veteran speedster marquise brown and in the most exciting move the first round selection of makai lemon don t sleep on second round tight end eli stowers either the john mackey award winner from vanderbilt could line up all over the field as a 6 foot 4 matchup nightmare dallas goedert is back likely for one final season and smith one of the more underrated wideouts around adds to the familiarity overall though there is a freshness to the group that will need to come together in the summer but could liven up an all too often static offense from a season ago 3 what becomes of carter jalen carter seems to be on the brink of becoming perhaps the league s elite defensive tackle hence he s seeking a seismic extension which has led to trade speculation how it all plays out is sure to be headline fodder and it wouldn t feel right to be without some melodrama in philly furthermore defensive coordinator vic fangio is back and losing carter would be a magnificent blow a potential boon will be the additions of cornerback tariq woolen and pass rusher jonathan greenard no matter the pedigree not all players fit into fangio s scheme see bryce huff jalen ramsey jevon holland etc woolen is a physically gifted cover man who made his share of questionable plays with the seahawks it will be interesting seeing how the newbies fit into fangio s scheme but the prevailing matter at hand for the defense is carter s future back to top three key storylines 1 plenty on daniels plate there s a lot to accomplish for jayden daniels this summer following a disastrous 2025 season the commanders sputtered and the 2024 ap offensive rookie of the year missed 10 games due to injuries going just 2 5 in the games he played how daniels looks and feels after sustaining a sprained knee strained hamstring and dislocated left elbow is tops on the agenda he also needs to get acclimated to david blough s offense which will see daniels taking snaps under center far more now that his former assistant qb coach is his offensive coordinator after two seasons with kliff kingsbury in that role daniels is also in the latest season of netflix s quarterback series all eyes and a heap of responsibility will be on daniels how he bounces back and how well he adapts to a new offense could be the story of the commanders season 2 how does overhauled defense look when you fall from being everyone s nfc championship game darling to a 5 12 struggle bus you can run out of fingers to point the commanders put a massive under construction sign in front of a defense that finished dead last in yards allowed they used the no 7 overall pick on ohio state linebacker sonny styles an athletic marvel who will draw plenty of hype as a preseason defensive rookie of the year candidate general manager adam peters opened the check book before turning in the card to get styles too washington broke the bank to sign pass rusher odafe oweh while adding plenty more veteran starters elsewhere nickel amik robertson safety nick cross pass rusher k 39 lavon chaisson linebacker leo chenal and defensive tackle tim settle the commanders added veteran depth as well binging on free agents isn t always a winning formula of course how quickly new defensive coordinator daronte jones and washington s cast of fresh faces get on the same page will be crucial in camp 3 all set at skill spots daniels injuries were a giant issue in 2025 but not surrounding the blossoming franchise qb with enough talent at the skill spots also loomed large looking at the offensive roster on paper it s difficult to feel the commanders have remedied those ills terry mclaurin who dealt with a contract kerfuffle last year as well as ankle quad and pelvic injuries will hopefully be back to his pro bowl self with a full camp and good health however the team s wr corps hasn t added much to get overjoyed about dyami brown and van jefferson were signed in free agency while treylon burks and luke mccaffrey are both back none of those four reached 30 receptions or 400 yards in 2025 rookie third rounder antonio williams figures to jump right into the mix and will likely need to be a big contributor quickly elsewhere jacory croskey merritt should be the lead back after an 805 yard rookie campaign but he was hardly a consistent producer in year 1 the most notable additions are former titans tight end chigoziem okonkwo who should be a breakout candidate after three straight 50 catch seasons with tennessee and ex buccaneers running back rachaad white with blough s promotion to oc familiarity remains but this offensive roster is certainly a candidate for a veteran add or two in the weeks before the regular season commences back to top

news_mentions.headline: NFL experts' Week 8 takeaways: Do Ravens need drastic QB measures? Plus, Cowboys collapse
news_mentions.body_text: each sunday three of the athletic 39 s nfl writers react to the biggest news plays and performances from the day 39 s games every sunday matters in the nfl that 39 s what makes the league so popular but this sunday seemed especially consequential with a significant quarterback injury a stunning comeback and several key division matchups the biggest news of the day came early as the return of baltimore ravens quarterback lamar jackson lasted one play before he left with a thumb injury it got worse when backup tyler huntley also left with an injury in the end emergency quarterback joe fagnano gave a game performance but it wasn 39 t nearly enough in a 36 10 loss to the buffalo bills now the ravens will have to hold their breath and see if their franchise quarterback is going to miss the rest of the season the most important game of the day was in detroit as the lions handed the minnesota vikings their first loss of the season detroit 39 s offense did just enough against the dominant minnesota defense in a 19 15 win the wildest game of the day was in dallas as the arizona cardinals scored two touchdowns in the final three minutes of regulation and won 33 30 in overtime it was another stunning collapse by the cowboys in a season that is getting away from them the season has already gotten away from the indianapolis colts who suffered a humiliating 42 7 loss to the jacksonville jaguars the fire sale that started earlier this week could accelerate with the trade deadline looming nfl writers mike jones austin mock and ted nguyen share their thoughts on the ravens 39 quarterback mess the stumbling cowboys the surging lions and the hapless indianapolis colts should the ravens trade serious draft capital for a quarterback in an attempt to save their season if lamar jackson misses a significant amount of time jones if tyler huntley will not miss time then the ravens don 39 t even need to consider this if both jackson and huntley will miss time baltimore needs to do something but there 39 s not really a quarterback worthy of serious draft capital on the trading block when it comes to veterans capable of stepping in and leading a team effectively the pickings are rather slim the cincinnati bengals aren 39 t going to trade joe flacco to a divisional rival the san francisco 49ers aren 39 t going to part with mac jones andy dalton would seem to have a little left in the tank and is a member of the atlanta falcons 39 crowded quarterback room but he wouldn 39 t seemingly command 34 serious draft capital 34 another option josh johnson who is in his 19th professional season and is a member of the bengals 39 practice squad baltimore wouldn 39 t have to trade for him to add him to their roster mock i don 39 t think so and am pretty sure that would be a poor decision in the long run first being desperate and turning to the trade market is a dangerous combination second i 39 m not even sure who you 39 d trade for at this point kirk cousins is probably the only starter that makes sense but i 39 m not sure if the las vegas raiders would be willing to do that mac jones will certainly be buzzy but i 39 m skeptical what we saw in half a season under kyle shanahan in the 49ers 39 system is the type of production you 39 ll get in baltimore at the end of the day you have to be content with understanding that the future is more important than the now and that 39 s where i 39 m at with the ravens maybe you can win some games down the stretch with poor quarterback play but if not you get a better draft pick to supplement lamar jackson for 2027 and beyond nguyen i 39 m not sure who would be available that could help them at this point cousins is leading the league in touchdown passes but i think the raiders are intent on keeping him as fernando mendoza 39 s mentor maybe the bears would be willing to trade tyson bagent and go with case keenum as their backup bagent knows offensive coordinator declan doyle 39 s system and the transition should be relatively simple it would take maybe a second round pick for the 49ers to trade mac jones there just aren 39 t a lot of options i 39 m not sure if the ravens defense is good enough to hold things together during a qb transition period sometimes you just have to accept your fate at the very least they may get to keep doyle longer who 39 s most to blame for the cowboys 39 stunning collapse against the cardinals jones there 39 s plenty of blame to go around a defense that let gardner minshew come off the bench to carve them up for three touchdown passes while completing 17 of 23 passes for 188 yards in less than 17 minutes of play a defense that let tyler allgeier gash them for 147 rushing yards and a touchdown on just 11 touches a defense that let michael wilson rack up 111 receiving yards and a touchdown on eight catches a defense that surrendered 30 points after halftime or do we want to go with a cowboys offense that got out gained 467 261 while averaging just 3 6 yards per play this was a bad day all around for coach brian schottenheimer and his team mock can i say everyone because it 39 s not that simple the easy answer is the defense because they 39 ve been horrendous for two seasons now and the offseason moves to address that side of the ball haven 39 t come to fruition the defense isn 39 t even close to being a respectable unit right now and you can 39 t consistently win games in the nfl with a unit that bad but the offense deserves some blame too with their inability to run the ball 34 percent success rate against the cardinals which resulted in them being unable to put away the cardinals with a lead so that comes back to the blame on everyone the coaching staff on both sides of the ball the front office it 39 s all bad right now the coaching staff isn 39 t elevating the talent they have and the front office hasn 39 t given them the talent to be a winning football team so while it 39 s easy to point fingers at one person or one unit the blame is shared and goes the whole way to the top of the organization nguyen the offense certainly deserves blame for not putting away the game against a cardinals defense that had been struggling however the defense gave up 20 points in the fourth quarter to a minshew led offense without any timeouts the cardinals drove 80 yards in just over a minute and should have won the game in regulation but missed an extra point and there were wide open receivers the cardinals weren 39 t making a bunch of amazing catches in overtime the offense went three and out and the cardinals drove right down the field the detroit lions didn 39 t light up the scoreboard against the minnesota vikings 39 fearsome defense but jared goff led the game winning drive in the fourth quarter goff has 15 touchdown passes and one interception is he the mvp so far this season jones if you ask vegas goff doesn 39 t even crack the top five in the mvp race the popular picks josh allen brock purdy joe burrow patrick mahomes and trevor lawrence lead the way according to most books however goff certainly deserves consideration sunday was a big statement game for the lions and the 11th year veteran goff has been masterful this season especially against the blitz where entering sunday 39 s game he had completed roughly 77 percent of his passes the vikings definitely got to him on sunday but when it mattered most goff came through goff has provided stability and effectiveness despite a change at offensive coordinator and injuries on that side of the ball and despite all the change detroit boasts one of the most prolific offenses in the league thanks largely to goff mock goff came into this week sixth in quarterback index qbi heading into the week and i 39 m not sure his stat line against the vikings will improve that number but it 39 s the vikings so we are happy to give him a pass but with the weapons that they have on offense it 39 s hard for me to see goff getting enough credit to win the award the lions have a ton of talent going around with jahmyr gibbs amon ra st brown and even on the offensive line with penei sewell and then you factor in that allen is still doing otherworldly things in buffalo i don 39 t know if he can be the favorite with goff being non existent in the run game his passing numbers would need to be above and beyond allen and others and with gibbs in the backfield i 39 m not sure we will see that in the conversation sure but he 39 s in that second tier right now and likely behind allen purdy and mahomes if i was in charge nguyen he should definitely be in the conversation the hiring of offensive coordinator drew petzing and passing game coordinator mike kafka has gotten this offense back on track the lions still are a run first team and gibbs might win offensive player of the year goff has been extremely productive but it 39 s hard to overlook the super human play of allen this season goff 39 s final numbers would have to be substantially better than allen 39 s for him to win in my opinion after trading two of their best players the colts were crushed by the jaguars they don 39 t own their first round pick and daniel jones looks lost after getting a huge contract extension is this the most bleak situation in the nfl right now jones the colts have two more wins than the winless chargers but it 39 s clear indianapolis is headed toward a franchise reset this offseason they 39 ve already fired their general manager and unloaded two key players in quenton nelson and deforest buckner they really should go ahead and move jonathan taylor and josh downs and anyone else they can to stockpile picks for their next gm to work with in the spring mock i think so yes and if i were in charge i 39 d be selling off just about every player i could to try and maximize my draft capital in the coming years considering the colts don 39 t have their first rounder and with new ownership will a promising general manager and or coaching staff be willing to come in for a rebuild if head coach shane steichen isn 39 t around next season you 39 d have to really sell the new front office and staff on this being a long rebuild and preach patience because the roster is void of talent on both sides of the ball and there is no future quarterback at the moment and even then if you hit on a quarterback how long does it take to surround your rookie with enough talent to compete for titles before you have to pay him a gaudy amount with the lack of draft capital this is certainly the franchise furthest from winning and will need a full rebuild and most importantly time to get this thing turned around nguyen can 39 t think of many worse than the colts right now who don 39 t have a first round pick the sauce gardner trade for two first round picks could be the worst trade since the browns 39 for deshaun watson maybe the colts could recoup a first for taylor extending jones from a small sample of successful play after a career 39 s worth of underwhelming play was a bad mistake chris ballard put this team in dire straits before his firing which is one of the dangers of having a gm on the hot seat they start to make desperate moves to save their job this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: 2026 NFL season, Week 8: What We Learned from Sunday's games
news_mentions.description: Around The NFL breaks down what you need to know from Sunday's action in Week 8 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 8 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below early window buffalo bills 36 baltimore ravens 10 cincinnati bengals 43 tennessee titans 36 ot arizona cardinals 33 dallas cowboys 30 ot detroit lions 19 minnesota vikings 15 jacksonville jaguars 42 indianapolis colts 7 las vegas raiders 38 new york jets 33 pittsburgh steelers 27 cleveland browns 6 tampa bay buccaneers 16 atlanta falcons 0 late window los angeles rams 24 los angeles chargers 9 denver broncos 28 kansas city chiefs 24 new england patriots 24 miami dolphins 19 sunday night washington commanders 27 philadelphia eagles 10 nick shook s takeaways bills let hunters loose buffalo s biggest underlying question mark was its defense a leaky unit that struggled to get stops and limit opposing offenses in what became weekly shootouts for the bills that finally changed for the better on sunday with lamar jackson exiting quickly and tyler huntley back in the lineup buffalo decided it was time to hunt the quarterback dialing up blitzes and registering pressures on half of huntley s four passes which also incidentally forced huntley out of the game due to injury once undrafted rookie joe fagnano took over the carnivorous bills saw nothing but red meat blitzing on 64 5 of their total defensive snaps logging qb pressures at a rate of 61 3 and short circuiting baltimore s offense all afternoon the ravens finished with just 144 net yards of offense scored their only touchdown via a short field earned by a broderick washington interception and couldn t piece together more than one drive of significance which ended in a 26 yard tyler loop field goal buffalo s defense made sure it wouldn t allow derrick henry to carry the ravens and denied fagnano the space to breathe overwhelming the inexperienced signal caller in a runaway win quarterback injuries decimate ravens lamar jackson s anticipated return lasted just one snap his first pass attempt fell incomplete and on the follow through to his throw jackson s thumb collided with a defender s hand resulting in an injury that will land jackson on injured reserve for the foreseeable future after a few weeks of backup turned starter duty tyler huntley found himself on the field sunday appearing skittish and struggling to gain a single yard through the air before an injury knocked him out of action as well leaving the ravens with their emergency third qb joe fagnano as their only remaining option the uconn product gave his best effort but was constantly under duress leaving the ravens with little room to move the ball all afternoon zay flowers went without a catch on five targets rashod bateman s one catch for 22 yards accounted for the most receiving production for any raven and running back justice hill led baltimore in receptions with four it was a lifeless offense that left the ravens defense on the field for far too long buffalo won the time of possession battle 37 36 to 22 24 and sunday s display should rightfully worry ravens fans about their team s outlook for the remainder of 2026 it sounds as if jackson s season could be finished and recent results without him including sunday are discouraging at best moore delivers in return after missing a handful of weeks buffalo welcomed back its prized offseason acquisition d j moore who showed no signs of hesitancy and delivered a strong outing four catches 82 yards including a spectacular grab for 49 yards to set up a james cook touchdown and a touchdown catch moore s return helped draw some attention away from buffalo s tight ends dalton kincaid finished with a team best 86 yards and a touchdown on four catches took a bit of pressure off cook and unlocked enough of the unit s attack to help the bills climb out of a grind it out start to pour it on in the second half moore s rapport with josh allen remains strong even after the time off and helped allen pass jim kelly for the franchise s all time lead in touchdowns 260 now moore will need to prove he can be this reliable on a weekly basis next gen stats insight for ravens bills via nfl pro the bills blitzed on 64 5 of opposing dropbacks against the ravens in week 8 their highest blitz rate since 2021 and the highest blitz rate ravens quarterbacks have faced this season the bills blitz rate had not exceeded 39 in any of their prior six games this season when blitzing the bills generated 11 pressures including a season high seven quick pressures under 2 5 seconds and three sacks including a strip sack fumble recovery in the second quarter nfl research josh allen and james cook each had a rushing touchdown in week 8 marking the 16th time that allen and cook have scored a rushing touchdown in the same game sixteen games breaks a tie with dak prescott and ezekiel elliott for the most games by any teammate duo in nfl history in which both players had a rushing touchdown back to top bobby kownack s takeaways burrow was everything good bad about bengals offense what a roller coaster performance by joe burrow the cincy quarterback unquestionably served as the team s hero accounting for six touchdowns in an unexpected shootout with the titans but his three interceptions contributed initially to a slow start and later allowed tennessee to stay in it two of those picks were deep heaves to ja 39 marr chase with one way overthrown and another that came up far too short if you re going to make mistakes though make sure you make up for them burrow did that and more piling on the points and feeding his top two receivers to great success tee higgins had 10 catches for 155 yards and two tds on 11 targets while chase tallied 11 receptions for 141 yards and a score on 16 looks burrow also importantly cleaned it up in crunch time of his five drives that took place in the fourth quarter or overtime one ended in a chase brown fumble and the other ticked down the final 17 seconds to the extra frame on the other three burrow marched his bengals 73 81 and 70 yards throwing two touchdowns and scoring the game winner on a 9 yard scramble he finished with 426 yards five tds and three ints on 38 of 48 passing marking his third consecutive game with at least four passing touchdowns it s a bit scary how many points the bengals put up despite four giveaways and that s all credit to burrow standout performances not enough for tennessee there was not an ounce of quit in the titans after trading away their best player defensive tackle jeffery simmons on thursday the defense still generated four takeaways the most it has had in a game this season safety amani hooker had joe burrow s number intercepting him a whopping three times while defensive end jacob martin tallied three sacks and linebacker anthony hill was relentless with 14 tackles on offense cam ward enjoyed by far his best game of the season despite being without carnell tate ward dissected cincinnati s defense with regularity going 26 of 40 for 304 yards and two touchdowns snapping a five game interception streak and nearly doubling his average of 168 4 passing yards per game he led two separate go ahead td drives in the fourth quarter plus tony pollard continued his recent resurgence rushing for 117 yards and two scores after going for 129 and three tds in week 7 his 40 yard touchdown to open the scoring will be one of the highlights of the day in his or any game with pollard breaking multiple tackles before stiff arming one bengals defender into another s path in a keystone cops sequence on the way to pay dirt of course it was still not enough for the 1 7 titans but the fight they showed was admirable regardless of the nfl s aversion to moral victories concerning trends taking shape for bengals the most important result from sunday is the bengals moving to 5 2 in a highly competitive afc north however there are some underlying issues still plaguing cincinnati the bengals found themselves trailing 13 0 for the second straight week this deficit came at the end of the first quarter unlike last week s halftime hole against the ravens and the bengals started picking it up much earlier to go into intermission with a lead but they couldn t pull away like they did in baltimore instead the titans pushed them to overtime taking advantage of a defense that forced a pair of turnovers but couldn t get enough stops to make things easy in the past three games the bengals have needed to outlast a one win titans team in overtime looked asleep for far too long facing backup quarterback tyler huntley and let a then winless dolphins squad make things uncomfortable late before that it was two straight losses those who choose optimism will point to the bengals record and their three game winning streak but venturing through a season as escape artists typically catches up down the line next gen stats insight for titans bengals via nfl pro amani hooker picked off joe burrow three times which included 15 3 expected points added across five targets in coverage the second most coverage epa by a player in a game this season hooker allowed only 12 yards in coverage on the day nfl research joe burrow became just the second quarterback in league history to have 450 plus passing yards five plus passing tds and a rushing td in a game joining norm van brocklin week 1 1951 back to top nick shook s takeaways qb change sparks comeback through nearly three quarters the cardinals were repeating the same frustrating offensive performance that had become all too familiar in recent weeks jacoby brissett was under constant pressure and resorting to throws that amounted to little more than prayers and after watching brissett take two consecutive sacks for double digit negative yardage in the third quarter coach mike lafleur had enough calling for gardner minshew to replace the battered brissett oddly enough the quarterback change coincided with a revival of the running game that depended solely on tyler allgeier after jeremiyah love left with another ankle injury and bam knight was knocked out of action due to a concussion allgeier put the team on his back rushing 11 times for 147 yards and a touchdown and repeatedly turning to the sideline oxygen tank as a means of survival minshew meanwhile created a rhythm in the passing game that the cardinals haven t enjoyed in over a month completing 17 of 23 passes for 188 yards and three touchdowns including a magnificent final touchdown drive that covered 80 yards in eight plays and 1 03 to tie the game and balancing the offense by turning to michael wilson plenty eight catches 111 yards one touchdown arizona pulled off this 23 point outburst and improbable comeback after losing love knight and receiver kendrick bourne maximizing its returns with its remaining contributors with just enough time to escape defeat it will likely prompt a quarterback change and could be a minor springboard forward for a team that was desperate for a morale boosting win like this cowboys collapse could have devastating effect dallas will look back at this game and have no choice but to admit this was its worst loss of 2026 entering the final minute of the third quarter the cowboys were in control holding a 17 3 lead that was all but guaranteed to eventually become 20 3 or larger in that moment though their defense broke down surrendering a rumbling 63 yard touchdown run to tyler allgeier the first of a few massive chunks gained by allgeier in the final 16 minutes of regulation on a 52 yard allgeier run in the fourth quarter safety caleb downs got pancaked by hjalte froholdt twice in the same play typifying arizona s sudden takeover with the image of downs tumbling across the turf like a runaway cheese wheel speeding down a hill this all happened after dallas had suffocated arizona s offense for the first 44 minutes of the game and the cardinals awakening delivered repeated violent blows to the ribcage of the cowboys defense landing a liver punch in the form of a michael wilson dependent touchdown drive to tie the game in the final six seconds of regulation a quick defensive stop and a 44 yard scoring drive in overtime sent the cowboys to the mat for good resulting in one of the most stunning outcomes of the entire nfl season this type of loss can send a team into a spiral could cost defensive coordinator christian parker his job and will undoubtedly cause cowboys fans to angrily punch the air the same problems persist they still can t beat the lowly cardinals in texas and the solutions continue to prove fleeting arizona s rebuilt backfield disintegrates but one pillar remains standing tyler allgeier s second half outburst produced a victory for the cardinals but it was even more triumphant for a workhorse who has often been left to the shadows of more recognizable running mates in atlanta and arizona the talk at the start of the season revolved around first round pick jeremiyah love and when the cardinals couldn t generate consistently on the ground love s absence was quickly blamed allgeier never quite saw the chances he needed to blossom but found himself in an unexpected moment of opportunity sunday when love and bam knight exited due to injury he could have played an average brand of football as the lone remaining runner available but that s not allgeier those who were unfamiliar with his style were reminded rudely on his 63 yard touchdown run in which he broke
