news_mentions.description: Will Sam Darnold enjoy his best performance in weeks against the Bears on Monday night? Which two receivers have sneaky upside? Raza Umerani highlights nine sleepers to consider for your fantasy football lineup in Week 8.
news_mentions.body_text: fantasy football is a lot like trick or treating oftentimes you put together what you think is an excellent costume like having a great draft on paper only to realize that it s falling apart at the seams akin to fantasy busts and injuries some candies are can t miss classics jahmyr gibbs is m m s jaxon smith njigba is snickers josh allen is kitkat others leave a little to be desired but every year there s a candy that s handed out at one or two houses that wiggles down to the bottom of your pillow case you don t initially notice it amidst all the twix and mars bars but once you find it you re pleasantly surprised enough to go buy more from the store for me back in my halloween heyday that candy was milk duds no i won t apologize these sleepers are that proverbial candy of your choice they might not be reese s peanut butter cups or milky ways but they ll do enough to satisfy you over halloween weekend and perhaps beyond note all statistics come courtesy of next gen stats unless otherwise noted quarterbacks running backs wide receivers tight end defenses

news_mentions.headline: NFC East training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Commanders, Cowboys, Eagles, Giants
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC East training camp storylines to monitor for the Dallas Cowboys, New York Giants, Philadelphia Eagles and Washington Commanders.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the dallas cowboys new york giants philadelphia eagles and washington commanders catch up on each nfc east team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below dallas cowboys new york giants philadelphia eagles washington commanders three key storylines 1 summer bliss with pickens and no drama in oxnard aside from some contract squabbles with george pickens and brandon aubrey that were tame by cowboys standards this has been a drama free offseason for dallas will that change during training camp in oxnard california it s been a breath of fresh air that s even drawn applause from one of the greatest cowboys ever nfl all time leading rusher emmitt smith with dallas locked in on snapping a two year playoff drought the on field focus bodes well avoiding major storylines might well be the biggest development of the summer for the boys july 28 looms large for the team as it s when players are set to report to camp and owner jerry jones traditionally addresses the media in a lengthy news conference the cowboys have been transparent about not negotiating an extension with pickens who has signed his franchise tag and stated he doesn t intend to hold out we ll see just how copacetic everything remains when camp kicks off 2 downs arrives with plenty of hype ohio state safety caleb downs was viewed as a top line talent in this year s draft the cowboys getting him at no 11 overall was a major boon since joining the team downs has garnered rave reviews the highest defensive selection for the franchise since morris claiborne at no 6 in 2012 downs fills a massive db need for dallas and could prove to be a steal how he looks when the pads are on will be must see viewing for the fans at camp and a pivotal point in the cowboys defensive reconstruction downs isn t the cowboys only 2026 first round selection though picked 23rd overall malachi lawrence is a pass rusher who some felt went earlier than he should ve he has plenty of upside though and the cowboys have plenty of pass rushing needs to fill after mustering just 35 sacks in 2025 tied for 22nd in the league 3 a whole new world on defense dallas defense was a sieve in 2025 finishing dead last in points allowed and 30th in total d perhaps it wasn t too surprising considering the cowboys traded away micah parsons just before the season arrived nonetheless the disastrous results led to matt eberflus ousting young whippersnapper christian parker has taken over as defensive coordinator and garnered plenty of positive buzz he ll helm a defense that has undergone a colossal facelift in the offseason in addition to a pair of first rounders added to the mix dallas has signed safeties jalen thompson and p j locke along with cornerback cobie durant whilst trading for pass rusher rashan gary and linebacker dee winters dallas also has a full season ahead with pro bowler quinnen williams after he too was acquired via trade last season 2025 third round corner shavon revel played just seven games as a rookie rallying from an acl tear in college with downs likely to start from the get go lawrence and a host of other defensive draft picks have replenished the depth the turnover on this side of the ball is staggering but a fresh coat was needed after such a trying 2025 how the finished product ultimately looks will begin to take shape at camp for as ballyhooed as the dak prescott led offense has been the cowboys 2021 23 run of playoff appearances came with an offense and a defense ranked in the top seven in scoring back to top three key storylines 1 can giants get healthy stay healthy in camp harbaugh john harbaugh after 18 years with the ravens has arrived in gotham with plenty of fanfare but his team has already dealt with an alarming amount of injury exits rookie cornerback thaddeus dixon wide receiver special teamer gunner olszewski and defensive lineman roy robertson harris each stunningly suffered a torn achilles during organized team activities robertson harris injury is especially problematic considering the team traded away standout defensive tackle dexter lawrence abdul carter sprained his ankle in june while top receivers malik nabers knee and darius slayton core muscle surgery and second year running back cam skattebo ankle are on the mend as well monitoring the availability of nabers and skattebo for week 1 will carry on through the summer even though the latter has deemed himself a sure bet for the opener with harbaugh reputed to run tough practices the giants healing up and emerging unscathed is paramount 2 this is dart s team now at the start of last season jaxson dart waited his turn behind russell wilson after eventually getting handed the starting reins the first round pick weathered a debut campaign that saw him deal with injuries scrutiny for his devil may care scrambling and the firing of head coach brian daboll daboll and interim head coach mike kafka took turns navigating dart s first season now it s up to matt nagy to shepherd dart s growth the floor for dart is staying healthy the ceiling is what the big blue faithful are most excited about dart s development as a franchise signal caller is arguably the most important factor for the 2026 giants hype and hope have early expiration dates in the nfl so dart s second season is already a pivotal one after the qb showed plenty of potential 24 total touchdowns in his career opening campaign 3 big blue youth movement taking shape over the past two drafts the giants have stockpiled four first round picks carter dart lb arvell reese and ol francis mauigoa rookie wr malachi fields and first year cb colton hood a pair of day 2 picks in april figure to be big contributors though there is sterling veteran talent such as lt andrew thomas and olb brian burns the giants are a young squad looking to lay a winning foundation in the first year under harbaugh high draft spots and hype can provide anticipation but seeing the youngsters round into form this summer will be crucial for 2026 and beyond back to top three key storylines 1 hurts newest offensive scheme sean mannion is the latest offensive coordinator for the eagles and jalen hurts who truly found offensive bliss in 2022 his second and final season with shane steichen since then hurts has had a different offensive coordinator in each season even with kellen moore during a super bowl winning 2024 campaign philadelphia s passing game ebbed and flowed while running back saquon barkley largely fueled the offense drama was more prevalent last season than offensive chemistry as the passing game ranked 23rd in yards and the sputtering running attack diminished from the previous season s dominance hurts had a career best 25 touchdown passes but snapped a four season streak of double digit rushing scores finishing with eight last year s offense was far too predictable and stagnated on a seemingly weekly basis held to 20 points or less in 10 games including a dismal 23 19 playoff loss to the 49ers with o line guru jeff stoutland no longer coaching a group that was really the heartbeat of both of the eagles super bowl squads under nick sirianni the offense is undergoing more change than the annual alterations everyone s accustomed to a j brown is gone traded to the patriots in an offseason storyline that lingered for months all eyes are on hurts whose past accomplishments don t seem to hold too much weight with a feisty fanbase that believes its strong roster should be vying for lombardi trophies every year 2 new look wide receivers after four seasons two super bowl appearances and one lombardi trophy a j brown has departed philadelphia while brown s disharmony commanded the headlines he topped 1 000 yards receiving in each of his four years with the team devonta smith is now the unquestioned top target but gm howie roseman restocked the wr room with a trade for dontayvion wicks the signing of veteran speedster marquise brown and in the most exciting move the first round selection of makai lemon don t sleep on second round tight end eli stowers either the john mackey award winner from vanderbilt could line up all over the field as a 6 foot 4 matchup nightmare dallas goedert is back likely for one final season and smith one of the more underrated wideouts around adds to the familiarity overall though there is a freshness to the group that will need to come together in the summer but could liven up an all too often static offense from a season ago 3 what becomes of carter jalen carter seems to be on the brink of becoming perhaps the league s elite defensive tackle hence he s seeking a seismic extension which has led to trade speculation how it all plays out is sure to be headline fodder and it wouldn t feel right to be without some melodrama in philly furthermore defensive coordinator vic fangio is back and losing carter would be a magnificent blow a potential boon will be the additions of cornerback tariq woolen and pass rusher jonathan greenard no matter the pedigree not all players fit into fangio s scheme see bryce huff jalen ramsey jevon holland etc woolen is a physically gifted cover man who made his share of questionable plays with the seahawks it will be interesting seeing how the newbies fit into fangio s scheme but the prevailing matter at hand for the defense is carter s future back to top three key storylines 1 plenty on daniels plate there s a lot to accomplish for jayden daniels this summer following a disastrous 2025 season the commanders sputtered and the 2024 ap offensive rookie of the year missed 10 games due to injuries going just 2 5 in the games he played how daniels looks and feels after sustaining a sprained knee strained hamstring and dislocated left elbow is tops on the agenda he also needs to get acclimated to david blough s offense which will see daniels taking snaps under center far more now that his former assistant qb coach is his offensive coordinator after two seasons with kliff kingsbury in that role daniels is also in the latest season of netflix s quarterback series all eyes and a heap of responsibility will be on daniels how he bounces back and how well he adapts to a new offense could be the story of the commanders season 2 how does overhauled defense look when you fall from being everyone s nfc championship game darling to a 5 12 struggle bus you can run out of fingers to point the commanders put a massive under construction sign in front of a defense that finished dead last in yards allowed they used the no 7 overall pick on ohio state linebacker sonny styles an athletic marvel who will draw plenty of hype as a preseason defensive rookie of the year candidate general manager adam peters opened the check book before turning in the card to get styles too washington broke the bank to sign pass rusher odafe oweh while adding plenty more veteran starters elsewhere nickel amik robertson safety nick cross pass rusher k 39 lavon chaisson linebacker leo chenal and defensive tackle tim settle the commanders added veteran depth as well binging on free agents isn t always a winning formula of course how quickly new defensive coordinator daronte jones and washington s cast of fresh faces get on the same page will be crucial in camp 3 all set at skill spots daniels injuries were a giant issue in 2025 but not surrounding the blossoming franchise qb with enough talent at the skill spots also loomed large looking at the offensive roster on paper it s difficult to feel the commanders have remedied those ills terry mclaurin who dealt with a contract kerfuffle last year as well as ankle quad and pelvic injuries will hopefully be back to his pro bowl self with a full camp and good health however the team s wr corps hasn t added much to get overjoyed about dyami brown and van jefferson were signed in free agency while treylon burks and luke mccaffrey are both back none of those four reached 30 receptions or 400 yards in 2025 rookie third rounder antonio williams figures to jump right into the mix and will likely need to be a big contributor quickly elsewhere jacory croskey merritt should be the lead back after an 805 yard rookie campaign but he was hardly a consistent producer in year 1 the most notable additions are former titans tight end chigoziem okonkwo who should be a breakout candidate after three straight 50 catch seasons with tennessee and ex buccaneers running back rachaad white with blough s promotion to oc familiarity remains but this offensive roster is certainly a candidate for a veteran add or two in the weeks before the regular season commences back to top

news_mentions.headline: AFC North training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Bengals, Browns, Ravens, Steelers
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Nick Shook breaks down the top AFC North training camp storylines to monitor for the Baltimore Ravens, Cincinnati Bengals, Cleveland Browns and Pittsburgh Steelers.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams nick shook has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the baltimore ravens cincinnati bengals cleveland browns and pittsburgh steelers catch up on each afc north team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below baltimore ravens cincinnati bengals cleveland browns pittsburgh steelers three key storylines 1 minter era begins john harbaugh is gone and in steps rookie head coach jesse minter to replace him baltimore needed a fresh start minter is the face of it but with a fresh start comes uncertainty is minter capable of preparing and directing his team toward the super bowl contention that has become the standard expectation in the charm city will the shift from harbaugh to minter a product of the harbaugh family coaching tree be enough to push the ravens back into the postseason or is the similarity between the two too close to produce meaningful change it s not often a team changes coaches and is still expected to compete for division titles and more but that s where the ravens find themselves and as is always the case with rookie coaches there s plenty of learning ahead for better or worse does this move boost baltimore back to the top of the division or will the ravens suffer another disappointing finish like in 2025 2 new oc for lamar with a new coaching staff in baltimore lamar jackson has a new offensive coordinator declan doyle is only 30 years old and less than a year older than jackson which could produce a deeper level of understanding between coach and quarterback but he s a largely unproven play caller doyle spent his first season as an oc under offensive mastermind ben johnson in chicago meaning he wasn t holding the play sheet now he will be jackson who is embracing the new system will need to adjust quickly and help the new coordinator establish a rapport with him in order to maximize the potential of the offense which returns derrick henry mark andrews zay flowers and rashod bateman among others baltimore must find a replacement for departed tight end isaiah likely but if doyle is anything like the coach he spent 2025 under the new oc should produce positive results even if it takes a bit to get going 3 a restored defense a hidden detail in the ravens 2025 struggles existed in their defense a unit that is traditionally a strength but was a sieve early in the campaign the main reason defensive lineman nnamdi madubuike went down with a serious neck injury exposing a weakness and lack of depth up front that rendered baltimore s d mostly ineffective except for the moments in which safety kyle hamilton played superhero to save the day that s not sustainable and the ravens acted accordingly this offseason signing trey hendrickson to restore a fearsome presence in the pass rushing unit madubuike could return in 2026 too and age defying defensive end calais campbell has rejoined the ravens to give them some much needed depth this is the group that minter will direct and regardless of what happens offensively this unit s performance will determine how far baltimore can go in 2026 back to top three key storylines 1 can defense finally deliver a year after navigating the choppy dramatic waters that came with trey hendrickson s holdout the bengals are in a much better place defensively they invested significantly in that side of the ball adding dt jonathan allen de boye mafe s bryan cook and s kyle dugger in free agency before swinging a major trade for dt dexter lawrence on paper cincinnati has finally upgraded defensively and appears poised to chase a super bowl but we all know depth charts only matter so much the bengals defensive inadequacies have led to great frustration in the midst of a third straight playoff less season last december joe burrow openly wondered about his football future largely because he was exasperated by the frequent challenges and predictable disappointments if the d is fixed there s reason to believe these bengals can return to the postseason and embark on a deep run 2 burrow s health can joe burrow stay healthy for once while most of the blame for this team s recent struggles has been rightfully pinned on the defense burrow s lack of availability has also been a near annual problem last season a toe injury required surgery and knocked him out for nine games sending the bengals into a crisis mode that prompted them to trade for joe flacco by the time burrow returned cincinnati needed to be nearly perfect to rescue its playoff hopes an impossible goal the flawed bengals failed to reach in 2023 a similar story played out when burrow missed cincinnati s final seven games due to a season ending wrist injury as is the case with every nfl franchise the bengals title hopes ride on the quarterback s availability that will continue to be true in 2026 3 taylor under major pressure the pressure is on cincinnati s head coach a defensible case could have been made for zac taylor s dismissal after 2025 instead he emerged as the only returning coach in the afc north entering 2026 this time around the usual excuses don t exist the defense is improved and if burrow stays healthy he has the pieces necessary to produce at an elite clip if cincy doesn t live up to the lofty expectations set by burrow the blame will fall on taylor s shoulders his team must succeed in 2026 there is no alternative three key storylines 1 new era begins under monken after six seasons the browns sent kevin stefanski packing terminating a two time nfl coach of the year who produced cleveland s only playoff win since the browns returned as an expansion franchise in 1999 in the same breath owner jimmy haslam opted to retain general manager andrew berry touting the personnel chief s strong 2025 draft class and strangely the improvement of kicker andre szmyt as justification for keeping him around berry responded by compiling another draft class that has plenty of potential in 2026 and continues to rebuild the franchise after overseeing the worst decision made by a gm in the last 25 years if not longer trading three first round picks for deshaun watson who also received a fully guaranteed 230 million contract berry replaced stefanski with veteran oc todd monken who makes his head coaching debut with a team that still isn t quite stocked for legitimate contention monken s arrival seems to have breathed new life into the young browns but with results pending that s all we know about the monken era as of now the most important lesson we could learn from the browns this year might be how much patience haslam possesses because it s unlikely this team will suddenly become a contender in 2026 it s up to monken to get the most out of his players in his first season at the helm 2 serious qb questions cleveland is revamping its offensive approach which had become rather stale under stefanski with monken in charge and travis switzer serving as a first time coordinator a new scheme can t cover for a lack of reliability at quarterback though the browns appear to be laying the groundwork for watson to emerge from irrelevance and regain the starting job while 2025 fifth round pick shedeur sanders lurks in the shadows how long watson holds on to the reins is another story but unless the 30 year old pulls off a miracle and returns to his houston form browns fans can prepare for another season filled with frustration under center which might play perfectly into a plan to select a top signal caller in 2027 s loaded draft 3 how will defense look without garrett and schwartz myles garrett reset the single season sack record in 2025 which proved to be his final campaign in brown and orange berry took a massive swing when he agreed to a forward thinking trade with the rams sending garrett to los angeles in exchange for young star edge rusher jared verse and a collection of picks that includes the rams 2027 first round selection garrett s departure means the browns lose 23 sacks worth of production from last season plus a persistent concern carried by every opposing offense add in the departure of respected coordinator jim schwartz and suddenly cleveland s defense its better side in the last two challenging seasons harbors plenty of questions fortunately the browns still have some studs on that side of the ball defensive rookie of the year carson schwesinger five time pro bowl corner denzel ward verse and promising sophomore defensive tackle mason graham but they re going to need to prove the personnel is strong enough to overcome a change in sideline leadership back to top three key storylines 1 no guarantees in life post tomlin mike mccarthy is back in the nfl having returned to his beloved hometown of pittsburgh to lead a steelers team that is taking on a much different appearance than usual instead of replacing one longtime coach with a young star the steelers opted for the veteran with super bowl experience in mccarthy a move some interpreted as a ploy to convince aaron rodgers to return for a 22nd nfl season if that was indeed the plan it worked whether it bears fruit however remains to be seen mccarthy s track record of directing explosive offenses should encourage steelers fans who have grown tired of watching low ceiling units struggle to compete so too should the acquisition of veteran receiver michael pittman but much of this feels like it s held together by chicken wire at least as of now pittsburgh s backup options behind rodgers are longtime reserve mason rudolph 2025 sixth round pick will howard and 2026 third rounder drew allar if crisis strikes at qb visions of a playoff victory something the steelers haven t achieved since the 2016 campaign will evaporate ideally the mccarthy rodgers partnership evokes memories of their days in green bay that s far from a guarantee along with the steelers annual assuredness to finish at or above 500 now that mike tomlin has left the coaching ranks for a job in television 2 run game concerns pittsburgh became one of the leaders in the nfl s sudden shift toward tight end reliant sets in 2025 leaning on the likes of darnell washington pat freiermuth jonnu smith and connor heyward to beef up and bulldoze opposing defenses though smith and heyward are no longer on the roster the first round selection of arizona state ot max iheanachor should help the ground game but is the backfield good enough jaylen warren is pittsburgh s lead back while rico dowdle arrives via free agency to give the steelers an explosive weapon capable of posting a few huge days as evidenced by his 389 yard outburst in weeks 5 and 6 for carolina last season kaleb johnson however remains a question mark the iowa product averaged just 2 5 yards per carry on 28 attempts as a rookie and hasn t yet proven he can be counted on as a rugged power back pittsburgh will have the hogs to move defenses and create rushing lanes but it will be up to mccarthy to deploy his personnel properly in order to stay on schedule and remain balanced especially with the largely immobile rodgers in the lineup 3 graham to get d back on track tomlin s departure meant the arrival of a new defensive coordinator and mccarthy selected the experienced patrick graham as his new director pittsburgh s defense is paid well but hasn t lived up to expectations of late finishing 26th in total d under former dc teryl austin in 2025 graham s track record isn t a slam dunk either in his last three stops dolphins giants raiders his defenses have hovered near league average peaking at 12th in 2020 with new york and bottoming out at 30th with miami in 2019 to his credit graham found some consistency amid dysfunction in las vegas over the last three seasons guiding the raiders to two 15th place finishes in 2023 and 24 before improving slightly to 14th but 25th in scoring d in 2025 he ll have better talent in pittsburgh which means the true test of his expertise should arrive in 2026 luckily he s working under a coach with a reputation for leading potent offenses if graham can prove himself to be a worthy dc then the steelers might actually be in business back to top

news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 8 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below early window buffalo bills 36 baltimore ravens 10 cincinnati bengals 43 tennessee titans 36 ot arizona cardinals 33 dallas cowboys 30 ot detroit lions 19 minnesota vikings 15 jacksonville jaguars 42 indianapolis colts 7 las vegas raiders 38 new york jets 33 pittsburgh steelers 27 cleveland browns 6 tampa bay buccaneers 16 atlanta falcons 0 late window los angeles rams 24 los angeles chargers 9 denver broncos 28 kansas city chiefs 24 new england patriots 24 miami dolphins 19 sunday night washington commanders 27 philadelphia eagles 10 nick shook s takeaways bills let hunters loose buffalo s biggest underlying question mark was its defense a leaky unit that struggled to get stops and limit opposing offenses in what became weekly shootouts for the bills that finally changed for the better on sunday with lamar jackson exiting quickly and tyler huntley back in the lineup buffalo decided it was time to hunt the quarterback dialing up blitzes and registering pressures on half of huntley s four passes which also incidentally forced huntley out of the game due to injury once undrafted rookie joe fagnano took over the carnivorous bills saw nothing but red meat blitzing on 64 5 of their total defensive snaps logging qb pressures at a rate of 61 3 and short circuiting baltimore s offense all afternoon the ravens finished with just 144 net yards of offense scored their only touchdown via a short field earned by a broderick washington interception and couldn t piece together more than one drive of significance which ended in a 26 yard tyler loop field goal buffalo s defense made sure it wouldn t allow derrick henry to carry the ravens and denied fagnano the space to breathe overwhelming the inexperienced signal caller in a runaway win quarterback injuries decimate ravens lamar jackson s anticipated return lasted just one snap his first pass attempt fell incomplete and on the follow through to his throw jackson s thumb collided with a defender s hand resulting in an injury that will land jackson on injured reserve for the foreseeable future after a few weeks of backup turned starter duty tyler huntley found himself on the field sunday appearing skittish and struggling to gain a single yard through the air before an injury knocked him out of action as well leaving the ravens with their emergency third qb joe fagnano as their only remaining option the uconn product gave his best effort but was constantly under duress leaving the ravens with little room to move the ball all afternoon zay flowers went without a catch on five targets rashod bateman s one catch for 22 yards accounted for the most receiving production for any raven and running back justice hill led baltimore in receptions with four it was a lifeless offense that left the ravens defense on the field for far too long buffalo won the time of possession battle 37 36 to 22 24 and sunday s display should rightfully worry ravens fans about their team s outlook for the remainder of 2026 it sounds as if jackson s season could be finished and recent results without him including sunday are discouraging at best moore delivers in return after missing a handful of weeks buffalo welcomed back its prized offseason acquisition d j moore who showed no signs of hesitancy and delivered a strong outing four catches 82 yards including a spectacular grab for 49 yards to set up a james cook touchdown and a touchdown catch moore s return helped draw some attention away from buffalo s tight ends dalton kincaid finished with a team best 86 yards and a touchdown on four catches took a bit of pressure off cook and unlocked enough of the unit s attack to help the bills climb out of a grind it out start to pour it on in the second half moore s rapport with josh allen remains strong even after the time off and helped allen pass jim kelly for the franchise s all time lead in touchdowns 260 now moore will need to prove he can be this reliable on a weekly basis next gen stats insight for ravens bills via nfl pro the bills blitzed on 64 5 of opposing dropbacks against the ravens in week 8 their highest blitz rate since 2021 and the highest blitz rate ravens quarterbacks have faced this season the bills blitz rate had not exceeded 39 in any of their prior six games this season when blitzing the bills generated 11 pressures including a season high seven quick pressures under 2 5 seconds and three sacks including a strip sack fumble recovery in the second quarter nfl research josh allen and james cook each had a rushing touchdown in week 8 marking the 16th time that allen and cook have scored a rushing touchdown in the same game sixteen games breaks a tie with dak prescott and ezekiel elliott for the most games by any teammate duo in nfl history in which both players had a rushing touchdown back to top bobby kownack s takeaways burrow was everything good bad about bengals offense what a roller coaster performance by joe burrow the cincy quarterback unquestionably served as the team s hero accounting for six touchdowns in an unexpected shootout with the titans but his three interceptions contributed initially to a slow start and later allowed tennessee to stay in it two of those picks were deep heaves to ja 39 marr chase with one way overthrown and another that came up far too short if you re going to make mistakes though make sure you make up for them burrow did that and more piling on the points and feeding his top two receivers to great success tee higgins had 10 catches for 155 yards and two tds on 11 targets while chase tallied 11 receptions for 141 yards and a score on 16 looks burrow also importantly cleaned it up in crunch time of his five drives that took place in the fourth quarter or overtime one ended in a chase brown fumble and the other ticked down the final 17 seconds to the extra frame on the other three burrow marched his bengals 73 81 and 70 yards throwing two touchdowns and scoring the game winner on a 9 yard scramble he finished with 426 yards five tds and three ints on 38 of 48 passing marking his third consecutive game with at least four passing touchdowns it s a bit scary how many points the bengals put up despite four giveaways and that s all credit to burrow standout performances not enough for tennessee there was not an ounce of quit in the titans after trading away their best player defensive tackle jeffery simmons on thursday the defense still generated four takeaways the most it has had in a game this season safety amani hooker had joe burrow s number intercepting him a whopping three times while defensive end jacob martin tallied three sacks and linebacker anthony hill was relentless with 14 tackles on offense cam ward enjoyed by far his best game of the season despite being without carnell tate ward dissected cincinnati s defense with regularity going 26 of 40 for 304 yards and two touchdowns snapping a five game interception streak and nearly doubling his average of 168 4 passing yards per game he led two separate go ahead td drives in the fourth quarter plus tony pollard continued his recent resurgence rushing for 117 yards and two scores after going for 129 and three tds in week 7 his 40 yard touchdown to open the scoring will be one of the highlights of the day in his or any game with pollard breaking multiple tackles before stiff arming one bengals defender into another s path in a keystone cops sequence on the way to pay dirt of course it was still not enough for the 1 7 titans but the fight they showed was admirable regardless of the nfl s aversion to moral victories concerning trends taking shape for bengals the most important result from sunday is the bengals moving to 5 2 in a highly competitive afc north however there are some underlying issues still plaguing cincinnati the bengals found themselves trailing 13 0 for the second straight week this deficit came at the end of the first quarter unlike last week s halftime hole against the ravens and the bengals started picking it up much earlier to go into intermission with a lead but they couldn t pull away like they did in baltimore instead the titans pushed them to overtime taking advantage of a defense that forced a pair of turnovers but couldn t get enough stops to make things easy in the past three games the bengals have needed to outlast a one win titans team in overtime looked asleep for far too long facing backup quarterback tyler huntley and let a then winless dolphins squad make things uncomfortable late before that it was two straight losses those who choose optimism will point to the bengals record and their three game winning streak but venturing through a season as escape artists typically catches up down the line next gen stats insight for titans bengals via nfl pro amani hooker picked off joe burrow three times which included 15 3 expected points added across five targets in coverage the second most coverage epa by a player in a game this season hooker allowed only 12 yards in coverage on the day nfl research joe burrow became just the second quarterback in league history to have 450 plus passing yards five plus passing tds and a rushing td in a game joining norm van brocklin week 1 1951 back to top nick shook s takeaways qb change sparks comeback through nearly three quarters the cardinals were repeating the same frustrating offensive performance that had become all too familiar in recent weeks jacoby brissett was under constant pressure and resorting to throws that amounted to little more than prayers and after watching brissett take two consecutive sacks for double digit negative yardage in the third quarter coach mike lafleur had enough calling for gardner minshew to replace the battered brissett oddly enough the quarterback change coincided with a revival of the running game that depended solely on tyler allgeier after jeremiyah love left with another ankle injury and bam knight was knocked out of action due to a concussion allgeier put the team on his back rushing 11 times for 147 yards and a touchdown and repeatedly turning to the sideline oxygen tank as a means of survival minshew meanwhile created a rhythm in the passing game that the cardinals haven t enjoyed in over a month completing 17 of 23 passes for 188 yards and three touchdowns including a magnificent final touchdown drive that covered 80 yards in eight plays and 1 03 to tie the game and balancing the offense by turning to michael wilson plenty eight catches 111 yards one touchdown arizona pulled off this 23 point outburst and improbable comeback after losing love knight and receiver kendrick bourne maximizing its returns with its remaining contributors with just enough time to escape defeat it will likely prompt a quarterback change and could be a minor springboard forward for a team that was desperate for a morale boosting win like this cowboys collapse could have devastating effect dallas will look back at this game and have no choice but to admit this was its worst loss of 2026 entering the final minute of the third quarter the cowboys were in control holding a 17 3 lead that was all but guaranteed to eventually become 20 3 or larger in that moment though their defense broke down surrendering a rumbling 63 yard touchdown run to tyler allgeier the first of a few massive chunks gained by allgeier in the final 16 minutes of regulation on a 52 yard allgeier run in the fourth quarter safety caleb downs got pancaked by hjalte froholdt twice in the same play typifying arizona s sudden takeover with the image of downs tumbling across the turf like a runaway cheese wheel speeding down a hill this all happened after dallas had suffocated arizona s offense for the first 44 minutes of the game and the cardinals awakening delivered repeated violent blows to the ribcage of the cowboys defense landing a liver punch in the form of a michael wilson dependent touchdown drive to tie the game in the final six seconds of regulation a quick defensive stop and a 44 yard scoring drive in overtime sent the cowboys to the mat for good resulting in one of the most stunning outcomes of the entire nfl season this type of loss can send a team into a spiral could cost defensive coordinator christian parker his job and will undoubtedly cause cowboys fans to angrily punch the air the same problems persist they still can t beat the lowly cardinals in texas and the solutions continue to prove fleeting arizona s rebuilt backfield disintegrates but one pillar remains standing tyler allgeier s second half outburst produced a victory for the cardinals but it was even more triumphant for a workhorse who has often been left to the shadows of more recognizable running mates in atlanta and arizona the talk at the start of the season revolved around first round pick jeremiyah love and when the cardinals couldn t generate consistently on the ground love s absence was quickly blamed allgeier never quite saw the chances he needed to blossom but found himself in an unexpected moment of opportunity sunday when love and bam knight exited due to injury he could have played an average brand of football as the lone remaining runner available but that s not allgeier those who were unfamiliar with his style were reminded rudely on his 63 yard touchdown run in which he broke three tackles and followed a trio of teammates who escorted him to the goal line where he fell across it for a score while finally being brought down that touchdown made it a 17 10 game but more importantly it gave the cardinals reason to believe his ensuing 52 yarder saw hjalte froholdt get out in front and wreck caleb downs in open space setting an aggressive tone embodied by the runner benefitting from the blocking in those two plays and gardner minshew s stint as a mid game replacement the cardinals brought the fight to the cowboys refusing to lay down despite a double digit deficit and little reason to believe they d turn things around because of allgeier s toughness determination and relentless desire to produce when called upon he also caught five passes for 44 yards and an incredibly gritty touchdown reception the cardinals pulled off the stunning win and might have found a new identity in the process next gen stats insight for cardinals cowboys via nfl pro tyler including a diving int and a big late pass breakup before leaving with an injury when the defensive line is getting pressure and the secondary plays on a string it s a workable defense the issue have failed to sweep the steelers in the season series for the 35th straight season last accomplishing the feat in 1988 back to top bobby kownack s takeaways bucky puts bucs on his back handed a box score with the player names and teams redacted one would be forgiven for guessing sunday s nfc south showdown took place in 1926 rather than a century later the buccaneers ran the ball 55 times excluding kneeldowns part of a combined 83 carries by the two clubs in a bad weather game baker mayfield recorded just three pass attempts and completed none of them as tampa bay joined the 1974 bills as only the second team in the super bowl era to complete zero passes in a game and emerge victorious not only that but the bucs became the first team to win a game by 10 plus points without completing a pass since the 1945 pittsburgh steelers over the chicago cardinals so how did they pull out such an unlikely victory bucky irving his cuts were vicious and precise allowing him to weave through an atlanta defense that appeared to be on skates at times on a field flooded by rainwater he rushed for 170 yards and a touchdown on 27 carries eclipsing 100 yards in a first half for his first time as a pro and eventually setting a career high the operation also didn t slow down at all with kenneth gainwell occasionally mixing in and later on taking over to milk clock the backup back logged 25 carries for 140 yards it was a similar smashmouth formula that tampa bay used in last week s 43 13 pummeling of the panthers when mayfield only threw for 64 yards and the buccaneers have now produced three of the franchise s top 10 single game rushing outputs over the last four weeks at some point mayfield will need to air it out but it s been a remarkable run and remarkable running by tampa bay of late to reenter the nfc south race penix implodes atlanta ultimately lost for two reasons it couldn t stop bucky irving and michael penix couldn t stop giving the ball away while the bucs basically gave up trying to throw under a heavy rain that persisted for most of the contest penix accepted the challenge and promptly failed he couldn t find his targets especially during the first half spraying the ball around but not to his targets far too often he sailed one over drake london s head during atlanta s first drive into jacob parrish s hands but the corner couldn t handle it even provided that little bit of luck though he still threw three picks over the subsequent four possessions becoming the first quarterback to toss three interceptions in the first 18 minutes of a game since bailey zappe in 2023 and the first falcons qb to do it since matt ryan in 2012 penix threw his fourth int of the game after atlanta had finally found some momentum in better conditions ruining a 43 yard drive down to tampa bay s 24 yard line by leaving one behind tight end charlie woerner for zyon mccollum to collect the falcons had been averaging 31 0 points per game with penix starting which ranked behind only the bills 32 8 entering week 8 but he was a difference maker in the negative sense against tampa bay he finished 8 of 24 for 125 yards and an ugly 12 0 passer rating in a messy game like sunday s was the best thing quarterbacks can do is protect the ball he didn t and he lost miserable conditions lead to slopfest the true victor of sunday s game might have been the elements atlanta and tampa bay spent most of the day just trying to get through a torrential downpour the rain caused errors in every conceivable way there were overthrows botched snaps missed kicks fumbles and all varieties of dropped passes would be touchdowns easy pickups and interceptions there are too many examples to point to but perhaps the most emblematic football folly took place on the bucs second drive after the center quarterback exchange went wrong baker mayfield recovered the ball and improvised magnificently darting into traffic before throwing it backward to bucky irving who streaked toward the end zone and nearly made it there before jessie bates punched the ball out right at the goal line for a touchback by halftime the game had seen more fumbles five and interceptions three than completions two both teams tightened up on ball security out of half and the rain let up some toward the fourth quarter but tampa bay was able to outlast by stacking some successes despite the elements throughout the contest chase mclaughlin was money helping build a lead in the first half by going 3 of 3 on field goals of 46 34 and 42 yards alex anzalone picked off penix twice six plays apart jacob parrish made up for an earlier drop with a second quarter interception and the bucs shut out the falcons offense on third down 0 for 12 for such an ugly ugly day there will actually be a fair amount of pretty plays for todd bowles and co to rewatch next gen stats insight for falcons buccaneers via nfl pro bucky irving generated all 170 of his rushing yards against atlanta after contact the third most in a single game this season nfl research the buccaneers had a franchise record 322 rushing yards in week 8 against the falcons those 322 rushing yards are the second most by any team in a game where they had zero completions over the last 90 years behind only the 1933 boston redskins who had 420 against the giants in a 21 20 win back to top kevin patra s takeaways rams rumble over chargers in battle of l a sean mcvay s offense got off to an ugly start failing to record a first down in its first five drives the rams finally broke through with less than 90 seconds remaining in the first half on a matthew stafford 40 yard bomb to tutu atwell the home squad skated from there scoring 21 straight to blow out their sofi stadium mates the rams came out at halftime and saddled up the rushing attack after just 10 yards on the ground through two quarters blake corum and kyren williams blasted their way for 129 rushing yards and two touchdowns on 27 carries for the game corum started the second half generating chunk gains juking defenders out of their shoes he capped the drive with a 23 yard scamper to give l a a lead it wouldn t relent finding pay dirt on both sides of halftime seemed to break the chargers the successful rushing attack stabilized an offense that was stubbing its toe early after a wobbly start mcvay s squad has battled back to 500 with games against washington and arizona on tap chargers disaster season continues the chargers play poorly they also played scared jim harbaugh s winless club had multiple chances to strike an early big punch but repeatedly whiffed the chargers settled for three field goals on fourth and short situations deep in rams territory the final decision proved to be the worst facing a fourth and 2 at the rams 23 yard line with under 2 minutes left in the first half harbaugh elected to kick a field goal to go up 9 3 if the chargers went for and converted it they could have gone up double digits and perhaps burned the clock so the rams couldn t have scored late to jumpstart their offense winning teams make winning plays on winning decisions losing teams stay losing with a losing mentality speaking of mentality justin herbert s is lost in a blind wilderness the chargers qb threw a pair of ugly interceptions the type you can t believe that a 50 million player would make right to defenders herbert isn t trusting what he s seeing and isn t seeing what defenses are putting in front of him he s a mess mentally right now with little hope of digging out of the hole when the highest paid player on the team is making rookie level mistakes what can you expect from the rest of the club rams d takes advantage of herbert mistakes quentin lake jumped a first quarter justin herbert pass to the outside and scampered into chargers territory even after the offense generated just 8 yards the return was enough to give the rams an early three point lead after halftime trent mcduffie saw a pass tossed right to him in zone coverage which he returned 26 yards to set up a td that would put the game out of reach the rams stuffed the chargers run game 2 6 yards per carry and pestered herbert into mistakes in addition to two sacks and two picks the rams generated 20 qb pressures including three from defensive tackle aaron donald the rams early play keeping the chargers out of the end zone proved huge giving the offense time to figure things out without falling too far behind next gen stats insight for rams chargers via nfl pro matthew stafford averaged a time to throw of 2 38 seconds in the rams week 8 victory over the chargers his third quickest in a game since joining the rams in 2021 stafford was efficient on quick passes completing 13 of 14 passes for 94 yards and a touchdown 57 1 success rate when he held on to the ball for over 2 5 seconds he completed just four of 11 passes for 63 yards with an interception 33 3 success rate nfl research the chargers are the first team in nfl history to lose each of their first seven games of a season after winning at least 11 games in the previous season back to top nick shook s takeaways fourth quarter broncos are back denver s offensive output is slowly starting to improve bo nix completed 20 of 32 passes for 222 yards and two touchdowns took a few shots downfield and connected once with jaylen waddle for a big gain and most importantly delivered in a frantic fourth quarter comeback effort facing a goal to go situation nix ran himself into pressure when inexplicably trying to break a clean pocket but didn t let that mistake sink him he calmly executed a play action rollout later in the sequence and found fullback nate adkins for a touchdown then coolly converted the two point try by firing a bullet to waddle to make it a three point game jonah coleman later handled the rest ripping off a 51 yard gain after catching a short pass from nix to set up denver s go ahead touchdown a score that was ultimately the deciding trip to the end zone denver still finished 2 for 11 on third down and under 300 total yards of offense but when it needed to score late it found a way to get the job done in a high pressure situation the broncos will need to build off that going forward chiefs rediscover offensive mojo still fall short after being completely shut down by seattle last week kansas city was able to get back on track and produce in denver on sunday thanks to some early big plays headlined by running back emmett johnson s 73 yard touchdown reception explosive plays propelled the chiefs to a 17 13 lead before patrick mahomes pieced together a methodical 11 play 63 yard touchdown drive to take an 11 point lead late in the third quarter that score came at the end of what was the chiefs most impressive drive of the season and appeared to be enough to keep the broncos at bay until denver s fourth quarter scoring outburst moved the broncos within three points of tying the chiefs and then ahead of kansas city in the game s final two minutes in years past that would have been too much time to give mahomes and co and it nearly was again sunday but kansas city s inability to finish off its frantic two minute drill reminded us of this offense s limitations mahomes wasn t able to scramble for a touchdown instead throwing away a pass a few yards shy of the goal line and kenneth walker s hesitant third down run preceded a sequence that will live in chiefs fans memories for a while facing fourth and goal from the 1 kansas city stacked three receivers in a tight bunch set on the left sent the shotgun snap to mahomes and let the route combination work freeing rashee rice for what should have been the game winning touchdown jaylon moore s slight movement before the snap drew a false start penalty though and mahomes crumbled beneath the denver pass rush on the game s final play there were things to like from this game including kansas city s ability to compete on the road without receiving stellar production from walker 25 touches 84 scrimmage yards but the frustrating result erased the chiefs grip on first place in the afc west race instead they ll have to try to keep pace with denver the rest of the way oh and we already knew this but it was reaffirmed sunday harrison butker is marching toward unemployment his wide right miss from 54 yards loomed large in this contest and is just the latest of a growing string of misses from deep denver s defense shows cracks but holds up in biggest moment the broncos have built their 6 2 mark on the backs of their defenders who have collectively stifled opposing offenses by harassing quarterbacks relentlessly over the last month on sunday they weren t quite as effective for most of the afternoon patrick mahomes managed to lead one drive in which he repeatedly converted third downs by barely moving the ball beyond the line to gain showing flashes of what has made him a special quarterback in the post tyreek hill era in kansas city and dealing a few deflating blows to the denver defense in the process that wasn t enough to tear them down though in need of a stop denver managed to force a chiefs drive to stall in the fourth quarter leading to butker s 54 yard miss and granting the broncos a fresh opportunity to complete their comeback effort and even after letting mahomes drive the chiefs down the field rapidly in the final two minutes denver bowed up and denied the chiefs from entering the end zone in the game s final seconds as nix noted afterward the broncos have been leaning on their defense all season and they managed to prevent the opposition from gaining the one yard they needed most the fact they ended the game with a sack credited to malcolm roach but truly the product of a collective unified pass rush was fitting next gen stats insight for chiefs broncos via nfl pro on first and goal from the denver 4 yard line in the game s final minute the chiefs owned a 76 chance of winning per next gen stats win probability they did not score losing 28 24 nfl research the broncos came back to win in week 8 after trailing by 11 points in the fourth quarter against the chiefs the win was the broncos third in bo nix s career in which they came back from a double digit fourth quarter deficit to win which is the most such wins in the nfl since 2024 this was just the third game in patrick mahomes career in which the chiefs blew a double digit fourth quarter lead and the first since week 2 2021 in baltimore back to top brooke cersosimo s takeaways maye pats offense has big second half the patriots looked as if they were still feeling last week s loss to chicago in the first half of sunday s contest new england s receiving yards leader hunter henry remained drake maye s preferred option early against the dolphins catching all three of his targets for 30 yards but the veteran tight end left the game with a foot injury midway through the second quarter and never returned maye looked stumped without henry and his top three receivers a j brown ankle knee who s missing his fifth game this season romeo doubs and mack hollins both on injured reserve for the rest of the half the offense compiled less than 100 total yards and had a 13 3 deficit going into the locker room prompting too many mike vrabel eye rolls to count then came some much needed adjustments from offensive coordinator josh mcdaniels and maye after a three and out maye began stretching the field and finding the few pats receivers at his disposal to string together three straight touchdown drives that scoring avalanche opened with maye finding kyle williams on a 43 yard touchdown before maye stunned a defender when taking it in himself on an option from 2 yards out maye s third td saw him connect with demario douglas deep downfield for a 48 yard touchdown maye finished the day 16 of 20 passing for 199 yards with the three total tds it marked maye s fifth straight game with three or more total touchdowns the first time a patriots qb has done so since tom brady accomplished the feat in 10 consecutive games in 2007 despite some dicey moments early the pats appear to be back on track dormant third quarter sinks fins miami built some momentum offensively before halftime with 11 and 12 play scoring drives that gave it a 10 point lead heading into the locker room the latter was undoubtedly miami s most impressive march of the day as malik willis connected with greg dulcich caleb douglas jalen tolbert kevin coleman and finally malik washington in the end zone for a 1 yard score that s about when the fun stopped for miami as the third quarter saw it gain a piddly 13 net yards zero pass yards on eight plays credit the dolphins for trying to get out of the 11 point hole late with a nice 35 yard touchdown from willis to coleman late in the fourth quarter though a missed field goal failed two point try and an unsuccessful onside kick attempt all but sealed their fate willis finished the loss 21 of 32 passing for 211 yards two tds and an int which crazily launched off a defender s helmet at the line of scrimmage into kevin byard s hands downfield for the first time in several weeks the run game went away with ollie gordon racking up 69 yards on 19 carries 3 6 yards per attempt the game was ultimately decided by five points but it didn t feel all that close for much of the rainy second half some love for the defenses there were a handful of players on both teams that made notable plays the dolphins entered the contest with only six sacks dead last in the nfl but logged three sunday 2024 first round pick chop robinson led all players with two takedowns of drake maye while josh uche a former patriot had one miami also received solid contributions from jordyn brooks 11 total tackles jacob rodriguez eight tackles forced fumble and julius brents fumble recovery new england sacked malik willis five times in the win with gabe jacas and cory durden leading the way with 1 5 sacks apiece carlton davis nine tackles kaden elliss nine tackles 5 sacks two tfls and kevin byard int also deserve flowers for their performances next gen stats insight for patriots dolphins via nfl pro drake maye completed 16 of 20 passes for 199 yards and two tds against the dolphins in week 8 maye was perfect on throws of more than 10 air yards completing all five attempts for 149 yards and both of his touchdowns since week 4 maye has thrown six deep 20 air yards touchdown passes without an interception the most deep touchdowns in the nfl over that span nfl research with sunday s win over the miami dolphins patriots head coach mike vrabel is 13 4 in his career in games with eight or more days of rest back to top grant gordon s takeaways daniels gets long awaited win in a battle of attrition for the commanders eagles and those tuned in washington and jayden daniels emerged as survivors and victors there were zero style points but daniels and co rallied from a 10 point deficit in the first quarter as the quarterback stunningly earned his first win since oct 5 2025 battling through injuries in this season and the last daniels had gone 0 7 1 over his last eight starts with washington this one is unlikely to be a triumph he ll put on a highlight reel as the commanders and eagles entered sunday night on a combined eight game winless streak the product was emblematic of the teams travails for the most part daniels however largely avoided big mistakes throwing for 217 yards and an 8 yard touchdown pass to stefon diggs that led to a 10 all score in the second quarter and was part of a 27 0 run for washington daniels and washington have been desperate for a win at 2 4 1 the commanders are still within flailing distance of the nfc east s top spot though that s hard to fathom with the showing regardless dan quinn daniels and the commanders have something to celebrate at the expense of a division rival that is dealing with harder times eagles endure another ugly loss after 10 points and nearly 15 minutes of game time things looked sunny for philadelphia for the first time in a long time the eagles hadn t laid claim to a double digit lead since week 4 unfortunately during a trying season for the eagles in which injuries have taken hold they lost their sixth in a row for the first time in nick sirianni s tenure as a banged up saquon barkley was limited and fill in starter tanner mckee was bamboozled by washington pressure held scoreless following a 3 yard touchdown run by barkley with 4 27 to go in the first quarter the eagles mustered just 268 yards of offense the running game was held to 91 yards and mckee couldn t hold up against the commanders pressure washington racked up a season best five sacks as mckee was pressured 20 times 46 5 pressure rate and it seemed as though he was under duress far more than that despite a roster completely hobbled by injuries this was a winnable game for the eagles but mckee and the offense simply had no answers emblematic of the struggles was philadelphia s best drive of the second half a 15 play odyssey that took up 7 35 it ended with a jake elliott 41 yard field goal attempt clanging off the upright following back to back 5 yard penalties eight games into the season and residing in an nfc east that s hardly a heavyweight division it s still arduous to believe the eagles season isn t done washington wins in trenches in week 7 the eagles defense was shockingly held to six qb pressures no sacks and no tackles for loss in a setback against the cowboys the stats weren t so damning in this one but it still wasn t where it should be credit to the commanders offensive line for that guard samuel cosmi more than held his own against jalen carter carter had one of the eagles two sacks and it came versus cosmi but overall cosmi won this battle allowing the sack and one pressure in 19 matchups including 12 one on ones the pressure and the sack allowed to carter were cosmi s only blemishes in 33 pass block snaps former first round pick josh conerly and center lucas patrick also had commendable showings next gen stats insight for eagles commanders via nfl pro washington generated pressure on 46 5 of dropbacks against philadelphia a season high mark ten pressures and a sack came on 12 blitzes 83 3 the second highest pressure rate by any defense in a game this season minimum five blitzes nfl research the eagles have lost six straight games for the first time since 2012 when philadelphia lost eight in a row from weeks 5 13 it was also the eagles third loss in a row versus an nfc east opponent the first time they ve done so since weeks 9 11 in 2005 philadelphia s 2 6 start is its worst since 1999 andy reid s first year at the helm back to top

news_mentions.headline: Notable injuries, news from Sunday's Week 7 games: Giants' Tyrone Tracy Jr. injures  hamstring
news_mentions.description: Here are the injuries and news developments we're monitoring around the league on this Week 7 Sunday.
news_mentions.body_text: here are the injuries and news developments we re monitoring around the league on this week 7 sunday baltimore ravens guard olaivavega ioane knee was ruled out of sunday s loss to cincinnati carolina panthers offensive tackle taylor moton suffered a fractured fibula in sunday s loss to tampa bay and will be out for a while head coach dave canales said cincinnati bengals tight end erick all knee and safety kyle dugger quadricep were ruled out of sunday s win over baltimore cleveland browns cornerback myles harden hamstring did not return to sunday s win over tennessee detroit lions cornerback ennis rakestraw ankle did not return to sunday s win over the packers green bay packers center sean rhyan ankle and offensive lineman jacob monk quad did not return to sunday s loss to the lions houston texans wide receiver jaylin noel has a turf toe injury head coach demeco ryans told reporters after sunday s loss to the giants las vegas raiders defensive end patrick johnson stinger neck did not return to sunday s loss to the rams miami dolphins cornerback julius brents stinger did not return to sunday s win over the jets minnesota vikings running back aaron jones knee did not return to sunday s win over indianapolis new orleans saints safety justin reid concussion and running back cj donaldson shoulder were ruled out of sunday s loss to pittsburgh in paris new york giants running back tyrone tracy hamstring did not return to sunday s win over houston running back cam skattebo said after the game that he felt something in his hamstring on his 42 yard run in overtime skattebo added that he did not slide on purpose on the play per espn new york jets defensive tackle t 39 vondre sweat knee was ruled out of sunday s loss to miami seattle seahawks wide receiver rashid shaheed knee was ruled out against the chiefs rb velus jones hamstring was also ruled out
