news_mentions.headline: NFC South training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Buccaneers, Falcons, Panthers, Saints
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Nick Shook breaks down the top NFC South training camp storylines to monitor for the Atlanta Falcons, Carolina Panthers, New Orleans Saints and Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams nick shook has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the atlanta falcons carolina panthers new orleans saints and tampa bay buccaneers catch up on each nfc south team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below atlanta falcons carolina panthers new orleans saints tampa bay buccaneers three key storylines 1 stefanski era begins despite a strong finish to the 2025 season the falcons dismissed raheem morris in january and replaced him with another recently fired head man in kevin stefanski shifting the organizational focus from a defensive minded coach to one with extensive experience on the other side of the ball amid the coaching change stefanski wisely chose to retain defensive coordinator jeff ulbrich attempting to maintain a sense of continuity for a unit that was the team s strength last year now the responsibility of pushing the falcons out of the 500 range falls on the shoulders of stefanski a coach with a point to prove after being unceremoniously dumped by the browns he s had success two playoff appearances a postseason win and two coach of the year awards but nothing would be sweeter to stefanski than immediately leading atlanta to the playoffs in his first season at the helm he ll need to produce results fairly quickly too given the falcons expectation of competing after consecutive 8 9 finishes 2 all eyes on the quarterbacks much of stefanski s first year success will depend on the quarterback situation tua tagovailoa hopped on board after he was cut by the dolphins bringing experience to a room that could use it while also providing the falcons with a second left handed quarterback tagovailoa might need to handle the starting duties early in the season too depending on how quickly michael penix can return from the season ending knee injury suffered in 2025 that dynamic could create its own intrigue or perhaps controversy if tagovailoa excels the fit makes sense too stefanski s wide zone rushing attack has traditionally paired with a timing based passing game the scheme that best matches tagovailoa s strengths with two options under center an optimist will say the falcons are in an advantageous position others will note two options usually means no answer at quarterback that is unless penix returns and gets back on track atlanta s former top 10 pick still needs to prove he s worth that draft status and year 3 is typically the pivotal season his progress or lack thereof will heavily influence the trajectory of this team in 2026 3 ulbrich s new look defense atlanta s defense has its work cut out the 2025 falcons improved to 15th in yards allowed per game and 19th in scoring d while finishing second in sacks numbers that suggest there s reason to feel encouraged entering 2026 plenty of departures have followed though leading tackler kaden elliss left for new orleans veteran arnold ebiketie departed for philadelphia david onyemata signed with the jets and dee alford joined the bills leading sack artist and 2025 first round pick james pearce returns but his status remains uncertain after he was arrested and subsequently entered a pretrial intervention program to resolve three felony charges during the offseason the nfl has yet to determine pearce s fate in 2026 but if he misses significant time the combined absences could be enough to sink the unit atlanta responded by adding linebacker christian harris and defensive tackle maason smith as projected starters and also signed da 39 shawn hand and samson ebukam as key rotational players preventing ulbrich from returning to an empty cupboard still the challenge exists fortunately atlanta s very strong in the secondary with the safety duo of jessie bates and xavier watts flanked by stout cover man a j terrell and in april the franchise spent a second round pick on a j s brother avieon terrell giving the defensive backfield another versatile piece if nickelback billy bowman can bounce back from an achilles tear that abruptly ended his promising rookie campaign last november the falcons are quite well equipped to handle opposing aerial attacks still following an offseason with notable roster churn the defense will need to jell quickly in order for atlanta to start off on the right foot back to top three key storylines 1 crunch time for young three seasons into his nfl career bryce young hasn t quite produced enough hard evidence to prove he s a franchise quarterback carolina s leadership will suggest otherwise publicly in late april general manager dan morgan said we really feel like the arrow is up with bryce but that sentiment will change quickly if young regresses in year 4 in 2025 he showed signs of blossoming but wasn t consistent in 2026 he needs to become more reliable on a weekly basis an outcome that should be more likely after another offseason spent under coach dave canales if this is young s breakout season the panthers will happily start discussing a long term extension with the former no 1 overall pick but even if they don t say it publicly they still need to be convinced young is headed in such a direction otherwise the fifth year of his deal could spell the beginning of a transition 2 upgrades in key defensive spots the panthers defense received some much needed offseason love it s only right that a former linebacker morgan spent much of his team s resources upgrading that side of the ball after fielding a middling unit in 2025 carolina should be better in the front seven thanks to the additions of edge rusher jaelan phillips signed for a four year 120 million deal linebacker devin lloyd three years 45 million and defensive tackle lee hunter a second round pick who has the potential to become an ideal run stuffing complement to derrick brown it s not a full scale overhaul because carolina didn t need one rather it was a measured reinforcement of a unit that will aim to improve especially in the pass rushing department if young can take a step or two forward and the panthers can evolve into a stronger more balanced team they ll be well positioned to defend their nfc south crown 3 backfield depth backfield questions linger in charlotte where the panthers benefited from a one year deal with rico dowdle in 2025 then watched him walk to pittsburgh in free agency their current running back situation is once again headlined by chuba hubbard who has eclipsed 1 000 yards once in five nfl seasons while averaging 4 1 yards per carry much of this position group depends on whether 2024 second rounder jonathon brooks who has played three games in his first two seasons due to two acl tears can prove he s healthy enough to contribute carolina attempted to build in some insurance by signing veteran aj dillon but his own injury history and minimal usage in philadelphia in 2025 make for an uncertain outlook trevor etienne also returns for his second season after spending most of his rookie snaps on special teams in total the picture appears unsure if not incomplete that can change if brooks contributes but that s a big question mark for a team expecting to contend for a division title back to top three key storylines 1 can shough build on promising finish tyler shough s late season rise inspired an offseason of optimism in the big easy where the saints larger vision became at least partially visible by the end of the 2025 campaign as new orleans closed the year with four wins in its final five games shough emerged as a promising quarterback with the potential to become a franchise signal caller under coach kellen moore perhaps quicker than most anyone expected now with a full offseason as qb1 under his belt shough enters year 2 with heightened expectations at 26 he s already older than the average sophomore starter and is paired with a former quarterback in moore who has demonstrated his ability to guide offenses toward fruitful futures both in dallas and philadelphia now moore is equipped with a quarterback he can mold a passer who appears wiser and more capable than the average second year starter thanks in part to his extensive collegiate experience there s legitimate reason to think the saints have already answered the most challenging question that comes with a rebuild now it s about proving those optimists right by continuing to build on the progress shough made as a rookie 2 new offensive weapons moore has some new toys in his offense upon the start of free agency new orleans quickly scooped up running back travis etienne giving the saints a much needed successor to alvin kamara with a similar three down skill set kamara is still on the roster too providing new orleans with some depth in a room that also includes kendre miller and devin neal the receiver position welcomed a prestigious addition too when the saints followed their hearts and selected arizona state star jordyn tyson at no 8 overall adding to an intriguing receiver room that includes chris olave and devaughn vele as has long been the case in new orleans health will be paramount for this club tyson and olave have a history of missing time due to injury and kamara played in a career low 11 games last season beyond olave tyson and vele the saints lack reliable depth at wr two more rookies bryce lance and barion brown are slated to compete for spots among a group that also includes trey palmer kevin austin and ja 39 lynn polk if they can keep their best healthy the saints could surprise some folks but as we ve learned in recent years that s far from guaranteed 3 jordan s last dance cam jordan is back for one final season after an offseason mostly spent unsigned the saints legend ultimately re upped on a one year deal in june signing up for one last run with the team he s helped define since entering the league as a first round pick back in 2011 with that comes a message to the rest of this ascending squad there s no time to waste jordan and chase young comprised a potent edge rushing duo in 2025 with each hitting double digit sacks with playmakers at all three levels the saints defense is ready to match its ninth place finish from 2025 it ll have a little extra to play for in 2026 too back to top three key storylines 1 mayfield entering pivotal season baker mayfield has enjoyed a career renaissance in florida over the last three seasons earning a three year 100 million deal with the team after a strong 2023 campaign and largely living up to the standards that come with such a contract when viewed from a league wide perspective baker deserves his spot and shouldn t worry about his future in tampa but those who have followed this team closely also understand that mayfield is a streaky player he s electrifying when at his best and can propel the buccaneers toward great success but he also struggles to get out of his own way at times in 2025 mayfield started white hot leading tampa bay to a 6 2 start and pushing the team into the national conversation as a possible super bowl contender then injuries struck sending mayfield into a stretch of struggles that coincided with roster losses elsewhere and resulted in a pile of defeats and a postseason spent at home for the first time since 2022 he finished with fewer than 4 000 passing yards instead of watching his offensive coordinator land a head coaching job elsewhere thanks in part to his successes as dave canales and liam coen had done before his play caller was fired now mayfield enters a contract year with a hard negotiating deadline the start of training camp without his favorite target mike evans who left for san francisco and with fresh questions to answer should things go well mayfield will remain the bucs franchise quarterback for the foreseeable future but if he encounters more struggles it could cost him millions and inspire changes beyond his control that drastically change the landscape in tampa 2 bowles seat is warm near the end of a frustrating somewhat inexplicable collapse in 2025 plenty of folks expected the buccaneers to move on from todd bowles and start fresh with a new coach that didn t happen of course and bowles is back to justify the organization s support in 2026 if the bucs struggle like they did last season with bowles defense finishing 20th in points allowed he ll likely be out of a job and tampa bay will be facing a potentially significant shift in identity for the first time since tom brady arrived in 2020 some thought it s precisely what the buccaneers needed after 2025 and pointed toward evans departure as proof that things weren t right at one buc place the team will have to embark on the new campaign without two franchise legends in evans and linebacker lavonte david who retired after 14 seasons another concerning sign about tampa s trajectory it will be up to bowles to prove the concerns are overblown 3 does tampa have enough on defense to win despite being led by a defensive minded head coach bowles buccaneers became an offense first team over the last few seasons as mayfield powered an explosive attack bowles units proved average at best finishing 23rd 18th and 19th in total yards allowed over the last three seasons the bucs haven t landed inside the top 10 since 2022 bowles first season as head coach entering 2026 the bucs seem to have an assortment of pieces that could form an improved defense the team wisely spent its first round pick on miami edge rusher rueben bain supplying bowles with a legitimate threat at the edge position opposite yaya diaby for the first time since the final few years of shaq barrett s career which ended with a one game campaign in 2024 tampa bay s secondary should benefit from another year of development for benjamin morrison jacob parrish and tykee smith but as of now it remains a unit carried by antoine winfield linebacker includes some questions too after david s retirement free agent addition alex anzalone arrives to great expectations and veteran christian rozeboom also entered the fray furthermore tampa spent its second round pick on lb josiah trotter with bowles in charge this defense could very well exceed expectations it could also determine the team s fate and the security of its coach s employment back to top

news_mentions.headline: NFL Week 8 Sunday aftermath: Ravens' season on the brink; can Vikings trust Kyler Murray?
news_mentions.description: Kevin Patra breaks down Sunday's Week 8 action in the latest edition of The Aftermath. Is the Ravens' season on the brink of collapse? Can the Vikings trust Kyler Murray?
news_mentions.body_text: now that it s november the playoff picture is starting to emerge and week 8 featured a number of key divisional matchups that could have lasting effects on the rest of the season the broncos and steelers notched revenge wins over the chiefs and browns respectively the lions asserted themselves in the uber tough nfc north while the jaguars handed the colts a potentially fatal blow in a season cratering toward disaster let s examine some key storylines in sunday s aftermath including another concerning loss for schottenheimer s boys minnesota s qb issues rear their ugly head in detroit buccaneers lean on run game in historic win broncos take over driver s seat in afc west race burrow channels norm van brocklin against tennessee but first we start with lamar jackson suffering a potential season ending injury and where the ravens go from here ravens season on the brink after jackson injury the baltimore ravens find themselves in quite the quandary lamar jackson s return was supposed to buoy a club coming off back to back divisional defeats it lasted one play on sunday in buffalo jackson s right thumb injury which will require surgery leaves the 4 4 ravens floundering in the afc north cellar before we hit thanksgiving jesse minter told reporters after the 36 10 loss to buffalo that jackson will be placed on injured reserve knocking him out for at least four games asked if the setback ultimately could end jackson s season the ravens first year head coach admitted that it s possible potentially but we ll see where it s at minter said without the two time mvp qb the ravens offense is clipped baltimore is 7 14 in games in which jackson has not started since 2019 averaging just 17 6 points in 2026 the team has scored six touchdowns in the 18 quarters jackson has missed jackson s latest injury shrouds his future in baltimore we ll have plenty of time to delve into the contract situation later right now the focus is on how the ravens survive it would be bad enough if jackson s thumb issue were baltimore s only qb injury but backup tyler huntley also exited sunday s game and didn t return espn reported that huntley suffered a possible turf toe injury and will undergo an mri on monday to determine how much time if any he could miss undrafted rookie third stringer joe fagnano battled against the bills but given the situation trying to keep up with josh allen on the road with no prep time he performed as expected completing 10 of his 21 pass attempts for 91 yards with a pick and three sacks taken the ravens are in a rough spot with a short week before thursday night s game against the rolling jaguars even if huntley doesn t miss much time is it worth baltimore trading for a qb ahead of the nov 10 deadline would shelling out more assets in a potentially lost season be wise let s rip through some of the potential qb options for the ravens if they decide to go the trade route tyson bagent the bears qb2 struggled in his last outing against green bay in week 5 and was eventually benched for case keenum but his familiarity with declan doyle would benefit baltimore considered one of the league s better backups by many bagent could be a long term play for the ravens i have my doubts about if the bears would be willing to part with their no 2 but such a move could help recoup some of the trade capital sent away in last week s jeffery simmons deal the cost to pry bagent away from chicago could prove prohibitive for a ravens team on the brink jacoby brissett benched in favor of gardner minshew during the cardinals stirring comeback win over dallas on sunday brissett has experience while inconsistencies have plagued him this season in arizona he is a professional qb who could pick up the offense quickly editor s update on monday mike lafleur named minshew as the cardinals starter moving forward shedeur sanders cleveland has insisted that it has no intention of trading sanders but coach todd monken hasn t seemed to be in the former colorado quarterback s corner at any point in the process sanders has his warts but he could bring more pop to the ravens offense than huntley or fagnano the browns shipped joe flacco to cincinnati last year so intra division trades can t be ruled out we know the browns brass will take a pick if it makes sense kirk cousins i don t think the raiders would trade him while they re still in contention at 4 4 if they were willing to the cost would probably be prohibitive however for the next week any qb trade list should at least mention the veteran playing at a high level in front of no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza two non trade options easton stick currently on the tampa bay buccaneers practice squad stick was in l a in 2024 with minter so at least there would be some familiarity jimmy garoppolo the veteran hasn t officially retired if he wants a shot to play again baltimore could be his last best chance cowboys collapse in stunning loss credit gardner minshew for bringing the mania once again credit tyler allgeier for gashing the cowboys defense and powering the cards back into the game credit michael wilson for continuing to do his best puka nacua impression credit the cardinals defense for forcing field goals late and getting a three and out in overtime credit mike lafleur s club for not quitting when quitting could have been easy and credit the first year coach for being willing to make a second half qb change in the heat of the moment credit the cards but let s be real this was an epic collapse for which dallas should be crushed brian schottenheimer s club held a 24 10 fourth quarter lead before disintegrating like walter donovan drinking from the wrong chalice he chose poorly could be the title of every cowboys move on sunday a confluence of ineptitude caused dallas to collapse at home to drop to 3 5 on the season the defense became a sieve in the fourth quarter and couldn t tackle i understand that the cowboys had some injuries but letting allgeier look like jim brown is not a product of a few missing players the secondary inexplicably got burned late when all the cowboys needed to do was keep everything in front of them frankly arizona could have scored quicker in the fourth quarter if not for a few misses the defensive breakdowns continue to perplex dallas this season the offense also did its part in the collapse stalling out inside the red zone early then failing to get a first down after the cardinals failed on the onside kick an explosive offense should be able to move the chains to secure a victory then there was the depressing three and out to begin overtime dallas got outgained in yardage 467 261 on sunday that should not happen despite the latest example of schottenheimer s teams playing below their talent jerry jones stuck by his coach after the game that s not in my mind at this time jones said when asked about a potential coaching change per espn com a lot of people let brian down today and so for whatever criticism we want to have of brian we can all get in line the line for blame in dallas is long it starts at the top vikings qb problems can t be brushed aside brian flores defense had done the heavy lifting to build minnesota s 6 0 start but sunday s divisional loss to the lions showed that the ferocious unit can t do it alone detroit went big and ran over the vikings in the second half wearing down the stout defense to the tune of 164 rushing yards after halftime by the end flores group was gassed and couldn t stop jahmyr gibbs and the lions from grinding out the w if the vikings offense had any semblance of consistency the end game scenario would have played out much differently kyler murray continues to struggle with his consistency despite facing the worst passing defense in the nfl on sunday he couldn t keep the vikings on the field he sailed more than a few balls way too high never seemed comfortable and rarely moved the chains on nine third down throws he completed four three went for first downs murray connected on some deep balls and averaged 11 2 air yards per attempt the second highest mark of his career but he also missed a host of shots per next gen stats on downfield attempts 10 plus air yards murray threw for a season high 115 yards despite only completing four of his 13 attempts 30 8 his lowest downfield completion rate in a game since 2023 min 10 downfield attempts the inability to keep the chains moving sits in stark contrast to the best offenses under kevin o connell we ll see if koc pulls the plug and gives carson wentz a shot at least we know he ll force feed justin jefferson if the struggles persist the j j mccarthy trade probably needed to happen but seeing the 2024 first rounder look like a different qb in new york while murray struggles has to sting minnesota with a tough trio of games on tap vs buffalo 6 1 at green bay 5 3 and against san francisco 6 1 in mexico city the vikings must get more production from the qb position or they ll see their once strong nfc north lead evaporate editor s update on monday after publishing kevin o connell said kyler murray is dealing with hamstring tightness is the bucs offense sustainable the monsoon in tampa fla dictated the run heavy approach from zac robinson s offense but even in pristine weather the buccaneers would have leaned on the ground game the slop tipped the scales even harder with baker mayfield attempting just three passes all falling incomplete in the 16 0 win we knew it was going to be a nasty day and what kind of conditions it was going to be bucs coach todd bowles said we were worried about ball security and we took care of it other than the fumble in the end zone bowles added i didn t say we were not going to throw the ball the conditions told robinson that you could see it it s a downpour and the wind was blowing you can kind of see the ball wasn t going anywhere tampa became just the second team in the super bowl era to have zero completed passes in a single game joining the 1974 bills who did so in a win over the jets per nfl research three of the four teams to not have a completion in a game since 1950 have gone on to win including the buccaneers on sunday they are the first team to win by 10 points without completing a pass since the 1945 pittsburgh steelers beat the chicago cardinals the ground game has gotten the bucs back in the nfc south race in week 7 against carolina tampa bay rushed for 258 yards while mayfield attempted just 11 passes completing seven for 64 yards and a td bucky irving has been sensational making defenders miss and has the pop to turn those broken tackles into big runs all 170 of irving s rushing yards came after contact on sunday per next gen stats one of the more inexplicable issues with the bucs early struggles when they started 1 5 was the offensive line s play the veteran crew missed far too many blocks and committed too many penalties over the last couple weeks the group has gotten back on track by smashing defenses in the face tampa s rushing attack is absolutely replicable i expect irving to keep motoring through defenses slithering through holes and ripping chunk gains that said it s 2026 at some point mayfield will be asked to win a game through the air with the bears and lions on tap in weeks 9 and 11 the bucs will have to keep pace with higher powered offenses after thumping two division rivals though tampa is back on track in a moribund division and the bucs feel like the most stable nfc south club as we head into the second half of the season broncos take command in afc west race it s not pretty but who cares when you stack a w bo nix earned his 15th career game winning drive in denver s 28 24 win over kansas city on sunday breaking a tie with dak prescott for the most such drives in a player s first three seasons since at least 1950 according to nfl research the broncos came back to win after trailing the rival chiefs by 11 points in the fourth quarter it marked the third victory in nix s career in which denver erased a fourth quarter deficit of 10 points the most such wins in the nfl since 2024 conversely sunday marked the third game in patrick mahomes career in which the chiefs blew a fourth quarter lead of 10 points and the first since over five years ago in week 2 of 2021 at the ravens harrison butker s missed fourth quarter field goal opened the door for denver and nix immediately cashed in hitting running back jonah coleman for a 51 yard catch and run to set up the go ahead 5 yard td the 15 point fourth quarter explosion came after nix and the offense once again struggled to stay on the field denver went three and out on three third quarter drives entering the final frame the home fans were frustrated then boom big plays galore and the broncos not only escaped with a win but took control of the afc west race the big plays included a massive goal line stand by the denver defense which held the chiefs out of the end zone in the game s final seconds after they got a first and goal at the 4 the sequence was aided by a k c false start but a denver d that once again missed too many tackles ultimately stood tall when needed with malcolm roach taking down mahomes for the game ending sack it was ball out or go home edge rusher que robinson said of the dramatic finish via the denver post and we weren t going home without that dub the loss stings k c which could have taken complete control of the division race with a sweep over the broncos denver 6 2 has now won four straight while the chiefs 5 2 have lost back to back games after taking advantage of a soft early slate andy reid s trust in butker came back to bite him according to the next gen stats fourth down decision guide with kansas city leading 24 21 and facing fourth and 8 from the broncos 36 yard line with 2 36 remaining a punt would have given the chiefs the highest win probability 74 3 1 8 percentage points ahead of going for it 72 5 while a field goal attempt ranked last 71 5 reid elected for the fg butker missed the 54 yard attempt giving the ball back to the broncos who scored two plays later sometimes analytics does suggest punting week 8 sunday spotlight

window buffalo bills 36 baltimore ravens 10 cincinnati bengals 43 tennessee titans 36 ot arizona cardinals 33 dallas cowboys 30 ot detroit lions 19 minnesota vikings 15 jacksonville jaguars 42 denver broncos 28 kansas city chiefs 24 new england patriots 24 miami dolphins 19 sunday night washington commanders 27 philadelphia eagles 10 nick shook s takeaways bills let hunters loose buffalo s biggest underlying question mark was its defense a leaky unit that struggled to get stops and limit opposing offenses in what became weekly shootouts for the bills that finally changed for the better on sunday with lamar jackson exiting quickly and tyler huntley back in the lineup buffalo decided it was time to hunt the quarterback dialing up blitzes and registering pressures on half of huntley s four passes which also incidentally forced huntley out of the game due to injury once undrafted rookie joe fagnano took over the carnivorous bills saw nothing but red meat blitzing on 64 5 of their total defensive snaps logging qb pressures at a rate of 61 3 and short circuiting baltimore s offense all afternoon the ravens finished with just 144 net yards of offense scored their only touchdown via a short field earned by a broderick washington interception and couldn t piece together more than one drive of significance which ended in a 26 yard tyler loop field goal buffalo s defense made sure it wouldn t allow derrick henry to carry the ravens and denied fagnano the space to breathe overwhelming the inexperienced signal caller in a runaway win quarterback injuries decimate ravens lamar jackson s anticipated return lasted just one snap his first pass attempt fell incomplete and on the follow through to his throw jackson s thumb collided with a defender s hand resulting in an injury that will land jackson on injured reserve for the foreseeable future after a few weeks of backup turned starter duty tyler huntley found himself on the field sunday appearing skittish and struggling to gain a single yard through the air before an injury knocked him out of action as well leaving the ravens with their emergency third qb joe fagnano as their only remaining option the uconn product gave his best effort but was constantly under duress leaving the ravens with little room to move the ball all afternoon zay flowers went without a catch on five targets rashod bateman s one catch for 22 yards accounted for the most receiving production for any raven and running back justice hill led baltimore in receptions with four it was a lifeless offense that left the ravens defense on the field for far too long buffalo won the time of possession battle 37 36 to 22 24 and sunday s display should rightfully worry ravens fans about their team s outlook for the remainder of 2026 it sounds as if jackson s season could be finished and recent results without him including sunday are discouraging at best moore delivers in return after missing a handful of weeks buffalo welcomed back its prized offseason acquisition d j moore who showed no signs of hesitancy and delivered a strong outing four catches 82 yards including a spectacular grab for 49 yards to set up a james cook touchdown and a touchdown catch moore s return helped draw some attention away from buffalo s tight ends dalton kincaid finished with a team best 86 yards and a touchdown on four catches took a bit of pressure off cook and unlocked enough of the unit s attack to help the bills climb out of a grind it out start to pour it on in the second half moore s rapport with josh allen remains strong even after the time off and helped allen pass jim kelly for the franchise s all time lead in touchdowns 260 now moore will need to prove he can be this reliable on a weekly basis next gen stats insight for ravens bills via nfl pro the bills blitzed on 64 5 of opposing dropbacks against the ravens in week 8 their highest blitz rate since 2021 and the highest blitz rate ravens quarterbacks have faced this season the bills blitz rate had not exceeded 39 in any of their prior six games this season when blitzing the bills generated 11 pressures including a season high seven quick pressures under 2 5 seconds and three sacks including a strip sack fumble recovery in the second quarter nfl research josh allen and james cook each had a rushing touchdown in week 8 marking the 16th time that allen and cook have scored a rushing touchdown in the same game sixteen games breaks a tie with dak prescott and ezekiel elliott for the most games by any teammate duo in nfl history in which both players had a rushing touchdown back to top bobby kownack s takeaways burrow was everything good bad about bengals offense what a roller coaster performance by joe burrow the cincy quarterback unquestionably served as the team s hero accounting for six touchdowns in an unexpected shootout with the titans but his three interceptions contributed initially to a slow start and later allowed tennessee to stay in it two of those picks were deep heaves to ja 39 marr chase with one way overthrown and another that came up far too short if you re going to make mistakes though make sure you make up for them burrow did that and more piling on the points and feeding his top two receivers to great success tee higgins had 10 catches for 155 yards and two tds on 11 targets while chase tallied 11 receptions for 141 yards and a score on 16 looks burrow also importantly cleaned it up in crunch time of his five drives that took place in the fourth quarter or overtime one ended in a chase brown fumble and the other ticked down the final 17 seconds to the extra frame on the other three burrow marched his bengals 73 81 and 70 yards throwing two touchdowns and scoring the game winner on a 9 yard scramble he finished with 426 yards five tds and three ints on 38 of 48 passing marking his third consecutive game with at least four passing touchdowns it s a bit scary how many points the bengals put up despite four giveaways and that s all credit to burrow standout performances not enough for tennessee there was not an ounce of quit in the titans after trading away their best player defensive tackle jeffery simmons on thursday the defense still generated four takeaways the most it has had in a game this season safety amani hooker had joe burrow s number intercepting him a whopping three times while defensive end jacob martin tallied three sacks and linebacker anthony hill was relentless with 14 tackles on offense cam ward enjoyed by far his best game of the season despite being without carnell tate ward dissected cincinnati s defense with regularity going 26 of 40 for 304 yards and two touchdowns snapping a five game interception streak and nearly doubling his average of 168 4 passing yards per game he led two separate go ahead td drives in the fourth quarter plus tony pollard continued his recent resurgence rushing for 117 yards and two scores after going for 129 and three tds in week 7 his 40 yard touchdown to open the scoring will be one of the highlights of the day in his or any game with pollard breaking multiple tackles before stiff arming one bengals defender into another s path in a keystone cops sequence on the way to pay dirt of course it was still not enough for the 1 7 titans but the fight they showed was admirable regardless of the nfl s aversion to moral victories concerning trends taking shape for bengals the most important result from sunday is the bengals moving to 5 2 in a highly competitive afc north however there are some underlying issues still plaguing cincinnati the bengals found themselves trailing 13 0 for the second straight week this deficit came at the end of the first quarter unlike last week s halftime hole against the ravens and the bengals started picking it up much earlier to go into intermission with a lead but they couldn t pull away like they did in baltimore instead the titans pushed them to overtime taking advantage of a defense that forced a pair of turnovers but couldn t get enough stops to make things easy in the past three games the bengals have needed to outlast a one win titans team in overtime looked asleep for far too long facing backup quarterback tyler huntley and let a then winless dolphins squad make things uncomfortable late before that it was two straight losses those who choose optimism will point to the bengals record and their three game winning streak but venturing through a season as escape artists typically catches up down the line next gen stats insight for titans bengals via nfl pro amani hooker picked off joe burrow three times which included 15 3 expected points added across five targets in coverage the second most coverage epa by a player in a game this season hooker allowed only 12 yards in coverage on the day nfl research joe burrow became just the second quarterback in league history to have 450 plus passing yards five plus passing tds and a rushing td in a game joining norm van brocklin week 1 1951 back to top nick shook s takeaways qb change sparks comeback through nearly three quarters the cardinals were repeating the same frustrating offensive performance that had become all too familiar in recent weeks jacoby brissett was under constant pressure and resorting to throws that amounted to little more than prayers and after watching brissett take two consecutive sacks for double digit negative yardage in the third quarter coach mike lafleur had enough calling for gardner minshew to replace the battered brissett oddly enough the quarterback change coincided with a revival of the running game that depended solely on tyler allgeier after jeremiyah love left with another ankle injury and bam knight was knocked out of action due to a concussion allgeier put the team on his back rushing 11 times for 147 yards and a touchdown and repeatedly turning to the sideline oxygen tank as a means of survival minshew meanwhile created a rhythm in the passing game that the cardinals haven t enjoyed in over a month completing 17 of 23 passes for 188 yards and three touchdowns including a magnificent final touchdown drive that covered 80 yards in eight plays and 1 03 to tie the game and balancing the offense by turning to michael wilson plenty eight catches 111 yards one touchdown arizona pulled off this 23 point outburst and improbable comeback after losing love knight and receiver kendrick bourne maximizing its returns with its remaining contributors with just enough time to escape defeat it will likely prompt a quarterback change and could be a minor springboard forward for a team that was desperate for a morale boosting win like this cowboys collapse could have devastating effect dallas will look back at this game and have no choice but to admit this was its worst loss of 2026 entering the final minute of the third quarter the cowboys were in control holding a 17 3 lead that was all but guaranteed to eventually become 20 3 or larger in that moment though their defense broke down surrendering a rumbling 63 yard touchdown run to tyler allgeier the first of a few massive chunks gained by allgeier in the final 16 minutes of regulation on a 52 yard allgeier run in the fourth quarter safety caleb downs got pancaked by hjalte froholdt twice in the same play typifying arizona s sudden takeover with the image of downs tumbling across the turf like a runaway cheese wheel speeding down a hill this all happened after dallas had suffocated arizona s offense for the first 44 minutes of the game and the cardinals awakening delivered repeated violent blows to the ribcage of the cowboys defense landing a liver punch in the form of a michael wilson dependent touchdown drive to tie the game in the final six seconds of regulation a quick defensive stop and a 44 yard scoring drive in overtime sent the cowboys to the mat for good resulting in one of the most stunning outcomes of the entire nfl season this type of loss can send a team into a spiral could cost defensive coordinator christian parker his job and will undoubtedly cause cowboys fans to angrily punch the air the same problems persist they still can t beat the lowly cardinals in texas and the solutions continue to prove fleeting arizona s rebuilt backfield disintegrates but one pillar remains standing tyler allgeier s second half outburst produced a victory for the cardinals but it was even more triumphant for a workhorse who has often been left to the shadows of more recognizable running mates in atlanta and arizona the talk at the start of the season revolved around first round pick jeremiyah love and when the cardinals couldn t generate consistently on the ground love s absence was quickly blamed allgeier never quite saw the chances he needed to blossom but found himself in an unexpected moment of opportunity sunday when love and bam knight exited due to injury he could have played an average brand of football as the lone remaining runner available but that s not allgeier those who were unfamiliar with his style were reminded rudely on his 63 yard touchdown run in which he broke three tackles and followed a trio of teammates who escorted him to the goal line where he fell across it for a score while finally being brought down that touchdown made it a 17 10 game but more importantly it gave the cardinals reason to believe his ensuing 52 yarder saw hjalte froholdt get out in front and wreck caleb downs in open space setting an aggressive tone embodied by the runner benefitting from the blocking in those two plays and gardner minshew s stint as a mid game replacement the cardinals brought the fight to the cowboys refusing to lay down despite a double digit deficit and little reason to believe they d turn things around because of allgeier s toughness determination and relentless desire to produce when called upon he also caught five passes for 44 yards and an incredibly gritty touchdown reception the cardinals pulled off the stunning win and might have found a new identity in the process next gen stats insight for cardinals cowboys via nfl pro tyler excluding kneeldowns part of a combined 83 carries by the two clubs in a bad weather game baker mayfield recorded just three pass attempts and completed none of them as tampa bay joined the 1974 bills as only the second team in the super bowl era to complete zero passes in a game and emerge victorious not only that but the bucs became the first team to win a game by 10 plus points without completing a pass since the 1945 pittsburgh steelers over the chicago cardinals so how did they pull out such an unlikely victory bucky irving his cuts were vicious and precise allowing him to weave through an atlanta defense that appeared to be on skates at times on a field flooded by rainwater he rushed for 170 yards and a touchdown on 27 carries eclipsing 100 yards in a first half for his first time as a pro and eventually setting a career high the operation also didn t slow down at all with kenneth gainwell occasionally mixing in and later on taking over to milk clock the backup back logged 25 carries for 140 yards it was a similar smashmouth formula that tampa bay used in last week s 43 13 pummeling of the panthers when mayfield only threw for 64 yards and the buccaneers have now produced three of the franchise s top 10 single game rushing outputs over the last four weeks at some point mayfield will need to air it out but it s been a remarkable run and remarkable running by tampa bay of late to reenter the nfc south race penix implodes atlanta ultimately lost for two reasons it couldn t stop bucky irving and michael penix couldn t stop giving the ball away while the bucs basically gave up trying to throw under a heavy rain that persisted for most of the contest penix accepted the challenge and promptly failed he couldn t find his targets especially during the first half spraying the ball around but not to his targets far too often he sailed one over drake london s head during atlanta s first drive into jacob parrish s hands but the corner couldn t handle it even provided that little bit of luck though he still threw three picks over the subsequent four possessions becoming the first quarterback to toss three interceptions in the first 18 minutes of a game since bailey zappe in 2023 and the first falcons qb to do it since matt ryan in 2012 penix threw his fourth int of the game after atlanta had finally found some momentum in better conditions ruining a 43 yard drive down to tampa bay s 24 yard line by leaving one behind tight end charlie woerner for zyon mccollum to collect the falcons had been averaging 31 0 points per game with penix starting which ranked behind only the bills 32 8 entering week 8 but he was a difference maker in the negative sense against tampa bay he finished 8 of 24 for 125 yards and an ugly 12 0 passer rating in a messy game like sunday s was the best thing quarterbacks can do is protect the ball he didn t and he lost miserable conditions lead to slopfest the true victor of sunday s game might have been the elements atlanta and tampa bay spent most of the day just trying to get through a torrential downpour the rain caused errors in every conceivable way there were overthrows botched snaps missed kicks fumbles and all varieties of dropped passes would be touchdowns easy pickups and interceptions there are too many examples to point to but perhaps the most emblematic football folly took place on the bucs second drive after the center quarterback exchange went wrong baker mayfield recovered the ball and improvised magnificently darting into traffic before throwing it backward to bucky irving who streaked toward the end zone and nearly made it there before jessie bates punched the ball out right at the goal line for a touchback by halftime the game had seen more fumbles five and interceptions three than completions two both teams tightened up on ball security out of half and the rain let up some toward the fourth quarter but tampa bay was able to outlast by stacking some successes despite the elements throughout the contest chase mclaughlin was money helping build a lead in the first half by going 3 of 3 on field goals of 46 34 and 42 yards alex anzalone picked off penix twice six plays apart jacob parrish made up for an earlier drop with a second quarter interception and the bucs shut out the falcons offense on third down 0 for 12 for such an ugly ugly day there will actually be a fair amount of pretty plays for todd bowles and co to rewatch next gen stats insight for falcons buccaneers via nfl pro bucky irving generated all 170 of his rushing yards against atlanta after contact the third most in a single game this season nfl research the buccaneers had a franchise record 322 rushing yards in week 8 against the falcons those 322 rushing yards are the second most by any team in a game where they had zero completions over the last 90 years behind only the 1933 boston redskins who had 420 against the giants in a 21 20 win back to top kevin patra s takeaways rams rumble over chargers in battle of l a sean mcvay s offense got off to an ugly start failing to record a first down in its first five drives the rams finally broke through with less than 90 seconds remaining in the first half on a matthew stafford 40 yard bomb to tutu atwell the home squad skated from there scoring 21 straight to blow out their sofi stadium mates the rams came out at halftime and saddled up the rushing attack after just 10 yards on the ground through two quarters blake corum and kyren williams blasted their way for 129 rushing yards and two touchdowns on 27 carries for the game corum started the second half generating chunk gains juking defenders out of their shoes he capped the drive with a 23 yard scamper to give l a a lead it wouldn t relent finding pay dirt on both sides of halftime seemed to break the chargers the successful rushing attack stabilized an offense that was stubbing its toe early after a wobbly start mcvay s squad has battled back to 500 with games against washington and arizona on tap chargers disaster season continues the chargers play poorly they also played scared jim harbaugh s winless club had multiple chances to strike an early big punch but repeatedly whiffed the chargers settled for three field goals on fourth and short situations deep in rams territory the final decision proved to be the worst facing a fourth and 2 at the rams 23 yard line with under 2 minutes left in the first half harbaugh elected to kick a field goal to go up 9 3 if the chargers went for and converted it they could have gone up double digits and perhaps burned the clock so the rams couldn t have scored late to jumpstart their offense winning teams make winning plays on winning decisions losing teams stay losing with a losing mentality speaking of mentality justin herbert s is lost in a blind wilderness the chargers qb threw a pair of ugly interceptions the type you can t believe that a 50 million player would make right to defenders herbert isn t trusting what he s seeing and isn t seeing what defenses are putting in front of him he s a mess mentally right now with little hope of digging out of the hole when the highest paid player on the team is making rookie level mistakes what can you expect from the rest of the club rams d takes advantage of herbert mistakes quentin lake jumped a first quarter justin herbert pass to the outside and scampered into chargers territory even after the offense generated just 8 yards the return was enough to give the rams an early three point lead after halftime trent mcduffie saw a pass tossed right to him in zone coverage which he returned 26 yards to set up a td that would put the game out of reach the rams stuffed the chargers run game 2 6 yards per carry and pestered herbert into mistakes in addition to two sacks and two picks the rams generated 20 qb pressures including three from defensive tackle aaron donald the rams early play keeping the chargers out of the end zone proved huge giving the offense time to figure things out without falling too far behind next gen stats insight for rams chargers via nfl pro matthew stafford averaged a time to throw of 2 38 seconds in the rams week 8 victory over the chargers his third quickest in a game since joining the rams in 2021 stafford was efficient on quick passes completing 13 of 14 passes for 94 yards and a touchdown 57 1 success rate when he held on to the ball for over 2 5 seconds he completed just four of 11 passes for 63 yards with an interception 33 3 success rate nfl research the chargers are the first team in nfl history to lose each of their first seven games of a season after winning at least 11 games in the previous season back to top nick shook s takeaways fourth quarter broncos are back denver s offensive output is slowly starting to improve bo nix completed 20 of 32 passes for 222 yards and two touchdowns took a few shots downfield and connected once with jaylen waddle for a big gain and most importantly delivered in a frantic fourth quarter comeback effort facing a goal to go situation nix ran himself into pressure when inexplicably trying to break a clean pocket but didn t let that mistake sink him he calmly executed a play action rollout later in the sequence and found fullback nate adkins for a touchdown then coolly converted the two point try by firing a bullet to waddle to make it a three point game jonah coleman later handled the rest ripping off a 51 yard gain after catching a short pass from nix to set up denver s go ahead touchdown a score that was ultimately the deciding trip to the end zone denver still finished 2 for 11 on third down and under 300 total yards of offense but when it needed to score late it found a way to get the job done in a high pressure situation the broncos will need to build off that going forward chiefs rediscover offensive mojo still fall short after being completely shut down by seattle last week kansas city was able to get back on track and produce in denver on sunday thanks to some early big plays headlined by running back emmett johnson s 73 yard touchdown reception explosive plays propelled the chiefs to a 17 13 lead before patrick mahomes pieced together a methodical 11 play 63 yard touchdown drive to take an 11 point lead late in the third quarter that score came at the end of what was the chiefs most impressive drive of the season and appeared to be enough to keep the broncos at bay until denver s fourth quarter scoring outburst moved the broncos within three points of tying the chiefs and then ahead of kansas city in the game s final two minutes in years past that would have been too much time to give mahomes and co and it nearly was again sunday but kansas city s inability to finish off its frantic two minute drill reminded us of this offense s limitations mahomes wasn t able to scramble for a touchdown instead throwing away a pass a few yards shy of the goal line and kenneth walker s hesitant third down run preceded a sequence that will live in chiefs fans memories for a while facing fourth and goal from the 1 kansas city stacked three receivers in a tight bunch set on the left sent the shotgun snap to mahomes and let the route combination work freeing rashee rice for what should have been the game winning touchdown jaylon moore s slight movement before the snap drew a false start penalty though and mahomes crumbled beneath the denver pass rush on the game s final play there were things to like from this game including kansas city s ability to compete on the road without receiving stellar production from walker 25 touches 84 scrimmage yards but the frustrating result erased the chiefs grip on first place in the afc west race instead they ll have to try to keep pace with denver the rest of the way oh and we already knew this but it was reaffirmed sunday harrison butker is marching toward unemployment his wide right miss from 54 yards loomed large in this contest and is just the latest of a growing string of misses from deep denver s defense shows cracks but holds up in biggest moment the broncos have built their 6 2 mark on the backs of their defenders who have collectively stifled opposing offenses by harassing quarterbacks relentlessly over the last month on sunday they weren t quite as effective for most of the afternoon patrick mahomes managed to lead one drive in which he repeatedly converted third downs by barely moving the ball beyond the line to gain showing flashes of what has made him a special quarterback in the post tyreek hill era in kansas city and dealing a few deflating blows to the denver defense in the process that wasn t enough to tear them down though in need of a stop denver managed to force a chiefs drive to stall in the fourth quarter leading to butker s 54 yard miss and granting the broncos a fresh opportunity to complete their comeback effort and even after letting mahomes drive the chiefs down the field rapidly in the final two minutes denver bowed up and denied the chiefs from entering the end zone in the game s final seconds as nix noted afterward the broncos have been leaning on their defense all season and they managed to prevent the opposition from gaining the one yard they needed most the fact they ended the game with a sack credited to malcolm roach but truly the product of a collective unified pass rush was fitting next gen stats insight for chiefs broncos via nfl pro on first and goal from the denver 4 yard line in the game s final minute the chiefs owned a 76 chance of winning per next gen stats win probability they did not score losing 28 24 nfl research the broncos came back to win in week 8 after trailing by 11 points in the fourth quarter against the chiefs the win was the broncos third in bo nix s career in which they came back from a double digit fourth quarter deficit to win which is the most such wins in the nfl since 2024 this was just the third game in patrick mahomes career in which the chiefs blew a double digit fourth quarter lead and the first since week 2 2021 in baltimore back to top brooke cersosimo s takeaways maye pats offense has big second half the patriots looked as if they were still feeling last week s loss to chicago in the first half of sunday s contest new england s receiving yards leader hunter henry remained drake maye s preferred option early against the dolphins catching all three of his targets for 30 yards but the veteran tight end left the game with a foot injury midway through the second quarter and never returned maye looked stumped without henry and his top three receivers a j brown ankle knee who s missing his fifth game this season romeo doubs and mack hollins both on injured reserve for the rest of the half the offense compiled less than 100 total yards and had a 13 3 deficit going into the locker room prompting too many mike vrabel eye rolls to count then came some much needed adjustments from offensive coordinator josh mcdaniels and maye after a three and out maye began stretching the field and finding the few pats receivers at his disposal to string together three straight touchdown drives that scoring avalanche opened with maye finding kyle williams on a 43 yard touchdown before maye stunned a defender when taking it in himself on an option from 2 yards out maye s third td saw him connect with demario douglas deep downfield for a 48 yard touchdown maye finished the day 16 of 20 passing for 199 yards with the three total tds it marked maye s fifth straight game with three or more total touchdowns the first time a patriots qb has done so since tom brady accomplished the feat in 10 consecutive games in 2007 despite some dicey moments early the pats appear to be back on track dormant third quarter sinks fins miami built some momentum offensively before halftime with 11 and 12 play scoring drives that gave it a 10 point lead heading into the locker room the latter was undoubtedly miami s most impressive march of the day as malik willis connected with greg dulcich caleb douglas jalen tolbert kevin coleman and finally malik washington in the end zone for a 1 yard score that s about when the fun stopped for miami as the third quarter saw it gain a piddly 13 net yards zero pass yards on eight plays credit the dolphins for trying to get out of the 11 point hole late with a nice 35 yard touchdown from willis to coleman late in the fourth quarter though a missed field goal failed two point try and an unsuccessful onside kick attempt all but sealed their fate willis finished the loss 21 of 32 passing for 211 yards two tds and an int which crazily launched off a defender s helmet at the line of scrimmage into kevin byard s hands downfield for the first time in several weeks the run game went away with ollie gordon racking up 69 yards on 19 carries 3 6 yards per attempt the game was ultimately decided by five points but it didn t feel all that close for much of the rainy second half some love for the defenses there were a handful of players on both teams that made notable plays the dolphins entered the contest with only six sacks dead last in the nfl but logged three sunday 2024 first round pick chop robinson led all players with two takedowns of drake maye while josh uche a former patriot had one miami also received solid contributions from jordyn brooks 11 total tackles jacob rodriguez eight tackles forced fumble and julius brents fumble recovery new england sacked malik willis five times in the win with gabe jacas and cory durden leading the way with 1 5 sacks apiece carlton davis nine tackles kaden elliss nine tackles 5 sacks two tfls and kevin byard int also deserve flowers for their performances next gen stats insight for patriots 149 yards and both of his touchdowns since week 4 maye has thrown six deep 20 air yards touchdown passes without an interception the most deep touchdowns in the nfl over that span nfl research with sunday s win over the miami dolphins patriots head coach mike vrabel is 13 4 in his career in games with eight or more days of rest back to top grant gordon s takeaways daniels gets long awaited win in a battle of attrition for the commanders eagles and those tuned in washington and jayden daniels emerged as survivors and victors there were zero style points but daniels and co rallied from a 10 point deficit in the first quarter as the quarterback stunningly earned his first win since oct 5 2025 battling through injuries in this season and the last daniels had gone 0 7 1 over his last eight starts with washington this one is unlikely to be a triumph he ll put on a highlight reel as the commanders and eagles entered sunday night on a combined eight game winless streak the product was emblematic of the teams travails for the most part daniels however largely avoided big mistakes throwing for 217 yards and an 8 yard touchdown pass to stefon diggs that led to a 10 all score in the second quarter and was part of a 27 0 run for washington daniels and washington have been desperate for a win at 2 4 1 the commanders are still within flailing distance of the nfc east s top spot though that s hard to fathom with the showing regardless dan quinn daniels and the commanders have something to celebrate at the expense of a division rival that is dealing with harder times eagles endure another ugly loss after 10 points and nearly 15 minutes of game time things looked sunny for philadelphia for the first time in a long time the eagles hadn t laid claim to a double digit lead since week 4 unfortunately during a trying season for the eagles in which injuries have taken hold they lost their sixth in a row for the first time in nick sirianni s tenure as a banged up saquon barkley was limited and fill in starter tanner mckee was bamboozled by washington pressure held scoreless following a 3 yard touchdown run by barkley with 4 27 to go in the first quarter the eagles mustered just 268 yards of offense the running game was held to 91 yards and mckee couldn t hold up against the commanders pressure washington racked up a season best five sacks as mckee was pressured 20 times 46 5 pressure rate and it seemed as though he was under duress far more than that despite a roster completely hobbled by injuries this was a winnable game for the eagles but mckee and the offense simply had no answers emblematic of the struggles was philadelphia s best drive of the second half a 15 play odyssey that took up 7 35 it ended with a jake elliott 41 yard field goal attempt clanging off the upright following back to back 5 yard penalties eight games into the season and residing in an nfc east that s hardly a heavyweight division it s still arduous to believe the eagles season isn t done washington wins in trenches in week 7 the eagles defense was shockingly held to six qb pressures no sacks and no tackles for loss in a setback against the cowboys the stats weren t so damning in this one but it still wasn t where it should be credit to the commanders offensive line for that guard samuel cosmi more than held his own against jalen carter carter had one of the eagles two sacks and it came versus cosmi but overall cosmi won this battle allowing the sack and one pressure in 19 matchups including 12 one on ones the pressure and the sack allowed to carter were cosmi s only blemishes in 33 pass block snaps former first round pick josh conerly and center lucas patrick also had commendable showings next gen stats insight for eagles commanders via nfl pro news_mentions.headline: Buccaneers' Todd Bowles on zero-completion win over Falcons: There's a 'first time for everything'
news_mentions.description: The Buccaneers outlasted the Falcons in a rain-soaked affair despite Baker Mayfield attempting only three passes and converting on none of them, becoming the second team in the Super Bowl era to win a game without a single completion.
news_mentions.body_text: conventional wisdom said baker mayfield would need to throw for more than the 64 yards he managed in last week s victory if the buccaneers hoped to begin a winning streak on sunday conventional wisdom was wrong tampa bay instead outlasted the falcons 16 0 in a rain soaked affair at raymond james stadium despite mayfield attempting only three passes and converting on none of them as the bucs became the second team 1974 bills in the super bowl era to win a game without a single completion i have not head coach todd bowles said when asked if he s ever won without a completion per the team s transcript but there is a first time for everything as noted it s the second such occurrence since the league merger but it s certainly a first for bowles who would ve been only 10 years old when the 74 bills accomplished the unthinkable feat a torrential downpour set the stage for such an odd accomplishment the falcons were especially affected by the storm attempting to throw their way through it to disastrous results michael penix tossed three interceptions in the first 18 minutes of the game frequently missing his pass catchers as he delivered a slippery football with little to no authority over its destination tampa bay conversely took to the ground again and again attacking an atlanta defense that entered the weekend fourth against the run i didn t say we were not going to throw the ball the conditions told him that bowles said when asked about game plan discussions with offensive coordinator zac robinson you could see it it s a downpour and the wind was blowing you can kind of see the ball wasn t going anywhere mayfield attempted his first pass with 7 53 remaining in the first quarter nearly a 28 yard touchdown that ted hurst dropped after throwing another pass with 4 10 left in the opening frame he wouldn t record another one until his third snap of the third quarter that was it there was a dropback in the second quarter during which mayfield had the ball slip out his grasp while trying to throw a good representation of the sloppiness that contributed to five fumbles and three ints between the teams but it was otherwise all runs the buccaneers simply didn t need to take any of the risks involved with airing it out further their defense was that stifling and their running game was that dominant bucky irving and kenneth gainwell gashed the falcons for a combined 310 rushing yards on 52 attempts on tampa bay s lone td drive the two combined to go 90 yards on six carries with both breaking off big runs irving for 46 and gainwell for 28 including mayfield s 14 rushing yards the buccaneers set a new franchise single game record with 324 it s winning that s the way i think about it mayfield said we won it s getting our guys lined up making sure we are running the right run plays obviously ball security is crucial in these conditions we had some early ones we decided to go to the shotgun and pistol sets it s just easier to receive the snaps instead of it coming back through your hands under center so going from there and just trying to manage the game it s time management and just trying to bleed the clock as much as possible just get everybody on the same page and go from there that s my job in these conditions and listen i will do whatever it takes to win that s all that matters to me offensive lineman luke goedeke who helped pave the way for tampa bay s historic rushing performance said of mayfield only attempting three passes yeah i mean it s great it s just a testament to the offense the o line the tight ends the wide receivers running backs it s just everyone doing their job and bake he hands off a mean ball so really hats off to him as well the buccaneers have now won two straight both against divisional opponents to inch back to 3 5 they re right in the thick of it in the nfc south knotted in the win column with the falcons 3 5 and panthers who sit atop the standings at 3 4 they ve still got a long ways to go and surely mayfield will be called on to pass a lot more than he did on sunday moving forward but the potential turnaround has begun on the strength of a punishing run game we did a lot to dig ourselves out of it bowles said of being back in contention for the division we re still in it being 3 5 not being 500 or anything else i told them to keep their shovels close because we have a lot more digging to do but it gets us back in it

news_mentions.headline: NFL Week 8 fantasy sleepers: QB Sam Darnold, RB Rico Dowdle, WR Ja'Kobi Lane among upside plays
news_mentions.description: Will Sam Darnold enjoy his best performance in weeks against the Bears on Monday night? Which two receivers have sneaky upside? Raza Umerani highlights nine sleepers to consider for your fantasy football lineup in Week 8.
news_mentions.body_text: fantasy football is a lot like trick or treating oftentimes you put together what you think is an excellent costume like having a great draft on paper only to realize that it s falling apart at the seams akin to fantasy busts and injuries some candies are can t miss classics jahmyr gibbs is m m s jaxon smith njigba is snickers josh allen is kitkat others leave a little to be desired but every year there s a candy that s handed out at one or two houses that wiggles down to the bottom of your pillow case you don t initially notice it amidst all the twix and mars bars but once you find it you re pleasantly surprised enough to go buy more from the store for me back in my halloween heyday that candy was milk duds no i won t apologize these sleepers are that proverbial candy of your choice they might not be reese s peanut butter cups or milky ways but they ll do enough to satisfy you over halloween weekend and perhaps beyond note all statistics come courtesy of next gen stats unless otherwise noted quarterbacks running backs wide receivers tight end defenses
