stumped without henry and his top three receivers a j brown ankle knee who s missing his fifth game this season romeo doubs and mack hollins both on injured reserve for the rest of the half the offense compiled less than 100 total yards and had a 13 3 deficit going into the locker room prompting too many mike vrabel eye rolls to count then came some much needed adjustments from offensive coordinator josh mcdaniels and maye after a three and out maye began stretching the field and finding the few pats receivers at his disposal to string together three straight touchdown drives that scoring avalanche opened with maye finding kyle williams on a 43 yard touchdown before maye stunned a defender when taking it in himself on an option from 2 yards out maye s third td saw him connect with demario douglas deep downfield for a 48 yard touchdown maye finished the day 16 of 20 passing for 199 yards with the three total tds it marked maye s fifth straight game with three or more total touchdowns the first time a patriots qb has done so since tom brady accomplished the feat in 10 consecutive games in 2007 despite some dicey moments early the pats appear to be back on track dormant third quarter sinks fins miami built some momentum offensively before halftime with 11 and 12 play scoring drives that gave it a 10 point lead heading into the locker room the latter was undoubtedly miami s most impressive march of the day as malik willis connected with greg dulcich caleb douglas jalen tolbert kevin coleman and finally malik washington in the end zone for a 1 yard score that s about when the fun stopped for miami as the third quarter saw it gain a piddly 13 net yards zero pass yards on eight plays credit the dolphins for trying to get out of the 11 point hole late with a nice 35 yard touchdown from willis to coleman late in the fourth quarter though a missed field goal failed two point try and an unsuccessful onside kick attempt all but sealed their fate willis finished the loss 21 of 32 passing for 211 yards two tds and an int which crazily launched off a defender s helmet at the line of scrimmage into kevin byard s hands downfield for the first time in several weeks the run game went away with ollie gordon racking up 69 yards on 19 carries 3 6 yards per attempt the game was ultimately decided by five points but it didn t feel all that close for much of the rainy second half some love for the defenses there were a handful of players on both teams that made notable plays the dolphins entered the contest with only six sacks dead last in the nfl but logged three sunday 2024 first round pick chop robinson led all players with two takedowns of drake maye while josh uche a former patriot had one miami also received solid contributions from jordyn brooks 11 total tackles jacob rodriguez eight tackles forced fumble and julius brents fumble recovery new england sacked malik willis five times in the win with gabe jacas and cory durden leading the way with 1 5 sacks apiece carlton davis nine tackles kaden elliss nine tackles 5 sacks two tfls and kevin byard int also deserve flowers for their performances next gen stats insight for patriots dolphins via nfl pro drake maye completed 16 of 20 passes for 199 yards and two tds against the dolphins in week 8 maye was perfect on throws of more than 10 air yards completing all five attempts for 149 yards and both of his touchdowns since week 4 maye has thrown six deep 20 air yards touchdown passes without an interception the most deep touchdowns in the nfl over that span nfl research with sunday s win over the miami dolphins patriots head coach mike vrabel is 13 4 in his career in games with eight or more days of rest back to top grant gordon s takeaways daniels gets long awaited win in a battle of attrition for the commanders eagles and those tuned in washington and jayden daniels emerged as survivors and victors there were zero style points but daniels and co rallied from a 10 point deficit in the first quarter as the quarterback stunningly earned his first win since oct 5 2025 battling through injuries in this season and the last daniels had gone 0 7 1 over his last eight starts with washington this one is unlikely to be a triumph he ll put on a highlight reel as the commanders and eagles entered sunday night on a combined eight game winless streak the product was emblematic of the teams travails for the most part daniels however largely avoided big mistakes throwing for 217 yards and an 8 yard touchdown pass to stefon diggs that led to a 10 all score in the second quarter and was part of a 27 0 run for washington daniels and washington have been desperate for a win at 2 4 1 the commanders are still within flailing distance of the nfc east s top spot though that s hard to fathom with the showing regardless dan quinn daniels and the commanders have something to celebrate at the expense of a division rival that is dealing with harder times eagles endure another ugly loss after 10 points and nearly 15 minutes of game time things looked sunny for philadelphia for the first time in a long time the eagles hadn t laid claim to a double digit lead since week 4 unfortunately during a trying season for the eagles in which injuries have taken hold they lost their sixth in a row for the first time in nick sirianni s tenure as a banged up saquon barkley was limited and fill in starter tanner mckee was bamboozled by washington pressure held scoreless following a 3 yard touchdown run by barkley with 4 27 to go in the first quarter the eagles mustered just 268 yards of offense the running game was held to 91 yards and mckee couldn t hold up against the commanders pressure washington racked up a season best five sacks as mckee was pressured 20 times 46 5 pressure rate and it seemed as though he was under duress far more than that despite a roster completely hobbled by injuries this was a winnable game for the eagles but mckee and the offense simply had no answers emblematic of the struggles was philadelphia s best drive of the second half a 15 play odyssey that took up 7 35 it ended with a jake elliott 41 yard field goal attempt clanging off the upright following back to back 5 yard penalties eight games into the season and residing in an nfc east that s hardly a heavyweight division it s still arduous to believe the eagles season isn t done washington wins in trenches in week 7 the eagles defense was shockingly held to six qb pressures no sacks and no tackles for loss in a setback against the cowboys the stats weren t so damning in this one but it still wasn t where it should be credit to the commanders offensive line for that guard samuel cosmi more than held his own against jalen carter carter had one of the eagles two sacks and it came versus cosmi but overall cosmi won this battle allowing the sack and one pressure in 19 matchups including 12 one on ones the pressure and the sack allowed to carter were cosmi s only blemishes in 33 pass block snaps former first round pick josh conerly and center lucas patrick also had commendable showings next gen stats insight for eagles commanders via nfl pro washington generated pressure on 46 5 of dropbacks against philadelphia a season high mark ten pressures and a sack came on 12 blitzes 83 3 the second highest pressure rate by any defense in a game this season minimum five blitzes nfl research the eagles have lost six straight games for the first time since 2012 when philadelphia lost eight in a row from weeks 5 13 it was also the eagles third loss in a row versus an nfc east opponent the first time they ve done so since weeks 9 11 in 2005 philadelphia s 2 6 start is its worst since 1999 andy reid s first year at the helm back to top

any team in a game where they had zero completions over the last 90 years behind only the 1933 boston redskins who had 420 against the giants in a 21 20 win back to top kevin patra s takeaways rams rumble over chargers in battle of l a sean mcvay s offense got off to an ugly start failing to record a first down in its first five drives the rams finally broke through with less than 90 seconds remaining in the first half on a matthew stafford 40 yard bomb to tutu atwell the home squad skated from there scoring 21 straight to blow out their sofi stadium mates the rams came out at halftime and saddled up the rushing attack after just 10 yards on the ground through two quarters blake corum and kyren williams blasted their way for 129 rushing yards and two touchdowns on 27 carries for the game corum started the second half generating chunk gains juking defenders out of their shoes he capped the drive with a 23 yard scamper to give l a a lead it wouldn t relent finding pay dirt on both sides of halftime seemed to break the chargers the successful rushing attack stabilized an offense that was stubbing its toe early after a wobbly start mcvay s squad has battled back to 500 with games against washington and arizona on tap chargers disaster season continues the chargers play poorly they also played scared jim harbaugh s winless club had multiple chances to strike an early big punch but repeatedly whiffed the chargers settled for three field goals on fourth and short situations deep in rams territory the final decision proved to be the worst facing a fourth and 2 at the rams 23 yard line with under 2 minutes left in the first half harbaugh elected to kick a field goal to go up 9 3 if the chargers went for and converted it they could have gone up double digits and perhaps burned the clock so the rams couldn t have scored late to jumpstart their offense winning teams make winning plays on winning decisions losing teams stay losing with a losing mentality speaking of mentality justin herbert s is lost in a blind wilderness the chargers qb threw a pair of ugly interceptions the type you can t believe that a 50 million player would make right to defenders herbert isn t trusting what he s seeing and isn t seeing what defenses are putting in front of him he s a mess mentally right now with little hope of digging out of the hole when the highest paid player on the team is making rookie level mistakes what can you expect from the rest of the club rams d takes advantage of herbert mistakes quentin lake jumped a first quarter justin herbert pass to the outside and scampered into chargers territory even after the offense generated just 8 yards the return was enough to give the rams an early three point lead after halftime trent mcduffie saw a pass tossed right to him in zone coverage which he returned 26 yards to set up a td that would put the game out of reach the rams stuffed the chargers run game 2 6 yards per carry and pestered herbert into mistakes in addition to two sacks and two picks the rams generated 20 qb pressures including three from defensive tackle aaron donald the rams early play keeping the chargers out of the end zone proved huge giving the offense time to figure things out without falling too far behind next gen stats insight for rams chargers via nfl pro matthew stafford averaged a time to throw of 2 38 seconds in the rams week 8 victory over the chargers his third quickest in a game since joining the rams in 2021 stafford was efficient on quick passes completing 13 of 14 passes for 94 yards and a touchdown 57 1 success rate when he held on to the ball for over 2 5 seconds he completed just four of 11 passes for 63 yards with an interception 33 3 success rate nfl research the chargers are the first team in nfl history to lose each of their first seven games of a season after winning at least 11 games in the previous season back to top nick shook s takeaways fourth quarter broncos are back denver s offensive output is slowly starting to improve bo nix completed 20 of 32 passes for 222 yards and two touchdowns took a few shots downfield and connected once with jaylen waddle for a big gain and most importantly delivered in a frantic fourth quarter comeback effort facing a goal to go situation nix ran himself into pressure when inexplicably trying to break a clean pocket but didn t let that mistake sink him he calmly executed a play action rollout later in the sequence and found fullback nate adkins for a touchdown then coolly converted the two point try by firing a bullet to waddle to make it a three point game jonah coleman later handled the rest ripping off a 51 yard gain after catching a short pass from nix to set up denver s go ahead touchdown a score that was ultimately the deciding trip to the end zone denver still finished 2 for 11 on third down and under 300 total yards of offense but when it needed to score late it found a way to get the job done in a high pressure situation the broncos will need to build off that going forward chiefs rediscover offensive mojo still fall short after being completely shut down by seattle last week kansas city was able to get back on track and produce in denver on sunday thanks to some early big plays headlined by running back emmett johnson s 73 yard touchdown reception explosive plays propelled the chiefs to a 17 13 lead before patrick mahomes pieced together a methodical 11 play 63 yard touchdown drive to take an 11 point lead late in the third quarter that score came at the end of what was the chiefs most impressive drive of the season and appeared to be enough to keep the broncos at bay until denver s fourth quarter scoring outburst moved the broncos within three points of tying the chiefs and then ahead of kansas city in the game s final two minutes in years past that would have been too much time to give mahomes and co and it nearly was again sunday but kansas city s inability to finish off its frantic two minute drill reminded us of this offense s limitations mahomes wasn t able to scramble for a touchdown instead throwing away a pass a few yards shy of the goal line and kenneth walker s hesitant third down run preceded a sequence that will live in chiefs fans memories for a while facing fourth and goal from the 1 kansas city stacked three receivers in a tight bunch set on the left sent the shotgun snap to mahomes and let the route combination work freeing rashee rice for what should have been the game winning touchdown jaylon moore s slight movement before the snap drew a false start penalty though and mahomes crumbled beneath the denver pass rush on the game s final play there were things to like from this game including kansas city s ability to compete on the road without receiving stellar production from walker 25 touches 84 scrimmage yards but the frustrating result erased the chiefs grip on first place in the afc west race instead they ll have to try to keep pace with denver the rest of the way oh and we already knew this but it was reaffirmed sunday harrison butker is marching toward unemployment his wide right miss from 54 yards loomed large in this contest and is just the latest of a growing string of misses from deep denver s defense shows cracks but holds up in biggest moment the broncos have built their 6 2 mark on the backs of their defenders who have collectively stifled opposing offenses by harassing quarterbacks relentlessly over the last month on sunday they weren t quite as effective for most of the afternoon patrick mahomes managed to lead one drive in which he repeatedly converted third downs by barely moving the ball beyond the line to gain showing flashes of what has made him a special quarterback in the post tyreek hill era in kansas city and dealing a few deflating blows to the denver defense in the process that wasn t enough to tear them down though in need of a stop denver managed to force a chiefs drive to stall in the fourth quarter leading to butker s 54 yard miss and granting the broncos a fresh opportunity to complete their comeback effort and even after letting mahomes drive the chiefs down the field rapidly in the final two minutes denver bowed up and denied the chiefs from entering the end zone in the game s final seconds as nix noted afterward the broncos have been leaning on their defense all season and they managed to prevent the opposition from gaining the one yard they needed most the fact they ended the game with a sack credited to malcolm roach but truly the product of a collective unified pass rush was fitting next gen stats insight for chiefs broncos via nfl pro on first and goal from the denver 4 yard line in the game s final minute the chiefs owned a 76 chance of winning per next gen stats win probability they did not score losing 28 24 nfl research the broncos came back to win in week 8 after trailing by 11 points in the fourth quarter against the chiefs the win was the broncos third in bo nix s career in which they came back from a double digit fourth quarter deficit to win which is the most such wins in the nfl since 2024 this was just the third game in patrick mahomes career in which the chiefs blew a double digit fourth quarter lead and the first since week 2 2021 in baltimore back to top brooke cersosimo s takeaways maye pats offense has big second half the patriots looked as if they were still feeling last week s loss to chicago in the first half of sunday s contest new england s receiving yards leader hunter henry remained drake maye s preferred option early against the dolphins catching all three of his targets for 30 yards but the veteran tight end left the game with a foot injury midway through the second quarter and never returned maye looked stumped without henry and his top three receivers a j brown ankle knee who s missing his fifth game this season romeo doubs and mack hollins both on injured reserve for the rest of the half the offense compiled less than 100 total yards and had a 13 3 deficit going into the locker room prompting too many mike vrabel eye rolls to count then came some much needed adjustments from offensive coordinator josh mcdaniels and maye after a three and out maye began stretching the field and finding the few pats receivers at his disposal to string together three straight touchdown drives that scoring avalanche opened with maye finding kyle williams on a 43 yard touchdown before maye stunned a defender when taking it in himself on an option from 2 yards out maye s third td saw him connect with demario douglas deep downfield for a 48 yard touchdown maye finished the day 16 of 20 passing for 199 yards with the three total tds it marked maye s fifth straight game with three or more total touchdowns the first time a patriots qb has done so since tom brady accomplished the feat in 10 consecutive games in 2007 despite some dicey moments early the pats appear to be back on track dormant third quarter sinks fins miami built some momentum offensively before halftime with 11 and 12 play scoring drives that gave it a 10 point lead heading into the locker room the latter was undoubtedly miami s most impressive march of the day as malik willis connected with greg dulcich caleb douglas jalen tolbert kevin coleman and finally malik washington in the end zone for a 1 yard score that s about when the fun stopped for miami as the third quarter saw it gain a piddly 13 net yards zero pass yards on eight plays credit the dolphins for trying to get out of the 11 point hole late with a nice 35 yard touchdown from willis to coleman late in the fourth quarter though a missed field goal failed two point try and an unsuccessful onside kick attempt all but sealed their fate willis finished the loss 21 of 32 passing for 211 yards two tds and an int which crazily launched off a defender s helmet at the line of scrimmage into kevin byard s hands downfield for the first time in several weeks the run game went away with ollie gordon racking up 69 yards on 19 carries 3 6 yards per attempt the game was ultimately decided by five points but it didn t feel all that close for much of the rainy second half some love for the defenses there were a handful of players on both teams that made notable plays the dolphins entered the contest with only six sacks dead last in the nfl but logged three sunday 2024 first round pick chop robinson led all players with two takedowns of drake maye while josh uche a former patriot had one miami also received solid contributions from jordyn brooks 11 total tackles jacob rodriguez eight tackles forced fumble and julius brents fumble recovery new england sacked malik willis five times in the win with gabe jacas and cory durden leading the way with 1 5 sacks apiece carlton davis nine tackles kaden elliss nine tackles 5 sacks two tfls and kevin byard int also deserve flowers for their performances next gen stats insight for patriots dolphins via nfl pro drake maye completed 16 of 20 passes for 199 yards and two tds against the dolphins in week 8 maye was perfect on throws of more than 10 air yards completing all five attempts for 149 yards and both of his touchdowns since week 4 maye has thrown six deep 20 air yards touchdown passes without an interception the most deep touchdowns in the nfl over that span nfl research with sunday s win over the miami dolphins patriots head coach mike vrabel is 13 4 in his career in games with eight or more days of rest back to top grant gordon s takeaways daniels gets long awaited win in a battle of attrition for the commanders eagles and those tuned in washington and jayden daniels emerged as survivors and victors there were zero style points but daniels and co rallied from a 10 point deficit in the first quarter as the quarterback stunningly earned his first win since oct 5 2025 battling through injuries in this season and the last daniels had gone 0 7 1 over his last eight starts with washington this one is unlikely to be a triumph he ll put on a highlight reel as the commanders and eagles entered sunday night on a combined eight game winless streak the product was emblematic of the teams travails for the most part daniels however largely avoided big mistakes throwing for 217 yards and an 8 yard touchdown pass to stefon diggs that led to a 10 all score in the second quarter and was part of a 27 0 run for washington daniels and washington have been desperate for a win at 2 4 1 the commanders are still within flailing distance of the nfc east s top spot though that s hard to fathom with the showing regardless dan quinn daniels and the commanders have something to celebrate at the expense of a division rival that is dealing with harder times eagles endure another ugly loss after 10 points and nearly 15 minutes of game time things looked sunny for philadelphia for the first time in a long time the eagles hadn t laid claim to a double digit lead since week 4 unfortunately during a trying season for the eagles in which injuries have taken hold they lost their sixth in a row for the first time in nick sirianni s tenure as a banged up saquon barkley was limited and fill in starter tanner mckee was bamboozled by washington pressure held scoreless following a 3 yard touchdown run by barkley with 4 27 to go in the first quarter the eagles mustered just 268 yards of offense the running game was held to 91 yards and mckee couldn t hold up against the commanders pressure washington racked up a season best five sacks as mckee was pressured 20 times 46 5 pressure rate and it seemed as though he was under duress far more than that despite a roster completely hobbled by injuries this was a winnable game for the eagles but mckee and the offense simply had no answers emblematic of the struggles was philadelphia s best drive of the second half a 15 play odyssey that took up 7 35 it ended with a jake elliott 41 yard field goal attempt clanging off the upright following back to back 5 yard penalties eight games into the season and residing in an nfc east that s hardly a heavyweight division it s still arduous to believe the eagles season isn t done washington wins in trenches in week 7 the eagles defense was shockingly held to six qb pressures no sacks and no tackles for loss in a setback against the cowboys the stats weren t so damning in this one but it still wasn t where it should be credit to the commanders offensive line for that guard samuel cosmi more than held his own against jalen carter carter had one of the eagles two sacks and it came versus cosmi but overall cosmi won this battle allowing the sack and one pressure in 19 matchups including 12 one on ones the pressure and the sack allowed to carter were cosmi s only blemishes in 33 pass block snaps former first round pick josh conerly and center lucas patrick also had commendable showings next gen stats insight for eagles commanders via nfl pro washington generated pressure on 46 5 of dropbacks against philadelphia a season high mark ten pressures and a sack came on 12 blitzes 83 3 the second highest pressure rate by any defense in a game this season minimum five blitzes nfl research the eagles have lost six straight games for the first time since 2012 when philadelphia lost eight in a row from weeks 5 13 it was also the eagles third loss in a row versus an nfc east opponent the first time they ve done so since weeks 9 11 in 2005 philadelphia s 2 6 start is its worst since 1999 andy reid s first year at the helm back to top

news_mentions.headline: Patriots rule out A.J. Brown (ankle/knee), TreVeyon Henderson (illness) for Sunday vs. Dolphins
news_mentions.description: Not long after he returned from injured reserve, the New England Patriots will again be without wide receiver A.J. Brown on Sunday. Brown has been downgraded to out for New England's game against the Miami Dolphins, the team announced Saturday.
news_mentions.body_text: not long after he returned from injured reserve the new england patriots will again be without wide receiver a j brown on sunday brown has been downgraded to out for new england s game against the miami dolphins the team announced saturday the 29 year old wideout missed four games previously with a high ankle sprain and although the ankle ailment is still included on the injury report the reason brown missed the past two days of practices was due to a knee issue flaring up according to nfl network insider ian rapoport brown received a questionable designation on friday but it was determined on saturday that he d be unable to go meaning he ll have appeared in three of new england s first eight games after coming to foxborough via offseason trade from the philadelphia eagles running back treveyon henderson illness and offensive tackle marcus bryant who practiced in full all week with an ankle injury were also both ruled out brown s tenure in new england has not at all gotten off to the start so many had hoped for he s caught only three passes in each of his three games bringing his tally nearing the midway point of the season to nine receptions for 101 yards his speed and movement looked to still be somewhat affected by his high ankle sprain the past two weeks as he s averaged 8 3 yards per reception since returning a far cry from his career average of 15 3 yards per catch with romeo doubs new england s other big offseason acquisition at wr on injured reserve drake maye will need to turn to demario douglas efton chism and kyle williams a heavy dose of rhamondre stevenson can also be expected in henderson s absence plus a mixing in of corey kiner the pats are banged up but they face an exploitable miami defense that ranks 25th in points allowed it s important they still find ways to capitalize and win they re coming off a loss and sitting at 4 3 want to avoid falling any farther behind the afc east leading buffalo bills 5 1 new england squares off against miami at 4 25 p m et on sunday

news_mentions.headline: AFC East training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Bills, Dolphins, Jets, Patriots
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Jeremy Bergman breaks down the top AFC East training camp storylines to monitor for the Buffalo Bills, Miami Dolphins, New England Patriots and New York Jets.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams jeremy bergman has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the buffalo bills miami dolphins new england patriots and new york jets catch up on each afc east team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below buffalo bills miami dolphins new england patriots new york jets three key storylines 1 new era in buffalo for a bills roster that is returning most of its 2025 starters the biggest change this summer will be at the top the start of the joe brady era in buffalo gets underway in earnest when training camp kicks off in late july in taking over for sean mcdermott a sturdy leader who oversaw buffalo s longest period of sustained success since the great marv levy was at the helm brady has a lot to live up to the 36 year old first time head coach was elevated to improve on mcdermott s performance and lift buffalo over the hump and into the super bowl a january title game can t be won in august but the foundation of such an achievement can be built in the summer as it is for all champions brady s job starts and ends with accentuating what josh allen does best freeing up the qb to take further control of the offense the defense mcdermott s specialty has been handed off to ex nfl safety jim leonhard who coached the broncos star dbs over the past couple seasons no team with a new head coach is better positioned to win in 2026 than the bills who made it to the divisional round in 25 brady s first camp must set that tone 2 chubb chasing big season as one of buffalo s only notable offseason additions bradley chubb meets the bills at a critical time for both the team and the player chubb is coming off a solid comeback season from his torn acl logging 8 5 sacks for the dolphins in 2025 and playing a full slate of games for the first time since his rookie campaign the bills are in dire need of a pass rusher after gregory rousseau led the team with just seven sacks last year and joey bosa appears closer to retirement than returning entering the fray alongside second round pick t j parker chubb will be tasked with captaining a front seven that struggled to frustrate trevor lawrence and bo nix in the 2025 postseason chubb 30 has expressed that he s never been hungrier buffalo is starving for a true game wrecker off the edge 3 moore enough or more required the bills have missed stefon diggs draftees khalil shakir and keon coleman and free agent additions josh palmer and brandin cooks haven t quite filled his vacancy over the past couple years buffalo s trade for dj moore is meant to do just that reuniting with brady his ex panthers oc moore has an opportunity to be wr1 for josh allen in buffalo in a way he simply wasn t for caleb williams in chicago in 2025 the seeds of their hopefully fruitful partnership will be sowed in july and august moore admitted to growing pains in the spring but expects perfection this fall after the offseason long onboarding process in addition to providing a sure handed outlet for allen moore will be looked at to bring along the embattled coleman who got called out by owner terry pegula in january and has been under a microscope since if moore can bring coleman along and elevate a middling bills wr room then brady s first year returns could be big back to top three key storylines 1 first look at miami s offensive overhaul tua tagovailoa tyreek hill and jaylen waddle are out malik willis is in while de 39 von achane re upped for the long haul who else will fill out the dolphins offensive roster malik washington returns as a solid pass catching option joined by tutu atwell jalen tolbert terrace marshall and jalen reagor all looking to break out after sidekick roles in nfc receiving rooms imported from the collegiate ranks are chris bell kevin coleman and caleb douglas it s a who s who of who s that in miami s wr corps but somebody s gotta catch passes from willis ahead of what is expected to be a rebuilding year in south florida all eyes at least in the fantasy world will be on the fins wideouts in camp to see who swims and who flounders 2 leaders from the pack how will green bay south look in the heat of a miami summer we re about to find out jeff hafley and jon eric sullivan s first training camp with the dolphins after years with the packers provides the first time nfl head coach and general manager an opportunity to put their imprint on the team green bay camps are typically jovial affairs with oversized players riding undersized bikes alongside community members miami camps held outside one of america s biggest cities have a different feel last year s dolphins camp for one portended the subpar season miami was about to embark on as mike mcdaniel s roster was overwhelmed in joint practices and hampered by the injury bug if hafley and sullivan can avoid that sluggish start they will have already re calibrated the doomish vibes that preceded the 2025 season 3 we re talking about willis from entering the league as a third round pick to signing a three year 67 5 million deal with his third nfl team in four years malik willis is rewriting his nfl story on the fly the quarterback embarks on his first full season as a starter this summer in south beach after shining in a pair of breakout performances in place of jordan love both losses last year in green bay the three year contract implies that he is the qb of the present and immediate future in miami but nothing is assured in this league willis is being thrown into a less than advantageous position quarterbacking a rebuilding roster under a rookie head coach quinn ewers a second year backup with collegiate pedigree and three nfl starts to his name waits in the wings if things go south in south florida and the dolphins slump into top five draft positioning how secure will willis place in miami s future be a standout 2027 qb draft class could be staring sullivan in the face all that is to say willis isn t a made man yet and his first summer as a starter will be a critical one toward establishing himself as a long term answer in miami or elsewhere back to top three key storylines 1 patriots upgraded weaponry after months of rumors and rumblings new england finally completed its trade for disgruntled eagles wideout a j brown in june as the move had been predetermined for months so open a secret that it was never a secret brown wasted no time establishing chemistry with mvp runner up drake maye at minicamp brown has found himself in heaven in new england but how will the other patriots wideouts feel before brown was acquired to provide maye a true wr1 romeo doubs was the big ticket offensive acquisition of the offseason now slotted in as the no 2 doubs should find himself in a role similar to the one he played in green bay thriving on occasion down the roster new england still has mack hollins demario douglas and kayshon boutte for now but it will be interesting to see if kyle williams can break out in his second year since his third round selection the wazzu product caught just 10 passes in his rookie season but found the end zone thrice if williams can step up in training camp ahead of year 2 maye and the reigning afc champs could be in prime position to repeat 2 questions with two defenders ahead of training camp there remain two unsettled availability situations that need monitoring in foxborough the first is that of star cornerback christian gonzalez who s due for a major contract extension after his first pro bowl season gonzalez said during spring work that he wishes to be in new england for the long haul but for a cb of his caliber that means a top of the market deal worth 30 million plus per season something new england may be loath to offer before it has to gonzalez skipped voluntary sessions but showed up for mandatory minicamp what will his strategy be if he doesn t have a deal done by late july gabe jacas meanwhile hasn t practiced with the team since being drafted in the second round the no 55 overall pick remains unsigned and has been away from the club after undergoing an offseason medical procedure about which the pats have provided few details jacas for whom new england traded up in april s draft is behind heading into summer camp which isn t a good sign for the pats pass rusher depth we ll see if the rookie comes into camp signed and ready to break into the starting 11 3 will super bowl loss off field distractions linger the off field story of the offseason has mostly faded out of circulation but questions remain about how new england will bounce back from some messy months to start 2026 the april publication of photos showing patriots coach mike vrabel and former athletic reporter dianna russini at an arizona resort ignited a months long maelstrom of unwanted press in foxborough vrabel took off day 3 of the nfl draft to begin counseling but he was present throughout spring workouts the coach s players have defended him and the team s offseason program seemingly has gone off without a hitch that doesn t mean that when things ramp up in the summer with more coverage and eyeballs further scrutiny of vrabel won t creep in in addition to dealing with the fallout from the photos the pats are looking to recover from a humiliating super bowl defeat and avoid the fate of many a title game loser missing the ensuing postseason ahead of the kickoff game against their super bowl lx foes in seattle vrabel and the pats will be put through the media wringer again how will they respond back to top three key storylines 1 is defense better vetted i m not sure if you heard but the jets defense had zero interceptions last year zilch nada nil over 17 whole games the historic feat and a 31st ranked scoring d inspired general manager darren mougey to totally remake the defense during the offseason new york has since stockpiled veterans familiar jet draftee demario davis jersey native minkah fitzpatrick and fresh t 39 vondre sweat david onyemata joseph ossai nahshon wright add on two top rookies no 2 pick david bailey national champ d angelo ponds and the jets are projected to have upwards of eight new defensive starters in 26 the leadership of davis fitzpatrick and returning dl harrison phillips should provide a foundation that was sorely lacking from aaron glenn s first unit but camp will bear out whether the new look group with a first time dc in brian duker has a chance to keep new york in games this season or at the very least take the ball away 2 the return of the geno gang green s latest qb makeover reunites geno smith with the team that drafted him in the 2013 second round a few so so years and a broken jaw ended his initial jets run but the signal caller now 35 is back in florham park with more years under his belt ready to rewrite his narrative surrounding him is the most talented crop of playmakers new york has had in years garrett wilson and breece hall anchor the returning skill players while adonai mitchell and rookies kenyon sadiq and omar cooper get their first full seasons with the jets a steady o line is returning four of five starters dylan parham is set to replace left guard john simpson frank reich is in for the ousted tanner engstrand as offensive coordinator bringing a veteran presence with a track record of coaching a super bowl winning offense in philadelphia how quickly can the jets jell into a more potent attack their summer sessions will provide the first glimpse one thing to monitor smith is reportedly under investigation for battery in florida the qb has yet to comment on the matter 3 jets in five in the streets of manhattan millions of fans rejoiced after the knicks half century long title drought was broken in thrilling fashion in the nba finals the throng of excitement unleashed a positive unifying energy not seen around new york sports in quite some time roughly 35 miles west in florham park new jersey the jets are going through their own drought of sorts fifteen years without postseason football twenty three seasons with no division title fifty seven campaigns sans a super bowl title breece hall who witnessed the game 5 title securing victory was among jets players this spring who expressed positive jealousy over the knicks fortune aaron glenn said he wishes to replicate mike brown s clutch players competitive stamina with his guys will the summer of love continue across the hudson is curse breaking contagious camp may offer clues back to top
