news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams michael baca has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc south catch up on the atlanta falcons offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 23 rookie veterans location ibm performance field flowery branch georgia fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs detroit lions 7 p m et on friday aug 8 week 2 vs tennessee titans 7 p m et nfl network on friday aug 15 week 3 at dallas cowboys 8 p m et nfl network on friday aug 22 2025 schedule note for the second consecutive season the falcons will open the campaign with four of their first five games against teams that made the playoffs the year before nfl research what you need to know 1 following a dramatic and underwhelming season at quarterback which saw kirk cousins lose his job to michael penix the falcons will put their best foot forward in order to achieve harmony under center penix this season s unquestioned starting qb looks to finely tune his role after showing flashes along his three starts as a rookie entering his second training camp the strong armed lefty now has ample time to establish a rapport with a pass catching corps that remains largely unchanged and to grow into his role as the offense s leading voice over the summer cousins meanwhile appears to have accepted his fate as a backup at this juncture making for what could be a peculiar scene if the high priced qb sees plenty of action in the preseason moreover if cousins 36 looks improved another year removed from a torn achilles could other teams reignite a trade discussion 2 atlanta s mission to improve its pass rush continued with a splashy first round in april s draft selecting jalon walker at no 15 overall before trading back into round 1 to take james pearce 10 picks later walker a product of georgia and last year s butkus award winner was seen as one of top pass rushing prospects but pearce s selection one achieved by trading away next year s first round pick was one of the more surprising developments of the 2025 nfl draft walker and pearce s progression throughout training camp and in the preseason ought to be keenly observed considering the heavy investment the falcons who hired jeff ulbrich as their new defensive coordinator also signed leonard floyd this offseason as part of revamping a pass rush that finished 31st in the league in sacks 31 last season 3 training camp and preseason is where kicking competitions thrive and there s a compelling one brewing in atlanta following younghoe koo s down season the falcons signed german born kicker lenny krieg to a three year deal that includes a signing bonus and a base salary guarantee that kind of contract doesn t come often in the international market but it came after krieg impressed at the international player pathway program s pro day koo who s held the job the past six seasons generated a career low 73 5 field goal percentage and his struggles cost the falcons a game down the stretch with three missed kicks in a three point loss koo and krieg s battle over the next two months could provide the scintillating moments we look for as we prepare for the oncoming season

news_mentions.headline: NFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for 49ers, Cardinals, Rams, Seahawks
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Arizona Cardinals, Los Angeles Rams, San Francisco 49ers and Seattle Seahawks.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers and seattle seahawks catch up on each nfc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks three key storylines 1 sorting out brissett s contract drama installing rookie head coach mike lafleur s offense certainly hasn t gone off without a hitch jacoby brissett who took the quarterbacking reins from an injured kyler murray last season and never gave them back is the presumed starter and wants to get paid like one having skipped voluntary workouts brissett reported for mandatory minicamp to avoid fines but just how much actual work he got in isn t all that apparent will brissett hold out or hold in during training camp that threatens to become a prevailing topic in arizona even if it all gets sorted out the whole matter of getting ready for the football season remains lafleur has downplayed brissett s lack of offseason involvement citing the 33 year old s experience in the league but this is hardly a splendid way to kick off your head coaching career the good news is brissett threw for a career best 3 366 yards in 12 starts during a tumultuous 3 14 season in 2025 if the journeyman settles harmoniously into lafleur s offense perhaps improvement or at least a little excitement lies ahead for the cards 2 a whole lotta love right jeremiyah love could be the most anticipated 2026 rookie in the league at least on the offensive side all due respect to no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza but love s talent and eye popping ability is off the charts so much so that the cardinals used the third overall selection of the draft on him guaranteeing the 21 year old more money than any running back in nfl history there were plenty of question marks with the pick though the cardinals have holes aplenty on their roster but having signed tyler allgeier as a free agent and bringing back veteran banger james conner running back was far from the most glaring weakness in the end love was just too special a talent to pass up so how will lafleur handle his rookie love has made it clear he s a team first guy and on the franchise s current timeline immediately using love as a bell cow might not be wise even if it makes sense monetarily and to a fan base that would love to do nothing more than get behind a bona fide star we shall see 3 time for a new era over the previous two years the cardinals plucked three first round picks wide receiver marvin harrison 2024 no 4 overall and defensive linemen darius robinson 2024 no 27 and walter nolen 2025 no 16 that trio has combined to play 53 of a potential 85 games robinson 21 games in two years and nolen six games as a rookie have combined for four sacks and 12 starts harrison 103 receptions 1 493 yards and 12 touchdowns in 29 games has likely been the most disappointing seen as a can t miss selection who s floundered or at the least failed to live up to his pedigree as a top five pick after seven seasons kyler murray is gone after three years jonathan gannon is gone there s a new coach in lafleur and whether it s brissett more than likely gardner minshew or rookie carson beck there will be a new week 1 starting quarterback love looks every bit the can t miss sensation harrison seemed to be it s pivotal for the homegrown talent to blossom staying healthy is the first step meshing with lafleur is the next and that ll begin in earnest later this month back to top three key storylines 1 refacing defense around garrett the rams don t mess around when it comes to making a super bowl push having traded for then broncos pass rusher von miller before adding wide receiver odell beckham ahead of their run to super bowl lvi triumph the rams shook up this offseason by trading for myles garrett already an all time pass rushing great who s coming off a year in which he set a new single season sack record that move put an enormous cherry on top of an already rich roster but you can t crown a champion before the super bowl and just how well garrett meshes in defensive coordinator chris shula s system will be something to monitor during camp shula s already stated he s going to let garrett do what he does best while still sticking to his schematic principles byron young team high 12 sacks kobie turner seven and braden fiske three combined for 22 sacks last season with garrett s record breaking 23 ostensibly replacing jared verse s 7 5 as verse was sent to the browns nothing s easy in the nfl though this isn t copy and paste under former cleveland defensive coordinator jim schwartz garrett was a one man pass rushing gang racking up 51 sacks over the past three seasons he s arguably the finest quarterback menace of this century just how brightly he ll shine in l a will start to come into focus over the next few weeks 2 time to make the offseason count if there were offseason trophies to hand out los angeles would likely be first in line still for as loaded as this roster is it s imperative the rams stiff arm distractions and keep their heads from getting too high into the clouds puka nacua has a looming potentially top of the market extension and he needs to continue working on himself after a stint in rehab l a already caused a stir when it shocked the nfl world by drafting quarterback ty simpson with the 13th overall pick simpson who remains unsigned is battling it out with stetson bennett to back up reigning mvp matthew stafford who s coming back for his age 38 season there were also trade rumblings regarding davante adams but it seems like those are in the past meanwhile the rams added cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson from the chiefs corners who shine in kansas city don t always star elsewhere speaking of the chiefs their head coach andy reid once helmed an eagles squad dubbed the dream team after a haul of splendid offseason adds said dream team nightmarishly missed the playoffs nothing from an nfl offseason is guaranteed this l a story is all about winning a super bowl no reason for subplots with so much potential for greatness sean mcvay needs to keep his boys eyes on the prize 3 even with the reigning mvp rams have offensive questions regardless of how long in the tooth stafford is the 2025 nfl mvp is still brilliant in the arm like few others in the league he can spin it and make the mesmerizing look normal his league leading 4 707 yards and 46 touchdown tosses last season came with a talented but shallow receiver stable nacua led the nfl with 129 receptions adams contributed 60 grabs with an nfl high 14 going for tds l a didn t have another receiver with more than 18 catches that s one of the reasons drafting simpson when wide receivers makai lemon kc concepcion and omar cooper were still available was so puzzling konata mumpfield jordan whittington and sixth round rookie cj daniels could be the main depth pieces at wr leaders of the league s 13 personnel movement the rams have a staggering herd of tight ends with the most notable being colby parkinson tyler higbee terrance ferguson and rookie max klare ferguson only caught 11 passes as a rookie but he and parkinson could offer the most upside in the receiving game the nfl s no 1 offense in 2025 is expected to run it back in precision form but some fine tuning might lay ahead back to top three key storylines 1 getting healthy staying healthy is key conspiracy theorists can place the blame on electromagnetic fields from a nearby substation but for whatever reason injury woes have plagued kyle shanahan s squads for years niners starters missed north of 50 games in 2025 at the moment the anticipated returns of defensive end nick bosa torn acl missed 14 games tight end george kittle hamstring tear ankle sprain achilles tear six games and linebacker fred warner broken and dislocated ankle 11 games are atop the queue san francisco went 12 5 last season and advanced to the divisional round with those three who are each perennially regarded as among the best at their respective positions missing significant time warner is good to go bosa expects to be ready around the start of camp and kittle is working to return for week 1 however maintaining health is the key christian mccaffrey missed 13 games in 2024 but rebounded with an nfl high and career high 413 touches keeping cmc and the rest of the 49ers all star cast healthy has to be the top priority in camp and beyond there is no shortage of talent on the team san francisco just needs to keep it on the field to stay on pace in the shark infested nfc west 2 figuring out the wr room signing away mike evans from the buccaneers was a immense boon but he s missed 12 games over the past two seasons and will celebrate his 33rd birthday in august it s imperative that the stockpile of younger wideouts improves and the veteran adds of evans and christian kirk still have tread on the tires previous mainstays jauan jennings and deebo samuel are gone the latter is a free agent after a year with washington and it wouldn t be a shocker to see a reunion in san francisco jennings signed late in the offseason with the vikings brandon aiyuk is still technically with the team but is on the reserve left squad list while continually trolling the 49ers and plenty of others in video missives as evans and kirk get acclimated to quarterback brock purdy and shanahan s offense 2024 first rounder ricky pearsall faces a crucial camp needing to overcome past injuries and calamity to truly emerge similar things can be said about recent picks jacob cowing 2024 fourth rounder and jordan watkins 25 fourth rounder de 39 zhaun stribling taken in the second round this spring as the team s top draft choice profiles as perhaps the best replacement yet for samuel it s time for the fresh faces to step up in the passing game 3 defense must improve under a nother new dc from 2021 through 23 the 49ers were a top 10 defense in points and yards allowed the first two years in that span featured demeco ryans as defensive coordinator the current texans head coach has clearly left a large void steve wilks lasted just the 2023 season despite the team s super bowl run and overall great statistics third in points eighth in yards raheem morris is the next defensive coordinator up replacing robert saleh who was hired as the titans head coach after replacing 2024 dc nick sorensen as the fifth niners defensive play caller in five seasons morris should be helped hugely by the returns of fred warner and nick bosa but developing young talent ranks right up there with staying healthy when it comes to improving on last year s no 20 ranking in total d most glaringly the 2025 49ers finished dead last in team sacks with just 20 myles garrett now a division rival had 23 sacks on his own also on the injury comeback trail 2025 first rounder mykel williams bosa and williams getting healed up is a start the acquisition of defensive tackle osa odighizuwa in a trade with the cowboys might prove to be a pivotal move while the return of linebacker dre greenlaw after a lost year in denver could also bode well rookie third rounder romello height has already garnered some positive reports and alfred collins made a great first year impression morris might well be joining the 49ers at the right time back to top three key storylines 1 darnold staying on point sam darnold authored a storybook tale last season once viewed as a mega bust darnold quarterbacked the seahawks his fourth nfl team following the jets who used the 2018 nfl draft s third overall pick on him to a super bowl title darnold seemingly exorcised the ghosts of his past but he is still only 29 and has plenty to play for he s back with the pressure of defending a championship can he provide an encore earn a lucrative extension and keep seattle atop the league new offensive coordinator brian fleury s system is similar to the departed klint kubiak s but change is change and darnold must learn the differences continuity in the receiving corps should help with jaxon smith njigba leading a group that also includes cooper kupp jake bobo and rashid shaheed the last of whom should command a bigger role in the aerial attack after re signing on a lucrative deal in march furthermore tory horton flashed as a rookie last season before suffering a shin injury the speedster s return could have a dynamic domino effect adding another bona fide threat at receiver and another big play option in the return game which could open up more possibilities for shaheed in both avenues there s also optimism for a major breakout at tight end aj barner who scored the seahawks only offensive touchdown in the super bowl became a dude in his second season 52 receptions 519 yards six tds and might well become a pro bowl caliber player in year 3 if his chemistry with darnold continues 2 what s the frequency without kenneth with kenneth walker having signed with kansas city and zach charbonnet acl most likely absent to begin the season all eyes will be on first round draft pick jadarian price the notre dame product is a smooth runner who averaged 6 yards per carry in his career with the fighting irish however he was jeremiyah love s understudy and had 15 plus touches just once in his 41 games at nd the seahawks were adamant in balancing walker and charbonnet last season before the latter was injured asking price to take on a bell cow workload would seem unlikely camp could preview what kind of roles are in store for other backs like george holani and emanuel wilson perhaps rashid shaheed could be used a bit in the run game too the wide receiver corps along with the charles cross led offensive line are the offensive strengths but seattle wants balance that starts with price and will take shape before week 1 3 can seahawks avoid noise again in case you might have forgotten and judging by the lack of offseason pomp and circumstance many have the seahawks are the reigning super bowl champions for a franchise that boasts one of the loudest home field advantages the volume for a post lombardi offseason has seemingly been turned down to negative 11 that seems to be the preference for mike macdonald s seahawks though they snuck up on some people last season and after winning the most arduous division in football trounced the patriots in the super bowl this year jaxon smith njigba s not going to catch anyone by surprise the reigning offensive player of the year had a fine 2024 hitting 100 catches and exceeding 1 100 yards but he was an absolute force last season leading the league with 1 793 receiving yards and quickly erasing any doubt as to how the passing game would fare without dk metcalf also while jsn got paid this offseason his fellow 2023 first rounder devon witherspoon has yet to posing a potential problem for the seahawks right guard anthony bradford started all 17 games last year his third season in a row of starting the majority of the seahawks games he garnered a 51 9 overall pff grade which ranked 70th among the 81 guards who took at least 300 snaps could fifth rounder beau stephens replace him and solidify a longtime sore spot for seattle s starting lineup general manager john schneider was able to keep most of the lombardi band together but losing walker outside linebacker boye mafe cornerback tariq woolen and safety coby bryant isn t nothing keeping everything quiet and copacetic is far more difficult when you re defending champs so it s paramount for macdonald and schneider to figure out any issues before they grow into problems back to top

subplots across the nfc west catch up on the los angeles rams offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 23 rookies and veterans location loyola marymount university los angeles california fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs dallas cowboys 7 p m et on saturday aug 9 week 2 vs los angeles chargers 7 p m et on and the 2024 s season s best team the super bowl champion eagles in week 3 with both on the road nfl research what you need to know 1 on the heels of an nfc west championship season in which they took recent track record it s enticing to see how these rookies come along considering l a s recent success drafting at certain positions it s arduous not to be fascinated by the potential of third round news_mentions.description: Around The NFL breaks down what you need to know from Sunday's action in Week 8 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 8 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below early window buffalo bills 36 baltimore ravens 10 cincinnati bengals 43 tennessee titans 36 ot arizona cardinals 33 dallas cowboys 30 ot detroit lions 19 minnesota vikings 15 jacksonville jaguars 42 indianapolis colts 7 las vegas raiders 38 new york jets 33 pittsburgh steelers 27 cleveland browns 6 tampa bay buccaneers 16 atlanta falcons 0 late window los angeles rams 24 los angeles chargers 9 denver broncos 28 kansas city chiefs 24 new england patriots 24 miami dolphins 19 sunday night washington commanders 27 philadelphia eagles 10 nick shook s takeaways bills let hunters loose buffalo s biggest underlying question mark was its defense a leaky unit that struggled to get stops and limit opposing offenses in what became weekly shootouts for the bills that finally changed for the better on sunday with lamar jackson exiting quickly and tyler huntley back in the lineup buffalo decided it was time to hunt the quarterback dialing up blitzes and registering pressures on half of huntley s four passes which also incidentally forced huntley out of the game due to injury once undrafted rookie joe fagnano took over the carnivorous bills saw nothing but red meat blitzing on 64 5 of their total defensive snaps logging qb pressures at a rate of 61 3 and short circuiting baltimore s offense all afternoon the ravens finished with just 144 net yards of offense scored their only touchdown via a short field earned by a broderick washington interception and couldn t piece together more than one drive of significance which ended in a 26 yard tyler loop field goal buffalo s defense made sure it wouldn t allow derrick henry to carry the ravens and denied fagnano the space to breathe overwhelming the inexperienced signal caller in a runaway win quarterback injuries decimate ravens lamar jackson s anticipated return lasted just one snap his first pass attempt fell incomplete and on the follow through to his throw jackson s thumb collided with a defender s hand resulting in an injury that will land jackson on injured reserve for the foreseeable future after a few weeks of backup turned starter duty tyler huntley found himself on the field sunday appearing skittish and struggling to gain a single yard through the air before an injury knocked him out of action as well leaving the ravens with their emergency third qb joe fagnano as their only remaining option the uconn product gave his best effort but was constantly under duress leaving the ravens with little room to move the ball all afternoon zay flowers went without a catch on five targets rashod bateman s one catch for 22 yards accounted for the most receiving production for any raven and running back justice hill led baltimore in receptions with four it was a lifeless offense that left the ravens defense on the field for far too long buffalo won the time of possession battle 37 36 to 22 24 and sunday s display should rightfully worry ravens fans about their team s outlook for the remainder of 2026 it sounds as if jackson s season could be finished and recent results without him including sunday are discouraging at best moore delivers in return after missing a handful of weeks buffalo welcomed back its prized offseason acquisition d j moore who showed no signs of hesitancy and delivered a strong outing four catches 82 yards including a spectacular grab for 49 yards to set up a james cook touchdown and a touchdown catch moore s return helped draw some attention away from buffalo s tight ends dalton kincaid finished with a team best 86 yards and a touchdown on four catches took a bit of pressure off cook and unlocked enough of the unit s attack to help the bills climb out of a grind it out start to pour it on in the second half moore s rapport with josh allen remains strong even after the time off and helped allen pass jim kelly for the franchise s all time lead in touchdowns 260 now moore will need to prove he can be this reliable on a weekly basis next gen stats insight for ravens bills via nfl pro the bills blitzed on 64 5 of opposing dropbacks against the ravens in week 8 their highest blitz rate since 2021 and the highest blitz rate ravens quarterbacks have faced this season the bills blitz rate had not exceeded 39 in any of their prior six games this season when blitzing the bills generated 11 pressures including a season high seven quick pressures under 2 5 seconds and three sacks including a strip sack fumble recovery in the second quarter nfl research josh allen and james cook each had a rushing touchdown in week 8 marking the 16th time that allen and cook have scored a rushing touchdown in the same game sixteen games breaks a tie with dak prescott and ezekiel elliott for the most games by any teammate duo in nfl history in which both players had a rushing touchdown back to top bobby kownack s takeaways burrow was everything good bad about bengals offense what a roller coaster performance by joe burrow the cincy quarterback unquestionably served as the team s hero accounting for six touchdowns in an unexpected shootout with the titans but his three interceptions contributed initially to a slow start and later allowed tennessee to stay in it two of those picks were deep heaves to ja 39 marr chase with one way overthrown and another that came up far too short if you re going to make mistakes though make sure you make up for them burrow did that and more piling on the points and feeding his top two receivers to great success tee higgins had 10 catches for 155 yards and two tds on 11 targets while chase tallied 11 receptions for 141 yards and a score on 16 looks burrow also importantly cleaned it up in crunch time of his five drives that took place in the fourth quarter or overtime one ended in a chase brown fumble and the other ticked down the final 17 seconds to the extra frame on the other three burrow marched his bengals 73 81 and 70 yards throwing two touchdowns and scoring the game winner on a 9 yard scramble he finished with 426 yards five tds and three ints on 38 of 48 passing marking his third consecutive game with at least four passing touchdowns it s a bit scary how many points the bengals put up despite four giveaways and that s all credit to burrow standout performances not enough for tennessee there was not an ounce of quit in the titans after trading away their best player defensive tackle jeffery simmons on thursday the defense still generated four takeaways the most it has had in a game this season safety amani hooker had joe burrow s number intercepting him a whopping three times while defensive end jacob martin tallied three sacks and linebacker anthony hill was relentless with 14 tackles on offense cam ward enjoyed by far his best game of the season despite being without carnell tate ward dissected cincinnati s defense with regularity going 26 of 40 for 304 yards and two touchdowns snapping a five game interception streak and nearly doubling his average of 168 4 passing yards per game he led two separate go ahead td drives in the fourth quarter plus tony pollard continued his recent resurgence rushing for 117 yards and two scores after going for 129 and three tds in week 7 his 40 yard touchdown to open the scoring will be one of the highlights of the day in his or any game with pollard breaking multiple tackles before stiff arming one bengals defender into another s path in a keystone cops sequence on the way to pay dirt of course it was still not enough for the 1 7 titans but the fight they showed was admirable regardless of the nfl s aversion to moral victories concerning trends taking shape for bengals the most important result from sunday is the bengals moving to 5 2 in a highly competitive afc north however there are some underlying issues still plaguing cincinnati the bengals found themselves trailing 13 0 for the second straight week this deficit came at the end of the first quarter unlike last week s halftime hole against the ravens and the bengals started picking it up much earlier to go into intermission with a lead but they couldn t pull away like they did in baltimore instead the titans pushed them to overtime taking advantage of a defense that forced a pair of turnovers but couldn t get enough stops to make things easy in the past three games the bengals have needed to outlast a one win titans team in overtime looked asleep for far too long facing backup quarterback tyler huntley and let a then winless dolphins squad make things uncomfortable late before that it was two straight losses those who choose optimism will point to the bengals record and their three game winning streak but venturing through a season as escape artists typically catches up down the line next gen stats insight for titans bengals via nfl pro amani hooker picked off joe burrow three times which included 15 3 expected points added across five targets in coverage the second most coverage epa by a player in a game this season hooker allowed only 12 yards in coverage on the day nfl research joe burrow became just the second quarterback in league history to have 450 plus passing yards five plus passing tds and a rushing td in a game joining norm van brocklin week 1 1951 back to top nick shook s takeaways qb change sparks comeback through nearly three quarters the cardinals were repeating the same frustrating offensive performance that had become all too familiar in recent weeks jacoby brissett was under constant pressure and resorting to throws that amounted to little more than prayers and after watching brissett take two consecutive sacks for double digit negative yardage in the third quarter coach mike lafleur had enough calling for gardner minshew to replace the battered brissett oddly enough the quarterback change coincided with a revival of the running game that depended solely on tyler allgeier after jeremiyah love left with another ankle injury and bam knight was knocked out of action due to a concussion allgeier put the team on his back rushing 11 times for 147 yards and a touchdown and repeatedly turning to the sideline oxygen tank as a means of survival minshew meanwhile created a rhythm in the passing game that the cardinals haven t enjoyed in over a month completing 17 of 23 passes for 188 yards and three touchdowns including a magnificent final touchdown drive that covered 80 yards in eight plays and 1 03 to tie the game and balancing the offense by turning to michael wilson plenty eight catches 111 yards one touchdown arizona pulled off this 23 point outburst and improbable comeback after losing love knight and receiver kendrick bourne maximizing its returns with its remaining contributors with just enough time to escape defeat it will likely prompt a quarterback change and could be a minor springboard forward for a team that was desperate for a morale boosting win like this cowboys collapse could have devastating effect dallas will look back at this game and have no choice but to admit this was its worst loss of 2026 entering the final minute of the third quarter the cowboys were in control holding a 17 3 lead that was all but guaranteed to eventually become 20 3 or larger in that moment though their defense broke down surrendering a rumbling 63 yard touchdown run to tyler allgeier the first of a few massive chunks gained by allgeier in the final 16 minutes of regulation on a 52 yard allgeier run in the fourth quarter safety caleb downs got pancaked by hjalte froholdt twice in the same play typifying arizona s sudden takeover with the image of downs tumbling across the turf like a runaway cheese wheel speeding down a hill this all happened after dallas had suffocated arizona s offense for the first 44 minutes of the game and the cardinals awakening delivered repeated violent blows to the ribcage of the cowboys defense landing a liver punch in the form of a michael wilson dependent touchdown drive to tie the game in the final six seconds of regulation a quick defensive stop and a 44 yard scoring drive in overtime sent the cowboys to the mat for good resulting in one of the most stunning outcomes of the entire nfl season this type of loss can send a team into a spiral could cost defensive coordinator christian parker his job and will undoubtedly cause cowboys fans to angrily punch the air the same problems persist they still can t beat the lowly cardinals in texas and the solutions continue to prove fleeting arizona s rebuilt backfield disintegrates but one pillar remains standing tyler allgeier s second half outburst produced a victory for the cardinals but it was even more triumphant for a workhorse who has often been left to the shadows of more recognizable running mates in atlanta and arizona the talk at the start of the season revolved around first round pick jeremiyah love and when the cardinals couldn t generate consistently on the ground love s absence was quickly blamed allgeier never quite saw the chances he needed to blossom but found himself in an unexpected moment of opportunity sunday when love and bam knight exited due to injury he could have played an average brand of football as the lone remaining runner available but that s not allgeier those who were unfamiliar with his style were reminded rudely on his 63 yard touchdown run in which he broke three tackles and followed a trio of teammates who escorted him to the goal line where he fell across it for a score while finally being brought down that touchdown made it a 17 10 game but more importantly it gave the cardinals reason to believe his ensuing 52 yarder saw hjalte froholdt get out in front and wreck caleb downs in open space setting an aggressive tone embodied by the runner benefitting from the blocking in those two plays and gardner minshew s stint as a mid game replacement the cardinals brought the fight to the cowboys refusing to lay down despite a double digit deficit and little reason to believe they d turn things around because of allgeier s toughness determination and relentless desire to produce when called upon he also caught five passes for 44 yards and an incredibly gritty touchdown reception the cardinals pulled off the stunning win and might have found a new identity in the process next gen stats insight for cardinals cowboys via nfl pro tyler allgeier carried the ball 11 times for 147 yards and a touchdown in week 8 against the cowboys including three explosive gains of 10 or more yards after totaling just two explosive gains across 61 carries over the first seven weeks of the season allgeier recorded a 63 yard touchdown run on arizona s final play from scrimmage in the third quarter before opening the cardinals next drive with a 52 yard scamper he gained 96 rushing yards over expected the most by a cardinals rusher in a game since at least 2018 additionally allgeier finished as the cardinals third leading receiver catching all five targets for 44 yards and a touchdown nfl research the cardinals last second touchdown positioned them to kick a go ahead extra point with 0 06 remaining sunday but chad ryland pushed his attempt wide left entering the cardinals into some exclusive and undesirable company they became the third team to miss a go ahead pat in the final 10 seconds of regulation joining the bengals week 1 2022 and buccaneers week 2 2003 back to top kevin patra s takeaways lions run over undefeated vikings to close gap in nfc north detroit figured out the best way to combat brian flores relentless pressure packages go to the ground after falling behind 15 12 midway through the fourth quarter detroit ran the ball on 11 of its final 13 non kneel plays one of those two jared goff throws was the go ahead touchdown toss to jameson williams detroit leaned on jahmyr gibbs and bruising backup sione vaki gibbs blasted his way to 153 rushing yards and a td on 23 carries while vaki chipped in 11 totes for 65 yards detroit getting production from vaki is a positive sign for the lions down the stretch the lions couldn t get out of their way early with miscues hampering dan campbell s club including some bad penalties goff missed passes early and threw his first interception of the season when williams slipped on a route detroit put up just six points and goff was sacked four times through two quarters then the run game took over allowing the qb to utilize play action and wear down the vikings d it wasn t a perfect game for the home squad but the offense perked up late when needed to close out a big win that bunches the division even closer it was a need to have home game for detroit dan campbell s crew came up clutch in the end vikings offensive struggles continued it was only a matter of time before brian flores defense couldn t carry the day minnesota has been playing on the razor s edge through its first six wins with the defense spearheading wins while the offense was along for the ride against a high powered lions offense flores defense did enough forcing a turnover early field goals and a pivotal late three and out yes the defense ran out of gas against jahmyr gibbs late but kevin o connell s offense needed to do more kyler murray managed the game early but missed too many throws particularly high which led to stalled drives nearly a quarter of murray s 210 yards 24 3 came on a 51 yard bomb to jordan addison the qb missed several other shots right now murray isn t a station to station passer when the big plays don t connect the vikings offense struggles against a lions defense that entered with the worst pass d in the nfl and allowing the most yards murray came up small the vikings generated just 266 yards and 15 first downs going 3 for 10 on third down and 0 for 1 on fourth down isn t winning offense koc needs his offense to find itself at the start of a tough stretch of games right now it s not close detroit s defense stepped up for the second straight week kelvin sheppard s defense has played up a level the defensive line particularly the interior pestered kyler murray alim mcneill led the way with four qb pressures and one sack the secondary did a better job sticking with vikings receivers where we d seen wrs scamper wide open early in the season detroit s secondary at least challenged most plays cornerback d j reed was having his best game including a diving int and a big late pass breakup before leaving with an injury when the defensive line is getting pressure and the secondary plays on a string it s a workable defense the issue sheppard faces now is that he lost a trove of players on sunday star linebacker jack campbell was taken to a local hospital after suffering a neck injury d j wonnum and brian branch each exited with concussions after a collision rookie linebacker jimmy rolder suffered a hamstring injury reed s was a hip can an already shaky unit overcome injuries moving forward next gen stats insight for lions vikings via nfl pro the vikings blitzed on 26 of 29 dropbacks 89 7 in their week 8 loss against the lions the highest blitz rate by a team since at least 2018 breaking the previous record held by the vikings set last week against the colts 85 2 when blitzed jared goff completed 17 passes tied for the most against the blitz in a game this season for 130 yards a touchdown and an interception goff was sacked a season high three times on six pressures when blitzed nfl research jahmyr gibbs became the fifth player in nfl history prior to age 25 to have at least 1 000 scrimmage yards and 10 plus touchdowns in their team s first seven games of a season joining christian mccaffrey 2019 edgerrin james 2000 eric dickerson 1983 and jim brown 1958 back to top kevin patra s takeaways jags stampede floundering colts good teams don t just beat bad ones they take their soul jacksonville is a good team liam coen s squad walloped its division rival in every facet from the start the jaguars blasted indianapolis with an offensive barrage and smothering defense for a team that s struggled at times in the red zone coen s club simply avoided that area splashing scores from distance of the jags five offensive touchdowns only one came inside the red zone jacksonville ripped through a limp colts defense for scores of 31 yards 39 28 and 25 yards pass protection had some concerns but trevor lawrence overcame them side stepping pressure and ripping passes to wide open targets the mvp candidate generated 210 yards and three touchdowns on 10 of 14 attempts before taking a seat for the bulk of the fourth quarter jacksonville ran over the colts earning 183 rushing yards and two tds with bhayshul tuten leading the way 16 104 1 tuten was a tackle breaking maven earning 159 scrimmage yards and two scores have a day rayuan lane jaguars safety rayuan lane snagged a flubbed catch by colts tight end tyler warren and scampered the other way for a 92 yard pick six late in the second quarter the play was the cherry on top of a big day for the navy product who made his second career start and netted three tackles a qb hit and three passes defensed lane making plays after being thrust into significant action highlights a defense that came in waves sunday anthony campanile s defense forced three turnovers held the colts to 243 total yards and 4 1 yards per play jacksonville stymied jonathan taylor holding the veteran back to 2 9 yards per carry and discombobulated daniel jones a stingy run defense combined with sticky coverage on the back end is a recipe for a smothering unit a defense that forces turnovers and an offense that can generate explosives is a formula for blowout wins colts crumbling amid a fire sale shane steichen s squad played like a crew that knows the season is all but over awful tackling missed reps terrible penalties flubbed catches head scratching passes bad blocking porous coverage you name it the colts messed it up daniel jones continued to struggle missing passes and looking flustered in the pocket the first int wasn t his fault the second certainly was jones has been unable to overcome bad surroundings looking like the quarterback who wore out his welcome in new york jones finished 19 of 28 passing for 144 yards one td and two ints before being replaced by anthony richardson jonathan taylor scampered for 19 yards on his first touch he did little else the rest of the contest earning eight rushes for 23 yards and catching four passes for 24 yards he also fumbled on a trick play it might have been taylor s last game in indy most colts players seemed to play like their time in town could be coming to an end if steichen keeps his job beyond monday morning he ll have to do a much better job preparing and motivating his players next gen stats insight for jaguars colts via nfl pro trevor lawrence generated 15 0 yards per attempt the most in a game in his career much of that production came against zone coverage where he completed seven of nine passes for 167 yards and all three of his touchdowns lawrence was also efficient on play action connecting on four of five attempts for 124 yards and a touchdown nfl research bhayshul tuten is the first jaguars player to rush for 100 plus yards score a rushing touchdown record 50 plus receiving yards and a receiving td in the same game back to top jeremy bergman s takeaways raiders snap losing streak as cousins staves off mendoza klint kubiak gave kirk cousins a vote of confidence early in the week definitively declaring him the starting qb as calls for no 1 pick fernando mendoza increased amid las vegas four game skid consider kubiak and cousins vindicated the only thing that had been working for the raiders worked again on sunday afternoon picking up a leaky sometimes absent defense cousins was efficient and error free completing 19 of 26 passes for 247 yards to just four pass catchers two tight ends one running back one wide receiver after leading just one scoring drive in the first half the raiders offense under cousins was nearly flawless in the final two frames scoring three straight touchdowns out of the half and finding a game sealing field goal at the end of a clock killing drive at the end of the fourth quarter as much as we would all like to see mendoza get some reps just for curiosity s sake it s not prudent for the raiders to move away from kirko chainz as long as he s still moving the chains he s a steadying presence and a rising tide and las vegas gauntlet only gets tougher from here games against san francisco seattle denver and cleveland await before its december bye it s kirk s offense until the wheels call off jets run out of fuel again a running theme of the aaron glenn jets has been their inability to finish plays possessions games awareness of the problem has yet to lead to a remedy sunday s loss to las vegas was the latest example geno smith and the jets came out of the gates on fire reaching at least the raiders 21 yard line on each of their first six drives a run that extended into the third quarter in place of breece hall braelon allen was a force again running for 121 yards in the first half alone finished with 147 yards on 21 totes adonai mitchell career high 142 yards and garrett wilson 83 yards were big time chain movers all day but of those six opening scoring drives new york found the end zone just thrice keeping the game within reach for the raiders into the second half by the time las vegas forced its first punt with 1 33 to go in the third it was in striking distance to take the lead which it did because of course the jets found themselves back in the raiders red zone down four points with 5 24 to go in position to take a lead deep in the fourth but after three plays with no gain new york kicked its fourth field goal of the day of under 40 yards the jets had little time to launch a game winning drive after the raiders pushed their lead to five but reached las vegas 35 before smith launched an ill advised interception with seven seconds remaining new york s second half collapse would be more frustrating if it was more out of character but blowing opportunities in the red zone and in the win column is gang green s calling card at this point it doesn t get any easier for the 2 6 jets with the chiefs and bills up next an 11th straight losing season is in sight jeanty takes back seat to rookie ashton jeanty spent the week calling out the jets defense as a get right unit for the raiders run game he was right just not for him jeanty was relegated to a third down role against new york ceding starting reps to mike washington the fourth round rookie logged a career high 83 yards on 25 carries the most by any raiders rb this season it wasn t the most efficient outing but washington was a much more solid contributor in the lead role than jeanty had been in his previous three games 64 yards on 28 carries jeanty wasn t completely absent from the game however and played a crucial role on las vegas fourth quarter drive to take the lead breaking free for a 45 yard catch and run to flip the field he finished with just 9 rushing yards on two carries season low 22 snaps but jeanty proved once again that he is more useful to this offense in a pass catching role will las vegas solidify these roles in the weeks to come and if so how will the former produced three of the franchise s top 10 single game rushing outputs over the last four weeks at some point mayfield will need to air it out but it s been a remarkable run and remarkable running by tampa bay of late to reenter the nfc south race penix implodes atlanta ultimately lost for two reasons it couldn t stop bucky irving and michael penix couldn t stop giving the ball away while the bucs basically gave up trying to throw under a heavy rain that persisted for most of the contest penix accepted the challenge and promptly failed he couldn t find his targets especially during the first half spraying the ball around but not to his targets far too often he sailed one over drake london s head during atlanta s first drive into jacob parrish s hands but the corner couldn t handle it even provided that little bit of luck though he still threw three picks over the subsequent four possessions becoming the first quarterback to toss three interceptions in the first 18 minutes of a game since bailey zappe in 2023 and the first falcons qb to do it since matt ryan in 2012 penix threw his fourth int of the game after atlanta had finally found some momentum in better conditions ruining a 43 yard drive down to tampa bay s 24 yard line by leaving one behind tight end charlie woerner for zyon mccollum to collect the falcons had been averaging 31 0 points per game with penix starting which ranked behind only the bills 32 8 entering week 8 but he was a difference maker in the negative sense against tampa bay he finished 8 of 24 for 125 yards and an ugly 12 0 passer rating in a messy game like sunday s was the best thing quarterbacks can do is protect the ball he didn t and he lost miserable conditions lead to slopfest the true victor of sunday s game might have been the elements atlanta and tampa bay spent most of the day just trying to get through a torrential downpour the rain caused errors in every conceivable way there were overthrows botched snaps missed kicks fumbles and all varieties of dropped passes would be touchdowns easy pickups and interceptions there are too many examples to point to but perhaps the most emblematic football folly took place on the bucs second drive after the center quarterback exchange went wrong baker mayfield recovered the ball and improvised magnificently darting into traffic before throwing it backward to bucky irving who streaked toward the end zone and nearly made it there before jessie bates punched the ball out right at the goal line for a touchback by halftime the game had seen more fumbles five and interceptions three than completions two both teams tightened up on ball security out of half and the rain let up some toward the fourth quarter but tampa bay was able to outlast by stacking some successes despite the elements throughout the contest chase mclaughlin was money helping build a lead in the first half by going 3 of 3 on field goals of 46 34 and 42 yards alex anzalone picked off penix twice six plays apart jacob parrish made up for an earlier drop with a second quarter interception and the bucs shut out the falcons offense on third down 0 for 12 for such an ugly ugly day there will actually be a fair amount of pretty plays for todd bowles and co to rewatch next gen stats insight for falcons buccaneers via nfl pro bucky irving generated all 170 of his rushing yards against atlanta after kansas city in the game s final two minutes in years past that would have been too much time to give mahomes and co and it nearly was again sunday but kansas city s inability to finish off its frantic two minute drill reminded us of this offense s limitations mahomes wasn t able to scramble for a touchdown instead throwing away a pass a few yards shy of the goal line and kenneth walker s hesitant penalty though and mahomes crumbled beneath the denver pass rush on the game s final play there were things to like from this game including kansas city s ability to compete on the road without receiving stellar production from walker 25 touches 84 scrimmage yards but the frustrating result erased the chiefs grip on first place in the afc west race instead they ll have to try to keep pace with denver the rest of the way oh and we already knew this but it was reaffirmed sunday harrison butker is marching toward unemployment his wide right miss from 54 yards loomed large in this contest and is just the latest of a growing string of misses from deep denver s defense shows cracks but holds up in biggest moment the broncos have built their 6 2 mark on the backs of their defenders who have collectively stifled opposing offenses by harassing quarterbacks relentlessly over the last month on sunday they weren t quite as effective for most of the afternoon patrick mahomes managed to lead one drive in which he repeatedly converted third downs by barely moving the ball beyond the line to gain showing flashes of what has made him a special quarterback in the post tyreek hill era in kansas city and dealing a few deflating blows to the denver defense in the process that wasn t enough to tear them down though in need of a stop denver managed to force a chiefs drive to stall in the fourth quarter leading to butker s 54 yard miss and granting the broncos a fresh opportunity to complete their comeback effort and even after letting mahomes drive the chiefs down the field rapidly in the final two minutes denver bowed up and denied the chiefs from entering the end zone in the game s final seconds as nix noted afterward the broncos have been leaning on their defense all season and they managed to prevent the opposition from gaining the one yard they needed most the fact they ended the game with a sack credited to malcolm roach but truly the product of a collective unified pass touchdowns the first time a patriots qb has done so since tom brady accomplished the feat in 10 consecutive games in 2007 despite some dicey moments early the pats appear to be back on track dormant third quarter sinks fins miami built some momentum offensively before halftime with 11 and 12 play scoring drives that gave it a 10 point lead heading into the locker room the latter was undoubtedly miami s most impressive march of the day as malik willis connected with greg dulcich caleb douglas jalen tolbert kevin coleman and finally malik washington in the end zone for a 1 yard score that s about when the fun stopped for miami as the third quarter saw it gain a piddly 13 net yards zero pass yards on eight plays credit the dolphins for trying to get out of the 11 point hole late with a nice 35 yard touchdown from willis to coleman late in the fourth quarter though a missed field goal failed two point try and an unsuccessful onside kick attempt all but sealed their fate willis finished the loss 21 of 32 passing for 211 yards two tds and an int which crazily launched off a defender s helmet at the line of scrimmage into kevin byard s hands downfield for the first time in several weeks the run game went away with ollie gordon racking up 69 yards on 19 carries 3 6 yards per attempt the game was ultimately decided by five points but it didn t feel all that close for much of the rainy second half some love for the defenses there were a handful of players on both teams that made notable plays the dolphins entered the contest with only six sacks dead last in the nfl but logged three sunday 2024 first round pick chop robinson led all players with two takedowns of drake maye while josh uche a former patriot had one miami also received solid contributions from jordyn news_mentions.headline: AFC East training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Bills, Dolphins, Jets, Patriots
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Jeremy Bergman breaks down the top AFC East training camp storylines to monitor for the Buffalo Bills, Miami Dolphins, New England Patriots and New York Jets.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams jeremy bergman has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the buffalo bills miami dolphins new england patriots and new york jets catch up on each afc east team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below buffalo bills miami dolphins new england patriots new york jets three key storylines 1 new era in buffalo for a bills roster that is returning most of its 2025 starters the biggest change this summer will be at the top the start of the joe brady era in buffalo gets underway in earnest when training camp kicks off in late july in taking over for sean mcdermott a sturdy leader who oversaw buffalo s longest period of sustained success since the great marv levy was at the helm brady has a lot to live up to the 36 year old first time head coach was elevated to improve on mcdermott s performance and lift buffalo over the hump and into the super bowl a january title game can t be won in august but the foundation of such an achievement can be built in the summer as it is for all champions brady s job starts and ends with accentuating what josh allen does best freeing up the qb to take further control of the offense the defense mcdermott s specialty has been handed off to ex nfl safety jim leonhard who coached the broncos star dbs over the past couple seasons no team with a new head coach is better positioned to win in 2026 than the bills who made it to the divisional round in 25 brady s first camp must set that tone 2 chubb chasing big season as one of buffalo s only notable offseason additions bradley chubb meets the bills at a critical time for both the team and the player chubb is coming off a solid comeback season from his torn acl logging 8 5 sacks for the dolphins in 2025 and playing a full slate of games for the first time since his rookie campaign the bills are in dire need of a pass rusher after gregory rousseau led the team with just seven sacks last year and joey bosa appears closer to retirement than returning entering the fray alongside second round pick t j parker chubb will be tasked with captaining a front seven that struggled to frustrate trevor lawrence and bo nix in the 2025 postseason chubb 30 has expressed that he s never been hungrier buffalo is starving for a true game wrecker off the edge 3 moore enough or more required the bills have missed stefon diggs draftees khalil shakir and keon coleman and free agent additions josh palmer and brandin cooks haven t quite filled his vacancy over the past couple years buffalo s trade for dj moore is meant to do just that reuniting with brady his ex panthers oc moore has an opportunity to be wr1 for josh allen in buffalo in a way he simply wasn t for caleb williams in chicago in 2025 the seeds of their hopefully fruitful partnership will be sowed in july and august moore admitted to growing pains in the spring but expects perfection this fall after the offseason long onboarding process in addition to providing a sure handed outlet for allen moore will be looked at to bring along the embattled coleman who got called out by owner terry pegula in january and has been under a microscope since if moore can bring coleman along and elevate a middling bills wr room then brady s first year returns could be big back to top three key storylines 1 first look at miami s offensive overhaul tua tagovailoa tyreek hill and jaylen waddle are out malik willis is in while de 39 von achane re upped for the long haul who else will fill out the dolphins offensive roster malik washington returns as a solid pass catching option joined by tutu atwell jalen tolbert terrace marshall and jalen reagor all looking to break out after sidekick roles in nfc receiving rooms imported from the collegiate ranks are chris bell kevin coleman and caleb douglas it s a who s who of who s that in miami s wr corps but somebody s gotta catch passes from willis ahead of what is expected to be a rebuilding year in south florida all eyes at least in the fantasy world will be on the fins wideouts in camp to see who swims and who flounders 2 leaders from the pack how will green bay south look in the heat of a miami summer we re about to find out jeff hafley and jon eric sullivan s first training camp with the dolphins after years with the packers provides the first time nfl head coach and general manager an opportunity to put their imprint on the team green bay camps are typically jovial affairs with oversized players riding undersized bikes alongside community members miami camps held outside one of america s biggest cities have a different feel last year s dolphins camp for one portended the subpar season miami was about to embark on as mike mcdaniel s roster was overwhelmed in joint practices and hampered by the injury bug if hafley and sullivan can avoid that sluggish start they will have already re calibrated the doomish vibes that preceded the 2025 season 3 we re talking about willis from entering the league as a third round pick to signing a three year 67 5 million deal with his third nfl team in four years malik willis is rewriting his nfl story on the fly the quarterback embarks on his first full season as a starter this summer in south beach after shining in a pair of breakout performances in place of jordan love both losses last year in green bay the three year contract implies that he is the qb of the present and immediate future in miami but nothing is assured in this league willis is being thrown into a less than advantageous position quarterbacking a rebuilding roster under a rookie head coach quinn ewers a second year backup with collegiate pedigree and three nfl starts to his name waits in the wings if things go south in south florida and the dolphins slump into top five draft positioning how secure will willis place in miami s future be a standout 2027 qb draft class could be staring sullivan in the face all that is to say willis isn t a made man yet and his first summer as a starter will be a critical one toward establishing himself as a long term answer in miami or elsewhere back to top three key storylines 1 patriots upgraded weaponry after months of rumors and rumblings new england finally completed its trade for disgruntled eagles wideout a j brown in june as the move had been predetermined for months so open a secret that it was never a secret brown wasted no time establishing chemistry with mvp runner up drake maye at minicamp brown has found himself in heaven in new england but how will the other patriots wideouts feel before brown was acquired to provide maye a true wr1 romeo doubs was the big ticket offensive acquisition of the offseason now slotted in as the no 2 doubs should find himself in a role similar to the one he played in green bay thriving on occasion down the roster new england still has mack hollins demario douglas and kayshon boutte for now but it will be interesting to see if kyle williams can break out in his second year since his third round selection the wazzu product caught just 10 passes in his rookie season but found the end zone thrice if williams can step up in training camp ahead of year 2 maye and the reigning afc champs could be in prime position to repeat 2 questions with two defenders ahead of training camp there remain two unsettled availability situations that need monitoring in foxborough the first is that of star cornerback christian gonzalez who s due for a major contract extension after his first pro bowl season gonzalez said during spring work that he wishes to be in new england for the long haul but for a cb of his caliber that means a top of the market deal worth 30 million plus per season something new england may be loath to offer before it has to gonzalez skipped voluntary sessions but showed up for mandatory minicamp what will his strategy be if he doesn t have a deal done by late july gabe jacas meanwhile hasn t practiced with the team since being drafted in the second round the no 55 overall pick remains unsigned and has been away from the club after undergoing an offseason medical procedure about which the pats have provided few details jacas for whom new england traded up in april s draft is behind heading into summer camp which isn t a good sign for the pats pass rusher depth we ll see if the rookie comes into camp signed and ready to break into the starting 11 3 will super bowl loss off field distractions linger the off field story of the offseason has mostly faded out of circulation but questions remain about how new england will bounce back from some messy months to start 2026 the april publication of photos showing patriots coach mike vrabel and former athletic reporter dianna russini at an arizona resort ignited a months long maelstrom of unwanted press in foxborough vrabel took off day 3 of the nfl draft to begin counseling but he was present throughout spring workouts the coach s players have defended him and the team s offseason program seemingly has gone off without a hitch that doesn t mean that when things ramp up in the summer with more coverage and eyeballs further scrutiny of vrabel won t creep in in addition to dealing with the fallout from the photos the pats are looking to recover from a humiliating super bowl defeat and avoid the fate of many a title game loser missing the ensuing postseason ahead of the kickoff game against their super bowl lx foes in seattle vrabel and the pats will be put through the media wringer again how will they respond back to top three key storylines 1 is defense better vetted i m not sure if you heard but the jets defense had zero interceptions last year zilch nada nil over 17 whole games the historic feat and a 31st ranked scoring d inspired general manager darren mougey to totally remake the defense during the offseason new york has since stockpiled veterans familiar jet draftee demario davis jersey native minkah fitzpatrick and fresh t 39 vondre sweat david onyemata joseph ossai nahshon wright add on two top rookies no 2 pick david bailey national champ d angelo ponds and the jets are projected to have upwards of eight new defensive starters in 26 the leadership of davis fitzpatrick and returning dl harrison phillips should provide a foundation that was sorely lacking from aaron glenn s first unit but camp will bear out whether the new look group with a first time dc in brian duker has a chance to keep new york in games this season or at the very least take the ball away 2 the return of the geno gang green s latest qb makeover reunites geno smith with the team that drafted him in the 2013 second round a few so so years and a broken jaw ended his initial jets run but the signal caller now 35 is back in florham park with more years under his belt ready to rewrite his narrative surrounding him is the most talented crop of playmakers new york has had in years garrett wilson and breece hall anchor the returning skill players while adonai mitchell and rookies kenyon sadiq and omar cooper get their first full seasons with the jets a steady o line is returning four of five starters dylan parham is set to replace left guard john simpson frank reich is in for the ousted tanner engstrand as offensive coordinator bringing a veteran presence with a track record of coaching a super bowl winning offense in philadelphia how quickly can the jets jell into a more potent attack their summer sessions will provide the first glimpse one thing to monitor smith is reportedly under investigation for battery in florida the qb has yet to comment on the matter 3 jets in five in the streets of manhattan millions of fans rejoiced after the knicks half century long title drought was broken in thrilling fashion in the nba finals the throng of excitement unleashed a positive unifying energy not seen around new york sports in quite some time roughly 35 miles west in florham park new jersey the jets are going through their own drought of sorts fifteen years without postseason football twenty three seasons with no division title fifty seven campaigns sans a super bowl title breece hall who witnessed the game 5 title securing victory was among jets players this spring who expressed positive jealousy over the knicks fortune aaron glenn said he wishes to replicate mike brown s clutch players competitive stamina with his guys will the summer of love continue across the hudson is curse breaking contagious camp may offer clues back to top

news_mentions.headline: 2026 NFL season, Week 8: What We Learned from Sunday's games
news_mentions.description: Around The NFL breaks down what you need to know from Sunday's action in Week 8 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 8 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below early window buffalo bills 36 baltimore ravens 10 cincinnati bengals 43 tennessee titans 36 ot arizona cardinals 33 dallas cowboys 30 ot detroit lions 19 minnesota vikings 15 jacksonville jaguars 42 indianapolis colts 7 las vegas raiders 38 new york jets 33 pittsburgh steelers 27 cleveland browns 6 tampa bay buccaneers 16 atlanta falcons 0 late window los angeles rams 24 los angeles chargers 9 denver broncos 28 kansas city chiefs 24 new england patriots 24 miami dolphins 19 sunday night washington commanders 27 philadelphia eagles 10 nick shook s takeaways bills let hunters loose buffalo s biggest underlying question mark was its defense a leaky unit that struggled to get stops and limit opposing offenses in what became weekly shootouts for the bills that finally changed for the better on sunday with lamar jackson exiting quickly and tyler huntley back in the lineup buffalo decided it was time to hunt the quarterback dialing up blitzes and registering pressures on half of huntley s four passes which also incidentally forced huntley out of the game due to injury once undrafted rookie joe fagnano took over the carnivorous bills saw nothing but red meat blitzing on 64 5 of their total defensive snaps logging qb pressures at a rate of 61 3 and short circuiting baltimore s offense all afternoon the ravens finished with just 144 net yards of offense scored their only touchdown via a short field earned by a broderick washington interception and couldn t piece together more than one drive of significance which ended in a 26 yard tyler loop field goal buffalo s defense made sure it wouldn t allow derrick henry to carry the ravens and denied fagnano the space to breathe overwhelming the inexperienced signal caller in a runaway win quarterback injuries decimate ravens lamar jackson s anticipated return lasted just one snap his first pass attempt fell incomplete and on the follow through to his throw jackson s thumb collided with a defender s hand resulting in an injury that will land jackson on injured reserve for the foreseeable future after a few weeks of backup turned starter duty tyler huntley found himself on the field sunday appearing skittish and struggling to gain a single yard through the air before an injury knocked him out of action as well leaving the ravens with their emergency third qb joe fagnano as their only remaining option the uconn product gave his best effort but was constantly under duress leaving the ravens with little room to move the ball all afternoon zay flowers went without a catch on five targets rashod bateman s one catch for 22 yards accounted for the most receiving production for any raven and running back justice hill led baltimore in receptions with four it was a lifeless offense that left the ravens defense on the field for far too long buffalo won the time of possession battle 37 36 to 22 24 and sunday s display should rightfully worry ravens fans about their team s outlook for the remainder of
