denver broncos 28 kansas city chiefs 24 new england patriots 24 miami dolphins 19 sunday night washington commanders 27 philadelphia eagles 10 nick shook s takeaways bills let hunters loose buffalo s biggest underlying question mark was its defense a leaky unit that struggled to get stops and limit opposing offenses in what became weekly shootouts for the bills that finally changed for the better on sunday with lamar jackson exiting quickly and tyler huntley back in the lineup buffalo decided it was time to hunt the quarterback dialing up blitzes and registering pressures on half of huntley s four passes which also incidentally forced huntley out of the game due to injury once undrafted rookie joe fagnano took over the carnivorous bills saw nothing but red meat blitzing on 64 5 of their total defensive snaps logging qb pressures at a rate of 61 3 and short circuiting baltimore s offense all afternoon the ravens finished with just 144 net yards of offense scored their only touchdown via a short field earned by a broderick washington interception and couldn t piece together more than one drive of significance which ended in a 26 yard tyler loop field goal buffalo s defense made sure it wouldn t allow derrick henry to carry the ravens and denied fagnano the space to breathe overwhelming the inexperienced signal caller in a runaway win quarterback injuries decimate ravens lamar jackson s anticipated return lasted just one snap his first pass attempt fell incomplete and on the follow through to his throw jackson s thumb collided with a defender s hand resulting in an injury that will land jackson on injured reserve for the foreseeable future after a few weeks of backup turned starter duty tyler huntley found himself on the field sunday appearing skittish and struggling to gain a single yard through the air before an injury knocked him out of action as well leaving the ravens with their emergency third qb joe fagnano as their only remaining option the uconn product gave his best effort but was constantly under duress leaving the ravens with little room to move the ball all afternoon zay flowers went without a catch on five targets rashod bateman s one catch for 22 yards accounted for the most receiving production for any raven and running back justice hill led baltimore in receptions with four it was a lifeless offense that left the ravens defense on the field for far too long buffalo won the time of possession battle 37 36 to 22 24 and sunday s display should rightfully worry ravens fans about their team s outlook for the remainder of 2026 it sounds as if jackson s season could be finished and recent results without him including sunday are discouraging at best moore delivers in return after missing a handful of weeks buffalo welcomed back its prized offseason acquisition d j moore who showed no signs of hesitancy and delivered a strong outing four catches 82 yards including a spectacular grab for 49 yards to set up a james cook touchdown and a touchdown catch moore s return helped draw some attention away from buffalo s tight ends dalton kincaid finished with a team best 86 yards and a touchdown on four catches took a bit of pressure off cook and unlocked enough of the unit s attack to help the bills climb out of a grind it out start to pour it on in the second half moore s rapport with josh allen remains strong even after the time off and helped allen pass jim kelly for the franchise s all time lead in touchdowns 260 now moore will need to prove he can be this reliable on a weekly basis next gen stats insight for ravens bills via nfl pro the bills blitzed on 64 5 of opposing dropbacks against the ravens in week 8 their highest blitz rate since 2021 and the highest blitz rate ravens quarterbacks have faced this season the bills blitz rate had not exceeded 39 in any of their prior six games this season when blitzing the bills generated 11 pressures including a season high seven quick pressures under 2 5 seconds and three sacks including a strip sack fumble recovery in the second quarter nfl research josh allen and james cook each had a rushing touchdown in week 8 marking the 16th time that allen and cook have scored a rushing touchdown in the same game sixteen games breaks a tie with dak prescott and ezekiel elliott for the most games by any teammate duo in nfl history in which both players had a rushing touchdown back to top bobby kownack s takeaways burrow was everything good bad about bengals offense what a roller coaster performance by joe burrow the cincy quarterback unquestionably served as the team s hero accounting for six touchdowns in an unexpected shootout with the titans but his three interceptions contributed initially to a slow start and later allowed tennessee to stay in it two of those picks were deep heaves to ja 39 marr chase with one way overthrown and another that came up far too short if you re going to make mistakes though make sure you make up for them burrow did that and more piling on the points and feeding his top two receivers to great success tee higgins had 10 catches for 155 yards and two tds on 11 targets while chase tallied 11 receptions for 141 yards and a score on 16 looks burrow also importantly cleaned it up in crunch time of his five drives that took place in the fourth quarter or overtime one ended in a chase brown fumble and the other ticked down the final 17 seconds to the extra frame on the other three burrow marched his bengals 73 81 and 70 yards throwing two touchdowns and scoring the game winner on a 9 yard scramble he finished with 426 yards five tds and three ints on 38 of 48 passing marking his third consecutive game with at least four passing touchdowns it s a bit scary how many points the bengals put up despite four giveaways and that s all credit to burrow standout performances not enough for tennessee there was not an ounce of quit in the titans after trading away their best player defensive tackle jeffery simmons on thursday the defense still generated four takeaways the most it has had in a game this season safety amani hooker had joe burrow s number intercepting him a whopping three times while defensive end jacob martin tallied three sacks and linebacker anthony hill was relentless with 14 tackles on offense cam ward enjoyed by far his best game of the season despite being without carnell tate ward dissected cincinnati s defense with regularity going 26 of 40 for 304 yards and two touchdowns snapping a five game interception streak and nearly doubling his average of 168 4 passing yards per game he led two separate go ahead td drives in the fourth quarter plus tony pollard continued his recent resurgence rushing for 117 yards and two scores after going for 129 and three tds in week 7 his 40 yard touchdown to open the scoring will be one of the highlights of the day in his or any game with pollard breaking multiple tackles before stiff arming one bengals defender into another s path in a keystone cops sequence on the way to pay dirt of course it was still not enough for the 1 7 titans but the fight they showed was admirable regardless of the nfl s aversion to moral victories concerning trends taking shape for bengals the most important result from sunday is the bengals moving to 5 2 in a highly competitive afc north however there are some underlying issues still plaguing cincinnati the bengals found themselves trailing 13 0 for the second straight week this deficit came at the end of the first quarter unlike last week s halftime hole against the ravens and the bengals started picking it up much earlier to go into intermission with a lead but they couldn t pull away like they did in baltimore instead the titans pushed them to overtime taking advantage of a defense that forced a pair of turnovers but couldn t get enough stops to make things easy in the past three games the bengals have needed to outlast a one win titans team in overtime looked asleep for far too long facing backup quarterback tyler huntley and let a then winless dolphins squad make things uncomfortable late before that it was two straight losses those who choose optimism will point to the bengals record and their three game winning streak but venturing through a season as escape artists typically catches up down the line next gen stats insight for titans bengals via nfl pro amani hooker picked off joe burrow three times which included 15 3 expected points added across five targets in coverage the second most coverage epa by a player tds and a rushing td in a game joining norm van brocklin week 1 1951 back to top nick shook s takeaways qb change sparks comeback through nearly three quarters the cardinals were repeating the same frustrating offensive performance that had become all too familiar in recent weeks jacoby brissett was under constant pressure and resorting to throws that amounted to little more than prayers and after watching brissett take two consecutive sacks for double digit negative yardage in the third quarter coach mike lafleur had enough calling for gardner minshew to replace the battered brissett oddly enough the quarterback change coincided with a revival of the running game that depended solely on tyler allgeier after jeremiyah love left with another ankle injury and bam knight was knocked out of action due to a concussion allgeier put the team on his back rushing 11 times for 147 yards and a touchdown and repeatedly turning to the sideline oxygen tank as a means of survival minshew meanwhile created a rhythm in the passing game that the cardinals haven t enjoyed in over a month completing 17 of 23 passes for 188 yards and three touchdowns including a magnificent final touchdown drive that covered 80 yards in eight plays and 1 03 to tie the game and balancing the offense by turning to michael wilson plenty eight catches 111 yards one touchdown arizona pulled off this 23 point outburst and improbable comeback after losing love knight and receiver kendrick bourne maximizing its returns with its remaining contributors with just enough time to escape defeat it will likely prompt a quarterback change and could be a minor springboard forward for a team that was desperate for a morale boosting win like this cowboys collapse could have devastating effect dallas will look back at this game and have no choice but to admit this was its worst loss of 2026 entering the final minute of the third quarter the cowboys were in control holding a 17 3 lead that was all but guaranteed to eventually become 20 3 or larger in that moment though their defense broke down surrendering a rumbling 63 yard touchdown run to tyler allgeier the first of a few massive chunks gained by allgeier in the final 16 minutes of regulation on a 52 yard allgeier run in the fourth quarter safety caleb downs got pancaked by hjalte froholdt twice in the same play typifying arizona s sudden takeover with the image of downs tumbling across the turf like a runaway cheese wheel speeding down a hill this all happened after dallas had suffocated arizona s offense for the first 44 minutes of the game and the cardinals awakening delivered repeated violent blows to the ribcage of the cowboys defense landing a liver punch in the form of a michael wilson dependent touchdown drive to tie the game in the final six seconds of regulation a quick defensive stop and a 44 yard scoring drive in overtime sent the cowboys to the mat for good resulting in one of the most stunning outcomes of the entire nfl season this type of loss can send a team into a spiral could cost defensive coordinator christian parker his job and will undoubtedly cause cowboys fans to angrily punch the air the same problems persist they still can t beat the lowly cardinals in texas and the solutions continue to prove fleeting arizona s rebuilt backfield disintegrates but one pillar remains standing tyler allgeier s second half outburst produced a victory for the cardinals but it was even more triumphant for a workhorse who has often been left to the shadows of more recognizable running mates in atlanta and arizona the talk at the start of the season revolved around first round pick jeremiyah love and when the cardinals couldn t generate consistently on the ground love s absence was quickly blamed allgeier never quite saw the chances he needed to blossom but found himself in an unexpected moment of opportunity sunday when love and bam knight exited due to injury he could have played an average brand of football as the lone remaining runner available but that s not allgeier those who were unfamiliar with his style were reminded rudely on his 63 yard touchdown run in which he broke three tackles and followed a trio of teammates who escorted him to the goal line where he fell across it for a score while finally being brought down that touchdown made it a 17 10 game but more importantly it gave the cardinals reason to believe his ensuing 52 yarder saw hjalte froholdt get out in front and wreck caleb downs in open space setting an aggressive tone embodied by the runner benefitting from the blocking in those two plays and gardner minshew s stint as a mid game replacement the cardinals brought the fight to the cowboys refusing to lay down despite a double digit deficit and little reason to believe they d turn things around because of allgeier s toughness determination and relentless desire to produce when called upon he also caught five passes for 44 yards and an incredibly gritty touchdown reception the cardinals pulled off the stunning win and might have found a new identity in the process next gen stats insight for cardinals cowboys via nfl pro tyler the red zone and in the win column is gang green s calling card at this point it doesn t get any easier for the 2 6 jets with the chiefs and bills up next an 11th straight losing season is in sight jeanty takes back seat to rookie ashton jeanty spent the week calling out the jets defense as a get right unit for the raiders run game he was right just not for him jeanty was relegated to a third down role against new york ceding starting reps to mike washington the fourth round rookie logged a career high 83 yards on 25 carries the most by any raiders rb this season it wasn t the most efficient outing but washington was a much more solid contributor in the lead role than jeanty had been in his previous three games 64 yards on 28 carries jeanty wasn t completely absent from the game however and played a crucial role on las vegas fourth quarter drive to take the lead breaking free for a 45 yard catch and run to flip the field he finished with just 9 rushing yards on two carries season low 22 snaps but jeanty proved once again that he is more useful to this offense in a pass catching role will las vegas solidify these roles in the weeks to come and if so how will the former top 10 pick handle the apparent demotion next gen stats insight for raiders jets via nfl pro brock bowers caught seven of 10 targets for 92 yards and two touchdowns in the raiders win recording six of his receptions aligned as an outside receiver bowers six receptions lined up outside tied his career high from week 3 this season and tied for the most by any tight end since at least 2016 no raiders wide receiver has caught six passes lined up outside in a game this season nfl research the raiders and jets each had season highs in points scored while combining for 71 points the third highest scoring game between the teams and just the second time they both scored at least 30 points joining week 11 1968 when the raiders won 43 32 in the infamous heidi game the raiders have scored 221 points this season their most through eight games since 2002 226 points when they went to the super bowl back to top dan parr s takeaways steelers cruise thanks to dominant ground game stifling defense pittsburgh s most lopsided victory of the season was fueled by a season high 200 rushing yards running backs jaylen warren and rico dowdle each chipped in a rushing touchdown with warren running for 143 yards tying his career high on his 28th birthday aaron rodgers was held to 13 of 25 passing for 172 yards no touchdowns and one interception on a pass that was dropped by dk metcalf but struggles through the air didn t end up costing the steelers with a big lead for most of the game and no significant threat from the browns rushing game the steelers pass rushers were able to pin their ears back and make deshaun watson s life miserable for most of the afternoon pittsburgh recorded a season high eight sacks on 21 qb pressures watson has now been sacked a whopping 22 times in the last four games poor starts come back to bite browns cleveland was abysmal on offense especially early on against the steelers a team the browns defeated back in week 4 the browns finished the first quarter with negative 1 yard on 10 plays and two lost fumbles it s part of a troubling trend for todd monken whose team has been outscored 65 13 in the first quarter of games this season the key to the browns surprising 5 2 start to the season was their ability to bounce back from those rough starts but sunday offered cleveland a stark reminder of what it s like to fall behind and stay behind it was the first time the browns have never held a lead since the jaguars blew them out in week 1 and the first time they were held to zero touchdowns in a game since week 15 of last season second year tight end harold fannin was one of the few bright spots making a career high 10 catches for 154 yards of course the combination of not being able to run the ball protect the passer or stop the run on defense is a recipe for disaster the browns had allowed one rushing touchdown in their first six games they have now allowed six such scores in their last two games including three on sunday they ll play their third straight road game next week against a desperate saints team that will be coming off a bye steelers hit bye week in driver s seat of afc north pittsburgh will be alone at the top of the division entering week 9 the browns are the only team with a winning record the steelers have faced during their four game winning streak but the goal is to stack wins and that s what pittsburgh is doing under head coach mike mccarthy the steelers will want to find a way to get aaron rodgers going again though after the 42 year old was held to a season low 172 yards passing on sunday he s now thrown only one touchdown over the last two games the going could get tougher coming out of the bye with a trip to visit the bengals awaiting the steelers in week 10 then again cincinnati needed overtime at home on sunday to beat the lowly titans in a 43 36 shootout next gen stats insight for browns steelers via nfl pro steelers linebacker alex highsmith generated six qb pressures across 21 matchups 20 1 on 1 with browns offensive tackle spencer fano in week 8 including two quick pressures under 2 5 seconds and 0 5 sacks highsmith also drew three holding calls two of which were declined fano also allowed four pressures in 13 matchups with steelers linebacker nick herbig including one quick pressure and one sack nfl research the browns have lost 23 straight regular season road games against the steelers tied for the longest road losing streak against a single opponent in nfl history with the lions at the packers from 1992 to 2014 the browns loss also means they have failed to sweep the steelers in the season series for the 35th straight season last accomplishing the feat in 1988 back to top bobby kownack s takeaways bucky puts bucs on his back handed a box score with the player names and teams redacted one would be forgiven for guessing sunday s nfc south showdown took place in 1926 rather than a century later the buccaneers ran the ball 55 times excluding kneeldowns part of a combined 83 carries by the two clubs in a bad weather game baker mayfield recorded just three pass attempts and completed none of them as tampa bay joined the 1974 bills as only the second team in the super bowl era to complete zero passes in a game and emerge victorious not only that but the bucs became the first team to win a game by 10 plus points without completing a pass since the 1945 pittsburgh steelers over the chicago cardinals so how did they pull out such an unlikely victory bucky irving his cuts were vicious and precise allowing him to weave through an atlanta defense that appeared to be on skates at times on a field flooded by rainwater he rushed for 170 yards and a touchdown on 27 carries eclipsing 100 yards in a first half for his first time as a pro and eventually setting a career high the operation also didn t slow down at all with kenneth gainwell occasionally mixing in and later on taking over to milk clock the backup back logged 25 carries for 140 yards it was a similar smashmouth formula that tampa bay used in last week s 43 13 pummeling of the panthers when mayfield only threw for 64 yards and the buccaneers have now produced three of the franchise s top 10 single game rushing outputs over the last four weeks at some point mayfield will need to air it out but it s been a remarkable run and remarkable running by tampa bay of late to reenter the nfc south race penix implodes atlanta ultimately lost for two reasons it couldn t stop bucky irving and michael penix couldn t stop giving the ball away while the bucs basically gave up trying to throw under a heavy rain that persisted for most of the contest penix accepted the challenge and promptly failed he couldn t find his targets especially during the first half spraying the ball around but not to his targets far too often he sailed one over drake london s head during atlanta s first drive into jacob parrish s hands but the corner couldn t handle it even provided that little bit of luck though he still threw three picks over the subsequent four possessions becoming the first quarterback to toss three interceptions in the first 18 minutes of a game since bailey zappe in 2023 and the first falcons qb to do it since matt ryan in 2012 penix threw his fourth int of the game after atlanta had finally found some momentum in better conditions ruining a 43 yard drive down to tampa bay s 24 yard line by leaving one behind tight end charlie woerner for zyon mccollum to collect the falcons had been averaging 31 0 points per game with penix starting which ranked behind only the bills 32 8 entering week 8 but he was a difference maker in the negative sense against tampa bay he finished 8 of 24 for 125 yards and an ugly 12 0 passer rating in a messy game like sunday s was the best thing quarterbacks can do is protect the ball he didn t and he lost miserable conditions lead to slopfest the true victor of sunday s game might have been the elements atlanta and tampa bay spent most of the day just trying to get through a torrential downpour the rain caused errors in every conceivable way there were overthrows botched snaps missed kicks fumbles and all varieties of dropped passes would be touchdowns easy pickups and interceptions there are too many examples to point to but perhaps the most emblematic football folly took place on the bucs second drive after the center quarterback exchange went wrong baker mayfield recovered the ball and improvised magnificently darting into traffic before throwing it backward to bucky irving who streaked toward the end zone and nearly made it there before jessie bates punched the ball out right at the goal line for a touchback by halftime the game had seen more fumbles five and interceptions three than completions two both teams tightened up on ball security out of half and the rain let up some toward the fourth quarter but tampa bay was able to outlast by stacking some successes despite the elements throughout the contest chase mclaughlin was money helping build a lead in the first half by going 3 of 3 on field goals of 46 34 and 42 yards alex anzalone picked off penix twice six plays apart jacob parrish made up for an earlier drop with a second quarter interception and the bucs shut out the falcons offense on third down 0 for 12 for such an ugly ugly day there will actually be a fair amount of pretty plays for todd bowles and co to rewatch next gen stats insight for falcons buccaneers via nfl pro bucky irving generated all 170 of his rushing yards against atlanta after contact the third most in a single game this season nfl research the buccaneers had a franchise record 322 rushing yards in week 8 against the falcons those 322 rushing yards are the second most by any team in a game where they had zero completions over the last 90 years behind only the 1933 boston redskins who had 420 against the giants in a 21 20 win back to top kevin patra s takeaways rams rumble over chargers in battle of l a sean mcvay s offense got off to an ugly start failing to record a first down in its first five drives the rams finally broke through with less than 90 seconds remaining in the first half on a matthew stafford 40 yard bomb to tutu atwell the home squad skated from there scoring 21 straight to blow out their sofi stadium mates the rams came out at halftime and saddled up the rushing attack after just 10 yards on the ground through two quarters blake corum and kyren williams blasted their way for 129 rushing yards and two touchdowns on 27 carries for the game corum started the second half generating chunk gains juking defenders out of their shoes he capped the drive with a 23 yard scamper to give l a a lead it wouldn t relent finding pay dirt on both sides of halftime seemed to break the chargers the successful rushing attack stabilized an offense that was stubbing its toe early after a wobbly start mcvay s squad has battled back to 500 with games against washington and arizona on tap chargers disaster season continues the chargers play poorly they also played scared jim harbaugh s winless club had multiple chances to strike an early big punch but repeatedly whiffed the chargers settled for three field goals on fourth and short situations deep in rams territory the final decision proved to be the worst facing a fourth and 2 at the rams 23 yard line with under 2 minutes left in the first half harbaugh elected to kick a field goal to go up 9 3 if the chargers went for and converted it they could have gone up double digits and perhaps burned the clock so the rams couldn t have scored late to jumpstart their offense winning teams make winning plays on winning decisions losing teams stay losing with a losing mentality speaking of mentality justin herbert s is lost in a blind wilderness the chargers qb threw a pair of ugly interceptions the type you can t believe that a 50 million player would make right to defenders herbert isn t trusting what he s seeing and isn t seeing what defenses are putting in front of him he s a mess mentally right now with little hope of digging out of the hole when the highest paid player on the team is making rookie level mistakes what can you expect from the rest of the club rams d takes advantage of herbert mistakes quentin lake jumped a first quarter justin herbert pass to the outside and scampered into chargers territory even after the offense generated just 8 yards the return was enough to give the rams an early three point lead after halftime trent mcduffie saw a pass tossed right to him in zone coverage which he returned 26 yards to set up a td that would put the game out of reach the rams stuffed the chargers run game 2 6 yards per carry and pestered herbert into mistakes in addition to two sacks and two picks the rams generated 20 qb pressures including three from defensive tackle aaron donald the rams early play keeping the chargers out of the end zone proved huge giving the offense time to figure things out without falling too far behind next gen stats insight for rams chargers via nfl pro matthew stafford averaged a time to throw of 2 38 seconds in the rams week 8 victory over the chargers his third quickest in a game since joining the rams in 2021 stafford was efficient on quick passes completing 13 of 14 passes for 94 yards and a touchdown 57 1 success rate when he held on to the ball for over 2 5 seconds he completed just four of 11 passes for 63 yards with an interception 33 3 success rate nfl research the chargers are the first team in nfl history to lose each of their first seven games of a season after winning at least 11 games in the previous season back to top nick shook s takeaways fourth quarter broncos are back denver s offensive output is slowly starting to improve bo nix completed 20 of 32 passes for 222 yards and two touchdowns took a few shots downfield and connected once with jaylen waddle for a big gain and most importantly delivered in a frantic fourth quarter comeback effort facing a goal to go situation nix ran himself into pressure when inexplicably trying to break a clean pocket but didn t let that mistake sink him he calmly executed a play action rollout later in the sequence and found fullback nate adkins for a touchdown then coolly converted the two point try by firing a bullet to waddle to make it a three point game jonah coleman later handled the rest ripping off a 51 yard gain after catching a short pass from nix to set up denver s go ahead touchdown a score that was ultimately the deciding trip to the end zone denver still finished 2 for 11 on third down and under 300 total yards of offense but when it needed to score late it found a way to get the job done in a high pressure situation the broncos will need to build off that going forward chiefs rediscover offensive mojo still fall short after being completely shut down by seattle last week kansas city was able to get back on track and produce in denver on sunday thanks to some early big plays headlined by running back emmett johnson s 73 yard touchdown reception explosive plays propelled the chiefs to a 17 13 lead before patrick mahomes pieced together a methodical 11 play 63 yard touchdown drive to take an 11 point lead late in the third quarter that score came at the end of what was the chiefs most impressive drive of the season and appeared to be enough to keep the broncos at bay until denver s fourth quarter scoring outburst moved the broncos within three points of tying the chiefs and then ahead of kansas city in the game s final two minutes in years past that would have been too much time to give mahomes and co and it nearly was again sunday but kansas city s inability to finish off its frantic two minute drill reminded us of this offense s limitations mahomes wasn t able to scramble for a touchdown instead throwing away a pass a few yards shy of the goal line and kenneth walker s hesitant third down run preceded a sequence that will live in chiefs fans memories for a while facing fourth and goal from the 1 kansas city stacked three receivers in a tight bunch set on the left sent the shotgun snap to mahomes and let the route combination work freeing rashee rice for what should have been the game winning touchdown jaylon moore s slight movement before the snap drew a false start penalty though and mahomes crumbled beneath the denver pass rush on the game s final play there were things to like from this game including kansas city s ability to compete on the road without receiving stellar production from walker 25 touches 84 scrimmage yards but the frustrating result erased the chiefs grip on first place in the afc west race instead they ll have to try to keep pace with denver the rest of the way oh and we already knew this but it was reaffirmed sunday harrison butker is marching toward unemployment his wide right miss from 54 yards loomed large in this contest and is just the latest of a growing string of misses from deep denver s defense shows cracks but holds up in biggest moment the broncos have built their 6 2 mark on the backs of their defenders who have collectively stifled opposing offenses by harassing quarterbacks relentlessly over the last month on sunday they weren t quite as effective for most of the afternoon patrick mahomes managed to lead one drive in which he repeatedly converted third downs by barely moving the ball beyond the line to gain showing flashes of what has made him a special quarterback in the post tyreek hill era in kansas city and dealing a few deflating blows to the denver defense in the process that wasn t enough to tear them down though in need of a stop denver managed to force a chiefs drive to stall in the fourth quarter leading to butker s 54 yard miss and granting the broncos a fresh opportunity to complete their comeback effort and even after letting mahomes drive the chiefs down the field rapidly in the final two minutes denver bowed up and denied the chiefs from entering the end zone in the game s final seconds as nix noted afterward the broncos have been leaning on their defense all season and they managed to prevent the opposition from gaining the one yard they needed most the fact they ended the game with a sack credited to malcolm roach but truly the product of a collective unified pass rush was fitting next gen stats insight for chiefs broncos via nfl pro on first and goal from the denver 4 yard line in the game s final minute the chiefs owned a 76 chance of winning per next gen stats win probability they did not score losing 28 24 nfl research the broncos came back to win in week 8 after trailing by 11 points in the fourth quarter against the chiefs the win was the broncos third in bo nix s career in which they came back from a double digit fourth quarter deficit to win which is the most such wins in the nfl since 2024 this was just the third game in patrick mahomes career in which the chiefs blew a double digit fourth quarter lead and the first since week 2 2021 in baltimore back to top brooke cersosimo s takeaways maye pats offense has big second half the patriots looked as if they were still feeling last week s loss to chicago in the first half of sunday s contest new england s receiving yards leader hunter henry remained drake maye s preferred option early against the dolphins catching all three of his targets for 30 yards but the veteran tight end left the game with a foot injury midway through the second quarter and never returned maye looked stumped without henry and his top three receivers a j brown ankle knee who s missing his fifth game this season romeo doubs and mack hollins both on injured reserve for the rest of the half the offense compiled less than 100 total yards and had a 13 3 deficit going into the locker room prompting too many mike vrabel eye rolls to count then came some much needed adjustments from offensive coordinator josh mcdaniels and maye after a three and out maye began stretching the field and finding the few pats receivers at his disposal to string together three straight touchdown drives that scoring avalanche opened with maye finding kyle williams on a 43 yard touchdown before maye stunned a defender when taking it in himself on an option from 2 yards out maye s third td saw him connect with demario douglas deep downfield for a 48 yard touchdown maye finished the day 16 of 20 passing for 199 yards with the three total tds it marked maye s fifth straight game with three or more total touchdowns the first time a patriots qb has done so since tom brady accomplished the feat in 10 consecutive games in 2007 despite some dicey moments early the pats appear to be back on track dormant third quarter sinks fins miami built some momentum offensively before halftime with 11 and 12 play scoring drives that gave it a 10 point lead heading into the locker room the latter was undoubtedly miami s most impressive march of the day as malik willis connected with greg dulcich caleb douglas jalen tolbert kevin coleman and finally malik washington in the end zone for a 1 yard score that s about when the fun stopped for miami as the third quarter saw it gain a piddly 13 net yards zero pass yards on eight plays credit the dolphins for trying to get out of the 11 point hole late with a nice 35 yard touchdown from willis to coleman late in the fourth quarter though a missed field goal failed two point try and an unsuccessful onside kick attempt all but sealed their fate willis finished the loss 21 of 32 passing for 211 yards two tds and an int which crazily launched off a defender s helmet at the line of scrimmage into kevin byard s hands downfield for the first time in several weeks the run game went away with ollie gordon racking up 69 yards on 19 carries 3 6 yards per attempt the game was ultimately decided by five points but it didn t feel all that close for much of the rainy second half some love for the defenses there were a handful of players on both teams that made notable plays the dolphins entered the contest with only six sacks dead last in the nfl but logged three sunday 2024 first round pick chop robinson led all players with two takedowns of drake maye while josh uche a former patriot had one miami also received solid contributions from jordyn brooks 11 total tackles jacob rodriguez eight tackles forced fumble and julius brents fumble recovery new england sacked malik willis five times in the win with gabe jacas and cory durden leading the way with 1 5 sacks apiece carlton davis nine tackles kaden elliss nine tackles 5 sacks two tfls and kevin byard int also deserve flowers for their performances next gen stats insight for patriots point deficit in the first quarter as the quarterback stunningly earned his first win since oct 5 2025 battling through injuries in this season and the last daniels had gone 0 7 1 over his last eight starts with washington this one is unlikely to be a triumph he ll put on a highlight reel as the commanders and eagles entered sunday night on a combined eight game winless streak the product was emblematic of the teams travails for the most part daniels however largely avoided big mistakes throwing for 217 yards and an 8 yard touchdown pass to stefon diggs that led to a 10 all score in the second quarter and was part of a 27 0 run for washington daniels and washington have been desperate for a win at 2 4 1 the commanders are still within flailing distance of the nfc east s top spot though that s hard to fathom with the showing regardless dan quinn daniels and the commanders have something to celebrate at the expense of a division rival that is dealing with harder times eagles endure another ugly loss after 10 points and nearly 15 minutes of game time things looked sunny for philadelphia for the first time in a long time the eagles hadn t laid claim to a double digit lead since week 4 unfortunately during a trying season for the eagles in which injuries have taken hold they lost their sixth in a row for the first time in nick sirianni s tenure as a banged up saquon barkley was limited and fill in starter tanner mckee was bamboozled by washington pressure held scoreless following a 3 yard touchdown run by barkley with 4 27 to go in the first quarter the eagles mustered just 268 yards of offense the running game was held to 91 yards and mckee couldn t hold up against the commanders pressure washington racked up a season best five sacks as mckee was pressured 20 times 46 5 pressure rate and it seemed as though he was under duress far more than that despite a roster completely hobbled by injuries this was a winnable game for the eagles but mckee and the offense simply had no answers emblematic of the struggles was philadelphia s best drive of the second half a 15 play odyssey that took up 7 35 it ended with a jake elliott 41 yard field goal attempt clanging off the upright following back to back 5 yard penalties eight games into the season and residing in an nfc east that s hardly a heavyweight division it s still arduous to believe the eagles season isn t done washington wins in trenches in week 7 the eagles defense was shockingly held to six qb pressures no sacks and no tackles for loss in a setback against the cowboys the stats weren t so damning in this one but it still wasn t where it should be credit to the commanders offensive line for that guard samuel cosmi more than held his own against jalen carter carter had one of the news_mentions.headline: Seahawks RB Zach Charbonnet (knee) off injury report, set for season debut vs. Bears
news_mentions.description: Seahawks running back Zach Charbonnet (knee) has no designation ahead of Monday's game against the Bears and is set to make his season debut.
news_mentions.body_text: zach charbonnet will make his long awaited return in prime time the seahawks running back has no designation ahead of monday s game against the bears and is set to play coming off a torn acl rookie jadarian price also has no injury designation ahead of the showdown though he is currently on injured reserve after missing the past four weeks with a chest injury and would still need to be activated to face chicago if we were to make a move i think that would happen on monday to my knowledge head coach mike macdonald said regarding activating price so we ll see if that s what we do we ve got some things going on roster wise that we re working through right now charbonnet and price both logged two full practices and one limited session this week charbonnet has made an impressively speedy recovery after tearing his acl during seattle s divisional round win over the 49ers on jan 17 he ll suit up just nine months and change post injury the 25 year old served as seattle s power back last year tallying 730 rushing yards and a team leading 12 rushing touchdowns while splitting work alongside kenneth walker with walker now a member of the chiefs charbonnet will mix back into a backfield that s been led by emanuel wilson and george holani the past couple weeks wilson has made the most of his opportunity he has three rushing touchdowns and 403 rushing yards on the season buoyed by his 100 yard effort on the ground in seattle s week 7 win over the chiefs while walker was held to 36 yards against his former squad holani has 108 yards and a score on 36 carries the group will face a difficult test as chicago ranks third in the league in defending the run price the no 32 overall pick in the 2026 draft is roughly in the same ballpark as holani stat wise he s seen 28 carries for 119 yards in what s been a slow start to his rookie year the seahawks have another couple of days to move him to the active roster if that s what they choose to do chicago 5 2 and seattle 4 3 square off at 8 15 p m et on monday night football

news_mentions.headline: Broncos RB Jonah Coleman 'ready for any opportunity' vs. Chiefs with RJ Harvey ruled out
news_mentions.description: Broncos running back Jonah Coleman didn't log a carry against the Chiefs in Denver's season-opening loss. That's in line to change heading into the team's Week 8 rematch, especially now that RJ Harvey (knee) has been ruled out.
news_mentions.body_text: broncos running back jonah coleman didn t log a carry against the chiefs in denver s season opening loss that s in line to change heading into the team s week 8 rematch especially after denver ruled out rj harvey knee and on saturday placed him on injured reserve i m ready for any opportunity i m given coleman said friday via the denver post whenever i m out there on the field i m going to give the team my all coleman commandeered the rb snap share last week during a win over the cardinals his first game back after a stint on ir due to a high ankle sprain he played 28 offensive snaps compared to harvey and j k dobbins combined 26 and he was by far denver s most efficient runner in the contest he turned nine carries into 54 yards 6 0 yards per carry while dobbins had 23 yards on six carries 3 8 ypc and harvey managed only 6 yards on three attempts 2 0 ypc of course dobbins and harvey both scored a td with dobbins plunging in from the 1 and harvey breaking free untouched on a magnificent 52 yard reception but coleman s usage was notable coming directly off an injury during the week 2 game against the jaguars in which coleman injured his ankle another game harvey missed he similarly led the running backs with 25 snaps on offense dobbins saw 19 and tyler badie currently on ir was on the field for 15 coleman and dobbins each handled 10 carries apiece that day with coleman going for 39 yards and a score while dobbins had 36 coleman also collected three receptions for 19 yards might the split lean even more coleman s way in a second game sans harvey it s certainly possible the rookie is now another month plus into his first season and he just handled 50 of the play time versus arizona when each member of denver s three pronged rushing attack was active more importantly though will whatever workload coleman receives help tilt the results in denver s favor after he went without a touch in the broncos week 1 loss to kansas city that opening defeat was a complete drubbing a 31 10 statement by the 2026 chiefs in response to the 2025 broncos snapping their nine year streak of afc west titles but a win by denver on sunday would propel coleman and co the top of the division for the first time this season it s definitely going to feel good to play against the chiefs coleman said obviously they re no 1 in the division and that s where we want to be

news_mentions.headline: NFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for 49ers, Cardinals, Rams, Seahawks
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Arizona Cardinals, Los Angeles Rams, San Francisco 49ers and Seattle Seahawks.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers and seattle seahawks catch up on each nfc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks three key storylines 1 sorting out brissett s contract drama installing rookie head coach mike lafleur s offense certainly hasn t gone off without a hitch jacoby brissett who took the quarterbacking reins from an injured kyler murray last season and never gave them back is the presumed starter and wants to get paid like one having skipped voluntary workouts brissett reported for mandatory minicamp to avoid fines but just how much actual work he got in isn t all that apparent will brissett hold out or hold in during training camp that threatens to become a prevailing topic in arizona even if it all gets sorted out the whole matter of getting ready for the football season remains lafleur has downplayed brissett s lack of offseason involvement citing the 33 year old s experience in the league but this is hardly a splendid way to kick off your head coaching career the good news is brissett threw for a career best 3 366 yards in 12 starts during a tumultuous 3 14 season in 2025 if the journeyman settles harmoniously into lafleur s offense perhaps improvement or at least a little excitement lies ahead for the cards 2 a whole lotta love right jeremiyah love could be the most anticipated 2026 rookie in the league at least on the offensive side all due respect to no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza but love s talent and eye popping ability is off the charts so much so that the cardinals used the third overall selection of the draft on him guaranteeing the 21 year old more money than any running back in nfl history there were plenty of question marks with the pick though the cardinals have holes aplenty on their roster but having signed tyler allgeier as a free agent and bringing back veteran banger james conner running back was far from the most glaring weakness in the end love was just too special a talent to pass up so how will lafleur handle his rookie love has made it clear he s a team first guy and on the franchise s current timeline immediately using love as a bell cow might not be wise even if it makes sense monetarily and to a fan base that would love to do nothing more than get behind a bona fide star we shall see 3 time for a new era over the previous two years the cardinals plucked three first round picks wide receiver marvin harrison 2024 no 4 overall and defensive linemen darius robinson 2024 no 27 and walter nolen 2025 no 16 that trio has combined to play 53 of a potential 85 games robinson 21 games in two years and nolen six games as a rookie have combined for four sacks and 12 starts harrison 103 receptions 1 493 yards and 12 touchdowns in 29 games has likely been the most disappointing seen as a can t miss selection who s floundered or at the least failed to live up to his pedigree as a top five pick after seven seasons kyler murray is gone after three years jonathan gannon is gone there s a new coach in lafleur and whether it s brissett more than likely gardner minshew or rookie carson beck there will be a new week 1 starting quarterback love looks every bit the can t miss sensation harrison seemed to be it s pivotal for the homegrown talent to blossom staying healthy is the first step meshing with lafleur is the next and that ll begin in earnest later this month back to top three key storylines 1 refacing defense around garrett the rams don t mess around when it comes to making a super bowl push having traded for then broncos pass rusher von miller before adding wide receiver odell beckham ahead of their run to super bowl lvi triumph the rams shook up this offseason by trading for myles garrett already an all time pass rushing great who s coming off a year in which he set a new single season sack record that move put an enormous cherry on top of an already rich roster but you can t crown a champion before the super bowl and just how well garrett meshes in defensive coordinator chris shula s system will be something to monitor during camp shula s already stated he s going to let garrett do what he does best while still sticking to his schematic principles byron young team high 12 sacks kobie turner seven and braden fiske three combined for 22 sacks last season with garrett s record breaking 23 ostensibly replacing jared verse s 7 5 as verse was sent to the browns nothing s easy in the nfl though this isn t copy and paste under former cleveland defensive coordinator jim schwartz garrett was a one man pass rushing gang racking up 51 sacks over the past three seasons he s arguably the finest quarterback menace of this century just how brightly he ll shine in l a will start to come into focus over the next few weeks 2 time to make the offseason count if there were offseason trophies to hand out los angeles would likely be first in line still for as loaded as this roster is it s imperative the rams stiff arm distractions and keep their heads from getting too high into the clouds puka nacua has a looming potentially top of the market extension and he needs to continue working on himself after a stint in rehab l a already caused a stir when it shocked the nfl world by drafting quarterback ty simpson with the 13th overall pick simpson who remains unsigned is battling it out with stetson bennett to back up reigning mvp matthew stafford who s coming back for his age 38 season there were also trade rumblings regarding davante adams but it seems like those are in the past meanwhile the rams added cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson from the chiefs corners who shine in kansas city don t always star elsewhere speaking of the chiefs their head coach andy reid once helmed an eagles squad dubbed the dream team after a haul of splendid offseason adds said dream team nightmarishly missed the playoffs nothing from an nfl offseason is guaranteed this l a story is all about winning a super bowl no reason for subplots with so much potential for greatness sean mcvay needs to keep his boys eyes on the prize 3 even with the reigning mvp rams have offensive questions regardless of how long in the tooth stafford is the 2025 nfl mvp is still brilliant in the arm like few others in the league he can spin it and make the mesmerizing look normal his league leading 4 707 yards and 46 touchdown tosses last season came with a talented but shallow receiver stable nacua led the nfl with 129 receptions adams contributed 60 grabs with an nfl high 14 going for tds l a didn t have another receiver with more than 18 catches that s one of the reasons drafting simpson when wide receivers makai lemon kc concepcion and omar cooper were still available was so puzzling konata mumpfield jordan whittington and sixth round rookie cj daniels could be the main depth pieces at wr leaders of the league s 13 personnel movement the rams have a staggering herd of tight ends with the most notable being colby parkinson tyler higbee terrance ferguson and rookie max klare ferguson only caught 11 passes as a rookie but he and parkinson could offer the most upside in the receiving game the nfl s no 1 offense in 2025 is expected to run it back in precision form but some fine tuning might lay ahead back to top three key storylines 1 getting healthy staying healthy is key conspiracy theorists can place the blame on electromagnetic fields from a nearby substation but for whatever reason injury woes have plagued kyle shanahan s squads for years niners starters missed north of 50 games in 2025 at the moment the anticipated returns of defensive end nick bosa torn acl missed 14 games tight end george kittle hamstring tear ankle sprain achilles tear six games and linebacker fred warner broken and dislocated ankle 11 games are atop the queue san francisco went 12 5 last season and advanced to the divisional round with those three who are each perennially regarded as among the best at their respective positions missing significant time warner is good to go bosa expects to be ready around the start of camp and kittle is working to return for week 1 however maintaining health is the key christian mccaffrey missed 13 games in 2024 but rebounded with an nfl high and career high 413 touches keeping cmc and the rest of the 49ers all star cast healthy has to be the top priority in camp and beyond there is no shortage of talent on the team san francisco just needs to keep it on the field to stay on pace in the shark infested nfc west 2 figuring out the wr room signing away mike evans from the buccaneers was a immense boon but he s missed 12 games over the past two seasons and will celebrate his 33rd birthday in august it s imperative that the stockpile of younger wideouts improves and the veteran adds of evans and christian kirk still have tread on the tires previous mainstays jauan jennings and deebo samuel are gone the latter is a free agent after a year with washington and it wouldn t be a shocker to see a reunion in san francisco jennings signed late in the offseason with the vikings brandon aiyuk is still technically with the team but is on the reserve left squad list while continually trolling the 49ers and plenty of others in video missives as evans and kirk get acclimated to quarterback brock purdy and shanahan s offense 2024 first rounder ricky pearsall faces a crucial camp needing to overcome past injuries and calamity to truly emerge similar things can be said about recent picks jacob cowing 2024 fourth rounder and jordan watkins 25 fourth rounder de 39 zhaun stribling taken in the second round this spring as the team s top draft choice profiles as perhaps the best replacement yet for samuel it s time for the fresh faces to step up in the passing game 3 defense must improve under a nother new dc from 2021 through 23 the 49ers were a top 10 defense in points and yards allowed the first two years in that span featured demeco ryans as defensive coordinator the current texans head coach has clearly left a large void steve wilks lasted just the 2023 season despite the team s super bowl run and overall great statistics third in points eighth in yards raheem morris is the next defensive coordinator up replacing robert saleh who was hired as the titans head coach after replacing 2024 dc nick sorensen as the fifth niners defensive play caller in five seasons morris should be helped hugely by the returns of fred warner and nick bosa but developing young talent ranks right up there with staying healthy when it comes to improving on last year s no 20 ranking in total d most glaringly the 2025 49ers finished dead last in team sacks with just 20 myles garrett now a division rival had 23 sacks on his own also on the injury comeback trail 2025 first rounder mykel williams bosa and williams getting healed up is a start the acquisition of defensive tackle osa odighizuwa in a trade with the cowboys might prove to be a pivotal move while the return of linebacker dre greenlaw after a lost year in denver could also bode well rookie third rounder romello height has already garnered some positive reports and alfred collins made a great first year impression morris might well be joining the 49ers at the right time back to top three key storylines 1 darnold staying on point sam darnold authored a storybook tale last season once viewed as a mega bust darnold quarterbacked the seahawks his fourth nfl team following the jets who used the 2018 nfl draft s third overall pick on him to a super bowl title darnold seemingly exorcised the ghosts of his past but he is still only 29 and has plenty to play for he s back with the pressure of defending a championship can he provide an encore earn a lucrative extension and keep seattle atop the league new offensive coordinator brian fleury s system is similar to the departed klint kubiak s but change is change and darnold must learn the differences continuity in the receiving corps should help with jaxon smith njigba leading a group that also includes cooper kupp jake bobo and rashid shaheed the last of whom should command a bigger role in the aerial attack after re signing on a lucrative deal in march furthermore tory horton flashed as a rookie last season before suffering a shin injury the speedster s return could have a dynamic domino effect adding another bona fide threat at receiver and another big play option in the return game which could open up more possibilities for shaheed in both avenues there s also optimism for a major breakout at tight end aj barner who scored the seahawks only offensive touchdown in the super bowl became a dude in his second season 52 receptions 519 yards six tds and might well become a pro bowl caliber player in year 3 if his chemistry with darnold continues 2 what s the frequency without kenneth with kenneth walker having signed with kansas city and zach charbonnet acl most likely absent to begin the season all eyes will be on first round draft pick jadarian price the notre dame product is a smooth runner who averaged 6 yards per carry in his career with the fighting irish however he was jeremiyah love s understudy and had 15 plus touches just once in his 41 games at nd the seahawks were adamant in balancing walker and charbonnet last season before the latter was injured asking price to take on a bell cow workload would seem unlikely camp could preview what kind of roles are in store for other backs like george holani and emanuel wilson perhaps rashid shaheed could be used a bit in the run game too the wide receiver corps along with the charles cross led offensive line are the offensive strengths but seattle wants balance that starts with price and will take shape before week 1 3 can seahawks avoid noise again in case you might have forgotten and judging by the lack of offseason pomp and circumstance many have the seahawks are the reigning super bowl champions for a franchise that boasts one of the loudest home field advantages the volume for a post lombardi offseason has seemingly been turned down to negative 11 that seems to be the preference for mike macdonald s seahawks though they snuck up on some people last season and after winning the most arduous division in football trounced the patriots in the super bowl this year jaxon smith njigba s not going to catch anyone by surprise the reigning offensive player of the year had a fine 2024 hitting 100 catches and exceeding 1 100 yards but he was an absolute force last season leading the league with 1 793 receiving yards and quickly erasing any doubt as to how the passing game would fare without dk metcalf also while jsn got paid this offseason his fellow 2023 first rounder devon witherspoon has yet to posing a potential problem for the seahawks right guard anthony bradford started all 17 games last year his third season in a row of starting the majority of the seahawks games he garnered a 51 9 overall pff grade which ranked 70th among the 81 guards who took at least 300 snaps could fifth rounder beau stephens replace him and solidify a longtime sore spot for seattle s starting lineup general manager john schneider was able to keep most of the lombardi band together but losing walker outside linebacker boye mafe cornerback tariq woolen and safety coby bryant isn t nothing keeping everything quiet and copacetic is far more difficult when you re defending champs so it s paramount for macdonald and schneider to figure out any issues before they grow into problems back to top

news_mentions.headline: AFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Broncos, Chargers, Chiefs, Raiders
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Bobby Kownack breaks down the top AFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Denver Broncos, Kansas City Chiefs, Las Vegas Raiders and Los Angeles Chargers.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams bobby kownack has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the denver broncos kansas city chiefs las vegas raiders and los angeles chargers catch up on each afc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below denver broncos kansas city chiefs las vegas raiders los angeles chargers three key storylines 1 nix s health receiving corps bo nix should be full go for training camp after suffering a broken ankle in last season s divisional round win but every step in the process bears watching when someone this important to a franchise is returning from injury once nix is out there eyes will also be glued to his pass catching group denver gifted its qb with a second no 1 wideout by trading for jaylen waddle to pair with courtland sutton and camp should provide the first hints as to whether the broncos will employ them as a 1a 1b combo or settle into a more defined pecking order plus can anyone from a proven supporting cast of troy franklin marvin mims and pat bryant emerge as the clear third option 2 denver has a new play caller reaching the doorstep of the super bowl didn t prevent sean payton from enacting sizable changes to the offensive staff he fired offensive coordinator joe lombardi two days after denver s afc title game loss and bumped davis webb up to replace him a month later payton publicly transferred play calling duties to the 31 year old former quarterback it s been a meteoric rise for webb who entered the coaching ranks as payton s qbs coach in 2023 webb has been learning under payton since then so nothing will be unrecognizable but nix still will need to get used to a new voice in his helmet any improvement for a 14th ranked scoring offense on a team that already won 14 games last season would be massive in the afc race 3 broncos are largely running it back roster wise the 2026 broncos are the personification of if it ain t broke don t fix it they took the big swing for waddle but barely signed any outside free agents denver instead focused on retaining talent losing defensive lineman john franklin myers and releasing linebacker dre greenlaw but basically keeping the band together even in the draft the club didn t make a pick until the third round apart from working waddle into the mix with webb now calling the shots the broncos can hit the ground running while many other contenders must start off with finding chemistry that s huge considering how unfriendly the first month and a half of denver s schedule appears at chiefs vs jaguars vs rams at 49ers at chargers and vs seahawks back to top three key storylines 1 when will mahomes be fully healthy patrick mahomes said during the offseason program that he s in a good spot in his acl lcl recovery and hopes to play in week 1 while andy reid told reporters the quarterback should be able to do some things at the start of training camp so how much will mahomes take on when the chiefs report and how quickly will he ramp up activity those questions don t have answers at the moment the chiefs hopes of returning to contention in 2026 and beyond rely heavily on the two time most valuable player so they ll be smart with him justin fields now on his fourth team in as many years could be one of the league s most intensely scrutinized backups as mahomes return timeline takes shape 2 kansas city s cb room begins anew again the chiefs have a habit of maximizing young cornerbacks talent and moving on before the bill comes due most recently they traded two time all pro trent mcduffie and let jaylen watson walk in free agency with both cover men going to the rams kansas city will call on 2025 third rounder nohl williams and mansoor delane this year s no 6 overall pick to fill the void fourth round rookie jadon canady should also be in competition for playing time with free agent signees kader kohou and l 39 jarius sneed the latter of whom returns to kansas city a couple of years after the team traded him to tennessee defensive coordinator steve spagnuolo s track record which includes three straight top six defenses in points allowed suggests things will work out just fine 3 bieniemy s back kansas city s offensive coordinator position has been devalued for years overshadowed by the prowess of patrick mahomes and andy reid perhaps it shouldn t have been during eric bieniemy s five years as the team s oc from 2018 through 2022 the chiefs never finished worse than sixth in the league in points or yards twice tallied the most points and three times amassed the most yards in the last three years without bieniemy the chiefs have ranked at average 17th in scoring and 15th in yardage there were obviously other factors in the decline such as tyreek hill exiting in a trade and travis kelce aging out of his prime but bieniemy returning still bodes well back to top three key storylines 1 mendoza s first camp the future of the raiders now rests on no 1 pick fernando mendoza s shoulders even if he isn t destined to start right away new head coach klint kubiak has communicated that his ideal scenario is to avoid putting a rookie under center in week 1 and by signing veteran kirk cousins las vegas essentially ensured mendoza s starting debut will come via choice rather than need still mendoza is coming off a perfect 16 0 season in which he took home the heisman trophy and led indiana to a national championship he s going to show up for the competition and all the buzz at raiders camp will revolve around him when he does 2 who steps up at wr las vegas has some starry names on offense quarterback fernando mendoza running back ashton jeanty and tight end brock bowers at wide receiver though there s work to do tre tucker was easily the team s most trustworthy wideout last year but he doesn t really profile as a wr1 jack bech and dont 39 e thornton 2025 second and fourth round picks respectively are looking to rebound from underwhelming rookie seasons free agent addition jalen nailor has a chance to show staying power in a larger role after flashing promise with 858 yards and 10 tds on 57 catches over the past two years with the vikings those are likely las vegas top four in some order but there s still a lot to shake out during the preseason 3 crosby s defense 2 0 in the four days between the raiders agreeing to send maxx crosby to the ravens and baltimore backing out of the trade las vegas spent a whole lot of dough rebuilding its defense for what was supposed to be the post crosby era now thanks to the blockbuster deal falling apart crosby is very much a part of the present the five time pro bowler returned to possibly the most talented unit the raiders have had during his career the linebacking corps has been rebuilt with nakobe dean and quay walker taron johnson brings more legitimacy to the cornerback room and kwity paye is set to line up on the edge opposite crosby reason for excitement in sin city extends far beyond the team s top picked qb back to top three key storylines 1 mcdaniel effect it was time for a change after the chargers scored 15 combined points in their last two wild card exits jim harbaugh fired offensive coordinator greg roman a longtime collaborator and replaced him with mike mcdaniel to hopefully supercharge the offense as the former dolphins coach did in his first couple years with miami mcdaniel s arrival as a quarterback whisperer is good news for justin herbert who already plays at a pro bowl level but the impact of his high octane system should be felt everywhere from the promising tight end trio of oronde gadsden david njoku and charlie kolar to omarion hampton in the backfield 2 fingers crossed for l a s o line los angeles offensive line should be a strength of the team in 2026 after disaster struck last season left tackle rashawn slater suffered a season ending patellar tendon tear in august while right tackle joe alt played just six games before requiring season ending ankle surgery herbert took a career high 54 sacks behind a patchwork offensive line leading the league with 268 pressures taken and a 43 3 pressure rate slater and alt are back but they ll also be joined on the line by free agent signings tyler biadasz and cole strange as well as second round rookie jake slaughter assuming the group stays healthy herbert should be well protected first though the bolts blockers have to jell together as a unit in august 3 chargers hope they have an edge rushing duo to build around the offseason didn t bring any sweeping changes for the chargers defense dalvin tomlinson 32 was their most notable signing to bulk up the interior and they lost a few pass rushers odafe oweh and da 39 shawn hand but largely maintained the status quo los angeles did however spend a first round pick on akheem mesidor the acc sack leader in 2025 with 12 5 there s enough pass rushing depth that mesidor won t have to take on too much too soon more importantly he has some stellar mentors in tuli tuipulotu who was sixth in the nfl last season with 13 sacks and nine time pro bowler khalil mack the hope is for a seamless transition from mack to mesidor alongside tuipulotu as the leaders of the l a edge rush back to top

news_mentions.description: With the start of NFL training camps just around the corner, Grant Gordon provides a refresher on the Arizona Cardinals' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc west catch up on the arizona cardinals offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 22 rookies and veterans location state farm stadium glendale ariz fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs kansas city chiefs 8 p m et on saturday aug 9 week 2 at denver broncos 7 p m et on saturday aug 16 week 3 vs las vegas raiders 4 30 p m et on saturday aug 23 2025 schedule note arizona plays san francisco and seattle in back to back weeks twice weeks 3 4 weeks 10 11 but doesn t play los angeles the reigning nfc west champion until week 14 and then again in week 18 nfl research what you need to know 1 beneficiaries of two first round draft picks in 2024 the cardinals were left wanting much more from marvin harrison and darius robinson in total harrison s 62 receptions for 885 yards and eight touchdowns as a rookie are pretty solid but many thought the no 4 overall selection would be a superstar out of the gate harrison and quarterback kyler murray furthering their chemistry could well be the team s prevailing storyline this season and that will get going in earnest during camp robinson picked 23 slots after harrison last year played in just six games because of a calf injury this will be a pivotal camp for him especially amid a revamped defensive front one that will offer him veterans to learn from and new faces to compete against for snaps 2 one of the easiest players in the nfl to root for calais campbell 38 returning to the team he began his illustrious career with in 2008 is more than just a feel great story campbell s leadership is just as important an addition as his talent to a club looking for its first winning season since 2021 this is a pivotal season for the monti ossenfort jonathan gannon regime and campbell pass rusher josh sweat and defensive tackle dalvin tomlinson should add some veteran moxie to a team lacking it outside of star safety budda baker gannon was hired for his defensive prowess coordinating the philadelphia eagles now his arizona d is finally stocked up at least on paper it s added some experienced talent and two high profile rookies in defensive lineman walter nolen first round no 16 overall and cornerback will johnson second no 47 johnson has the ceiling to become a massive draft steal how the cards defensive additions mesh with the starting staples begins this summer 3 james conner joined arizona in 2021 and has been a stellar fit who has exceeded his output and importance with the pittsburgh steelers for four years prior he s coming off career high tallies in carries 236 and rushing yards 1 094 but is entering his age 30 season 2024 third rounder trey benson 63 carries for 291 yards had a disappointing debut campaign but if he finds his footing could he push conner for touches it ll be interesting to see how camp develops in the arizona offensive backfield
