news_mentions.headline: AFC South training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Colts, Jaguars, Texans, Titans
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Kevin Patra breaks down the top AFC South training camp storylines to monitor for the Houston Texans, Indianapolis Colts, Jacksonville Jaguars and Tennessee Titans.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the houston texans indianapolis colts jacksonville jaguars and tennessee titans catch up on each afc south team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below houston texans indianapolis colts jacksonville jaguars tennessee titans three key storylines 1 another o line overhaul the most glaring weakness of the 2025 texans will take center stage during training camp as houston once again undergoes an offensive line revamp demeco ryans crew re upped right guard ed ingram and left tackle aireontae ersery showed glimpses of promise during his up and down rookie campaign the texans drafted center guard keylan rutledge in the first round they inked guard wyatt teller and right tackle braden smith both solid veterans when healthy in free agency veteran trent brown and 2024 second rounder blake fisher will battle for reps and or the swing tackle gig and evan brown and fourth round rookie febechi nwaiwu provide depth inside on paper it s a significantly improved group from the one that got bowled over a year ago however we ve said that before paper can get shredded just like last year s o line in houston how the crew shakes out will be the key to camp and how the texans season unfolds 2 can stroud offense get back on track tied to the first point is the play of c j stroud who has seen his production dip the past two seasons after a sensational rookie campaign in 2023 stroud s collapse reached a low with his ghastly performance see four interceptions 42 6 completion rate in the playoff loss to the new england patriots stroud has been scattershot behind a woeful offensive line at times last year he trusted his blocking so little that even when he had time he d rush decisions and make panicked throws the qb s play has been so incongruous to the poise and calm he displayed as a rookie that it s maddening for the offense to get back in gear and stop wasting a championship worthy defense stroud must be more consistent in the pocket an improved offensive line will certainly help but the qb must raise all boats even when the situation isn t perfect getting better run production with the import of david montgomery should improve the offensive efficiency monty rarely gets stuffed for negative gains solving a problem we saw far too often from houston s ground game a year ago he should keep the offense in better down and distances one other key player to track during camp is receiver tank dell who has been out since late in the 2024 season due to a severe knee injury the difference in stroud s production with and without dell in the lineup is stark what sort of shape will the receiver be in after so much time away and can he stay healthy 3 rich defense gets richer can the most ferocious defense in the league actually be better in 2026 edge monsters will anderson and danielle hunter are still in their primes derek stingley kamari lassiter jalen pitre and calen bullock form a lockdown backend and azeez al shaair still patrols the middle the texans upgraded a safety spot with veteran reed blankenship after shuffling through others at the position second round pick kayden mcdonald could play a significant role out of the gate alongside sheldon rankins and tommy togiai in the middle of the d line if mcdonald turns out to be a steal this defense will have zero weaknesses back to top three key storylines 1 how will jones look in return from injury daniel jones progress is the no 1 topic in indianapolis entering camp the colts predictably held the starter out of team drills during offseason workouts but expect him to be full go sometime during camp the focus will be on how many reps he can take and how he looks indy was a wonder early last season when jones was on his game making plays and looking at home in shane steichen s offense it fell apart when the qb got hurt the colts put all their eggs in the basket of jones returning healthy this offseason achilles injuries however can be a slog to return from yes jones is younger than kirk cousins but we saw how long it took for the latter to return to anything close to what he was before such an injury and cousins never relied on his mobility like jones does if jones is stuck in the pocket or struggles to push off the injured leg leading to limp passes will the colts offense wither how he looks early in camp won t say everything but it will give a strong indication of what to expect for the first quarter of the season in concert the colts will conduct a backup qb competition between anthony richardson and riley leonard barring richardson s trade request being granted of course given jones injury history the winner could see reps this season 2 overall roster health health is the main storyline throughout the colts roster from jones to alec pierce on offense to key defenders like deforest buckner and sauce gardner on defense buckner is one to track on d the colts have no replacement for the star dt who underwent neck surgery last winter he could be ready for week 1 but at this point it remains an unknown he was noncommittal when asked this offseason given how much of the summer months are filled with players dismissing injury and assuming they ll be ready it s a red flag when a veteran is evasive if buckner misses the start of the season or sees his play dip it could be devastating for indy s defense how much he participates in camp if at all will be closely tracked there isn t the same concern with gardner who missed significant time last season with a lingering calf injury but the star s status is worth keeping an eye on we also aren t sure what charvarius ward will look like after deciding against retiring following last year s concussion issues outside of injury questions what will the pass rush look like is laiatu latu ready to make a leap how much does arden key still have left is jt tuimoloau ready for a bigger role do the colts need to bring in another veteran edge 3 taylor s future in indy outside of health concerns hovering over colts camp the future of jonathan taylor is an interesting question the 27 year old running back is in the final year of his contract the situation is far less contentious than the last time he sought a new pact which saw him conduct a hold in until he got paid when asked about his contract this summer taylor was cordial about the state of affairs but made it known he d like to continue getting paid in indy could the situation turn sour again will the rb decide to ratchet things up if no extension comes before camp perhaps he s waiting for bijan robinson and jahmyr gibbs to reset the market again before making his next play we saw the offense s struggles when jones was out as defenses could sell out to stop jt it wasn t pretty if taylor is going to be asked to keep carrying a hefty load with little aid he might want commensurate compensation into the future back to top three key storylines 1 backfield shakeup when travis etienne signed in new orleans it opened up a swath of carries bhayshul tuten who has impressed this offseason is expected to have a hefty role but it s still unclear how big that part might be as free agent addition chris rodriguez was unable to participate in offseason workouts following a surgical procedure on his left foot the veteran is expected to be good to go for training camp which will give us a better idea of how liam coen might divvy up his rb reps last year etienne took the overwhelming majority of carries 260 to tuten s 83 will coen slice up the pie more or ride tuten at least to start the season a lot might have to do with rodriguez s health 2 what will hunter s role be when it was reported that the jags planned for the former no 2 overall pick to be a primary corner and part time receiver travis hunter didn t seem to take too kindly to that plan we won t know the truth until hunter is on the field for a significant amount of time how much he participates early in camp and where that participation takes place will indicate the club s intentions if the second year dual threat player is the lockdown corner most believe he s capable of being and continues to make plays at receiver the jags could have trouble taking him off the gridiron the rest of the offensive playmakers could have some say in how much time hunter sees at wr after a disappointing second season brian thomas has received glowing reviews this offseason parker washington soared to close last season and jakobi meyers remains a consistent professional if btj gets back on track there could be less of a reason to use hunter in a ton of offensive sets 3 lloyd s replacement the jags saw devin lloyd leave in free agency and didn t replace his production in anthony campanile s defense via free agency or early in the draft the decision puts 2023 fourth rounder ventrell miller in line to take over the role next to foye oluokun miller showed spunk this offseason but won t be handed the starting gig 2025 undrafted lb branson combs and 2026 seventh rounder parker hughes could have a shot to push miller for the starting gig if no one comes to the forefront the jags d could be in a rough spot lloyd shined last year under campanile who unleashed the linebacker s athleticism in a second team all pro campaign lacking playmaking in the middle would highlight some of the questions up front where there wasn t always consistent pressure from the front four back to top three key storylines 1 cam ward cam ward cam ward when discussing critical elements for the 2026 tennessee titans point nos 1 through 50 could all be about cam ward that s how vital his development is to any success in nashville robert saleh brings a professional coach to the head chair and did well to import brian daboll to nurture the young quarterback perhaps daboll wasn t meant for the head coaching gig in new york but he s proven he can help grow a qb josh allen daniel jones and jaxson dart all improved under daboll ward offers enticing upside while his accuracy came and went last year when he was in a groove the titans qb showcased a laser arm and the ability to find the range deep he needs to calibrate his short to mid area throws at times but the alluring positives pop off the page he doesn t need to live in the acrobatic athletic plays but they can add an indefensible element to tennessee s offense improving his mental processing particularly against man coverage where he struggled is one of the early steps ward has to make this season the titans must see significant strides forward from their qb in year 2 after the club improved his surroundings 2 better receiving corps in attempting to make life easier for ward tennessee upgraded the wr room first they inked wan 39 dale robinson from new york the slot maven excelled in daboll s offense and can help teach a young wideout room the ropes robinson is coming off a 1 014 yard season and generated a career high 11 yards per catch in 2025 the veteran will be particularly helpful to ward on third downs when he can win from the slot and make himself available to the quarterback then the titans used the no 4 overall pick on ohio state wr carnell tate who provides a vertical threat and heady playmaking tate s ability to make catches in close knit areas will be a boon for his new qb second year wrs elic ayomanor and chimere dike both showed glimmers of promise during their rookie campaigns if they take a step forward this could be an enticing group the lingering question is what role calvin ridley will play the veteran struggled on the field and missed the bulk of the season due to injury in seven tilts he had just 303 yards on 17 catches with zero tds his 11 1 drop rate last season was fifth worst in the nfl minimum 25 targets per next gen stats the titans eschewed cutting ridley believing he can still aid ward and the offense what that role is will be determined during camp 3 will improved d on paper translate to field the titans sported a woeful defense last season with saleh taking over the club the unit was completely revamped on paper it s much improved but how will all the new pieces mesh i love adding a penetrating john franklin myers next to all world dt jeffery simmons however is there enough on the edges jermaine johnson had his best years under saleh but hasn t been a consistent force first round rookie keldric faulk boasts talent but will he be a day 1 difference maker will second round rookie linebacker anthony hill immediately step into the middle of the defense next to the underrated cedric gray the secondary was horrendous last season tennessee responded by signing cordale flott alontae taylor and joshua williams all have had moments in their careers when they ve been stellar but there is also a reason each was available namely inconsistency i trust saleh to know how he wants his d to run and to get the most out of his players there is no question this crew is significantly improved on paper but questions remain particularly with all the free agent veteran additions back to top

news_mentions.body_text: each sunday three of the athletic 39 s nfl writers react to the biggest news plays and performances from the day 39 s games every sunday matters in the nfl that 39 s what makes the league so popular but this sunday seemed especially consequential with a significant quarterback injury a stunning comeback and several key division matchups the biggest news of the day came early as the return of baltimore ravens quarterback lamar jackson lasted one play before he left with a thumb injury it got worse when backup tyler huntley also left with an injury in the end emergency quarterback joe fagnano gave a game performance but it wasn 39 t nearly enough in a 36 10 loss to the buffalo bills now the ravens will have to hold their breath and see if their franchise quarterback is going to miss the rest of the season the most important game of the day was in detroit as the lions handed the minnesota vikings their first loss of the season detroit 39 s offense did just enough against the dominant minnesota defense in a 19 15 win the wildest game of the day was in dallas as the arizona cardinals scored two touchdowns in the final three minutes of regulation and won 33 30 in overtime it was another stunning collapse by the cowboys in a season that is getting away from them the season has already gotten away from the indianapolis colts who suffered a humiliating 42 7 loss to the jacksonville jaguars the fire sale that started earlier this week could accelerate with the trade deadline looming nfl writers mike jones austin mock and ted nguyen share their thoughts on the ravens 39 quarterback mess the stumbling cowboys the surging lions and the hapless indianapolis colts should the ravens trade serious draft capital for a quarterback in an attempt to save their season if lamar jackson misses a significant amount of time jones if tyler huntley will not miss time then the ravens don 39 t even need to consider this if both jackson and huntley will miss time baltimore needs to do something but there 39 s not really a quarterback worthy of serious draft capital on the trading block when it comes to veterans capable of stepping in and leading a team effectively the pickings are rather slim the cincinnati bengals aren 39 t going to trade joe flacco to a divisional rival the san francisco 49ers aren 39 t going to part with mac jones andy dalton would seem to have a little left in the tank and is a member of the atlanta falcons 39 crowded quarterback room but he wouldn 39 t seemingly command 34 serious draft capital 34 another option josh johnson who is in his 19th professional season and is a member of the bengals 39 practice squad baltimore wouldn 39 t have to trade for him to add him to their roster mock i don 39 t think so and am pretty sure that would be a poor decision in the long run first being desperate and turning to the trade market is a dangerous combination second i 39 m not even sure who you 39 d trade for at this point kirk cousins is probably the only starter that makes sense but i 39 m not sure if the las vegas raiders would be willing to do that mac jones will certainly be buzzy but i 39 m skeptical what we saw in half a season under kyle shanahan in the 49ers 39 system is the type of production you 39 ll get in baltimore at the end of the day you have to be content with understanding that the future is more important than the now and that 39 s where i 39 m at with the ravens maybe you can win some games down the stretch with poor quarterback play but if not you get a better draft pick to supplement lamar jackson for 2027 and beyond nguyen i 39 m not sure who would be available that could help them at this point cousins is leading the league in touchdown passes but i think the raiders are intent on keeping him as fernando mendoza 39 s mentor maybe the bears would be willing to trade tyson bagent and go with case keenum as their backup bagent knows offensive coordinator declan doyle 39 s system and the transition should be relatively simple it would take maybe a second round pick for the 49ers to trade mac jones there just aren 39 t a lot of options i 39 m not sure if the ravens defense is good enough to hold things together during a qb transition period sometimes you just have to accept your fate at the very least they may get to keep doyle longer who 39 s most to blame for the cowboys 39 stunning collapse against the cardinals jones there 39 s plenty of blame to go around a defense that let gardner minshew come off the bench to carve them up for three touchdown passes while completing 17 of 23 passes for 188 yards in less than 17 minutes of play a defense that let tyler allgeier gash them for 147 rushing yards and a touchdown on just 11 touches a defense that let michael wilson rack up 111 receiving yards and a touchdown on eight catches a defense that surrendered 30 points after halftime or do we want to go with a cowboys offense that got out gained 467 261 while averaging just 3 6 yards per play this was a bad day all around for coach brian schottenheimer and his team mock can i say everyone because it 39 s not that simple the easy answer is the defense because they 39 ve been horrendous for two seasons now and the offseason moves to address that side of the ball haven 39 t come to fruition the defense isn 39 t even close to being a respectable unit right now and you can 39 t consistently win games in the nfl with a unit that bad but the offense deserves some blame too with their inability to run the ball 34 percent success rate against the cardinals which resulted in them being unable to put away the cardinals with a lead so that comes back to the blame on everyone the coaching staff on both sides of the ball the front office it 39 s all bad right now the coaching staff isn 39 t elevating the talent they have and the front office hasn 39 t given them the talent to be a winning football team so while it 39 s easy to point fingers at one person or one unit the blame is shared and goes the whole way to the top of the organization nguyen the offense certainly deserves blame for not putting away the game against a cardinals defense that had been struggling however the defense gave up 20 points in the fourth quarter to a minshew led offense without any timeouts the cardinals drove 80 yards in just over a minute and should have won the game in regulation but missed an extra point and there were wide open receivers the cardinals weren 39 t making a bunch of amazing catches in overtime the offense went three and out and the cardinals drove right down the field the detroit lions didn 39 t light up the scoreboard against the minnesota vikings 39 fearsome defense but jared goff led the game winning drive in the fourth quarter goff has 15 touchdown passes and one interception is he the mvp so far this season jones if you ask vegas goff doesn 39 t even crack the top five in the mvp race the popular picks josh allen brock purdy joe burrow patrick mahomes and trevor lawrence lead the way according to most books however goff certainly deserves consideration sunday was a big statement game for the lions and the 11th year veteran goff has been masterful this season especially against the blitz where entering sunday 39 s game he had completed roughly 77 percent of his passes the vikings definitely got to him on sunday but when it mattered most goff came through goff has provided stability and effectiveness despite a change at offensive coordinator and injuries on that side of the ball and despite all the change detroit boasts one of the most prolific offenses in the league thanks largely to goff mock goff came into this week sixth in quarterback index qbi heading into the week and i 39 m not sure his stat line against the vikings will improve that number but it 39 s the vikings so we are happy to give him a pass but with the weapons that they have on offense it 39 s hard for me to see goff getting enough credit to win the award the lions have a ton of talent going around with jahmyr gibbs amon ra st brown and even on the offensive line with penei sewell and then you factor in that allen is still doing otherworldly things in buffalo i don 39 t know if he can be the favorite with goff being non existent in the run game his passing numbers would need to be above and beyond allen and others and with gibbs in the backfield i 39 m not sure we will see that in the conversation sure but he 39 s in that second tier right now and likely behind allen purdy and mahomes if i was in charge nguyen he should definitely be in the conversation the hiring of offensive coordinator drew petzing and passing game coordinator mike kafka has gotten this offense back on track the lions still are a run first team and gibbs might win offensive player of the year goff has been extremely productive but it 39 s hard to overlook the super human play of allen this season goff 39 s final numbers would have to be substantially better than allen 39 s for him to win in my opinion after trading two of their best players the colts were crushed by the jaguars they don 39 t own their first round pick and daniel jones looks lost after getting a huge contract extension is this the most bleak situation in the nfl right now jones the colts have two more wins than the winless chargers but it 39 s clear indianapolis is headed toward a franchise reset this offseason they 39 ve already fired their general manager and unloaded two key players in quenton nelson and deforest buckner they really should go ahead and move jonathan taylor and josh downs and anyone else they can to stockpile picks for their next gm to work with in the spring mock i think so yes and if i were in charge i 39 d be selling off just about every player i could to try and maximize my draft capital in the coming years considering the colts don 39 t have their first rounder and with new ownership will a promising general manager and or coaching staff be willing to come in for a rebuild if head coach shane steichen isn 39 t around next season you 39 d have to really sell the new front office and staff on this being a long rebuild and preach patience because the roster is void of talent on both sides of the ball and there is no future quarterback at the moment and even then if you hit on a quarterback how long does it take to surround your rookie with enough talent to compete for titles before you have to pay him a gaudy amount with the lack of draft capital this is certainly the franchise furthest from winning and will need a full rebuild and most importantly time to get this thing turned around nguyen can 39 t think of many worse than the colts right now who don 39 t have a first round pick the sauce gardner trade for two first round picks could be the worst trade since the browns 39 for deshaun watson maybe the colts could recoup a first for taylor extending jones from a small sample of successful play after a career 39 s worth of underwhelming play was a bad mistake chris ballard put this team in dire straits before his firing which is one of the dangers of having a gm on the hot seat they start to make desperate moves to save their job this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: 2026 NFL season, Week 8: What We Learned from Sunday's games
news_mentions.description: Around The NFL breaks down what you need to know from Sunday's action in Week 8 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 8 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below early window buffalo bills 36 baltimore ravens 10 cincinnati bengals 43 tennessee titans 36 ot arizona cardinals 33 dallas cowboys 30 ot detroit lions 19 minnesota vikings 15 jacksonville jaguars 42 indianapolis colts 7 las vegas raiders 38 new york jets 33 pittsburgh steelers 27 cleveland browns 6 tampa bay buccaneers 16 atlanta falcons 0 late window los angeles rams 24 los angeles chargers 9 denver broncos 28 kansas city chiefs 24 new england patriots 24 miami dolphins 19 sunday night washington commanders 27 philadelphia eagles 10 nick shook s takeaways bills let hunters loose buffalo s biggest underlying question mark was its defense a leaky unit that struggled to get stops and limit opposing offenses in what became weekly shootouts for the bills that finally changed for the better on sunday with lamar jackson exiting quickly and tyler huntley back in the lineup buffalo decided it was time to hunt the quarterback dialing up blitzes and registering pressures on half of huntley s four passes which also incidentally forced huntley out of the game due to injury once undrafted rookie joe fagnano took over the carnivorous bills saw nothing but red meat blitzing on 64 5 of their total defensive snaps logging qb pressures at a rate of 61 3 and short circuiting baltimore s offense all afternoon the ravens finished with just 144 net yards of offense scored their only touchdown via a short field earned by a broderick washington interception and couldn t piece together more than one drive of significance which ended in a 26 yard tyler loop field goal buffalo s defense made sure it wouldn t allow derrick henry to carry the ravens and denied fagnano the space to breathe overwhelming the inexperienced signal caller in a runaway win quarterback injuries decimate ravens lamar jackson s anticipated return lasted just one snap his first pass attempt fell incomplete and on the follow through to his throw jackson s thumb collided with a defender s hand resulting in an injury that will land jackson on injured reserve for the foreseeable future after a few weeks of backup turned starter duty tyler huntley found himself on the field sunday appearing skittish and struggling to gain a single yard through the air before an injury knocked him out of action as well leaving the ravens with their emergency third qb joe fagnano as their only remaining option the uconn product gave his best effort but was constantly under duress leaving the ravens with little room to move the ball all afternoon zay flowers went without a catch on five targets rashod bateman s one catch for 22 yards accounted for the most receiving production for any raven and running back justice hill led baltimore in receptions with four it was a lifeless offense that left the ravens defense on the field for far too long buffalo won the time of possession battle 37 36 to 22 24 and sunday s display should rightfully worry ravens fans about their team s outlook for the remainder of 2026 it sounds as if jackson s season could be finished and recent results without him including sunday are discouraging at best moore delivers in return after missing a handful of weeks buffalo welcomed back its prized offseason acquisition d j moore who showed no signs of hesitancy and delivered a strong outing four catches 82 yards including a spectacular grab for 49 yards to set up a james cook touchdown and a touchdown catch moore s return helped draw some attention away from buffalo s tight ends dalton kincaid finished with a team best 86 yards and a touchdown on four catches took a bit of pressure off cook and unlocked enough of the unit s attack to help the bills climb out of a grind it out start to pour it on in the second half moore s rapport with josh allen remains strong even after the time off and helped allen pass jim kelly for the franchise s all time lead in touchdowns 260 now moore will need to prove he can be this reliable on a weekly basis next gen stats insight for ravens bills via nfl pro the bills blitzed on 64 5 of opposing dropbacks against the ravens in week 8 their highest blitz rate since 2021 and the highest blitz rate ravens quarterbacks have faced this season the bills blitz rate had not exceeded 39 in any of their prior six games this season when blitzing the bills generated 11 pressures including a season high seven quick pressures under 2 5 seconds and three sacks including a strip sack fumble recovery in the second quarter nfl research josh allen and james cook each had a rushing touchdown in week 8 marking the 16th time that allen and cook have scored a rushing touchdown in the same game sixteen games breaks a tie with dak prescott and ezekiel elliott for the most games by any teammate duo in nfl history in which both players had a rushing touchdown back to top bobby kownack s takeaways burrow was everything good bad about bengals offense what a roller coaster performance by joe burrow the cincy quarterback unquestionably served as the team s hero accounting for six touchdowns in an unexpected shootout with the titans but his three interceptions contributed initially to a slow start and later allowed tennessee to stay in it two of those picks were deep heaves to ja 39 marr chase with one way overthrown and another that came up far too short if you re going to make mistakes though make sure you make up for them burrow did that and more piling on the points and feeding his top two receivers to great success tee higgins had 10 catches for 155 yards and two tds on 11 targets while chase tallied 11 receptions for 141 yards and a score on 16 looks burrow also importantly cleaned it up in crunch time of his five drives that took place in the fourth quarter or overtime one ended in a chase brown fumble and the other ticked down the final 17 seconds to the extra frame on the other three burrow marched his bengals 73 81 and 70 yards throwing two touchdowns and scoring the game winner on a 9 yard scramble he finished with 426 yards five tds and three ints on 38 of 48 passing marking his third consecutive game with at least four passing touchdowns it s a bit scary how many points the bengals put up despite four giveaways and that s all credit to burrow standout performances not enough for tennessee there was not an ounce of quit in the titans after trading away their best player defensive tackle jeffery simmons on thursday the defense still generated four takeaways the most it has had in a game this season safety amani hooker had joe burrow s number intercepting him a whopping three times while defensive end jacob martin tallied three sacks and linebacker anthony hill was relentless with 14 tackles on offense cam ward enjoyed by far his best game of the season despite being without carnell tate ward dissected cincinnati s defense with regularity going 26 of 40 for 304 yards and two touchdowns snapping a five game interception streak and nearly doubling his average of 168 4 passing yards per game he led two separate go ahead td drives in the fourth quarter plus tony pollard continued his recent resurgence rushing for 117 yards and two scores after going for 129 and three tds in week 7 his 40 yard touchdown to open the scoring will be one of the highlights of the day in his or any game with pollard breaking multiple tackles before stiff arming one bengals defender into another s path in a keystone cops sequence on the way to pay dirt of course it was still not enough for the 1 7 titans but the fight they showed was admirable regardless of the nfl s aversion to moral victories concerning trends taking shape for bengals the most important result from sunday is the bengals moving to 5 2 in a highly competitive afc north however there are some underlying issues still plaguing cincinnati the bengals found themselves trailing 13 0 for the second straight week this deficit came at the end of the first quarter unlike last week s halftime hole against the ravens and the bengals started picking it up much earlier to go into intermission with a lead but they couldn t pull away like they did in baltimore instead the titans pushed them to overtime taking advantage of a defense that forced a pair of turnovers but couldn t get enough stops to make things easy in the past three games the bengals have needed to outlast a one win titans team in overtime looked asleep for far too long facing backup quarterback tyler huntley and let a then winless dolphins squad make things uncomfortable late before that it was two straight losses those who choose optimism will point to the bengals record and their three game winning streak but venturing through a season as escape artists typically catches up down the line next gen stats insight for titans bengals via nfl pro amani hooker picked off joe burrow three times which included 15 3 expected points added across five targets in coverage the second most coverage epa by a player in a game this season hooker allowed only 12 yards in coverage on the day nfl research joe burrow became just the second quarterback in league history to have 450 plus passing yards five plus passing tds and a rushing td in a game joining norm van brocklin week 1 1951 back to top nick shook s takeaways qb change sparks comeback through nearly three quarters the cardinals were repeating the same frustrating offensive performance that had become all too familiar in recent weeks jacoby brissett was under constant pressure and resorting to throws that amounted to little more than prayers and after watching brissett take two consecutive sacks for double digit negative yardage in the third quarter coach mike lafleur had enough calling for gardner minshew to replace the battered brissett oddly enough the quarterback change coincided with a revival of the running game that depended solely on tyler allgeier after jeremiyah love left with another ankle injury and bam knight was knocked out of action due to a concussion allgeier put the team on his back rushing 11 times for 147 yards and a touchdown and repeatedly turning to the sideline oxygen tank as a means of survival minshew meanwhile created a rhythm in the passing game that the cardinals haven t enjoyed in over a month completing 17 of 23 passes for 188 yards and three touchdowns including a magnificent final touchdown drive that covered 80 yards in eight plays and 1 03 to tie the game and balancing the offense by turning to michael wilson plenty eight catches 111 yards one touchdown arizona pulled off this 23 point outburst and improbable comeback after losing love knight and receiver kendrick bourne maximizing its returns with its remaining contributors with just enough time to escape defeat it will likely prompt a quarterback change and could be a minor springboard forward for a team that was desperate for a morale boosting win like this cowboys collapse could have devastating effect dallas will look back at this game and have no choice but to admit this was its worst loss of 2026 entering the final minute of the third quarter the cowboys were in control holding a 17 3 lead that was all but guaranteed to eventually become 20 3 or larger in that moment though their defense broke down surrendering a rumbling 63 yard touchdown run to tyler allgeier the first of a few massive chunks gained by allgeier in the final 16 minutes of regulation on a 52 yard allgeier run in the fourth quarter safety caleb downs got pancaked by hjalte froholdt twice in the same play typifying arizona s sudden takeover with the image of downs tumbling across the turf like a runaway cheese wheel speeding down a hill this all happened after dallas had suffocated arizona s offense for the first 44 minutes of the game and the cardinals awakening delivered repeated violent blows to the ribcage of the cowboys defense landing a liver punch in the form of a michael wilson dependent touchdown drive to tie the game in the final six seconds of regulation a quick defensive stop and a 44 yard scoring drive in overtime sent the cowboys to the mat for good resulting in one of the most stunning outcomes of the entire nfl season this type of loss can send a team into a spiral could cost defensive coordinator christian parker his job and will undoubtedly cause cowboys fans to angrily punch the air the same problems persist they still can t beat the lowly cardinals in texas and the solutions continue to prove fleeting arizona s rebuilt backfield disintegrates but one pillar remains standing tyler allgeier s second half outburst produced a victory for the cardinals but it was even more triumphant for a workhorse who has often been left to the shadows of more recognizable running mates in atlanta and arizona the talk at the start of the season revolved around first round pick jeremiyah love and when the cardinals couldn t generate consistently on the ground love s absence was quickly blamed allgeier never quite saw the chances he needed to blossom but found himself in an unexpected moment of opportunity sunday when love and bam knight exited due to injury he could have played an average brand of football as the lone remaining runner available but that s not allgeier those who were unfamiliar with his style were reminded rudely on his 63 yard touchdown run in which he broke three tackles and followed a trio of teammates who escorted him to the goal line where he fell across it for a score while finally being brought down that touchdown made it a 17 10 game but more importantly it gave the cardinals reason to believe his ensuing 52 yarder saw hjalte froholdt get out in front and wreck caleb downs in open space setting an aggressive tone embodied by the runner benefitting from the blocking in those two plays and gardner minshew s stint as a mid game replacement the cardinals brought the fight to the cowboys refusing to lay down despite a double digit deficit and little reason to believe they d turn things around because of allgeier s toughness determination and relentless desire to produce when called upon he also caught five passes for 44 yards and an incredibly gritty touchdown reception the cardinals pulled off the stunning win and might have found a new identity in the process next gen stats insight for cardinals cowboys via nfl pro tyler allgeier carried the ball 11 times for 147 yards and a touchdown in week 8 against the cowboys including three explosive gains of 10 or more yards after totaling just two explosive gains across 61 carries over the first seven weeks of the season allgeier recorded a 63 yard touchdown run on arizona s final play from scrimmage in the third quarter before opening the cardinals next drive with a 52 yard scamper he gained 96 rushing yards over expected the most by a cardinals rusher in a game since at least 2018 additionally allgeier finished as the cardinals third leading receiver catching all five targets for 44 yards and a touchdown nfl research the cardinals last second touchdown positioned them to kick a go ahead extra point with 0 06 remaining sunday but chad ryland pushed his attempt wide left entering the cardinals into some exclusive and undesirable company they became the third team to miss a go ahead pat in the final 10 seconds of regulation joining the bengals week 1 2022 and buccaneers week 2 2003 back to top kevin patra s takeaways lions run over undefeated vikings to close gap in nfc north detroit figured out the best way to combat brian flores relentless pressure packages go to the ground after falling behind 15 12 midway through the fourth quarter detroit ran the ball on 11 of its final 13 non kneel plays one of those two jared goff throws was the go ahead touchdown toss to jameson williams detroit leaned on jahmyr gibbs and bruising backup sione vaki gibbs blasted his way to 153 rushing yards and a td on 23 carries while vaki chipped in 11 totes for 65 yards detroit getting production from vaki is a positive sign for the lions down the stretch the lions couldn t get out of their way early with miscues hampering dan campbell s club including some bad penalties goff missed passes early and threw his first interception of the season when williams slipped on a route detroit put up just six points and goff was sacked four times through two quarters then the run game took over allowing the qb to utilize play action and wear down the vikings d it wasn t a perfect game for the home squad but the offense perked up late when needed to close out a big win that bunches the division even closer it was a need to have home game for detroit dan campbell s crew came up clutch in the end vikings offensive struggles continued it was only a matter of time before brian flores defense couldn t carry the day minnesota has been playing on the razor s edge through its first six wins with the defense spearheading wins while the offense was along for the ride against a high powered lions offense flores defense did enough forcing a turnover early field goals and a pivotal late three and out yes the defense ran out of gas against jahmyr gibbs late but kevin o connell s offense needed to do more kyler murray managed the game early but missed too many throws particularly high which led to stalled drives nearly a quarter of murray s 210 yards 24 3 came on a 51 yard bomb to jordan addison the qb missed several other shots right now murray isn t a station to station passer when the big plays don t connect the vikings offense struggles against a lions defense that entered with the worst pass d in the nfl and allowing the most yards murray came up small the vikings generated just 266 yards and 15 first downs going 3 for 10 on third down and 0 for 1 on fourth down isn t winning offense koc needs his offense to find itself at the start of a tough stretch of games right now it s not close detroit s defense stepped up for the second straight week kelvin sheppard s defense has played up a level the defensive line particularly the interior pestered kyler murray alim mcneill led the way with four qb pressures and one sack the secondary did a better job sticking with vikings receivers where we d seen wrs scamper wide open early in the season detroit s secondary at least challenged most plays cornerback d j reed was having his best game including a diving int and a big late pass breakup before leaving with an injury when the defensive line is getting pressure and the secondary plays on a string it s a workable defense the issue sheppard faces now is that he lost a trove of players on sunday star linebacker jack campbell was taken to a local hospital after suffering a neck injury d j wonnum and brian branch each exited with concussions after a collision rookie linebacker jimmy rolder suffered a hamstring injury reed s was a hip can an already shaky unit overcome injuries moving forward next gen stats insight for lions and did not return running back bam knight concussion and wide receiver kendrick bourne ankle were ruled out baltimore ravens quarterback lamar jackson right thumb was ruled out from sunday s game against buffalo jackson needs surgery on his injured thumb and will be placed on injured reserve coach jesse minter said after the game qb tyler huntley was also ruled out and suffered what is thought to be a turf toe injury per espn s adam schefter huntley is expected to undergo an mri on monday schefter reported buffalo bills wide receiver josh palmer hamstring was ruled out of sunday s win over baltimore chicago bears linebackers coach richard smith will not travel with the team to seattle for monday s game against the seahawks due to a health issue the team announced assistant linebackers coach kevin koch will handle lb coach duties per the team cincinnati bengals defensive end cashius howell right wrist and defensive end cedric johnson left ankle were ruled out of sunday s win over tennessee cleveland browns defensive tackle maliek collins elbow did not return to sunday s loss to pittsburgh dallas cowboys tight end jake ferguson ankle was ruled out of sunday s loss to arizona cornerback joey porter ankle did not return while safety caleb downs was evaluated for a concussion and ruled out detroit lions linebacker jack campbell was transported to a local hospital to be evaluated for a neck injury suffered in the second half of sunday s win over minnesota the team announced campbell is resting and will remain in the hospital on sunday night for continued evaluation and monitoring campbell left the field on a stretcher after suffering the injury center cade mays ankle running back jacob saylors neck edge rusher d j wonnum concussion and safety brian branch news_mentions.headline: NFL Network: Packers, Micah Parsons (knee) targeting Thanksgiving Eve return vs. Rams
news_mentions.description: The Packers and Micah Parsons are targeting Green Bay's Thanksgiving Eve game against the Rams as the first game the three-time All-Pro will take the field since tearing his ACL in Week 15 of last year, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport reported.
news_mentions.body_text: there s now a clear date in mind for micah parsons s return the packers and parsons are targeting green bay s thanksgiving eve showdown with the rams as the first game the three time all pro will take the field for since tearing his acl in week 15 of last year nfl network insider ian rapoport reported parsons who is currently on the physically unable to perform list is expected to start practicing next week per rapoport who added the team plans to have him participate in individual drills during his first week back before moving on to team drills the following week assuming all goes well green bay then has a week 11 bye before a matchup with los angeles on nov 25 parsons has been working his way back from the torn acl as well as a meniscus repair at his pace ensuring he s fully healthy when he takes the field rather than rushing back before his body is ready green bay has held serve adequately enough without him although they currently sit at the bottom of the nfc north the packers are 5 3 and their defense has been far from a weakness the unit has held opponents to 20 or fewer points in five straight outings has proven opportunistic with 15 takeaways and only two days ago wrecked a leaky panthers offensive line to score six sacks while pressuring bryce young on 48 9 of his dropbacks returning a talent of parsons caliber will presumably elevate green bay s d to another level though the 27 year old pass rusher logged at least 12 sacks in each of his first five seasons in the league including a 12 5 sack campaign while making the pro bowl and all pro team during his first year in green bay despite missing the club s final three games the provided timeline for parsons return currently has him missing two more games week 9 at the patriots and week 10 versus the vikings if the packers find another win or two ahead of their bye they could come out of it in good shape as their star defender hopefully returns for the stretch run
