news_mentions.headline: AFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Broncos, Chargers, Chiefs, Raiders
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Bobby Kownack breaks down the top AFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Denver Broncos, Kansas City Chiefs, Las Vegas Raiders and Los Angeles Chargers.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams bobby kownack has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the denver broncos kansas city chiefs las vegas raiders and los angeles chargers catch up on each afc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below denver broncos kansas city chiefs las vegas raiders los angeles chargers three key storylines 1 nix s health receiving corps bo nix should be full go for training camp after suffering a broken ankle in last season s divisional round win but every step in the process bears watching when someone this important to a franchise is returning from injury once nix is out there eyes will also be glued to his pass catching group denver gifted its qb with a second no 1 wideout by trading for jaylen waddle to pair with courtland sutton and camp should provide the first hints as to whether the broncos will employ them as a 1a 1b combo or settle into a more defined pecking order plus can anyone from a proven supporting cast of troy franklin marvin mims and pat bryant emerge as the clear third option 2 denver has a new play caller reaching the doorstep of the super bowl didn t prevent sean payton from enacting sizable changes to the offensive staff he fired offensive coordinator joe lombardi two days after denver s afc title game loss and bumped davis webb up to replace him a month later payton publicly transferred play calling duties to the 31 year old former quarterback it s been a meteoric rise for webb who entered the coaching ranks as payton s qbs coach in 2023 webb has been learning under payton since then so nothing will be unrecognizable but nix still will need to get used to a new voice in his helmet any improvement for a 14th ranked scoring offense on a team that already won 14 games last season would be massive in the afc race 3 broncos are largely running it back roster wise the 2026 broncos are the personification of if it ain t broke don t fix it they took the big swing for waddle but barely signed any outside free agents denver instead focused on retaining talent losing defensive lineman john franklin myers and releasing linebacker dre greenlaw but basically keeping the band together even in the draft the club didn t make a pick until the third round apart from working waddle into the mix with webb now calling the shots the broncos can hit the ground running while many other contenders must start off with finding chemistry that s huge considering how unfriendly the first month and a half of denver s schedule appears at chiefs vs jaguars vs rams at 49ers at chargers and vs seahawks back to top three key storylines 1 when will mahomes be fully healthy patrick mahomes said during the offseason program that he s in a good spot in his acl lcl recovery and hopes to play in week 1 while andy reid told reporters the quarterback should be able to do some things at the start of training camp so how much will mahomes take on when the chiefs report and how quickly will he ramp up activity those questions don t have answers at the moment the chiefs hopes of returning to contention in 2026 and beyond rely heavily on the two time most valuable player so they ll be smart with him justin fields now on his fourth team in as many years could be one of the league s most intensely scrutinized backups as mahomes return timeline takes shape 2 kansas city s cb room begins anew again the chiefs have a habit of maximizing young cornerbacks talent and moving on before the bill comes due most recently they traded two time all pro trent mcduffie and let jaylen watson walk in free agency with both cover men going to the rams kansas city will call on 2025 third rounder nohl williams and mansoor delane this year s no 6 overall pick to fill the void fourth round rookie jadon canady should also be in competition for playing time with free agent signees kader kohou and l 39 jarius sneed the latter of whom returns to kansas city a couple of years after the team traded him to tennessee defensive coordinator steve spagnuolo s track record which includes three straight top six defenses in points allowed suggests things will work out just fine 3 bieniemy s back kansas city s offensive coordinator position has been devalued for years overshadowed by the prowess of patrick mahomes and andy reid perhaps it shouldn t have been during eric bieniemy s five years as the team s oc from 2018 through 2022 the chiefs never finished worse than sixth in the league in points or yards twice tallied the most points and three times amassed the most yards in the last three years without bieniemy the chiefs have ranked at average 17th in scoring and 15th in yardage there were obviously other factors in the decline such as tyreek hill exiting in a trade and travis kelce aging out of his prime but bieniemy returning still bodes well back to top three key storylines 1 mendoza s first camp the future of the raiders now rests on no 1 pick fernando mendoza s shoulders even if he isn t destined to start right away new head coach klint kubiak has communicated that his ideal scenario is to avoid putting a rookie under center in week 1 and by signing veteran kirk cousins las vegas essentially ensured mendoza s starting debut will come via choice rather than need still mendoza is coming off a perfect 16 0 season in which he took home the heisman trophy and led indiana to a national championship he s going to show up for the competition and all the buzz at raiders camp will revolve around him when he does 2 who steps up at wr las vegas has some starry names on offense quarterback fernando mendoza running back ashton jeanty and tight end brock bowers at wide receiver though there s work to do tre tucker was easily the team s most trustworthy wideout last year but he doesn t really profile as a wr1 jack bech and dont 39 e thornton 2025 second and fourth round picks respectively are looking to rebound from underwhelming rookie seasons free agent addition jalen nailor has a chance to show staying power in a larger role after flashing promise with 858 yards and 10 tds on 57 catches over the past two years with the vikings those are likely las vegas top four in some order but there s still a lot to shake out during the preseason 3 crosby s defense 2 0 in the four days between the raiders agreeing to send maxx crosby to the ravens and baltimore backing out of the trade las vegas spent a whole lot of dough rebuilding its defense for what was supposed to be the post crosby era now thanks to the blockbuster deal falling apart crosby is very much a part of the present the five time pro bowler returned to possibly the most talented unit the raiders have had during his career the linebacking corps has been rebuilt with nakobe dean and quay walker taron johnson brings more legitimacy to the cornerback room and kwity paye is set to line up on the edge opposite crosby reason for excitement in sin city extends far beyond the team s top picked qb back to top three key storylines 1 mcdaniel effect it was time for a change after the chargers scored 15 combined points in their last two wild card exits jim harbaugh fired offensive coordinator greg roman a longtime collaborator and replaced him with mike mcdaniel to hopefully supercharge the offense as the former dolphins coach did in his first couple years with miami mcdaniel s arrival as a quarterback whisperer is good news for justin herbert who already plays at a pro bowl level but the impact of his high octane system should be felt everywhere from the promising tight end trio of oronde gadsden david njoku and charlie kolar to omarion hampton in the backfield 2 fingers crossed for l a s o line los angeles offensive line should be a strength of the team in 2026 after disaster struck last season left tackle rashawn slater suffered a season ending patellar tendon tear in august while right tackle joe alt played just six games before requiring season ending ankle surgery herbert took a career high 54 sacks behind a patchwork offensive line leading the league with 268 pressures taken and a 43 3 pressure rate slater and alt are back but they ll also be joined on the line by free agent signings tyler biadasz and cole strange as well as second round rookie jake slaughter assuming the group stays healthy herbert should be well protected first though the bolts blockers have to jell together as a unit in august 3 chargers hope they have an edge rushing duo to build around the offseason didn t bring any sweeping changes for the chargers defense dalvin tomlinson 32 was their most notable signing to bulk up the interior and they lost a few pass rushers odafe oweh and da 39 shawn hand but largely maintained the status quo los angeles did however spend a first round pick on akheem mesidor the acc sack leader in 2025 with 12 5 there s enough pass rushing depth that mesidor won t have to take on too much too soon more importantly he has some stellar mentors in tuli tuipulotu who was sixth in the nfl last season with 13 sacks and nine time pro bowler khalil mack the hope is for a seamless transition from mack to mesidor alongside tuipulotu as the leaders of the l a edge rush back to top

news_mentions.headline: AFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Broncos, Chargers, Chiefs, Raiders
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Bobby Kownack breaks down the top AFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Denver Broncos, Kansas City Chiefs, Las Vegas Raiders and Los Angeles Chargers.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams bobby kownack has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the denver broncos kansas city chiefs las vegas raiders and los angeles chargers catch up on each afc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below denver broncos kansas city chiefs las vegas raiders los angeles chargers three key storylines 1 nix s health receiving corps bo nix should be full go for training camp after suffering a broken ankle in last season s divisional round win but every step in the process bears watching when someone this important to a franchise is returning from injury once nix is out there eyes will also be glued to his pass catching group denver gifted its qb with a second no 1 wideout by trading for jaylen waddle to pair with courtland sutton and camp should provide the first hints as to whether the broncos will employ them as a 1a 1b combo or settle into a more defined pecking order plus can anyone from a proven supporting cast of troy franklin marvin mims and pat bryant emerge as the clear third option 2 denver has a new play caller reaching the doorstep of the super bowl didn t prevent sean payton from enacting sizable changes to the offensive staff he fired offensive coordinator joe lombardi two days after denver s afc title game loss and bumped davis webb up to replace him a month later payton publicly transferred play calling duties to the 31 year old former quarterback it s been a meteoric rise for webb who entered the coaching ranks as payton s qbs coach in 2023 webb has been learning under payton since then so nothing will be unrecognizable but nix still will need to get used to a new voice in his helmet any improvement for a 14th ranked scoring offense on a team that already won 14 games last season would be massive in the afc race 3 broncos are largely running it back roster wise the 2026 broncos are the personification of if it ain t broke don t fix it they took the big swing for waddle but barely signed any outside free agents denver instead focused on retaining talent losing defensive lineman john franklin myers and releasing linebacker dre greenlaw but basically keeping the band together even in the draft the club didn t make a pick until the third round apart from working waddle into the mix with webb now calling the shots the broncos can hit the ground running while many other contenders must start off with finding chemistry that s huge considering how unfriendly the first month and a half of denver s schedule appears at chiefs vs jaguars vs rams at 49ers at chargers and vs seahawks back to top three key storylines 1 when will mahomes be fully healthy patrick mahomes said during the offseason program that he s in a good spot in his acl lcl recovery and hopes to play in week 1 while andy reid told reporters the quarterback should be able to do some things at the start of training camp so how much will mahomes take on when the chiefs report and how quickly will he ramp up activity those questions don t have answers at the moment the chiefs hopes of returning to contention in 2026 and beyond rely heavily on the two time most valuable player so they ll be smart with him justin fields now on his fourth team in as many years could be one of the league s most intensely scrutinized backups as mahomes return timeline takes shape 2 kansas city s cb room begins anew again the chiefs have a habit of maximizing young cornerbacks talent and moving on before the bill comes due most recently they traded two time all pro trent mcduffie and let jaylen watson walk in free agency with both cover men going to the rams kansas city will call on 2025 third rounder nohl williams and mansoor delane this year s no 6 overall pick to fill the void fourth round rookie jadon canady should also be in competition for playing time with free agent signees kader kohou and l 39 jarius sneed the latter of whom returns to kansas city a couple of years after the team traded him to tennessee defensive coordinator steve spagnuolo s track record which includes three straight top six defenses in points allowed suggests things will work out just fine 3 bieniemy s back kansas city s offensive coordinator position has been devalued for years overshadowed by the prowess of patrick mahomes and andy reid perhaps it shouldn t have been during eric bieniemy s five years as the team s oc from 2018 through 2022 the chiefs never finished worse than sixth in the league in points or yards twice tallied the most points and three times amassed the most yards in the last three years without bieniemy the chiefs have ranked at average 17th in scoring and 15th in yardage there were obviously other factors in the decline such as tyreek hill exiting in a trade and travis kelce aging out of his prime but bieniemy returning still bodes well back to top three key storylines 1 mendoza s first camp the future of the raiders now rests on no 1 pick fernando mendoza s shoulders even if he isn t destined to start right away new head coach klint kubiak has communicated that his ideal scenario is to avoid putting a rookie under center in week 1 and by signing veteran kirk cousins las vegas essentially ensured mendoza s starting debut will come via choice rather than need still mendoza is coming off a perfect 16 0 season in which he took home the heisman trophy and led indiana to a national championship he s going to show up for the competition and all the buzz at raiders camp will revolve around him when he does 2 who steps up at wr las vegas has some starry names on offense quarterback fernando mendoza running back ashton jeanty and tight end brock bowers at wide receiver though there s work to do tre tucker was easily the team s most trustworthy wideout last year but he doesn t really profile as a wr1 jack bech and dont 39 e thornton 2025 second and fourth round picks respectively are looking to rebound from underwhelming rookie seasons free agent addition jalen nailor has a chance to show staying power in a larger role after flashing promise with 858 yards and 10 tds on 57 catches over the past two years with the vikings those are likely las vegas top four in some order but there s still a lot to shake out during the preseason 3 crosby s defense 2 0 in the four days between the raiders agreeing to send maxx crosby to the ravens and baltimore backing out of the trade las vegas spent a whole lot of dough rebuilding its defense for what was supposed to be the post crosby era now thanks to the blockbuster deal falling apart crosby is very much a part of the present the five time pro bowler returned to possibly the most talented unit the raiders have had during his career the linebacking corps has been rebuilt with nakobe dean and quay walker taron johnson brings more legitimacy to the cornerback room and kwity paye is set to line up on the edge opposite crosby reason for excitement in sin city extends far beyond the team s top picked qb back to top three key storylines 1 mcdaniel effect it was time for a change after the chargers scored 15 combined points in their last two wild card exits jim harbaugh fired offensive coordinator greg roman a longtime collaborator and replaced him with mike mcdaniel to hopefully supercharge the offense as the former dolphins coach did in his first couple years with miami mcdaniel s arrival as a quarterback whisperer is good news for justin herbert who already plays at a pro bowl level but the impact of his high octane system should be felt everywhere from the promising tight end trio of oronde gadsden david njoku and charlie kolar to omarion hampton in the backfield 2 fingers crossed for l a s o line los angeles offensive line should be a strength of the team in 2026 after disaster struck last season left tackle rashawn slater suffered a season ending patellar tendon tear in august while right tackle joe alt played just six games before requiring season ending ankle surgery herbert took a career high 54 sacks behind a patchwork offensive line leading the league with 268 pressures taken and a 43 3 pressure rate slater and alt are back but they ll also be joined on the line by free agent signings tyler biadasz and cole strange as well as second round rookie jake slaughter assuming the group stays healthy herbert should be well protected first though the bolts blockers have to jell together as a unit in august 3 chargers hope they have an edge rushing duo to build around the offseason didn t bring any sweeping changes for the chargers defense dalvin tomlinson 32 was their most notable signing to bulk up the interior and they lost a few pass rushers odafe oweh and da 39 shawn hand but largely maintained the status quo los angeles did however spend a first round pick on akheem mesidor the acc sack leader in 2025 with 12 5 there s enough pass rushing depth that mesidor won t have to take on too much too soon more importantly he has some stellar mentors in tuli tuipulotu who was sixth in the nfl last season with 13 sacks and nine time pro bowler khalil mack the hope is for a seamless transition from mack to mesidor alongside tuipulotu as the leaders of the l a edge rush back to top

news_mentions.headline: NFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for 49ers, Cardinals, Rams, Seahawks
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Arizona Cardinals, Los Angeles Rams, San Francisco 49ers and Seattle Seahawks.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers and seattle seahawks catch up on each nfc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks three key storylines 1 sorting out brissett s contract drama installing rookie head coach mike lafleur s offense certainly hasn t gone off without a hitch jacoby brissett who took the quarterbacking reins from an injured kyler murray last season and never gave them back is the presumed starter and wants to get paid like one having skipped voluntary workouts brissett reported for mandatory minicamp to avoid fines but just how much actual work he got in isn t all that apparent will brissett hold out or hold in during training camp that threatens to become a prevailing topic in arizona even if it all gets sorted out the whole matter of getting ready for the football season remains lafleur has downplayed brissett s lack of offseason involvement citing the 33 year old s experience in the league but this is hardly a splendid way to kick off your head coaching career the good news is brissett threw for a career best 3 366 yards in 12 starts during a tumultuous 3 14 season in 2025 if the journeyman settles harmoniously into lafleur s offense perhaps improvement or at least a little excitement lies ahead for the cards 2 a whole lotta love right jeremiyah love could be the most anticipated 2026 rookie in the league at least on the offensive side all due respect to no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza but love s talent and eye popping ability is off the charts so much so that the cardinals used the third overall selection of the draft on him guaranteeing the 21 year old more money than any running back in nfl history there were plenty of question marks with the pick though the cardinals have holes aplenty on their roster but having signed tyler allgeier as a free agent and bringing back veteran banger james conner running back was far from the most glaring weakness in the end love was just too special a talent to pass up so how will lafleur handle his rookie love has made it clear he s a team first guy and on the franchise s current timeline immediately using love as a bell cow might not be wise even if it makes sense monetarily and to a fan base that would love to do nothing more than get behind a bona fide star we shall see 3 time for a new era over the previous two years the cardinals plucked three first round picks wide receiver marvin harrison 2024 no 4 overall and defensive linemen darius robinson 2024 no 27 and walter nolen 2025 no 16 that trio has combined to play 53 of a potential 85 games robinson 21 games in two years and nolen six games as a rookie have combined for four sacks and 12 starts harrison 103 receptions 1 493 yards and 12 touchdowns in 29 games has likely been the most disappointing seen as a can t miss selection who s floundered or at the least failed to live up to his pedigree as a top five pick after seven seasons kyler murray is gone after three years jonathan gannon is gone there s a new coach in lafleur and whether it s brissett more than likely gardner minshew or rookie carson beck there will be a new week 1 starting quarterback love looks every bit the can t miss sensation harrison seemed to be it s pivotal for the homegrown talent to blossom staying healthy is the first step meshing with lafleur is the next and that ll begin in earnest later this month back to top three key storylines 1 refacing defense around garrett the rams don t mess around when it comes to making a super bowl push having traded for then broncos pass rusher von miller before adding wide receiver odell beckham ahead of their run to super bowl lvi triumph the rams shook up this offseason by trading for myles garrett already an all time pass rushing great who s coming off a year in which he set a new single season sack record that move put an enormous cherry on top of an already rich roster but you can t crown a champion before the super bowl and just how well garrett meshes in defensive coordinator chris shula s system will be something to monitor during camp shula s already stated he s going to let garrett do what he does best while still sticking to his schematic principles byron young team high 12 sacks kobie turner seven and braden fiske three combined for 22 sacks last season with garrett s record breaking 23 ostensibly replacing jared verse s 7 5 as verse was sent to the browns nothing s easy in the nfl though this isn t copy and paste under former cleveland defensive coordinator jim schwartz garrett was a one man pass rushing gang racking up 51 sacks over the past three seasons he s arguably the finest quarterback menace of this century just how brightly he ll shine in l a will start to come into focus over the next few weeks 2 time to make the offseason count if there were offseason trophies to hand out los angeles would likely be first in line still for as loaded as this roster is it s imperative the rams stiff arm distractions and keep their heads from getting too high into the clouds puka nacua has a looming potentially top of the market extension and he needs to continue working on himself after a stint in rehab l a already caused a stir when it shocked the nfl world by drafting quarterback ty simpson with the 13th overall pick simpson who remains unsigned is battling it out with stetson bennett to back up reigning mvp matthew stafford who s coming back for his age 38 season there were also trade rumblings regarding davante adams but it seems like those are in the past meanwhile the rams added cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson from the chiefs corners who shine in kansas city don t always star elsewhere speaking of the chiefs their head coach andy reid once helmed an eagles squad dubbed the dream team after a haul of splendid offseason adds said dream team nightmarishly missed the playoffs nothing from an nfl offseason is guaranteed this l a story is all about winning a super bowl no reason for subplots with so much potential for greatness sean mcvay needs to keep his boys eyes on the prize 3 even with the reigning mvp rams have offensive questions regardless of how long in the tooth stafford is the 2025 nfl mvp is still brilliant in the arm like few others in the league he can spin it and make the mesmerizing look normal his league leading 4 707 yards and 46 touchdown tosses last season came with a talented but shallow receiver stable nacua led the nfl with 129 receptions adams contributed 60 grabs with an nfl high 14 going for tds l a didn t have another receiver with more than 18 catches that s one of the reasons drafting simpson when wide receivers makai lemon kc concepcion and omar cooper were still available was so puzzling konata mumpfield jordan whittington and sixth round rookie cj daniels could be the main depth pieces at wr leaders of the league s 13 personnel movement the rams have a staggering herd of tight ends with the most notable being colby parkinson tyler higbee terrance ferguson and rookie max klare ferguson only caught 11 passes as a rookie but he and parkinson could offer the most upside in the receiving game the nfl s no 1 offense in 2025 is expected to run it back in precision form but some fine tuning might lay ahead back to top three key storylines 1 getting healthy staying healthy is key conspiracy theorists can place the blame on electromagnetic fields from a nearby substation but for whatever reason injury woes have plagued kyle shanahan s squads for years niners starters missed north of 50 games in 2025 at the moment the anticipated returns of defensive end nick bosa torn acl missed 14 games tight end george kittle hamstring tear ankle sprain achilles tear six games and linebacker fred warner broken and dislocated ankle 11 games are atop the queue san francisco went 12 5 last season and advanced to the divisional round with those three who are each perennially regarded as among the best at their respective positions missing significant time warner is good to go bosa expects to be ready around the start of camp and kittle is working to return for week 1 however maintaining health is the key christian mccaffrey missed 13 games in 2024 but rebounded with an nfl high and career high 413 touches keeping cmc and the rest of the 49ers all star cast healthy has to be the top priority in camp and beyond there is no shortage of talent on the team san francisco just needs to keep it on the field to stay on pace in the shark infested nfc west 2 figuring out the wr room signing away mike evans from the buccaneers was a immense boon but he s missed 12 games over the past two seasons and will celebrate his 33rd birthday in august it s imperative that the stockpile of younger wideouts improves and the veteran adds of evans and christian kirk still have tread on the tires previous mainstays jauan jennings and deebo samuel are gone the latter is a free agent after a year with washington and it wouldn t be a shocker to see a reunion in san francisco jennings signed late in the offseason with the vikings brandon aiyuk is still technically with the team but is on the reserve left squad list while continually trolling the 49ers and plenty of others in video missives as evans and kirk get acclimated to quarterback brock purdy and shanahan s offense 2024 first rounder ricky pearsall faces a crucial camp needing to overcome past injuries and calamity to truly emerge similar things can be said about recent picks jacob cowing 2024 fourth rounder and jordan watkins 25 fourth rounder de 39 zhaun stribling taken in the second round this spring as the team s top draft choice profiles as perhaps the best replacement yet for samuel it s time for the fresh faces to step up in the passing game 3 defense must improve under a nother new dc from 2021 through 23 the 49ers were a top 10 defense in points and yards allowed the first two years in that span featured demeco ryans as defensive coordinator the current texans head coach has clearly left a large void steve wilks lasted just the 2023 season despite the team s super bowl run and overall great statistics third in points eighth in yards raheem morris is the next defensive coordinator up replacing robert saleh who was hired as the titans head coach after replacing 2024 dc nick sorensen as the fifth niners defensive play caller in five seasons morris should be helped hugely by the returns of fred warner and nick bosa but developing young talent ranks right up there with staying healthy when it comes to improving on last year s no 20 ranking in total d most glaringly the 2025 49ers finished dead last in team sacks with just 20 myles garrett now a division rival had 23 sacks on his own also on the injury comeback trail 2025 first rounder mykel williams bosa and williams getting healed up is a start the acquisition of defensive tackle osa odighizuwa in a trade with the cowboys might prove to be a pivotal move while the return of linebacker dre greenlaw after a lost year in denver could also bode well rookie third rounder romello height has already garnered some positive reports and alfred collins made a great first year impression morris might well be joining the 49ers at the right time back to top three key storylines 1 darnold staying on point sam darnold authored a storybook tale last season once viewed as a mega bust darnold quarterbacked the seahawks his fourth nfl team following the jets who used the 2018 nfl draft s third overall pick on him to a super bowl title darnold seemingly exorcised the ghosts of his past but he is still only 29 and has plenty to play for he s back with the pressure of defending a championship can he provide an encore earn a lucrative extension and keep seattle atop the league new offensive coordinator brian fleury s system is similar to the departed klint kubiak s but change is change and darnold must learn the differences continuity in the receiving corps should help with jaxon smith njigba leading a group that also includes cooper kupp jake bobo and rashid shaheed the last of whom should command a bigger role in the aerial attack after re signing on a lucrative deal in march furthermore tory horton flashed as a rookie last season before suffering a shin injury the speedster s return could have a dynamic domino effect adding another bona fide threat at receiver and another big play option in the return game which could open up more possibilities for shaheed in both avenues there s also optimism for a major breakout at tight end aj barner who scored the seahawks only offensive touchdown in the super bowl became a dude in his second season 52 receptions 519 yards six tds and might well become a pro bowl caliber player in year 3 if his chemistry with darnold continues 2 what s the frequency without kenneth with kenneth walker having signed with kansas city and zach charbonnet acl most likely absent to begin the season all eyes will be on first round draft pick jadarian price the notre dame product is a smooth runner who averaged 6 yards per carry in his career with the fighting irish however he was jeremiyah love s understudy and had 15 plus touches just once in his 41 games at nd the seahawks were adamant in balancing walker and charbonnet last season before the latter was injured asking price to take on a bell cow workload would seem unlikely camp could preview what kind of roles are in store for other backs like george holani and emanuel wilson perhaps rashid shaheed could be used a bit in the run game too the wide receiver corps along with the charles cross led offensive line are the offensive strengths but seattle wants balance that starts with price and will take shape before week 1 3 can seahawks avoid noise again in case you might have forgotten and judging by the lack of offseason pomp and circumstance many have the seahawks are the reigning super bowl champions for a franchise that boasts one of the loudest home field advantages the volume for a post lombardi offseason has seemingly been turned down to negative 11 that seems to be the preference for mike macdonald s seahawks though they snuck up on some people last season and after winning the most arduous division in football trounced the patriots in the super bowl this year jaxon smith njigba s not going to catch anyone by surprise the reigning offensive player of the year had a fine 2024 hitting 100 catches and exceeding 1 100 yards but he was an absolute force last season leading the league with 1 793 receiving yards and quickly erasing any doubt as to how the passing game would fare without dk metcalf also while jsn got paid this offseason his fellow 2023 first rounder devon witherspoon has yet to posing a potential problem for the seahawks right guard anthony bradford started all 17 games last year his third season in a row of starting the majority of the seahawks games he garnered a 51 9 overall pff grade which ranked 70th among the 81 guards who took at least 300 snaps could fifth rounder beau stephens replace him and solidify a longtime sore spot for seattle s starting lineup general manager john schneider was able to keep most of the lombardi band together but losing walker outside linebacker boye mafe cornerback tariq woolen and safety coby bryant isn t nothing keeping everything quiet and copacetic is far more difficult when you re defending champs so it s paramount for macdonald and schneider to figure out any issues before they grow into problems back to top

market extension and he needs to continue working on himself after a stint in rehab l a already caused a stir when it shocked the nfl world by drafting quarterback ty simpson with the 13th overall pick simpson who remains unsigned is battling it out with stetson bennett to back up reigning mvp matthew stafford who s coming back for his age 38 season there were also trade rumblings regarding davante adams but it seems like those are in the past meanwhile the rams added cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson from the chiefs corners who shine in kansas city don t always star elsewhere speaking of the chiefs their head coach andy reid once helmed an eagles squad dubbed the dream team after a haul of splendid offseason adds said dream team nightmarishly missed the playoffs nothing from an nfl offseason is guaranteed this l a story is all about winning a super bowl no reason for subplots with so much potential for greatness sean mcvay needs to keep his boys eyes on the prize 3 even with the reigning mvp rams have offensive questions regardless of how long in the tooth stafford is the 2025 nfl mvp is still brilliant in the arm like few others in the league he can spin it and make the mesmerizing look normal his league leading 4 707 yards and 46 touchdown tosses last season came with a talented but shallow receiver stable nacua led the nfl with 129 receptions adams contributed 60 grabs with an nfl high 14 going for tds l a didn t have another receiver with more than 18 catches that s one of the reasons drafting simpson when wide receivers makai lemon kc concepcion and omar cooper were still available was so puzzling konata mumpfield jordan whittington and sixth round rookie cj daniels could be the main depth pieces at wr leaders of the league s 13 personnel movement the rams have a staggering herd of tight ends with the most notable being colby parkinson tyler higbee terrance ferguson and rookie max klare ferguson only caught 11 passes as a rookie but he and parkinson could offer the most upside in the receiving game the nfl s no 1 offense in 2025 is expected to run it back in precision form but some fine tuning might lay ahead back to top three key storylines 1 getting healthy staying healthy is key conspiracy theorists can place the blame on electromagnetic fields from a nearby substation but for whatever reason injury woes have plagued kyle shanahan s squads for years niners starters missed north of 50 games in 2025 at the moment the anticipated returns of defensive end nick bosa torn acl missed 14 games tight end george kittle hamstring tear ankle sprain achilles tear six games and linebacker fred warner broken and dislocated ankle 11 games are atop the queue san francisco went 12 5 last season and advanced to the divisional round with those three who are each perennially regarded as among the best at their respective positions missing significant time warner is good to go bosa expects to be ready around the start of camp and kittle is working to return for week 1 however maintaining health is the key christian mccaffrey missed 13 games in 2024 but rebounded with an nfl high and career high 413 touches keeping cmc and the rest of the 49ers all star cast healthy has to be the top priority in camp and beyond there is no shortage of talent on the team san francisco just needs to keep it on the field to stay on pace in the shark infested nfc west 2 figuring out the wr room signing away mike evans from the buccaneers was a immense boon but he s missed 12 games over the past two seasons and will celebrate his 33rd birthday in august it s imperative that the stockpile of younger wideouts improves and the veteran adds of evans and christian kirk still have tread on the tires previous mainstays jauan jennings and deebo samuel are gone the latter is a free agent after a year with washington and it wouldn t be a shocker to see a reunion in san francisco jennings signed late in the offseason with the vikings brandon aiyuk is still technically with the team but is on the reserve left squad list while continually trolling the 49ers and plenty of others in video missives as evans and kirk get acclimated to quarterback brock purdy and shanahan s offense 2024 first rounder ricky pearsall faces a crucial camp needing to overcome past injuries and calamity to truly emerge similar things can be said about recent picks jacob cowing 2024 fourth rounder and jordan watkins 25 fourth rounder de 39 zhaun stribling taken in the second round this spring as the team s top draft choice profiles as perhaps the best replacement yet for samuel it s time for the fresh faces to step up in the passing game 3 defense must improve under a nother new dc from 2021 through 23 the 49ers were a top 10 defense in points and yards allowed the first two years in that span featured demeco ryans as defensive coordinator the current texans head coach has clearly left a large void steve wilks lasted just the 2023 season despite the team s super bowl run and overall great statistics third in points eighth in yards raheem morris is the next defensive coordinator up replacing robert saleh who was hired as the titans head coach after replacing 2024 dc nick sorensen as the fifth niners defensive play caller in five seasons morris should be helped hugely by the returns of fred warner and nick bosa but developing young talent ranks right up there with staying healthy when it comes to improving on last year s no 20 ranking in total d most glaringly the 2025 49ers finished dead last in team sacks with just 20 myles garrett now a division rival had 23 sacks on his own also on the injury comeback trail 2025 first rounder mykel williams bosa and williams getting healed up is a start the acquisition of defensive tackle osa odighizuwa in a trade with the cowboys might prove to be a pivotal move while the return of linebacker dre greenlaw after a lost year in denver could also bode well rookie third rounder romello height has already garnered some positive reports and alfred collins made a great first year impression morris might well be joining the 49ers at the right time back to top three key storylines 1 darnold staying on point sam darnold authored a storybook tale last season once viewed as a mega bust darnold quarterbacked the seahawks his fourth nfl team following the jets who used the 2018 nfl draft s third overall pick on him to a super bowl title darnold seemingly exorcised the ghosts of his past but he is still only 29 and has plenty to play for he s back with the pressure of defending a championship can he provide an encore earn a lucrative extension and keep seattle atop the league new offensive coordinator brian fleury s system is similar to the departed klint kubiak s but change is change and darnold must learn the differences continuity in the receiving corps should help with jaxon smith njigba leading a group that also includes cooper kupp jake bobo and rashid shaheed the last of whom should command a bigger role in the aerial attack after re signing on a lucrative deal in march furthermore tory horton flashed as a rookie last season before suffering a shin injury the speedster s return could have a dynamic domino effect adding another bona fide threat at receiver and another big play option in the return game which could open up more possibilities for shaheed in both avenues there s also optimism for a major breakout at tight end aj barner who scored the seahawks only offensive touchdown in the super bowl became a dude in his second season 52 receptions 519 yards six tds and might well become a pro bowl caliber player in year 3 if his chemistry with darnold continues 2 what s the frequency without kenneth with kenneth walker having signed with kansas city and zach charbonnet acl most likely absent to begin the season all eyes will be on first round draft pick jadarian price the notre dame product is a smooth runner who averaged 6 yards per carry in his career with the fighting irish however he was jeremiyah love s understudy and had 15 plus touches just once in his 41 games at nd the seahawks were adamant in balancing walker and charbonnet last season before the latter was injured asking price to take on a bell cow workload would seem unlikely camp could preview what kind of roles are in store for other backs like george holani and emanuel wilson perhaps rashid shaheed could be used a bit in the run game too the wide receiver corps along with the charles cross led offensive line are the offensive strengths but seattle wants balance that starts with price and will take shape before week 1 3 can seahawks avoid noise again in case you might have forgotten and judging by the lack of offseason pomp and circumstance many have the seahawks are the reigning super bowl champions for a franchise that boasts one of the loudest home field advantages the volume for a post lombardi offseason has seemingly been turned down to negative 11 that seems to be the preference for mike macdonald s seahawks though they snuck up on some people last season and after winning the most arduous division in football trounced the patriots in the super bowl this year jaxon smith njigba s not going to catch anyone by surprise the reigning offensive player of the year had a fine 2024 hitting 100 catches and exceeding 1 100 yards but he was an absolute force last season leading the league with 1 793 receiving yards and quickly erasing any doubt as to how the passing game would fare without dk metcalf also while jsn got paid this offseason his fellow 2023 first rounder devon witherspoon has yet to posing a potential problem for the seahawks right guard anthony bradford started all 17 games last year his third season in a row of starting the majority of the seahawks games he garnered a 51 9 overall pff grade which ranked 70th among the 81 guards who took at least 300 snaps could fifth rounder beau stephens replace him and solidify a longtime sore spot for seattle s starting lineup general manager john schneider was able to keep most of the lombardi band together but losing walker outside linebacker boye mafe cornerback tariq woolen and safety coby bryant isn t nothing keeping everything quiet and copacetic is far more difficult when you re defending champs so it s paramount for macdonald and schneider to figure out any issues before they grow into problems back to top

news_mentions.headline: 2026 NFL season, Week 8: What We Learned from Sunday's games
news_mentions.description: Around The NFL breaks down what you need to know from Sunday's action in Week 8 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 8 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below early window buffalo bills 36 baltimore ravens 10 cincinnati bengals 43 tennessee titans 36 ot arizona cardinals 33 dallas cowboys 30 ot detroit lions 19 minnesota vikings 15 jacksonville jaguars 42 indianapolis colts 7 las vegas raiders 38 new york jets 33 pittsburgh steelers 27 cleveland browns 6 tampa bay buccaneers 16 atlanta falcons 0 late window los angeles rams 24 los angeles chargers 9 denver broncos 28 kansas city chiefs 24 new england patriots 24 miami dolphins 19 sunday night washington commanders 27 philadelphia eagles 10 nick shook s takeaways bills let hunters loose buffalo s biggest underlying question mark was its defense a leaky unit that struggled to get stops and limit opposing offenses in what became weekly shootouts for the bills that finally changed for the better on sunday with lamar jackson exiting quickly and tyler huntley back in the lineup buffalo decided it was time to hunt the quarterback dialing up blitzes and registering pressures on half of huntley s four passes which also incidentally forced huntley out of the game due to injury once undrafted rookie joe fagnano took over the carnivorous bills saw nothing but red meat blitzing on 64 5 of their total defensive snaps logging qb pressures at a rate of 61 3 and short circuiting baltimore s offense all afternoon the ravens finished with just 144 net yards of offense scored their only touchdown via a short field earned by a broderick washington interception and couldn t piece together more than one drive of significance which ended in a 26 yard tyler loop field goal buffalo s defense made sure it wouldn t allow derrick henry to carry the ravens and denied fagnano the space to breathe overwhelming the inexperienced signal caller in a runaway win quarterback injuries decimate ravens lamar jackson s anticipated return lasted just one snap his first pass attempt fell incomplete and on the follow through to his throw jackson s thumb collided with a defender s hand resulting in an injury that will land jackson on injured reserve for the foreseeable future after a few weeks of backup turned starter duty tyler huntley found himself on the field sunday appearing skittish and struggling to gain a single yard through the air before an injury knocked him out of action as well leaving the ravens with their emergency third qb joe fagnano as their only remaining option the uconn product gave his best effort but was constantly under duress leaving the ravens with little room to move the ball all afternoon zay flowers went without a catch on five targets rashod bateman s one catch for 22 yards accounted for the most receiving production for any raven and running back justice hill led baltimore in receptions with four it was a lifeless offense that left the ravens defense on the field for far too long buffalo won the time of possession battle 37 36 to 22 24 and sunday s display should rightfully worry ravens fans about their team s outlook for the remainder of 2026 it sounds as if jackson s season could be finished and recent results without him including sunday are discouraging at best moore delivers in return after missing a handful of weeks buffalo welcomed back its prized offseason acquisition d j moore who showed no signs of hesitancy and delivered a strong outing four catches 82 yards including a spectacular grab for 49 yards to set up a james cook touchdown and a touchdown catch moore s return helped draw some attention away from buffalo s tight ends dalton kincaid finished with a team best 86 yards and a touchdown on four catches took a bit of pressure off cook and unlocked enough of the unit s attack to help the bills climb out of a grind it out start to pour it on in the second half moore s rapport with josh allen remains strong even after the time off and helped allen pass jim kelly for the franchise s all time lead in touchdowns 260 now moore will need to prove he can be this reliable on a weekly basis next gen stats insight for ravens bills via nfl pro the bills blitzed on 64 5 of opposing dropbacks against the ravens in week 8 their highest blitz rate since 2021 and the highest blitz rate ravens quarterbacks have faced this season the bills blitz rate had not exceeded 39 in any of their prior six games this season when blitzing the bills generated 11 pressures including a season high seven quick pressures under 2 5 seconds and three sacks including a strip sack fumble recovery in the second quarter nfl research josh allen and james cook each had a rushing touchdown in week 8 marking the 16th time that allen and cook have scored a rushing touchdown in the same game sixteen games breaks a tie with dak prescott and ezekiel elliott for the most games by any teammate duo in nfl history in which both players had a rushing touchdown back to top bobby kownack s takeaways burrow was everything good bad about bengals offense what a roller coaster performance by joe burrow the cincy quarterback unquestionably served as the team s hero accounting for six touchdowns in an unexpected shootout with the titans but his three interceptions contributed initially to a slow start and later allowed tennessee to stay in it two of those picks were deep heaves to ja 39 marr chase with one way overthrown and another that came up far too short if you re going to make mistakes though make sure you make up for them burrow did that and more piling on the points and feeding his top two receivers to great success tee higgins had 10 catches for 155 yards and two tds on 11 targets while chase tallied 11 receptions for 141 yards and a score on 16 looks burrow also importantly cleaned it up in crunch time of his five drives that took place in the fourth quarter or overtime one ended in a chase brown fumble and the other ticked down the final 17 seconds to the extra frame on the other three burrow marched his bengals 73 81 and 70 yards throwing two touchdowns and scoring the game winner on a 9 yard scramble he finished with 426 yards five tds and three ints on 38 of 48 passing marking his third consecutive game with at least four passing touchdowns it s a bit scary how many points the bengals put up despite four giveaways and that s all credit to burrow standout performances not enough for tennessee there was not an ounce of quit in the titans after trading away their best player defensive tackle jeffery simmons on thursday the defense still generated four takeaways the most it has had in a game this season safety amani hooker had joe burrow s number intercepting him a whopping three times while defensive end jacob martin tallied three sacks and linebacker anthony hill was relentless with 14 tackles on offense cam ward enjoyed by far his best game of the season despite being without carnell tate ward dissected cincinnati s defense with regularity going 26 of 40 for 304 yards and two touchdowns snapping a five game interception streak and nearly doubling his average of 168 4 passing yards per game he led two separate go ahead td drives in the fourth quarter plus tony pollard continued his recent resurgence rushing for 117 yards and two scores after going for 129 and three tds in week 7 his 40 yard touchdown to open the scoring will be one of the highlights of the day in his or any game with pollard breaking multiple tackles before stiff arming one bengals defender into another s path in a keystone cops sequence on the way to pay dirt of course it was still not enough for the 1 7 titans but the fight they showed was admirable regardless of the nfl s aversion to moral victories concerning trends taking shape for bengals the most important result from sunday is the bengals moving to 5 2 in a highly competitive afc north however there are some underlying issues still plaguing cincinnati the bengals found themselves trailing 13 0 for the second straight week this deficit came at the end of the first quarter unlike last week s halftime hole against the ravens and the bengals started picking it up much earlier to go into intermission with a lead but they couldn t pull away like they did in baltimore instead the titans pushed them to overtime taking advantage of a defense that forced a pair of turnovers but couldn t get enough stops to make things easy in the past three games the bengals have needed to outlast a one win titans team in overtime looked asleep for far too long facing backup quarterback tyler huntley and let a then winless dolphins squad make things uncomfortable late before that it was two straight losses those who choose optimism will point to the bengals record and their three game winning streak but venturing through a season as escape artists typically catches up down the line next gen stats insight for titans bengals via nfl pro amani hooker picked off joe burrow three times which included 15 3 expected points added across five targets in coverage the second most coverage epa by a player in a game this season hooker allowed only 12 yards in coverage on the day nfl research joe burrow became just the second quarterback in league history to have 450 plus passing yards five plus passing tds and a rushing td in a game joining norm van brocklin week 1 1951 back to top nick shook s takeaways qb change sparks comeback through nearly three quarters the cardinals were repeating the same frustrating offensive performance that had become all too familiar in recent weeks jacoby brissett was under constant pressure and resorting to throws that amounted to little more than prayers and after watching brissett take two consecutive sacks for double digit negative yardage in the third quarter coach mike lafleur had enough calling for gardner minshew to replace the battered brissett oddly enough the quarterback change coincided with a revival of the running game that depended solely on tyler allgeier after jeremiyah love left with another ankle injury and bam knight was knocked out of action due to a concussion allgeier put the team on his back rushing 11 times for 147 yards and a touchdown and repeatedly turning to the sideline oxygen tank as a means of survival minshew meanwhile created a rhythm in the passing game that the cardinals haven t enjoyed in over a month completing 17 of 23 passes for 188 yards and three touchdowns including a magnificent final touchdown drive that covered 80 yards in eight plays and 1 03 to tie the game and balancing the offense by turning to michael wilson plenty eight catches 111 yards one touchdown arizona pulled off this 23 point outburst and improbable comeback after losing love knight and receiver kendrick bourne maximizing its returns with its remaining contributors with just enough time to escape defeat it will likely prompt a quarterback change and could be a minor springboard forward for a team that was desperate for a morale boosting win like this cowboys collapse could have devastating effect dallas will look back at this game and have no choice but to admit this was its worst loss of 2026 entering the final minute of the third quarter the cowboys were in control holding a 17 3 lead that was all but guaranteed to eventually become 20 3 or larger in that moment though their defense broke down surrendering a rumbling 63 yard touchdown run to tyler allgeier the first of a few massive chunks gained by allgeier in the final 16 minutes of regulation on a 52 yard allgeier run in the fourth quarter safety caleb downs got pancaked by hjalte froholdt twice in the same play typifying arizona s sudden takeover with the image of downs tumbling across the turf like a runaway cheese wheel speeding down a hill this all happened after dallas had suffocated arizona s offense for the first 44 minutes of the game and the cardinals awakening delivered repeated violent blows to the ribcage of the cowboys defense landing a liver punch in the form of a michael wilson dependent touchdown drive to tie the game in the final six seconds of regulation a quick defensive stop and a 44 yard scoring drive in overtime sent the cowboys to the mat for good resulting in one of the most stunning outcomes of the entire nfl season this type of loss can send a team into a spiral could cost defensive coordinator christian parker his job and will undoubtedly cause cowboys fans to angrily punch the air the same problems persist they still can t beat the lowly cardinals in texas and the solutions continue to prove fleeting arizona s rebuilt backfield disintegrates but one pillar remains standing tyler allgeier s second half outburst produced a victory for the cardinals but it was even more triumphant for a workhorse who has often been left to the shadows of more recognizable running mates in atlanta and arizona the talk at the start of the season revolved around first round pick jeremiyah love and when the cardinals couldn t generate consistently on the ground love s absence was quickly blamed allgeier never quite saw the chances he needed to blossom but found himself in an unexpected moment of opportunity sunday when love and bam knight exited due to injury he could have played an average brand of football as the lone remaining runner available but that s not allgeier those who were unfamiliar with his style were reminded rudely on his 63 yard touchdown run in which he broke three tackles and followed a trio of teammates who escorted him to the goal line where he fell across it for a score while finally being brought down that touchdown made it a 17 10 game but more importantly it gave the cardinals reason to believe his ensuing 52 yarder saw hjalte froholdt get out in front and wreck caleb downs in open space setting an aggressive tone embodied by the runner benefitting from the blocking in those two plays and gardner minshew s stint as a mid game replacement the cardinals brought the fight to the cowboys refusing to lay down despite a double digit deficit and little reason to believe they d turn things around because of allgeier s toughness determination and relentless desire to produce when called upon he also caught five passes for 44 yards and an incredibly gritty touchdown reception the cardinals pulled off the stunning win and might have found a new identity in the process next gen stats insight for cardinals cowboys via nfl pro tyler allgeier carried the ball 11 times for 147 yards and a touchdown in week 8 against the cowboys including three explosive gains of 10 or more yards after totaling just two explosive gains across 61 carries over the first seven weeks of the season allgeier recorded a 63 yard touchdown run on arizona s final play from scrimmage in the third quarter before opening the cardinals next drive with a 52 yard scamper he gained 96 rushing yards over expected the most by a cardinals rusher in a game since at least 2018 additionally allgeier finished as the cardinals third leading receiver catching all five targets for 44 yards and a touchdown nfl research the cardinals last second touchdown positioned them to kick a go ahead extra point with 0 06 remaining sunday but chad ryland pushed his attempt wide left entering the cardinals into some exclusive and undesirable company they became the third team to miss a go ahead pat in the final 10 seconds of regulation joining the bengals week 1 2022 and buccaneers week 2 2003 back to top kevin patra s takeaways lions run over undefeated vikings to close gap in nfc north detroit figured out the best way to combat brian flores relentless pressure packages go to the ground after falling behind 15 12 midway through the fourth quarter detroit ran the ball on 11 of its final 13 non kneel plays one of those two jared goff throws was the go ahead touchdown toss to jameson williams detroit leaned on jahmyr gibbs and bruising backup sione vaki gibbs blasted his way to 153 rushing yards and a td on 23 carries while vaki chipped in 11 totes for 65 yards detroit getting production from vaki is a positive sign for the lions down the stretch the lions couldn t get out of their way early with miscues hampering dan campbell s club including some bad penalties goff missed passes early and threw his first interception of the season when williams slipped on a route detroit put up just six points and goff was sacked four times through two quarters then the run game took over allowing the qb to utilize play action and wear down the vikings d it wasn t a perfect game for the home squad but the offense perked up late when needed to close out a big win that bunches the division even closer it was a need to have home game for detroit dan campbell s crew came up clutch in the end vikings offensive struggles continued it was only a matter of time before brian flores defense couldn t carry the day minnesota has been playing on the razor s edge through its first six wins with the defense spearheading wins while the offense was along for the ride against a high powered lions offense flores defense did enough forcing a turnover early field goals and a pivotal late three and out yes the defense ran out of gas against jahmyr gibbs late but kevin o connell s offense needed to do more kyler murray managed the game early but missed too many throws particularly high which led to stalled drives nearly a quarter of murray s 210 yards 24 3 came on a 51 yard bomb to jordan addison the qb missed several other shots right now murray isn t a station to station passer when the big plays don t connect the vikings offense struggles against a lions defense that entered with the worst pass d in the nfl and allowing the most yards murray came up small the vikings generated just 266 yards and 15 first downs going 3 for 10 on third down and 0 for 1 on fourth down isn t winning offense koc needs his offense to find itself at the start of a tough stretch of games right now it s not close detroit s defense stepped up for the second straight week kelvin sheppard s defense has played up a level the defensive line particularly the interior pestered kyler murray alim mcneill led the way with four qb pressures and one sack the secondary did a better job sticking with vikings receivers where we d seen wrs scamper wide open early in the season detroit s secondary at least challenged most plays cornerback d j reed was having his best game including a diving int and a big late pass breakup before leaving with an injury when the defensive line is getting pressure and the secondary plays on a string it s a workable defense the issue sheppard faces now is that he lost a trove of players on sunday star linebacker jack campbell was taken to a local hospital after suffering a neck injury d j wonnum and brian branch each exited with concussions after a collision rookie linebacker jimmy rolder suffered a hamstring injury reed s was a hip can an already shaky unit overcome injuries moving forward next gen stats insight for lions vikings via nfl pro the vikings blitzed on 26 of 29 dropbacks 89 7 in their week 8 loss against the lions the highest blitz rate by a team since at least 2018 breaking the previous record held by the vikings set last week against the colts 85 2 when blitzed jared goff completed 17 passes tied for the most against the blitz in a game this season for 130 yards a touchdown and an interception goff was sacked a season high three times on six pressures when blitzed nfl research jahmyr gibbs became the fifth player in nfl history prior to age 25 to have at least 1 000 scrimmage yards and 10 plus touchdowns in their team s first seven games of a season joining christian mccaffrey 2019 edgerrin james 2000 eric dickerson 1983 and jim brown 1958 back to top kevin patra s takeaways jags stampede floundering colts good teams don t just beat bad ones they take their soul jacksonville is a good team liam coen s squad walloped its division rival in every facet from the start the jaguars blasted indianapolis with an offensive barrage and smothering defense for a team that s struggled at times in the red zone coen s club simply avoided that area splashing scores from distance of the jags five offensive touchdowns only one came inside the red zone jacksonville ripped through a limp colts defense for scores of 31 yards 39 28 and 25 yards pass protection had some concerns but trevor lawrence overcame them side stepping pressure and ripping passes to wide open targets the mvp candidate generated 210 yards and three touchdowns on 10 of 14 attempts before taking a seat for the bulk of the fourth quarter jacksonville ran over the colts earning 183 rushing yards and two tds with bhayshul tuten leading the way 16 104 1 tuten was a tackle breaking maven earning 159 scrimmage yards and two scores have a day rayuan lane jaguars safety rayuan lane snagged a flubbed catch by colts tight end tyler warren and scampered the other way for a 92 yard pick six late in the second quarter the play was the cherry on top of a big day for the navy product who made his second career start and netted three tackles a qb hit and three passes defensed lane making plays after being thrust into significant action highlights a defense that came in waves sunday anthony campanile s defense forced three turnovers held the colts to 243 total yards and 4 1 yards per play jacksonville stymied jonathan taylor holding the veteran back to 2 9 yards per carry and discombobulated daniel jones a stingy run defense combined with sticky coverage on the back end is a recipe for a smothering unit a defense that forces turnovers and an offense that can generate explosives is a formula for blowout wins colts crumbling amid a fire sale shane steichen s squad played like a crew that knows the season is all but over awful tackling missed reps terrible penalties flubbed catches head scratching passes bad blocking porous coverage you name it the colts messed it up daniel jones continued to struggle missing passes and looking flustered in the pocket the first int wasn t his fault the second certainly was jones has been unable to overcome bad surroundings looking like the quarterback who wore out his welcome in new york jones finished 19 of 28 passing for 144 yards one td and two ints before being replaced by anthony richardson jonathan taylor scampered for 19 yards on his first touch he did little else the rest of the contest earning eight rushes for 23 yards and catching four passes for 24 yards he also fumbled on a trick play it might have been taylor s last game in indy most colts players seemed to play like their time in town could be coming to an end if steichen keeps his job beyond monday morning he ll have to do a much better job preparing and motivating his players next gen stats insight for jaguars colts via nfl pro trevor lawrence generated 15 0 yards per attempt the most in a game in his career much of that production came against zone coverage where he completed seven of nine passes for 167 yards and all three of his touchdowns lawrence was also efficient on play action connecting on four of five attempts for 124 yards and a touchdown nfl research bhayshul tuten is the first jaguars player to rush for 100 plus yards score a rushing touchdown record 50 plus receiving yards and a receiving td in the same game back to top jeremy bergman s takeaways raiders snap losing streak as cousins staves off mendoza klint kubiak gave kirk cousins a vote of confidence early in the week definitively declaring him the starting qb as calls for no 1 pick fernando mendoza increased amid las vegas four game skid consider kubiak and cousins vindicated the only thing that had been working for the raiders worked again on sunday afternoon picking up a leaky sometimes absent defense cousins was efficient and error free completing 19 of 26 passes for 247 yards to just four pass catchers two tight ends one running back one wide receiver after leading just one scoring drive in the first half the raiders offense under cousins was nearly flawless in the final two frames scoring three straight touchdowns out of the half and finding a game sealing field goal at the end of a clock killing drive at the end of the fourth quarter as much as we would all like to see mendoza get some reps just for curiosity s sake it s not prudent for the raiders to move away from kirko chainz as long as he s still moving the chains he s a steadying presence and a rising tide and las vegas gauntlet only gets tougher from here games against san francisco seattle denver and cleveland await before its december bye it s kirk s offense until the wheels call off jets run out of fuel again a running theme of the aaron glenn jets has been their inability to finish plays possessions games awareness of the problem has yet to lead to a remedy sunday s loss to las vegas was the latest example geno smith and the jets came out of the gates on fire reaching at least the raiders 21 yard line on each of their first six drives a run that extended into the third quarter in place of breece hall braelon allen was a force again running for 121 yards in the first half alone gain new york kicked its fourth field goal of the day of under 40 yards the jets had little time to launch a game winning drive after the raiders pushed their lead to five but reached las vegas 35 before smith launched an ill advised interception with seven seconds remaining new york s second half collapse would be more frustrating if it was more out of character but blowing opportunities in the red zone and in the win column is gang green s calling card at this point it doesn t get any easier for the 2 6 jets with the chiefs and bills up next an 11th straight losing season is in sight efficient outing but washington was a much more solid contributor in the lead role than jeanty had been in his previous three games 64 yards on 28 carries jeanty wasn t completely absent from the game however and played a crucial role on las vegas fourth quarter drive to take the lead breaking free for a 45 yard catch and run to flip the field he finished with just 9 rushing yards on two carries season low 22 snaps but jeanty proved once again that he is more useful to this offense in a pass catching role will las vegas solidify these roles in the weeks to come and if so how will the former basically gave up trying to throw under a heavy rain that persisted for most of the contest penix accepted the challenge and promptly failed he couldn t find his targets especially during the first half spraying the ball around but not to his targets far too often he sailed one over drake london s head during atlanta s first drive into jacob parrish s hands but the corner couldn t handle it even which ranked behind only the bills 32 8 entering week 8 but he was a difference maker in the negative sense against tampa bay he finished 8 of 24 for 125 yards and an ugly 12 0 passer rating in a messy game like sunday s was the best thing quarterbacks can do is protect the ball he didn t and he lost miserable conditions lead to slopfest the true victor of sunday s game might have been the elements atlanta and tampa bay spent most of the day just trying to get through a torrential downpour the rain caused errors in every conceivable way there were overthrows botched snaps missed kicks fumbles and all varieties of dropped passes would be touchdowns easy pickups and interceptions there are too many examples to point to but perhaps the most emblematic football folly took place on the bucs second drive after the center quarterback exchange went wrong baker mayfield recovered the ball and improvised magnificently darting into traffic before throwing it backward to bucky irving who streaked toward the end zone and nearly made it there before jessie bates punched the ball out right at the goal line for a touchback by halftime the game had seen more fumbles five and interceptions three than completions two both teams tightened up on ball security out of half and the rain let up some toward the fourth quarter but tampa bay was able to outlast by stacking some successes despite the elements throughout the contest chase mclaughlin was money helping build a lead in the first half by going 3 of 3 on field goals of 46 34 and 42 yards alex anzalone picked off penix twice six plays apart jacob parrish made up for an earlier drop with a second quarter interception and the bucs shut out the falcons offense on third down 0 for 12 for such an ugly ugly day there will actually lead one drive in which he repeatedly converted third downs by barely moving the ball beyond the line to gain showing flashes of what has made him a special quarterback in the post tyreek hill era in
