news_mentions.headline: 2026 NFL season, Week 8: What We Learned from Sunday's games
news_mentions.description: Around The NFL breaks down what you need to know from Sunday's action in Week 8 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 8 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below early window buffalo bills 36 baltimore ravens 10 cincinnati bengals 43 tennessee titans 36 ot arizona cardinals 33 dallas cowboys 30 ot detroit lions 19 minnesota vikings 15 jacksonville jaguars 42 indianapolis colts 7 las vegas raiders 38 new york jets 33 pittsburgh steelers 27 cleveland browns 6 tampa bay buccaneers 16 atlanta falcons 0 late window los angeles rams 24 los angeles chargers 9 denver broncos 28 kansas city chiefs 24 new england patriots 24 miami dolphins 19 sunday night washington commanders 27 philadelphia eagles 10 nick shook s takeaways bills let hunters loose buffalo s biggest underlying question mark was its defense a leaky unit that struggled to get stops and limit opposing offenses in what became weekly shootouts for the bills that finally changed for the better on sunday with lamar jackson exiting quickly and tyler huntley back in the lineup buffalo decided it was time to hunt the quarterback dialing up blitzes and registering pressures on half of huntley s four passes which also incidentally forced huntley out of the game due to injury once undrafted rookie joe fagnano took over the carnivorous bills saw nothing but red meat blitzing on 64 5 of their total defensive snaps logging qb pressures at a rate of 61 3 and short circuiting baltimore s offense all afternoon the ravens finished with just 144 net yards of offense scored their only touchdown via a short field earned by a broderick washington interception and couldn t piece together more than one drive of significance which ended in a 26 yard tyler loop field goal buffalo s defense made sure it wouldn t allow derrick henry to carry the ravens and denied fagnano the space to breathe overwhelming the inexperienced signal caller in a runaway win quarterback injuries decimate ravens lamar jackson s anticipated return lasted just one snap his first pass attempt fell incomplete and on the follow through to his throw jackson s thumb collided with a defender s hand resulting in an injury that will land jackson on injured reserve for the foreseeable future after a few weeks of backup turned starter duty tyler huntley found himself on the field sunday appearing skittish and struggling to gain a single yard through the air before an injury knocked him out of action as well leaving the ravens with their emergency third qb joe fagnano as their only remaining option the uconn product gave his best effort but was constantly under duress leaving the ravens with little room to move the ball all afternoon zay flowers went without a catch on five targets rashod bateman s one catch for 22 yards accounted for the most receiving production for any raven and running back justice hill led baltimore in receptions with four it was a lifeless offense that left the ravens defense on the field for far too long buffalo won the time of possession battle 37 36 to 22 24 and sunday s display should rightfully worry ravens fans about their team s outlook for the remainder of 2026 it sounds as if jackson s season could be finished and recent results without him including sunday are discouraging at best moore delivers in return after missing a handful of weeks buffalo welcomed back its prized offseason acquisition d j moore who showed no signs of hesitancy and delivered a strong outing four catches 82 yards including a spectacular grab for 49 yards to set up a james cook touchdown and a touchdown catch moore s return helped draw some attention away from buffalo s tight ends dalton kincaid finished with a team best 86 yards and a touchdown on four catches took a bit of pressure off cook and unlocked enough of the unit s attack to help the bills climb out of a grind it out start to pour it on in the second half moore s rapport with josh allen remains strong even after the time off and helped allen pass jim kelly for the franchise s all time lead in touchdowns 260 now moore will need to prove he can be this reliable on a weekly basis next gen stats insight for ravens bills via nfl pro the bills blitzed on 64 5 of opposing dropbacks against the ravens in week 8 their highest blitz rate since 2021 and the highest blitz rate ravens quarterbacks have faced this season the bills blitz rate had not exceeded 39 in any of their prior six games this season when blitzing the bills generated 11 pressures including a season high seven quick pressures under 2 5 seconds and three sacks including a strip sack fumble recovery in the second quarter nfl research josh allen and james cook each had a rushing touchdown in week 8 marking the 16th time that allen and cook have scored a rushing touchdown in the same game sixteen games breaks a tie with dak prescott and ezekiel elliott for the most games by any teammate duo in nfl history in which both players had a rushing touchdown back to top bobby kownack s takeaways burrow was everything good bad about bengals offense what a roller coaster performance by joe burrow the cincy quarterback unquestionably served as the team s hero accounting for six touchdowns in an unexpected shootout with the titans but his three interceptions contributed initially to a slow start and later allowed tennessee to stay in it two of those picks were deep heaves to ja 39 marr chase with one way overthrown and another that came up far too short if you re going to make mistakes though make sure you make up for them burrow did that and more piling on the points and feeding his top two receivers to great success tee higgins had 10 catches for 155 yards and two tds on 11 targets while chase tallied 11 receptions for 141 yards and a score on 16 looks burrow also importantly cleaned it up in crunch time of his five drives that took place in the fourth quarter or overtime one ended in a chase brown fumble and the other ticked down the final 17 seconds to the extra frame on the other three burrow marched his bengals 73 81 and 70 yards throwing two touchdowns and scoring the game winner on a 9 yard scramble he finished with 426 yards five tds and three ints on 38 of 48 passing marking his third consecutive game with at least four passing touchdowns it s a bit scary how many points the bengals put up despite four giveaways and that s all credit to burrow standout performances not enough for tennessee there was not an ounce of quit in the titans after trading away their best player defensive tackle jeffery simmons on thursday the defense still generated four takeaways the most it has had in a game this season safety amani hooker had joe burrow s number intercepting him a whopping three times while defensive end jacob martin tallied three sacks and linebacker anthony hill was relentless with 14 tackles on offense cam ward enjoyed by far his best game of the season despite being without carnell tate ward dissected cincinnati s defense with regularity going 26 of 40 for 304 yards and two touchdowns snapping a five game interception streak and nearly doubling his average of 168 4 passing yards per game he led two separate go ahead td drives in the fourth quarter plus tony pollard continued his recent resurgence rushing for 117 yards and two scores after going for 129 and three tds in week 7 his 40 yard touchdown to open the scoring will be one of the highlights of the day in his or any game with pollard breaking multiple tackles before stiff arming one bengals defender into another s path in a keystone cops sequence on the way to pay dirt of course it was still not enough for the 1 7 titans but the fight they showed was admirable regardless of the nfl s aversion to moral victories concerning trends taking shape for bengals the most important result from sunday is the bengals moving to 5 2 in a highly competitive afc north however there are some underlying issues still plaguing cincinnati the bengals found themselves trailing 13 0 for the second straight week this deficit came at the end of the first quarter unlike last week s halftime hole against the ravens and the bengals started picking it up much earlier to go into intermission with a lead but they couldn t pull away like they did in baltimore instead the titans pushed them to overtime taking advantage of a defense that forced a pair of turnovers but couldn t get enough stops to make things easy in the past three games the bengals have needed to outlast a one win titans team in overtime looked asleep for far too long facing backup quarterback tyler huntley and let a then winless dolphins squad make things uncomfortable late before that it was two straight losses those who choose optimism will point to the bengals record and their three game winning streak but venturing through a season as escape artists typically catches up down the line next gen stats insight for titans bengals via nfl pro amani hooker picked off joe burrow three times which included 15 3 expected points added across five targets in coverage the second most coverage epa by a player in a game this season hooker allowed only 12 yards in coverage on the day nfl research joe burrow became just the second quarterback in league history to have 450 plus passing yards five plus passing tds and a rushing td in a game joining norm van brocklin week 1 1951 back to top nick shook s takeaways qb change sparks comeback through nearly three quarters the cardinals were repeating the same frustrating offensive performance that had become all too familiar in recent weeks jacoby brissett was under constant pressure and resorting to throws that amounted to little more than prayers and after watching brissett take two consecutive sacks for double digit negative yardage in the third quarter coach mike lafleur had enough calling for gardner minshew to replace the battered brissett oddly enough the quarterback change coincided with a revival of the running game that depended solely on tyler allgeier after jeremiyah love left with another ankle injury and bam knight was knocked out of action due to a concussion allgeier put the team on his back rushing 11 times for 147 yards and a touchdown and repeatedly turning to the sideline oxygen tank as a means of survival minshew meanwhile created a rhythm in the passing game that the cardinals haven t enjoyed in over a month completing 17 of 23 passes for 188 yards and three touchdowns including a magnificent final touchdown drive that covered 80 yards in eight plays and 1 03 to tie the game and balancing the offense by turning to michael wilson plenty eight catches 111 yards one touchdown arizona pulled off this 23 point outburst and improbable comeback after losing love knight and receiver kendrick bourne maximizing its returns with its remaining contributors with just enough time to escape defeat it will likely prompt a quarterback change and could be a minor springboard forward for a team that was desperate for a morale boosting win like this cowboys collapse could have devastating effect dallas will look back at this game and have no choice but to admit this was its worst loss of 2026 entering the final minute of the third quarter the cowboys were in control holding a 17 3 lead that was all but guaranteed to eventually become 20 3 or larger in that moment though their defense broke down surrendering a rumbling 63 yard touchdown run to tyler allgeier the first of a few massive chunks gained by allgeier in the final 16 minutes of regulation on a 52 yard allgeier run in the fourth quarter safety caleb downs got pancaked by hjalte froholdt twice in the same play typifying arizona s sudden takeover with the image of downs tumbling across the turf like a runaway cheese wheel speeding down a hill this all happened after dallas had suffocated arizona s offense for the first 44 minutes of the game and the cardinals awakening delivered repeated violent blows to the ribcage of the cowboys defense landing a liver punch in the form of a michael wilson dependent touchdown drive to tie the game in the final six seconds of regulation a quick defensive stop and a 44 yard scoring drive in overtime sent the cowboys to the mat for good resulting in one of the most stunning outcomes of the entire nfl season this type of loss can send a team into a spiral could cost defensive coordinator christian parker his job and will undoubtedly cause cowboys fans to angrily punch the air the same problems persist they still can t beat the lowly cardinals in texas and the solutions continue to prove fleeting arizona s rebuilt backfield disintegrates but one pillar remains standing tyler allgeier s second half outburst produced a victory for the cardinals but it was even more triumphant for a workhorse who has often been left to the shadows of more recognizable running mates in atlanta and arizona the talk at the start of the season revolved around first round pick jeremiyah love and when the cardinals couldn t generate consistently on the ground love s absence was quickly blamed allgeier never quite saw the chances he needed to blossom but found himself in an unexpected moment of opportunity sunday when love and bam knight exited due to injury he could have played an average brand of football as the lone remaining runner available but that s not allgeier those who were unfamiliar with his style were reminded rudely on his 63 yard touchdown run in which he broke three tackles and followed a trio of teammates who escorted him to the goal line where he fell across it for a score while finally being brought down that touchdown made it a 17 10 game but more importantly it gave the cardinals reason to believe his ensuing 52 yarder saw hjalte froholdt get out in front and wreck caleb downs in open space setting an aggressive tone embodied by the runner benefitting from the blocking in those two plays and gardner minshew s stint as a mid game replacement the cardinals brought the fight to the cowboys refusing to lay down despite a double digit deficit and little reason to believe they d turn things around because of allgeier s toughness determination and relentless desire to produce when called upon he also caught five passes for 44 yards and an incredibly gritty touchdown reception the cardinals pulled off the stunning win and might have found a new identity in the process next gen stats insight for cardinals cowboys via nfl pro tyler allgeier carried the ball 11 times for 147 yards and a touchdown in week 8 against the cowboys including three explosive gains of 10 or more yards after totaling just two explosive gains across 61 carries over the first seven weeks of the season allgeier recorded a 63 yard touchdown run on arizona s final play from scrimmage in the third quarter before opening the cardinals next drive with a 52 yard scamper he gained 96 rushing yards over expected the most by a cardinals rusher in a game since at least 2018 additionally allgeier finished as the cardinals third leading receiver catching all five targets for 44 yards and a touchdown nfl research the cardinals last second touchdown positioned them to kick a go ahead extra point with 0 06 remaining sunday but chad ryland pushed his attempt wide left entering the cardinals into some exclusive and undesirable company they became the third team to miss a go ahead pat in the final 10 seconds of regulation joining the bengals week 1 2022 and buccaneers week 2 2003 back to top kevin patra s takeaways lions run over undefeated vikings to close gap in nfc north detroit figured out the best way to combat brian flores relentless pressure packages go to the ground after falling behind 15 12 midway through the fourth quarter detroit ran the ball on 11 of its final 13 non kneel plays one of those two jared goff throws was the go ahead touchdown toss to jameson williams detroit leaned on jahmyr gibbs and bruising backup sione vaki gibbs blasted his way to 153 rushing yards and a td on 23 carries while vaki chipped in 11 totes for 65 yards detroit getting production from vaki is a positive sign for the lions down the stretch the lions couldn t get out of their way early with miscues hampering dan campbell s club including some bad penalties goff missed passes early and threw his first interception of the season when williams slipped on a route detroit put up just six points and goff was sacked four times through two quarters then the run game took over allowing the qb to utilize play action and wear down the vikings d it wasn t a perfect game for the home squad but the offense perked up late when needed to close out a big win that bunches the division even closer it was a need to have home game for detroit dan campbell s crew came up clutch in the end vikings offensive struggles continued it was only a matter of time before brian flores defense couldn t carry the day minnesota has been playing on the razor s edge through its first six wins with the defense spearheading wins while the offense was along for the ride against a high powered lions offense flores defense did enough forcing a turnover early field goals and a pivotal late three and out yes the defense ran out of gas against jahmyr gibbs late but kevin o connell s offense needed to do more kyler murray managed the game early but missed too many throws particularly high which led to stalled drives nearly a quarter of murray s 210 yards 24 3 came on a 51 yard bomb to jordan addison the qb missed several other shots right now murray isn t a station to station passer when the big plays don t connect the vikings offense struggles against a lions defense that entered with the worst pass d in the nfl and allowing the most yards murray came up small the vikings generated just 266 yards and 15 first downs going 3 for 10 on third down and 0 for 1 on fourth down isn t winning offense koc needs his offense to find itself at the start of a tough stretch of games right now it s not close detroit s defense stepped up for the second straight week kelvin sheppard s defense has played up a level the defensive line particularly the interior pestered kyler murray alim mcneill led the way with four qb pressures and one sack the secondary did a better job sticking with vikings receivers where we d seen wrs scamper wide open early in the season detroit s secondary at least challenged most plays cornerback d j reed was having his best game including a diving int and a big late pass breakup before leaving with an injury when the defensive line is getting pressure and the secondary plays on a string it s a workable defense the issue sheppard faces now is that he lost a trove of players on sunday star linebacker jack campbell was taken to a local hospital after suffering a neck injury d j wonnum and brian branch each exited with concussions after a collision rookie linebacker jimmy rolder suffered a hamstring injury reed s was a hip can an already shaky unit overcome injuries moving forward next gen stats insight for lions vikings via nfl pro the vikings blitzed on 26 of 29 dropbacks 89 7 in their week 8 loss against the lions the highest blitz rate by a team since at least 2018 breaking the previous record held by the vikings set last week against the colts 85 2 when blitzed jared goff completed 17 passes tied for the most against the blitz in a game this season for 130 yards a touchdown and an interception goff was sacked a season high three times on six pressures when blitzed nfl research jahmyr gibbs became the fifth player in nfl history prior to age 25 to have at least 1 000 scrimmage yards and 10 plus touchdowns in their team s first seven games of a season joining christian mccaffrey 2019 edgerrin james 2000 eric dickerson 1983 and jim brown 1958 back to top kevin patra s takeaways jags stampede floundering colts good teams don t just beat bad ones they take their soul jacksonville is a good team liam coen s squad walloped its division rival in every facet from the start the jaguars blasted news_mentions.headline: Patriots rule out A.J. Brown (ankle/knee), TreVeyon Henderson (illness) for Sunday vs. Dolphins
news_mentions.description: Not long after he returned from injured reserve, the New England Patriots will again be without wide receiver A.J. Brown on Sunday. Brown has been downgraded to out for New England's game against the Miami Dolphins, the team announced Saturday.
news_mentions.body_text: not long after he returned from injured reserve the new england patriots will again be without wide receiver a j brown on sunday brown has been downgraded to out for new england s game against the miami dolphins the team announced saturday the 29 year old wideout missed four games previously with a high ankle sprain and although the ankle ailment is still included on the injury report the reason brown missed the past two days of practices was due to a knee issue flaring up according to nfl network insider ian rapoport brown received a questionable designation on friday but it was determined on saturday that he d be unable to go meaning he ll have appeared in three of new england s first eight games after coming to foxborough via offseason trade from the philadelphia eagles running back treveyon henderson illness and offensive tackle marcus bryant who practiced in full all week with an ankle injury were also both ruled out brown s tenure in new england has not at all gotten off to the start so many had hoped for he s caught only three passes in each of his three games bringing his tally nearing the midway point of the season to nine receptions for 101 yards his speed and movement looked to still be somewhat affected by his high ankle sprain the past two weeks as he s averaged 8 3 yards per reception since returning a far cry from his career average of 15 3 yards per catch with romeo doubs new england s other big offseason acquisition at wr on injured reserve drake maye will need to turn to demario douglas efton chism and kyle williams a heavy dose of rhamondre stevenson can also be expected in henderson s absence plus a mixing in of corey kiner the pats are banged up but they face an exploitable miami defense that ranks 25th in points allowed it s important they still find ways to capitalize and win they re coming off a loss and sitting at 4 3 want to avoid falling any farther behind the afc east leading buffalo bills 5 1 new england squares off against miami at 4 25 p m et on sunday

news_mentions.headline: AFC East training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Bills, Dolphins, Jets, Patriots
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Jeremy Bergman breaks down the top AFC East training camp storylines to monitor for the Buffalo Bills, Miami Dolphins, New England Patriots and New York Jets.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams jeremy bergman has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the buffalo bills miami dolphins new england patriots and new york jets catch up on each afc east team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below buffalo bills miami dolphins new england patriots new york jets three key storylines 1 new era in buffalo for a bills roster that is returning most of its 2025 starters the biggest change this summer will be at the top the start of the joe brady era in buffalo gets underway in earnest when training camp kicks off in late july in taking over for sean mcdermott a sturdy leader who oversaw buffalo s longest period of sustained success since the great marv levy was at the helm brady has a lot to live up to the 36 year old first time head coach was elevated to improve on mcdermott s performance and lift buffalo over the hump and into the super bowl a january title game can t be won in august but the foundation of such an achievement can be built in the summer as it is for all champions brady s job starts and ends with accentuating what josh allen does best freeing up the qb to take further control of the offense the defense mcdermott s specialty has been handed off to ex nfl safety jim leonhard who coached the broncos star dbs over the past couple seasons no team with a new head coach is better positioned to win in 2026 than the bills who made it to the divisional round in 25 brady s first camp must set that tone 2 chubb chasing big season as one of buffalo s only notable offseason additions bradley chubb meets the bills at a critical time for both the team and the player chubb is coming off a solid comeback season from his torn acl logging 8 5 sacks for the dolphins in 2025 and playing a full slate of games for the first time since his rookie campaign the bills are in dire need of a pass rusher after gregory rousseau led the team with just seven sacks last year and joey bosa appears closer to retirement than returning entering the fray alongside second round pick t j parker chubb will be tasked with captaining a front seven that struggled to frustrate trevor lawrence and bo nix in the 2025 postseason chubb 30 has expressed that he s never been hungrier buffalo is starving for a true game wrecker off the edge 3 moore enough or more required the bills have missed stefon diggs draftees khalil shakir and keon coleman and free agent additions josh palmer and brandin cooks haven t quite filled his vacancy over the past couple years buffalo s trade for dj moore is meant to do just that reuniting with brady his ex panthers oc moore has an opportunity to be wr1 for josh allen in buffalo in a way he simply wasn t for caleb williams in chicago in 2025 the seeds of their hopefully fruitful partnership will be sowed in july and august moore admitted to growing pains in the spring but expects perfection this fall after the offseason long onboarding process in addition to providing a sure handed outlet for allen moore will be looked at to bring along the embattled coleman who got called out by owner terry pegula in january and has been under a microscope since if moore can bring coleman along and elevate a middling bills wr room then brady s first year returns could be big back to top three key storylines 1 first look at miami s offensive overhaul tua tagovailoa tyreek hill and jaylen waddle are out malik willis is in while de 39 von achane re upped for the long haul who else will fill out the dolphins offensive roster malik washington returns as a solid pass catching option joined by tutu atwell jalen tolbert terrace marshall and jalen reagor all looking to break out after sidekick roles in nfc receiving rooms imported from the collegiate ranks are chris bell kevin coleman and caleb douglas it s a who s who of who s that in miami s wr corps but somebody s gotta catch passes from willis ahead of what is expected to be a rebuilding year in south florida all eyes at least in the fantasy world will be on the fins wideouts in camp to see who swims and who flounders 2 leaders from the pack how will green bay south look in the heat of a miami summer we re about to find out jeff hafley and jon eric sullivan s first training camp with the dolphins after years with the packers provides the first time nfl head coach and general manager an opportunity to put their imprint on the team green bay camps are typically jovial affairs with oversized players riding undersized bikes alongside community members miami camps held outside one of america s biggest cities have a different feel last year s dolphins camp for one portended the subpar season miami was about to embark on as mike mcdaniel s roster was overwhelmed in joint practices and hampered by the injury bug if hafley and sullivan can avoid that sluggish start they will have already re calibrated the doomish vibes that preceded the 2025 season 3 we re talking about willis from entering the league as a third round pick to signing a three year 67 5 million deal with his third nfl team in four years malik willis is rewriting his nfl story on the fly the quarterback embarks on his first full season as a starter this summer in south beach after shining in a pair of breakout performances in place of jordan love both losses last year in green bay the three year contract implies that he is the qb of the present and immediate future in miami but nothing is assured in this league willis is being thrown into a less than advantageous position quarterbacking a rebuilding roster under a rookie head coach quinn ewers a second year backup with collegiate pedigree and three nfl starts to his name waits in the wings if things go south in south florida and the dolphins slump into top five draft positioning how secure will willis place in miami s future be a standout 2027 qb draft class could be staring sullivan in the face all that is to say willis isn t a made man yet and his first summer as a starter will be a critical one toward establishing himself as a long term answer in miami or elsewhere back to top three key storylines 1 patriots upgraded weaponry after months of rumors and rumblings new england finally completed its trade for disgruntled eagles wideout a j brown in june as the move had been predetermined for months so open a secret that it was never a secret brown wasted no time establishing chemistry with mvp runner up drake maye at minicamp brown has found himself in heaven in new england but how will the other patriots wideouts feel before brown was acquired to provide maye a true wr1 romeo doubs was the big ticket offensive acquisition of the offseason now slotted in as the no 2 doubs should find himself in a role similar to the one he played in green bay thriving on occasion down the roster new england still has mack hollins demario douglas and kayshon boutte for now but it will be interesting to see if kyle williams can break out in his second year since his third round selection the wazzu product caught just 10 passes in his rookie season but found the end zone thrice if williams can step up in training camp ahead of year 2 maye and the reigning afc champs could be in prime position to repeat 2 questions with two defenders ahead of training camp there remain two unsettled availability situations that need monitoring in foxborough the first is that of star cornerback christian gonzalez who s due for a major contract extension after his first pro bowl season gonzalez said during spring work that he wishes to be in new england for the long haul but for a cb of his caliber that means a top of the market deal worth 30 million plus per season something new england may be loath to offer before it has to gonzalez skipped voluntary sessions but showed up for mandatory minicamp what will his strategy be if he doesn t have a deal done by late july gabe jacas meanwhile hasn t practiced with the team since being drafted in the second round the no 55 overall pick remains unsigned and has been away from the club after undergoing an offseason medical procedure about which the pats have provided few details jacas for whom new england traded up in april s draft is behind heading into summer camp which isn t a good sign for the pats pass rusher depth we ll see if the rookie comes into camp signed and ready to break into the starting 11 3 will super bowl loss off field distractions linger the off field story of the offseason has mostly faded out of circulation but questions remain about how new england will bounce back from some messy months to start 2026 the april publication of photos showing patriots coach mike vrabel and former athletic reporter dianna russini at an arizona resort ignited a months long maelstrom of unwanted press in foxborough vrabel took off day 3 of the nfl draft to begin counseling but he was present throughout spring workouts the coach s players have defended him and the team s offseason program seemingly has gone off without a hitch that doesn t mean that when things ramp up in the summer with more coverage and eyeballs further scrutiny of vrabel won t creep in in addition to dealing with the fallout from the photos the pats are looking to recover from a humiliating super bowl defeat and avoid the fate of many a title game loser missing the ensuing postseason ahead of the kickoff game against their super bowl lx foes in seattle vrabel and the pats will be put through the media wringer again how will they respond back to top three key storylines 1 is defense better vetted i m not sure if you heard but the jets defense had zero interceptions last year zilch nada nil over 17 whole games the historic feat and a 31st ranked scoring d inspired general manager darren mougey to totally remake the defense during the offseason new york has since stockpiled veterans familiar jet draftee demario davis jersey native minkah fitzpatrick and fresh t 39 vondre sweat david onyemata joseph ossai nahshon wright add on two top rookies no 2 pick david bailey national champ d angelo ponds and the jets are projected to have upwards of eight new defensive starters in 26 the leadership of davis fitzpatrick and returning dl harrison phillips should provide a foundation that was sorely lacking from aaron glenn s first unit but camp will bear out whether the new look group with a first time dc in brian duker has a chance to keep new york in games this season or at the very least take the ball away 2 the return of the geno gang green s latest qb makeover reunites geno smith with the team that drafted him in the 2013 second round a few so so years and a broken jaw ended his initial jets run but the signal caller now 35 is back in florham park with more years under his belt ready to rewrite his narrative surrounding him is the most talented crop of playmakers new york has had in years garrett wilson and breece hall anchor the returning skill players while adonai mitchell and rookies kenyon sadiq and omar cooper get their first full seasons with the jets a steady o line is returning four of five starters dylan parham is set to replace left guard john simpson frank reich is in for the ousted tanner engstrand as offensive coordinator bringing a veteran presence with a track record of coaching a super bowl winning offense in philadelphia how quickly can the jets jell into a more potent attack their summer sessions will provide the first glimpse one thing to monitor smith is reportedly under investigation for battery in florida the qb has yet to comment on the matter 3 jets in five in the streets of manhattan millions of fans rejoiced after the knicks half century long title drought was broken in thrilling fashion in the nba finals the throng of excitement unleashed a positive unifying energy not seen around new york sports in quite some time roughly 35 miles west in florham park new jersey the jets are going through their own drought of sorts fifteen years without postseason football twenty three seasons with no division title fifty seven campaigns sans a super bowl title breece hall who witnessed the game 5 title securing victory was among jets players this spring who expressed positive jealousy over the knicks fortune aaron glenn said he wishes to replicate mike brown s clutch players competitive stamina with his guys will the summer of love continue across the hudson is curse breaking contagious camp may offer clues back to top

material_news_signals.headline: Patriots rule out A.J. Brown (ankle/knee), TreVeyon Henderson (illness) for Sunday vs. Dolphins
material_news_signals.description: Not long after he returned from injured reserve, the New England Patriots will again be without wide receiver A.J. Brown on Sunday. Brown has been downgraded to out for New England's game against the Miami Dolphins, the team announced Saturday.
material_news_signals.body_text: not long after he returned from injured reserve the new england patriots will again be without wide receiver a j brown on sunday brown has been downgraded to out for new england s game against the miami dolphins the team announced saturday the 29 year old wideout missed four games previously with a high ankle sprain and although the ankle ailment is still included on the injury report the reason brown missed the past two days of practices was due to a knee issue flaring up according to nfl network insider ian rapoport brown received a questionable designation on friday but it was determined on saturday that he d be unable to go meaning he ll have appeared in three of new england s first eight games after coming to foxborough via offseason trade from the philadelphia eagles running back treveyon henderson illness and offensive tackle marcus bryant who practiced in full all week with an ankle injury were also both ruled out brown s tenure in new england has not at all gotten off to the start so many had hoped for he s caught only three passes in each of his three games bringing his tally nearing the midway point of the season to nine receptions for 101 yards his speed and movement looked to still be somewhat affected by his high ankle sprain the past two weeks as he s averaged 8 3 yards per reception since returning a far cry from his career average of 15 3 yards per catch with romeo doubs new england s other big offseason acquisition at wr on injured reserve drake maye will need to turn to demario douglas efton chism and kyle williams a heavy dose of rhamondre stevenson can also be expected in henderson s absence plus a mixing in of corey kiner the pats are banged up but they face an exploitable miami defense that ranks 25th in points allowed it s important they still find ways to capitalize and win they re coming off a loss and sitting at 4 3 want to avoid falling any farther behind the afc east leading buffalo bills 5 1 new england squares off against miami at 4 25 p m et on sunday

news_mentions.headline: Wu-Tang Clan to headline Thanksgiving halftime show for Bears-Lions game at Ford Field
news_mentions.description: The Lions announced that the 87th annual Thanksgiving Day Classic on Thurs., Nov. 26 against the Bears will feature Wu-Tang Clan as headliner of the Thanksgiving Halftime Show powered by Verizon.
news_mentions.body_text: the detroit lions announced today that the 87th annual thanksgiving day classic on thursday nov 26 against the chicago bears will feature wu tang clan as headliner of the thanksgiving halftime show powered by verizon film television and broadway actor and recording artist antonio cipriano will perform the national anthem this marks the second year of a multi year partnership where global rap icon eminem and his long time manager and president of shady records paul rosenberg will serve as executive producers of the show and select the talent the detroit lions thanksgiving day classic presented by ford will be nationally televised on cbs at 1 p m et our thanksgiving day classic is one of the greatest traditions in sports and wu tang clan is one of the greatest performers in music said rich haddad detroit lions president and ceo we are thrilled to have wu tang headlining our thanksgiving halftime show and grateful to marshall and paul for their partnership the lions thanksgiving day classic halftime show performance arrives as wu tang clan wraps its global farewell tour wu tang forever the final chamber and on the heels of the group being inducted into the rock roll hall of fame wu tang clan has released eight group albums three of them quadruple platinum releases and the collective s full catalog including solo projects spans more than 85 full length releases beyond music the members have built a cultural empire that includes clothing lines videogames books and film and television work wu tang clan has toured as a unit since its debut in 1993 founded on staten island new york in the early 1990s wu tang clan is rza gza method man raekwon ghostface killah u god masta killa inspectah deck cappadonna and the late ol dirty bastard odb we often like to do things that are both exciting and unexpected a wu tang clan thanksgiving performance in detroit certainly fits that description said paul rosenberg president of shady records both eminem and myself have been wu fans since the early 90 s along with a whole generation of detroit football fans and we are honored to bring them to this year s stage cipriano a grosse pointe woods mi native can currently be seen playing john logan in the amazon prime hit series off campus on stage he appeared on broadway at the broadhurst theatre in jagged little pill as phoenix cipriano won the 2017 sutton foster ovation award for best high school theater actor and was a finalist in the 2017 nhsmta jimmy awards his newly released single babydoll with singer jamie miller just hit 1 on the uk singles charts
